### [1] [VAR-Q: Tuning-free KV Cache Quantization for Visual Autoregressive Image and Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05380)
*Boxun Xu,Jiaji Lu,Yuxuan Yin,Zihu Wang,Ziyue Liu,Yu Wang,Zirui Liu,Peng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 分析视觉自回归生成（下一尺度/下一帧预测）KV cache 的异常值结构，提出免调优的分块分组 KV 量化框架 VAR-Q，KV 内存降低最多 78.5%，质量几乎无损，支持 6 倍批大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉自回归生成的 KV cache 采用块级解码，统计特性与语言模型不同；视觉 token 数量庞大导致 KV 内存超过权重，成为大规模部署瓶颈。现有 LLM KV 量化方法依赖异常值检测与校准，不适配该场景。

Method: 先做机制分析：(1) 少数巨值通道（outlier channels）承载功能负载，消融即崩溃，而等量内点通道消融无影响；(2) 异常值沿特征与块两轴组织，每 cell 内幅值稳定、跨 cell 漂移；(3) 该结构源于投影偏置与 RoPE 诱导的散射两种独立机制。据此提出 VAR-Q：沿同样两轴分组，利用生成循环天然提供的块边界，免异常值检测与校准；配合 bit-packing 内核实现运行时内存压缩。

Result: 在覆盖两种范式的 9 个模型上实现低比特量化，KV 内存最多降低 78.5%，质量退化可忽略，推理批大小提升 6 倍。

Conclusion: 视觉自回归 KV cache 的异常值具有可预测的双轴结构化特征，可被架构先验直接利用；免调优的分组量化即可在不损质量的前提下大幅压缩 KV 内存并提升吞吐。

Abstract: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Third, this structure arises from two independent mechanisms: projection bias and RoPE-induced scattering. Guided by these findings, we propose VAR-Q, a tuning-free KV-cache quantization framework that groups along the same two axes. The generation loop provides block boundaries for free, removing the need for outlier detection or calibration. Paired with bit-packing kernels for runtime memory reduction, VAR-Q delivers low-bit quantization across nine models spanning both paradigms, cutting KV memory by up to 78.5% with negligible quality degradation and enabling 6x larger inference batches.

</details>


### [2] [Visual Forensic Detection of Fabricated Bangla News Photocards using Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05403)
*Anindya Kundu,Kabya Mithun Saha,Md. Muhaiminul Islam,Fayek Ahmed,Aminul Kader Bulbul,Muhammad Ibrahim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将孟加拉语"photo card"式虚假新闻检测重构为视觉图像伪造检测，构建1,077条伪造+969条真实的数据集（经16种变换扩充至32,736样本），采用去泄漏的分组五折交叉验证。紧凑四块全批归一化CNN（489,954参数）从零训练达87.45%±0.53%，分类头热启动达88.75%±1.55%，ImageNet预训练YOLOv8n-cls（1.44M参数）达97.36%±0.42%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语虚假信息以photocard形式传播，误导信息存在于像素而非可读文本中，文本类事实核查工具无法识别；同时扁平化图像的ANN仅约52%准确率、损失卡在ln2≈0.693，说明必须保留空间线索并转向视觉伪造检测范式。

Method: 数据来自公共Facebook页面：真实卡片取自17家国有电视台的认证页面，伪造卡片取自伪广播者页面、匿名账号与公共群组；每图做16种光度与形态学变换扩充。对比ANN、全批归一化四块CNN（从零训练与ANN分类头热启动）以及ImageNet预训练的YOLOv8n-cls；采用无泄漏分层分组五折交叉验证，确保同一卡片的全部增强版本落在同一折。

Result: ANN约52%（损失停滞于ln2≈0.693）；紧凑CNN从零训练87.45%±0.53%，热启动88.75%±1.55%；YOLOv8n-cls（1.44M参数）97.36%±0.42%。报告各类别precision/recall/F1与汇总混淆矩阵，诊断并修复了未归一化分类头导致的单类坍缩；人工错误分析与偏差-方差诊断显示紧凑CNN处于欠拟合状态。

Conclusion: 像素级空间线索对photocard伪造检测至关重要，扁平化会破坏判别信息；紧凑CNN可作为轻量基线，但与预训练骨干间存在显著性能余量（约10个百分点），主要源于欠拟合，提示需要更强特征学习或迁移学习。

Abstract: In Bangladesh, much localized misinformation spreads as photocards: single-image news summaries that imitate the branding of well-known news organizations. Because the misleading message lives in the pixels rather than in machine-readable text, text-based fact-checking tools cannot see it. We recast photocard fake-news detection as visual image forgery detection. We build a dataset of 969 authentic and 1,077 fabricated Bangla photocards scraped from public Facebook pages: authentic cards from the verified pages of seventeen national television broadcasters, fabricated ones from pseudo-broadcaster pages, anonymous profiles, and public groups. Sixteen photometric and morphological transformations per image grow the corpus to 32,736 samples. A fully connected ANN reaches only about 52% accuracy, its loss stuck at ln(2) ~ 0.693, showing that flattening the image destroys the spatial cues forgery detection needs. A compact, fully batch-normalized four-block CNN with 489,954 parameters, about 1,644x smaller than the ANN, is evaluated with leakage-free stratified group five-fold cross-validation, which keeps every augmented version of a card in one fold. Under this protocol the CNN reaches 87.45% +/- 0.53% pooled accuracy from scratch and 88.75% +/- 1.55% when its classifier head is warm-started from the ANN. An ImageNet-pretrained YOLOv8n-cls backbone (1.44M parameters) fine-tuned on the same folds reaches 97.36% +/- 0.42%, marking the headroom above the compact model. We report per-class precision, recall, F1, and pooled confusion matrices, diagnose and fix a one-class collapse caused by an unnormalized classifier head, and give a manual error analysis and bias-variance diagnosis showing that the compact CNNs under-fit.

</details>


### [3] [mmHand: Toward Pixel-Level-Accuracy Hand Localization Using a Single Commodity mmWave Device](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05404)
*Xiaoyu Zhang,Zhengxiong Li,Chenhan Xu,Luchuan Song,Huining Li,Hongfei Xue,Yingxiao Wu,Wenyao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: mmHand：一种基于单商用毫米波设备的无设备、保护隐私的动态手部定位系统，通过mmImage生成、二维图像化表示与跨模态空间特征增强模型实现像素级手部定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手部定位应用广泛，但受数据模态限制：视觉方法存在隐私问题，可穿戴方法影响舒适性，因此需要一种无设备、隐私友好的高精度方案。

Method: 提出mmImage生成工具，从原始毫米波数据中充分提取空间信息并构造新的二维图像格式表示；设计含新的质量评估方法与针对毫米波数据的像素空间标注框架；构建具备强空间特征提取能力的跨模态空间特征增强模型，在毫米波雷达U-V像素坐标系下实现像素级手部定位。

Result: 在三种场景、12名受试者上开展实验，四项指标结果验证了系统的有效性。

Conclusion: mmHand以单商用毫米波设备实现无设备、保护隐私、像素级精度的动态手部定位，验证了毫米波图像化表示与跨模态特征增强的有效性。

Abstract: The hand localization problem has been a longstanding focus due to its many applications. The task involves modeling the hand as a singular point and determining its position within a defined coordinate system. However, due to data modality limitations, existing hand localization technologies face several challenges. For example, vision-based localization raises privacy concerns, while wearable-based methods compromise user comfort. In this paper, we introduce mmHand, a new device-free, privacy-preserving dynamic hand localization system with pixel-level accuracy, using a single commodity mmWave device. We first propose a mmImage generation tool to fully extract spatial information from raw mmWave data and introduce a novel 2D image-format representation of mmWave data. Next, we design a framework that provides a new quality evaluation method and pixel space labeling for the mmWave data. Finally, we present a cross-modality spatial feature-enhanced model with high spatial feature extraction capabilities, which can accurately localize hand positions at the pixel level in the mmWave radar U-V pixel coordinate system. We evaluate the system with experiments on 12 subjects in three scenarios, and the results across four metrics demonstrate the effectiveness of our hand localization system.

</details>


### [4] [When Does Sharing Work? Scaling a Shared SigLIP2 Across Image, Video, Audio, and Audio-Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05406)
*Xiaofei Sun,Peng Wang,Huayao Liu,Xiaoxiao Xu,Jun Song,Deqing Li,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Omni-Encoder，在单个共享参数的 SigLIP-2 ViT 中统一处理图像、视频、音频与视听输入，实现端到端联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对比预训练中图像、视频、音频编码器各自独立训练，跨模态对齐主要依赖"事后绑定"到一个冻结的锚点空间，参数不共享、优化不联合。

Method: 1) 模态原生输入层：将各信号映射至共享嵌入空间，其中 1D 卷积音频 tokenizer 将 mel 频谱转为与视觉 patch 对齐的 token；2) 多模态旋转位置编码（RoPE），以绝对时间戳为参数，将视觉帧与音频片段置于统一时空坐标系；3) 交替模态训练：交错排列图像、视频、音频、时间对齐视听批次，梯度累积为单次更新。

Result: 单一共享参数集在四类模态的 16 个基准上取得有竞争力结果；联合训练下各模态均优于其单独训练的对应版本。

Conclusion: 参数完全共享的单 ViT 多模态编码器可行且有效，交替模态训练是稳定联合优化的关键；代码与模型将公开。

Abstract: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. A multimodal rotary position embedding parameterized by absolute timestamps then places visual frames and audio segments in a unified spatiotemporal coordinate system. Finally, alternating-modality training interleaves image, video, audio, and temporally aligned audio-visual batches and accumulates their gradients into one update, which we find central to stable joint optimization. Omni-Encoder achieves competitive results on 16 benchmarks across all four modalities with one shared parameter set, and joint training improves each modality over its separately trained counterpart. Code and models will be publicly released.

</details>


### [5] [PEEK: One-Step-Look-Ahead Exposure Bias Correction for Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05407)
*Yunwei Bai,Ying Kiat Tan,Tsuhan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练-free的确定性采样器插件PEEK，通过look-ahead评估与插值缓解扩散模型采样中的暴露偏差，在8个模型上一致提升FID（最高49.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散生成质量受限于去噪网络与数值采样器之间的"训练-测试差距"（暴露偏差）：采样时去噪器的输入与真实数据分布差异大，导致生成图像模糊、细节缺失或形态失真。

Method: PEEK为无需训练的确定性采样插件。在每个符合条件的去噪步：①执行一步临时更新；②在look-ahead状态上再评估一次去噪器；③将look-ahead预测与"再后一步"的预测插值，形成下一噪声状态，从而获得更接近真实图像的高信噪状态预测。插值位置通过搜索优化，并借助prefix缓存与baseline噪声调度重基准缓存提升搜索效率。

Result: 在8个像素空间与隐空间扩散模型上（无条件、标签引导、文本引导，多分辨率），PEEK在NFE匹配条件下持续优于基线，FID最高改善49.3%，额外计算开销极小（每模型一次性标定≤2.2分钟）。

Conclusion: 通过额外的look-ahead去噪评估与自适应插值调度，可在几乎不增加计算成本的前提下有效缓解暴露偏差，提升现有确定性采样器的生成质量，具良好通用性。

Abstract: Diffusion image generators are successful due to accurate denoising networks and strong numerical samplers. Yet the two components are not fully matched. During sampling, the denoiser predicts for the next step based on flawed input that differ much from the real data. This train-test gap, or exposure bias, caps image generation quality (i.e., blurry, lacking in details or awkward in shape). To mitigate the problem, we propose PEEK, a novel training-free deterministic sampler plugin. At each eligible denoising step, PEEK first performs a provisional one-step update, evaluates the denoiser once at the look-ahead state, and interpolates it with the one-step-later prediction to form the next noisy state. By taking the additional step, we obtain a generally more-image-like prediction from the higher-signal noisy state, mitigating the exposure bias. To optimize the interpolation positions, PEEK searches for an interpolation schedule search made efficient by the prefix and baseline noise-schedule-rebasing caches. On 8 pixel-space and latent-space diffusion models with unconditional, label-guided, and text-guided settings across various output resolutions, PEEK consistently improves over NFE-matched baselines, with FID improvements up to 49.3\% at minimal extra computation cost (e.g., the one-time-per-model calibration takes at most 2.2 minutes across our experiments.). Project website is at https://dachengruoque.github.io/PEEK-Video/.

</details>


### [6] [Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation for Low-textured Scientific Sketch Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05408)
*Zhiqiang Wang,Sheri L. Barton,Jennifer H. Johnson,Yi He,Xingquan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ART（Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation），将数据增强选择建模为多臂老虎机问题，用奖励引导自适应构建视图库，再对预训练模型做自监督微调，以提升低纹理素描图像的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低纹理素描图像缺少现代深度模型可依赖的表面纹理与视觉变化，且素描对旋转、翻转、缩放、拉伸等变换高度敏感——部分变换保持结构完整性，部分则引入畸变损害表征学习，因此随机选择增强并不理想。

Method: 将增强变换视为多臂老虎机的臂，通过奖励持续评估各变换的有效性，在自监督微调前自适应构建奖励引导的视图库（view bank）；随后的表征损失不回传至ART，即增强选择与表征学习解耦。

Result: 在Mote Marine Laboratory的佛罗里达海牛素描数据上，变换疤痕检索平均Top-1准确率达71.40%（随机增强为68.83%）；位置感知素描检索为55.84%（冻结CLIP为18.18%）。

Conclusion: 奖励引导的增强选择优于随机增强，并显著超越冻结CLIP基线，表明面向素描敏感的变换进行自适应选择是提升低纹理图像检索表征学习的有效途径。

Abstract: Low-textured sketch images are widely used in scientific applications, including wildlife conservation, archaeological illustration, and forensic composites. Learning from and retrieving such images is challenging because they lack detailed surface textures and visual variations commonly exploited by modern deep learning models. This paper proposes Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation (ART) to fine-tune pretrained models to learn effective representations for accurate sketch image retrieval. Our key observation is that sketches are particularly sensitive to image transformations, such as rotation, flipping, zooming, and stretching. While some transformations preserve their structural integrity, others may introduce distortions that hinder representation learning. Instead of randomly choosing transformations to construct fine-tuning views, ART formulates augmentation selection as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem, where transformations are treated as arms and their effectiveness is continuously evaluated through rewards. This enables ART to adaptively construct reward-guided view banks before self-supervised fine-tuning; the subsequent representation loss does not feed back to ART. On Florida manatee sketches provided by Mote Marine Laboratory, ART achieves 71.40% average Top-1 accuracy for transformed-scar retrieval, compared with 68.83% for random augmentation selection, and 55.84% for location-aware sketch retrieval, compared with 18.18% for frozen CLIP.

</details>


### [7] [PointNDF: Cascaded Neural Displacement Fields for Point Cloud Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05411)
*Michael Y. Wang,Pingping Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PointNDF 点云去噪框架，用点块级几何上下文引导局部位移预测，通过神经位移场与级联细化实现更均匀的点分布与更优几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两阶段式学习方法先提取逐点特征、再用简单回归预测逐点位移，缺乏鲁棒的特征引导与分布感知的几何细化，难以同时保持点均匀性与几何质量。

Method: 采用 PTv3 编码器将多尺度几何信息聚合为全局点块描述子；不再直接回归无约束位移向量，而由神经位移场（NDF）融合全局点块描述子与逐点邻域特征，并通过有界向量分支与尺度因子分支预测位移；三个级联 NDF 阶段传播局部特征并渐进细化点位置。

Result: 在 PU-Net 与 ModelNet10 上取得有竞争力的去噪精度与良好的推理效率，点分布更均匀。

Conclusion: 将点块级几何上下文与局部位移预测相结合、并以有界位移场替代无约束回归，是提升点云去噪均匀性与几何质量的有效途径；代码已开源。

Abstract: Point cloud denoising aims to recover clean geometry from noisy 3D observations while preserving both fine surface details and the underlying spatial distribution of the points. Many learning-based methods adopt a two-stage pipeline that first extracts point-wise features from the noisy input and subsequently predicts point-wise displacements via simple regressions. However, these approaches often lack robust feature guidance and distribution-aware geometric refinement, causing them to fail at maintaining optimal point uniformity and geometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose PointNDF, a denoising framework that combines patch-level geometric context with local displacement prediction. Specifically, a Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) encoder aggregates multiscale geometric information into a global patch descriptor. Rather than directly regressing an unconstrained displacement vector, a Neural Displacement Field (NDF) fuses this global patch descriptor with per-point neighborhood features. It then predicts each displacement through bounded-vector and scale factor branches, thereby achieving a superior, more uniform point distribution. Three cascaded NDF stages propagate local features and progressively refine the point positions. Experiments on PU-Net and ModelNet10 demonstrate competitive denoising accuracy and favorable inference efficiency. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/peridous/PointNDF.

</details>


### [8] [SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05443)
*Saurabh Koju,Love Panta,Deepak Thapa,Rudra P. K. Poudel,Prajwal Ghimire,Angus Watson,Yash Raj Shrestha,Prashnna Kumar Gyawali,Binod Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出多步动作学习框架，从无标注手术视频中学习上下文不变的潜在动作，并验证其可跨手术上下文迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术世界模型有望提供术中引导、无风险训练并迁移专家操作技能，但相关研究有限；现有方法依赖真实运动学动作或特定任务的专家标注，适用任务范围窄；而自然领域的“仅从无标注视频学习潜在动作并跨上下文迁移”范式对手术域而言是“短视”的，无法捕捉手术过程的分层性与目标导向结构。

Method: 提出一种新颖的多步动作学习框架（multi-step action learning framework），用于学习上下文不变的潜在动作（context-invariant latent actions），使其易于跨不同手术上下文迁移；不依赖真实运动学或专家标注。

Result: 在公开数据集 SurgToolLoc-2022 与 PitVis-2023 上进行大量实验，并通过定量指标与外科专家定性评估共同验证方法有效性；代码与实现细节已开源。

Conclusion: 面向手术域，具备分层与目标导向结构的潜在动作可有效从无标注视频中习得并跨上下文迁移，为手术世界模型中的专家技能迁移提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. We observe that this paradigm is short-sighted for the surgical domain, failing to capture the hierarchical and goal-directed structure of surgical procedures. Thus, we propose a novel multi-step action learning framework to learn context-invariant latent actions that are easily transferable across various surgical contexts. *Matteo Ballegeer,Dries F. Benoit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SO3brep：在B-rep面邻接图上构建SO(3)-等变图神经网络，通过Wigner D矩阵与Clebsch-Gordan张量积保持面间相对朝向，实现SE(3)不变且旋转鲁棒，参数量最少而在5个基准上精度最高。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Across three face-segmentation and two classification benchmarks with randomly rotated test parts, SO3brep achieves the highest accuracy among the compared B-rep networks and equivariant point cloud networks, with the fewest parameters. Its advantage is largest with few labeled parts, a setting typical of industrial CAD. Code is available at https://github.com/UGent-CVAMO/so3brep.

</details>

TL;DR: FlowShift 是一个参数高效的后训练框架，将预训练的离散 UMM 转换为连续 rectified-flow 生成器，通过连续潜变量投影替换离散视觉接口、对注意力层施加 LoRA，并用双目标速度向量蒸馏（DOVD）对齐高保真连续教师与真值连续轨迹，从而在保持多模态理解能力的同时大幅提升生成保真度。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散 tokenization 在统一多模态模型（UMM）中虽带来强语义推理能力，却形成严格的量化瓶颈，损害细粒度视觉细节，导致生成图像结构正确但伪影严重。作者希望在保留骨干语义先验的前提下突破该瓶颈，而非直接丢弃预训练能力。

Conclusion: FlowShift 表明可通过后训练方式将离散 UMM 低成本转换为连续 rectified-flow 生成器，在实现高保真连续生成的同时不牺牲预训练获得的语义 grounding，兼顾感知质量、提示遵循与推理能力。

Abstract: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning. When applied to leading discrete UMMs, FlowShift significantly improves COCO-30K FID and aesthetic scores, while retaining over 99.5% of multimodal understanding capabilities. Ablations confirm DOVD drives generation quality. Ultimately, FlowShift achieves high-fidelity continuous generation without sacrificing pre-trained semantic grounding.

</details>


### [11] [From Activation to Intervention: Interpreting Sparse Visual Features through Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05522)
*Jianyang Gu,Jacob Beattie,Mridul Khurana,Julia Chae,Xi Xiao,Cheng Zhang,Anuj Karpatne,Wei-Lun Chao,Sara Beery,Tanya Berger-Wolf*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAE特征解释依赖最强激活的图像或像素区域，但当纹理、颜色等不同语义特征在同一位置频繁共激活时，这种证据产生歧义，难以判定特征真实语义。

Method: RecSAEI：在表征上沿SAE解码器方向施加干预，并将其重构成可视输出，以直接的可视证据揭示特征语义；同时将[CLS]上的SAE干预归因到稀疏的patch级SAE解码器方向，建立高层语义与基本视觉模式之间的组合关系。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose visual representations into individual features, offering a promising basis for explaining model behavior. Interpreting these features typically relies on images or pixel regions that most strongly activate them. However, this evidence becomes ambiguous when multiple features with different semantics frequently activate in the same locations, such as texture and color in the same patterns. We propose Reconstructive SAE Intervention (RecSAEI), a framework that shifts feature explanation from passive observation to active visual reconstruction. By intervening on representations along SAE decoder directions and reconstructing the visual output, we provide direct evidence of a feature's semantic meaning. We demonstrate that our method successfully disambiguates feature meanings across multiple datasets and vision encoders. Furthermore, our framework grounds [CLS] SAE interventions in a sparse set of patch SAE decoder directions. Beyond stable target response, this attribution also exposes the compositional relationship between elementary visual patterns and high-level semantics. Our results advocate for intervention reconstruction as an essential complementary signal for explaining neural networks.

</details>


### [12] [How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05559)
*S M Rayeed,Qian Ma,Charles V. Stewart,Yao Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Bio-VQA——最大生物视觉问答基准，覆盖分类层级推理、细粒度属性定位、定量空间推理与个体重识别四方面，含1.86M问题/217K图像，并用分级评分评测18个开源权重模型，揭示通用视觉能力无法迁移到生物域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物视觉基准多局限于少数类群的物种识别，未能检验VLM在生物监测实际需求（哪一个分类单元、数量多少、何种性状、个体是否重复出现）上的能力，因此其生物学视觉理解水平基本未被系统评测。

Method: 构建Bio-VQA：整合11个公开数据集、217K图像、1.86M问题，覆盖四个维度（层级分类推理、细粒度属性定位、定量空间推理、个体重识别）；将二元对错评分扩展为分级评分，使"接近正确"优于"远离正确"；评测参数规模3.75B至38.4B的18个开源权重模型，并与领域专家模型及图像盲基线对比。

Conclusion: Bio-VQA可作为检验VLM能力向生物域迁移程度的标准测试；结果表明当前开源VLM在生物视觉理解上与领域专用方法存在系统性差距，且单纯扩大规模难以弥合，亟需面向生物域的数据与建模改进。

Abstract: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Evaluating 18 open-weight models from 3.75B to 38.4B parameters, we find that general visual capabilities do not transfer to biological organisms: the best model counts animals exactly on 41.7% of images with 2 to 10 individuals, less than half its accuracy on everyday objects at the same counts. Taxonomic accuracy falls to one sixth, from 0.72 at phylum to 0.12 at scientific name, and scaling helps mostly at coarse ranks. The gap to a domain specialist widens accordingly, from 0.731 against BioCLIP-2's 0.874 at class (1.2x) to 0.269 against 0.544 at scientific name (2x). On trait size measurement, 15 of the 18 models do no better than an image-blind baseline that predicts one fixed number for every specimen, and on re-identification, 17 of the 18 models fall below chance under adversarial conditions. These failures persist across a tenfold range of model size. We hope Bio-VQA becomes a standard test of how well VLM capabilities transfer to the biological domain.

</details>


### [13] [Lesion Overlap Ranks PET Segmentation Models but Does Not Certify Patient-Level Tumor Burden](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05564)
*Tushar Kataria,Gerald Sabin,Ponnuswamy Sadayappan,Shireen Y. Elhabian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究基于1,014例autoPET FDG PET/CT，发现Dice等重叠指标虽与平均模型排序一致，但在患者层面无法可靠识别MTV负担误差，呼吁分割基准同时报告患者级MTV误差与漏检病灶数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化MTV（代谢肿瘤体积）只有在个体患者层面估计可靠时才有临床价值，但当前分割模型普遍以Dice等重叠指标评价，而非以体积负担误差评价。作者因此检验重叠指标能否识别不可靠的MTV估计。

Method: 使用1,014例autoPET FDG PET/CT研究：评估未参与微调的LesionTracer预测（out-of-fold），在489例肿瘤阳性患者上比较五个已发布模型，并在597例PSMA研究中复核；分析Dice与相对MTV误差的相关性（Spearman ρ）、阈值不一致率（Dice 0.80 vs. MTV误差25%）、空间误差在净MTV中的抵消效应，以及五模型漏检病灶情况。

Result: 五个FDG模型按平均Dice排序与按平均相对MTV误差排序完全一致（ρ=−1.00，精确p=0.017）；但患者层面out-of-fold Dice与相对MTV误差虽强相关（ρ=−0.75），仍有82/489例（16.8%）在Dice 0.80与MTV误差25%阈值上判定相反。训练暴露模型的相关系数为−0.47至−0.74，且处于更窄的高Dice区间。out-of-fold中假阳性与假阴性体积相互抵消，约三分之一的空间误差被净MTV掩盖。236/489例患者中，五个模型各自至少漏检一个病灶（未必为同一病灶）。

Conclusion: 平均模型排序的一致性并不能保证个体MTV估计的可靠性，也无法揭示共有的漏检病灶。PET分割基准应在Dice等重叠指标之外，补充报告患者级MTV误差与漏检病灶计数。

Abstract: Metabolic tumor volume (MTV) summarizes whole-body PET disease burden for prognostic stratification and treatment assessment. Automated MTV is useful only if its estimate is reliable for the individual patient, yet segmentation models are usually evaluated with overlap metrics such as Dice rather than burden error. We examined whether overlap metrics identify unreliable MTV estimates using 1,014 autoPET FDG PET/CT studies. We evaluated LesionTracer predictions held out from fine-tuning, compared five selected released models on 489 tumor-positive patients, and examined the findings in 597 PSMA studies. Across the five FDG models, ranking by higher mean Dice gave the same order as ranking by lower mean relative MTV error ($ρ=-1.00$, exact $p=0.017$). At the patient level, however, out-of-fold Dice tracked relative MTV error strongly ($ρ=-0.75$), yet 82 of 489 patients (16.8\%) fell on opposite sides of the Dice 0.80 and MTV-error 25\% thresholds. Within the training-exposed released models, correlations ranged from $-0.47$ to $-0.74$ over narrower, high-Dice ranges. Out of fold, opposing false-positive and false-negative volumes cancelled about one third of spatial error in net MTV. In 236 of 489 patients, each of the five models missed at least one lesion, though not necessarily the same lesion. Thus, agreement in average model rankings did not establish the reliability of individual MTV estimates or reveal shared lesion misses. PET segmentation benchmarks should report patient-level MTV error and missed-lesion counts alongside Dice and other overlap metrics.

</details>


### [14] [Discarded or Unreachable? Diagnosing and Repairing Spatial Relation Failure in Vision--Language Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05565)
*Mahdi Mostajabdaveh,Zirui Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对比视觉-语言模型对左右关系的评分接近随机，本文把症状分解为"可访问性失败"与"池化失败"两种成因，提出零参数、查询条件的空间矩读出，把patch网格几何存为向量，显著提升左右关系判别与检索精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比视觉-语言模型在左右（横向极性）关系上近乎随机，但这一症状可能源于两种相反机制：关系信息仍存在于池化嵌入中却无法被原生图文相似度获取；或池化丢弃了关系而稠密特征仍保留。厘清成因才能选择正确修复方案。

Method: (1) 诊断：在干净双物体照片上，检验池化向量翻转奇分量对横向极性的线性可解码性，并用百万级标题搜索测试原生打分；在受控C4轨道数据上检验池化与patch网格对排布轴及极性的保留。(2) 修复：提出零参数、查询条件的空间矩读出，从patch网格重算几何并以向量形式与原生嵌入并列存储，对未命名关系的查询精确复现原生排序。

Result: 十个编码器上，池化向量翻转奇分量的极性线性可解码率为0.77–0.99，但百万标题搜索下十倍之九在原生打分上仍为随机（访问失败）；在C4轨道数据上池化保留排布轴0.998–1.000却丢失极性，patch网格保留极性（池化失败）。在118,287图像索引上，左右成对准确率相对反向几何负样本从0.51–0.53提升至0.81–0.96，21个同类候选中的条件R@1从0.05提升到0.37–0.75，批量查询耗时低于1毫秒。

Conclusion: 两种失败均位于稠密特征下游，因此单一读出即可同时覆盖；空间矩读出以极低开销大幅改善关系敏感检索，且不损害无关系查询的原生行为。

Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models score left/right relations near chance, but the symptom has two causes that call for opposite repairs: the relation may survive in the pooled embedding yet be unreachable by native image-text similarity, or pooling may discard it while the dense features retain it. On clean two object photographs, across ten encoders, the lateral polarity is linearly decodable from the flip odd component of the pooled vector at 0.77-0.99, yet a search over a million captions leaves nine of the ten at chance under native scoring: an access failure. On controlled C4 orbits, where the relation is the only thing that varies, pooling keeps the arrangement axis at 0.998-1.000 and loses its polarity, which the patch grid retains: a pooling failure. Both sit downstream of the dense features, so one readout covers both. Our zero parameter, query conditioned spatial moment recomputes the geometry from the patch grid and stores it as a vector beside the native embedding. On a 118,287 image index it raises left/right pairwise accuracy against reversed geometry negatives from 0.51-0.53 to 0.81-0.96 and conditional R@1 among 21 category matched candidates from 0.05 to 0.37-0.75, at under a millisecond per batched query, while reproducing the native ranking exactly for queries that name no relation.

</details>


### [15] [Role-based Effectiveness of an Epistemic Uncertainty Estimate in Training Models for Semantic Segmentation of 3D LiDAR Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05569)
*Krishnakumar N,Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统考察确定性（认知）不确定性在点云语义分割中的不同角色：作为额外输入特征与作为逐样本损失权重，并在四个大规模LiDAR基准上验证其增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有点云分割多将不确定性建模用于精度提升，缺乏对"估计不确定性可承担何种角色"的探索；本文填补这一空白。

Method: 显式建模认知不确定性，构建一个基线ANN及两个不确定性感知变体（不确定性作为输入特征、作为训练损失中的逐样本置信权重），在ISPRS Vaihingen、AHN3、Paris-Lille-3D、Toronto-3D四个基准上与PointNet++、RandLA-Net及其不确定性增强版本对比，采用空间不相交的标准训练/测试划分。

Result: 不确定性感知建模提升mIoU，恢复基线完全漏检的少数类，且在一半配置中改善预测误差与估计不确定性的对齐（Patch Accuracy vs Patch Uncertainty）。

Conclusion: 不确定性在分割流程中可承担多重角色（特征、损失加权等），而非仅作为提升精度的工具。

Abstract: Point cloud segmentation is a fundamental task in 3D data analysis, with applications across robotics, augmented and virtual reality, and remote sensing. However, the inherent sparsity, noise, and unordered nature of point clouds introduce significant challenges, particularly in achieving reliable classification. While the state-of-the-art rely on training models for explicit modeling of uncertainty, there is a gap in exploring different roles that estimated uncertainty using generative approaches can play. This work investigates the impact of deterministic uncertainty in point cloud segmentation by explicitly modeling epistemic uncertainty and using it in different roles, namely, as a feature and in loss function. We evaluate a baseline artificial neural network (ANN) and two uncertainty-aware variants (uncertainty as an additional input feature and as a per-sample confidence weight in the training loss) on four large-scale LiDAR benchmarks spanning airborne and mobile acquisition, namely ISPRS Vaihingen, AHN3, Paris-Lille-3D, and Toronto-3D, together with PointNet++ and RandLA-Net references and their uncertainty-augmented counterparts under canonical spatially disjoint train and test splits. Under this protocol, uncertainty-aware modeling improves mean Intersection over Union, recovers minority classes that the baseline ANN never predicts at all, and in half of the configurations improves the alignment between prediction error and estimated uncertainty as measured by Patch Accuracy versus Patch Uncertainty. Our findings indicate that uncertainty can play multiple roles in the segmentation pipeline rather than as a device for improving accuracy alone.

</details>


### [16] [ChangeJEPA: Predict Before You Compare for Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05570)
*Buddhi Wijenayake,Dhananjaya Jayasundara,Vishal M. Patel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ChangeJEPA将双时相变化检测重构为潜在后状态预测，用联合嵌入预测架构区分真实变化与光照/季节等伪变化，在三个基准上取得最优IoU/F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统孪生特征比较范式中，两个时相图像被独立编码，编码器同时保留了真实场景变化与光照、季节、辐射、几何等噪声变化，导致解码器难以区分何种差异对应有意义变化。作者希望从表征学习层面抑制瞬态外观差异，而非仅依赖解码器判别。

Method: 提出ChangeJEPA——双时相联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）。输入变化前图像与部分变化后证据，在两个互补条件下预测完整的变化后表征：由变化前场景推导的先验假设，以及基于已观测变化后上下文更新的假设。使用联合嵌入预测损失将两种假设对齐到目标潜在表征，促进语义一致性并抑制瞬态外观变化。变化由变化前表征、观测到的变化后目标与预测潜在状态之间的不一致推断，综合变化证据、先验"意外度"、上下文更新和预测可靠性。

Abstract: Remote sensing change detection is typically formulated as Siamese feature comparison, where two images are encoded independently and a decoder determines which discrepancies correspond to meaningful change. A joint-embedding predictive loss aligns both hypotheses with the target latent representation, encouraging semantic consistency while suppressing transient appearance variations. Change is then inferred from the disagreement among the pre-change representation, the observed post-change target, and the predicted latent states, capturing complementary evidence of change, prior surprise, contextual update, and prediction reliability. Across SYSU-CD, LEVIR-CD+, and CDD, ChangeJEPA consistently outperforms its decoder matched Siamese baseline by up to 1.51 IoU points and achieves the best IoU and F1-score on all three benchmarks, demonstrating the advantage of latent post-state prediction over direct feature comparison. Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) systems serve users across languages and cultural contexts. Abstract: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. Abstract: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? ### [20] [CAPTOR: text-encoder-free grounding by counting caption co-occurrence over the visual words of a frozen encoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05599)
*Elad Yoshai,Natan T. Shaked*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAPTOR 通过聚类冻结图像编码器的 patch token 为视觉词，并用图注统计词频，构造无需文本编码器的图文相似度矩阵，从而为无语言的图像编码器提供文本查询接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本查询的图像定位需要对每个词与每个 patch 打分，而许多图像编码器（如仅用切片训练的病理模型）缺少对齐的文本编码器，无法直接计算该矩阵。

Method: 将冻结图像编码器的 patch token 聚类为视觉词；用各词所占 patch 比例描述带图注图像；以“图注提及该词的图像”与其余图像之间的标准化占比差定义词签名；矩阵可分解为词×词表 与 与查询无关的图像因子，故图像只编码一次，新词仅增加一行。

Abstract: Grounding a text query in an image needs a matrix scoring every term against every patch. Vision-language models compute it with an aligned text encoder, which many image encoders, such as histopathology-related models trained on slides alone, lack. The Caption-Anchored Patch-Term Occurrence Representation (CAPTOR) estimates the matrix without a text encoder. It clusters a frozen image encoder's patch tokens into visual words and describes each captioned image by its share of patches in each word. A term signature is the standardized difference of those shares between images whose captions mention the term and the rest. The matrix factorizes into a term-by-word table and a query-independent image factor, so an image is encoded once and a new term adds one table row. Against every training-free baseline, CAPTOR leads on Common Objects in Context (COCO), Pascal Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes. On COCO, scored on the cells one object owns, it reaches 0.565 mean intersection over union (mIoU) against 0.502. On all three, it is also level with a text alignment trained on the same backbone, which needs gradients, a text encoder and several times the captions. On held-out breast-cancer slides, it exceeds the strongest baseline scoring patches with a pathology text encoder by 0.160 mIoU. </details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VideoMogaNet，用深度可分离卷积+隐式门控聚合做线性复杂度的多阶时序建模，并引入时空双维交互，在多个视频基准上达到或超越SOTA且大幅降低时序分支开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频识别时序方法依赖显式跨通道聚合投影，关于通道数呈二次复杂度，计算开销大；且时空表示在CNN中偏局部阶交互、在Transformer中偏全局阶交互，存在偏置。

Conclusion: 以线性复杂度的多阶时序建模与时空双交互替代二次复杂度的跨通道投影，可在降低开销的同时保持甚至提升视频识别性能。

Abstract: Many temporal approaches for video recognition rely on explicit cross-channel aggregation projections, which have quadratic complexity in the number of channels, introducing significant computational overhead. In addition, the spatio-temporal representation used for video recognition is biased either toward local order interactions (for CNNs) or toward global order interactions (for transformers). Starting from the multi-order spatial representation of MogaNet, our method introduces two complementary contributions to tackle these problems. First, for the temporal modelling, we introduce parallel multi-order processing with depthwise-only convolutions and implicit gating-based aggregation, which is linear in the number of channels, inducing a considerable computational reduction. Second, we propose a dual interaction between spatial and temporal dimensions, which allows a better spatio-temporal representation without increasing the computational cost. By combining these two contributions, our proposed VideoMogaNet achieves performance on par with or better than state-of-the-art action recognition approaches across multiple video benchmarks (UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-400, Diving48), while considerably reducing the cost of the temporal branch.

</details>


### [22] [ARIDA - Active railway infrastructure dataset annotation using neural network predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05646)
*Maximilian Dornik,Christian Sieberichs,Simon Geerkens,Alexander Braun*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铁路感知需要大规模综合图像数据集，但人工标注（尤其轨道折线等复杂基础设施几何）严重拖慢数据集构建。

Abstract: Modern railway perception requires large comprehensive image datasets, but creating them is slowed by manual labeling, especially for track polylines and other complex infrastructure geometry. This paper presents the Active Railway Infrastructure Dataset Annotation framework, a railway-specific semi-automated pipeline that converts instance predictions from a mask scoring instance segmentation network into bounding-boxes, polygons, polylines, and paired polylines. To keep automatic track geometry annotation reliable without ground truth, it applies confidence thresholds and an unique contour-agreement quality score as an acceptance gate. An active learning loop ranks remaining images by uncertainty and adapts the number of manual queries per cycle. This is achieved through a novel quantity control mechanism, in which easy images are auto-accepted and human effort targets hard cases. Experiments on disjoint, diverse imagery and time-sequential, redundant imagery quantify effort reduction and accuracy trade-offs, achieving about two thirds reduction in the disjoint regime and up to 93% in the sequential regime. The study also provides guidance for initial label budgets and stopping to avoid over-annotation.

</details>


### [23] [NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05648)
*Dar-Yen Chen,Yi-Zhe Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 TSAD（Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation），将 MMDiT 的文本流中间 token 状态作为对抗蒸馏的判别表示，并结合 Aspect-Cued Discrimination（ACD），在 NitroFusion 框架上实现 NitroFusion2，将少步蒸馏从 4–8 步压缩到 1–2 步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗扩散蒸馏传统上依赖图像特征进行判别，未考虑多模态扩散 Transformer 中文本流经联合注意力而与图像产生依赖的特性；作者希望探索更有效且可引导的对抗表示。

Method: 利用 MMDiT 文本流的中间文本 token 状态作为对抗表示（TSAD）：文本流已"读取"图像但仍与文本条件绑定，改变条件即改变其从图像中提取的信息。进一步提出 ACD，以样本的不同方面（排版、物体、风格等）作为判别器条件，引导对抗训练强调的属性。在 NitroFusion 的专家判别器设计基础上集成二者构成 NitroFusion2。

Conclusion: MMDiT 文本流是一种强大且可引导的对抗扩散蒸馏表示。

Abstract: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. Because the text stream has already read the image while remaining tied to the text condition, changing that condition changes what information it extracts from the image. Building on this property, we introduce Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD), which conditions the discriminator on different aspects of the sample, such as typography, objects, or style, to steer which properties are emphasized during adversarial training. Building on the expert-discriminator design of NitroFusion, we integrate TSAD and ACD in NitroFusion2. NitroFusion2 brings few-step distillation from the conventional 4-8-step regime down to just 1-2 steps at comparable quality. At one step, it produces sharp rendered text and rich fine-grained details, making one-step generation practical rather than merely a stress test for distillation. At two steps, it remains competitive across the evaluated benchmarks. These results establish the MMDiT text stream as a powerful and steerable representation for adversarial diffusion distillation.

</details>


### [24] [Toward an Optimal Configuration for Tree Species Classification from Bark Images: A Leakage-Safe Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05680)

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树皮照片自动识别树种具有林业清查与木材加工业的实用价值，但深度学习方案中影响精度的设计选择缺乏系统研究，且既往结果可能因同一树干图像在训练/测试集间泄漏而被高估。

Method: 在BarkNet 1.0(20类)上采用树级、无泄漏划分，以ConvNeXt-V2为骨干做五折交叉验证的系统消融，逐一变化：图像块尺寸、块级预测聚合策略、单/两阶段训练、骨干容量、整图基线，以及推理时可用块数。

Result: 块级精度随块尺寸单调上升(160px的75.6%→512px的89.6%)，图像级精度同步上升并在512px附近约94.9%处趋于平台；学习式聚合最多比多数投票高0.7个百分点且随块增大而收窄；骨干容量(pico至tiny)影响不足1个百分点，两阶段训练无优势；整图分类(91.9%)低于块聚合，精度随推理块数增加并在约64块处饱和。

Conclusion: 推荐配置为在保留足够块数用于平均的前提下使用尽可能大的块(约512px)配合nano骨干；学习式聚合与模型容量属二阶因素，本研究为实践者与后续研究提供了可复现的参考基准。

Abstract: Background: The automatic identification of tree species from bark photographs is of practical interest for forestry inventory and the wood-processing industry, yet the design choices that govern the accuracy of deep-learning approaches have not been studied systematically, and some prior results may be inflated by leakage of images of the same trunk across training and test partitions. Methods: A systematic ablation study is conducted on the public BarkNet 1.0 dataset (20 species) under the established tree-level, leakage-safe partitioning scheme. Using ConvNeXt-V2 backbones, the following factors are varied in turn and evaluated by five-fold cross-validation: patch size, the strategy by which per-patch predictions are aggregated into an image-level decision, the training regime (single- versus two-stage), backbone capacity, the whole-image baseline, and the number of patches available at inference. Results: Per-patch accuracy rises monotonically with patch size (from 75.6% at 160 px to 89.6% at 512 px), and image-level accuracy rises in step, plateauing near 94.9% around 512 px. Learned aggregation exceeds majority voting by at most 0.7 pp, an advantage that shrinks as patches grow and attention becomes near-uniform. Backbone capacity (pico to tiny) alters accuracy by less than a point, and two-stage training offers no advantage over one-stage. Whole-image classification (91.9%) trails patch-based aggregation, since it admits no bag to average over; accuracy increases with the number of patches at inference, saturating around 64. Conclusions: The study yields a simple recommended configuration: patches as large as possible while leaving enough to average over (around 512 px here), with a nano backbone. It also quantifies the second-order role of learned aggregation and model capacity, providing a reproducible reference point for practitioners and future research

</details>


### [25] [TRUST-Stereo: Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05689)
*Pouya Sohrabipour,Yihong Feng,Chaitanya Kumar Reddy Pallerla,Tuan Dang,Ngan Le,Dongyi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRUST-Stereo通过不确定性引导的残差搜索与师生知识蒸馏，在仅用1.4M合成数据下实现高效、强零样本泛化的立体匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粗到细立体匹配效率高，但对传播视差的误差敏感：一旦传播误差使真实对应点超出后续局部搜索范围，匹配即失败。同时，轻量骨干网络的表征能力有限，难以兼顾速度与精度。

Method: 提出不确定性引导残差搜索模块（UGRSM），估计传播视差的可靠性并预测残差偏移，自适应重定位局部代价体中心；并设计两阶段"资深-初级教师助手"（Senior-Junior Teacher Assistant）知识蒸馏策略，将大型基础模型的丰富单目表征迁移到轻量骨干网络。

Result: 在KITTI 2012/2015、ETH3D、Middlebury上展现强零样本泛化；仅用1.4M合成立体像对即达多项SOTA：KITTI 2015 EPE 0.93，ETH3D Bad 1.0 为2.13%，Middlebury Bad 2.0 为6.79%，单对推理约50 ms。

Conclusion: 不确定性引导的残差搜索有效缓解传播误差导致的搜索范围失配，配合蒸馏获得的高质量轻量表征，使方法在极少合成数据、无真实伪标签训练下超越数据量更大的高效竞品。

Abstract: Coarse-to-fine stereo matching enables efficient disparity estimation but remains sensitive to errors in propagated disparity, which may place ground-truth correspondences outside subsequent local search ranges. We propose TRUST-Stereo (Teacher-Assisted Robust Uncertainty-Guided Search and Transfer for Fast Stereo Matching), which addresses this limitation through an Uncertainty-Guided Residual Search Module (UGRSM). UGRSM estimates the reliability of propagated disparity and predicts residual offsets to adaptively relocate local cost-volume centers. Additionally, we introduce a two-stage Senior-Junior Teacher Assistant knowledge distillation strategy to transfer rich monocular representations from a large foundation model to a lightweight backbone to achieve fast stereo matching performance. Experiments on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization. Using only 1.4M synthetic stereo pairs, TRUST-Stereo achieves state-of-the-art results on several benchmark metrics, outperforming competing efficient methods trained with substantially larger datasets, including real-world pseudo-labeled samples. Specifically, it achieves a KITTI 2015 EPE of 0.93, ETH3D Bad 1.0 of 2.13% and Middlebury Bad 2.0 of 6.79% while maintaining inference at approximately 50 ms per stereo pair.

</details>


### [26] [Anchored Slice Propagation with Boundary Transport for 3D CT Segmentation from Three Orthogonal Annotated Slices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05693)
*Tushar Kataria,Md Rakibul Haque,Shireen Y. Elhabian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在固定预训练亲和力骨干上对Sli2Vol传播链进行"锚定"校正并按一致性加权融合，同时比较SDF与学习式轮廓两种边界几何传输方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相邻切片亲和力传播中误差会逐级累积（每步预测成为下一步输入）；正交标注不仅提供三个起始掩码，其与传播链的交点处标签已知，可用于纠正漂移与评估链可信度。此外二值掩码丢弃了到边界的距离信息，难以跟踪层间渐变形状。

Method: 固定预训练亲和力骨干：(1) 在传播链穿过其他已标注平面处用已知标签校正预测，并以其与这些标签的一致度加权融合各链；(2) 对比两种边界几何传输：截断符号距离场(SDF)经稠密亲和力平均传播，以及顶点依同一亲和力运动线索演化的轮廓跟踪器（从手工规则出发，在506例CT体数据的超体素伪目标上学习运动校正，无需人工器官标签）。

Result: 在约403例CT扫描、17个腹部结构、2,091个留出结构实例上，锚定将平均Dice从正交掩码传播的0.737提升至0.769且所有结构均改善；学习式轮廓跟踪使食管Dice提升5.7%、后腔静脉提升5.9%，SDF传输使右肾上腺提升2.8%。各锚定方法平均Dice相近(0.769–0.772)；轮廓跟踪在肾脏、胃和肝血管树上表现较差。

Conclusion: 跨平面已有标注的锚定校正与一致性加权融合可稳定缓解漂移并普遍提升精度；边界几何传输带来结构特异的增益（轮廓利于细长/小结构，SDF利于局部形状），但非普适，且轮廓方法在体积大或拓扑复杂结构上退化。

Abstract: Sli2Vol propagates a binary mask through affinities between adjacent slices, but an error can persist because each prediction becomes the input to the next step. Three orthogonal annotations reduce dependence on any one chain, yet they offer more than three starting masks: where a chain crosses another annotated plane, the correct label is already known. Those labels could correct drift during propagation and indicate how much to trust each chain at fusion. Between annotated planes, the information carried by the chain may matter as well. A binary mask records foreground membership but discards distance to the boundary, a cue that could help follow gradual shape changes between slices.We address these two sources of error with a fixed pretrained affinity backbone. We anchor each chain by correcting its prediction where it crosses another annotated plane, then use its agreement with those labels to weight fusion. We compare this anchored mask with two ways of transporting boundary geometry: a truncated signed-distance field (SDF) propagated by dense affinity averaging, and a contour whose vertices follow motion cues from the same affinity. The contour tracker starts from a hand-crafted rule and learns a motion correction from supervoxel pseudo-objects in 506 CT volumes, without manual organ labels. On 2,091 held-out structure instances from approximately 403 CT scans spanning 17 abdominal structures, anchoring raises mean Dice from 0.737 with orthogonal mask propagation to 0.769 and improves every structure. Beyond the anchored mask, learned contour tracking improves Dice by 5.7\% for the esophagus and 5.9\% for the postcava, while SDF transport improves right-adrenal Dice by 2.8\%. The anchored methods have similar mean Dice (0.769--0.772); contour tracking performs worse on the kidneys, stomach, and hepatic vessel tree.

</details>


### [27] [GeoDIVE: Geospatial Descent Informed by Value Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05697)
*Hamza Iqbal,Dan Cher,Eric Xing,Pranavi Kolouju,Abby Stylianou,Robert Pless,Nathan Jacobs*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoDIVE 将多分辨率卫星影像库视为森林，用最佳优先遍历决定编码哪些瓦片，并以轻量模型预测子树内查询相似度的乐观上界，从而在大幅降低编码成本下匹配穷举搜索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业、基础设施规划、环境监测与灾害响应中的目标、结构与空间模式检索需求，其特征分散在极大区域并跨越悬殊的空间尺度，导致朴素嵌入、维护与搜索的搜索空间代价高昂。

Method: 把多分辨率卫星影像库建模为树/森林，采用最佳优先遍历选择待编码瓦片；在每个访问节点用查询表示与子树表示，由轻量模型预测其后代中最优查询相似度的乐观估计，用于指导遍历剪枝。

Result: 在图像查询与开放词汇文本查询评估中，GeoDIVE 以 10% 的编码成本达到穷举搜索效果（图像查询），并在两种模态的每个预算下优于所有测试基线；同时发布基于 Microsoft 建筑轮廓与 OpenStreetMap 多边形、配合 VLM 生成描述构建的 Git-10M 对象级图像与文本查询。

Conclusion: 乐观相似度估计驱动的层次化最佳优先搜索可高效实现多尺度地理空间检索，配套发布的基准数据为后续多尺度地理空间搜索评测提供支持。

Abstract: Finding specific objects, structures, and spatial patterns supports critical work in agriculture, infrastructure planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. These features, however, are often dispersed across very large regions and span dramatically different spatial scales, which defines a search space that is costly to embed, maintain, and search naively. We introduce GeoDIVE, a model that treats a multiresolution satellite image gallery as a forest and uses best-first traversal to determine which tiles to encode. At each visited node, a lightweight model then predicts an optimistic estimate of the best query similarity hidden among its descendants using the query and subtree representations. In evaluations with image and open-vocabulary text queries, GeoDIVE matches exhaustive search at 10% of the encoding cost for image queries and leads all tested baselines at every budget in both modalities. To support future evaluation of multiscale geospatial search, we also release object-level image and text queries for Git-10M, constructed from Microsoft building footprints and OpenStreetMap polygons with VLM-generated captions. Source code and models will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [28] [Mitigating Spurious Invariance in Contrastive Learning: A Probabilistic Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Medical Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05734)
*Wei Wei,Yading Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出概率化自监督学习框架ProbSSL，将对比学习中的特征嵌入建模为概率分布而非固定向量，以缓解医学图像增强导致的关键特征抑制问题，并在分割与分类任务上优于现有SSL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像人工标注成本高昂，自监督学习（SSL）受到关注，其中对比学习通过增强视图间的不变性学习语义表征。但在医学图像中这种不变性可能具有虚假性：细微却关键的医学特征可能在增强过程中被抑制，导致模型丢失判别性信息。

Method: 将学习到的特征嵌入编码为概率分布而非固定向量，以捕获更丰富、更细粒度的信息；并构建统一概率框架，把多种SSL方法（如对比式与其他自监督范式）纳入同一建模体系。

Result: 在多个数据集的医学图像分割与分类等下游任务上，性能优于当前最先进的SSL方法；额外实验验证了对更强数据增强的鲁棒性、有限微调标签下的标签效率以及计算开销权衡。

Conclusion: 概率分布式表征可有效缓解医学图像对比学习中增强引起的关键特征抑制问题，统一概率框架为整合多种SSL方法提供了可行途径，代码已开源。

Abstract: Owing to the prohibitive cost of manual annotation for enormous medical images, self-supervised learning (SSL) has gained substantial attention and shown promise in various medical imaging tasks. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has emerged as a prominent one, encouraging models to encode semantic information that remains invariant between different augmented views. However, this invariance can be spurious for medical images, as subtle but critical medical features can be suppressed during augmentations. In this paper, we mitigate this issue by encoding the learned feature embeddings as probability distributions rather than fixed vectors, thus capturing a richer and more nuanced spectrum of information. Furthermore, we propose a unified probabilistic framework that seamlessly integrates multiple SSL approaches. Our method achieves superior performance over the state-of-the-art SSL methods on various downstream tasks across multiple datasets, including medical image segmentation and classification. We further validate the method through additional analyses of robustness to stronger augmentations, label efficiency under limited fine-tuning labels, and computational trade-offs. The code is released at https://github.com/wwzjer/ProbSSL.

</details>


### [29] [C-WFDM: A ControlNet-Guided Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05737)
*Muhammad Nabi Yasinzai,Remika Mito,Mangor Pedersen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出C-WFDM（WFDM的ControlNet扩展），用于受试者级别的缺失模态补全，从已有MRI对比度合成T2w、FLAIR与T1Gd。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开与汇聚神经影像数据集中各模态可获得性不均（T1w常见，T2w/FLAIR次之，T1Gd稀缺），现有缺失模态基准多通过在完整四模态病例上人为扣留对比度来模拟缺失，无法反映真实可获得性模式。

Method: 在BrainScape快照（157个公开数据集、45,880例预处理扫描）上构建；以预训练WFDM为骨干，保留目标模态与元数据条件；加入目标模态专用的ControlNet适配器，用同一受试者的其他MRI对比度引导合成；按需使用已采集的条件对比度，仅在必要时使用生成的中间对比度。

Conclusion: 受试者级别、基于ControlNet的扩散补全可更真实地应对汇聚数据集的模态缺失，并在T2w/FLAIR合成上优于现有方法；T1Gd结果未在摘要中报告。

Abstract: Multimodal brain MRI provides complementary anatomical, tissue, and pathological information to support downstream artificial intelligence (AI) applications. However, modality availability is uneven across public and pooled neuroimaging datasets: T1-weighted (T1w) MRI is widely represented, T2-weighted (T2w) and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) MRI are less consistently available, and gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted (T1Gd) MRI is relatively scarce. Pooled datasets therefore contain participants with different combinations of acquired MRI contrasts, reflecting variation in the study designs, acquisition protocols, and clinical or research objectives of the contributing studies. Many missing-modality benchmarks simulate incomplete MRI by withholding contrasts from complete four-modality cases, which may not represent the observed availability patterns in pooled datasets. To address this gap, we introduce C-WFDM, a ControlNet extension of our Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model (WFDM), for subject-specific missing-modality completion. C-WFDM is built on an earlier BrainScape snapshot comprising 157 public MRI datasets and 45,880 preprocessed scans. The pretrained WFDM backbone retains target-modality and metadata conditioning, while target-specific ControlNet adapters use MRI contrasts from the same participant to guide synthesis. C-WFDM synthesizes T2w from T1w, FLAIR from T1w and T2w, and T1Gd from T1w, T2w, and FLAIR. Acquired conditioning contrasts are used when available, and generated intermediate contrasts are used only when required. We compare C-WFDM with ALDM, cWDM, and Pix2Pix using paired structural similarity index (SSIM), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and mean absolute error (MAE). In the BrainScape completion experiment, C-WFDM achieves the best T2w and FLAIR results among the evaluated models, with SSIM values of 0.9232 and 0.8904, respectively.

</details>


### [30] [Learning Hierarchical Patch Splitting Policies for Faster Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05742)
*Aditya Gupta,Jean Sebastien Dandurand,Kai Qiu,Rohan Choudhury,Laszlo A. Jeni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPLIT 提出用模型自身学到的任务相关信息来指导 ViT 的自适应 patch 划分，在减少约 30% token 的同时保持分类精度，并在 COCO、ADE20K 等密集预测任务上同样有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 的算力瓶颈在于输入 token 序列长度，而标准 patchification 对全图使用统一 patch 尺寸，忽略了区域内容差异。已有的自适应 patch 尺寸方法虽能减少 token 数，但依赖局部熵等像素级启发式，噪声大且未与任务语义对齐。

Method: 提出 Split Policy Learned Image Tokenization（SPLIT），让模型学习一个划分策略，依据模型认为"有意义"的区域来分配 token 分辨率，而非依据原始像素统计量，从而生成更短且与任务相关信息更匹配的 token 序列。

Result: 在分类任务上，SPLIT 以少 30% 的 token 达到全分辨率 ViT 基线的精度；在密集预测上，于 COCO 与 ADE20K 取得有竞争力的精度。

Conclusion: 语义对齐的 patchification 不仅适用于分类，还能泛化到密集预测任务，说明以模型语义解释驱动的算力分配是 ViT 高效化的一条有效路径。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are bottlenecked by the length of their input token sequence. Standard patchification fixes this length with a single patch size applied across the image, regardless of regional content. Prior work on adaptive patch sizing reduces token count by assigning coarser patches to visually simple regions, but relies on noisy pixel-level heuristics such as local entropy to make patchification decisions. We argue that this compute allocation should be grounded in the model's interpretation of task relevant information, not in raw pixel statistics. We introduce Split Policy Learned Image Tokenization which learns to allocate token resolution based on what the model finds meaningful, producing shorter token sequences that are better matched to task-relevant content. SPLIT matches the accuracy of full-resolution ViT classification baselines while using 30% fewer tokens. The same gains hold on dense prediction: SPLIT achieves competitive accuracy on COCO and ADE20K, demonstrating that semantically aligned patchification generalises well beyond classification.

</details>


### [31] [Decompose the Distillation: Interpretable Single-Pass Guidance for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05755)
*Wuyang Zhang,Xiaolin Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance is a widely used inference-time guidance rule for conditional image generation with diffusion models, which exposes a guidance scale that adjusts conditioning strength after training. This flexibility requires conditional and unconditional model evaluations at every sampling step, so an N-step trajectory takes 2N forward passes. Single-pass alternatives reduce such cost, yet most collapse CFG's two components into one opaque guided prediction, losing the separable base flow and guidance direction that support per-step control and diagnostics, even when the scale remains adjustable. This work introduces CtrlFlow, a single-pass guidance method that preserves CFG's separable base-flow and guidance-direction interface. To preserve both components at one-pass cost, CtrlFlow attaches two lightweight LoRA adapters to a frozen backbone, each adding 2.5% parameters, and predicts the base flow and guidance direction from one pass of the shared frozen backbone. Because the guidance scale multiplies the guidance direction only after the forward pass, one evaluation yields the guided velocity at any scale, so a single trained checkpoint remains adjustable at inference without retraining. Preserving two outputs introduces a training mismatch: inference amplifies guidance-direction errors by the chosen scale, while naive component-wise losses weight both outputs equally. To align training with this composed inference-time error, CtrlFlow uses a unified multi-scale distillation loss. Residual guidance errors can still persist at extreme scales, where even small guidance-direction errors are amplified by the guidance scale. To reduce this inference-time error, CtrlFlow applies scale-adaptive modulation to damp velocity-field errors and time-grid warping to concentrate solver evaluations where the trajectory changes most rapidly.

</details>


### [32] [ME^2FDiff: Multiscale Expert Enhancing Feature Diffusion in Residual Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05766)
*Afrida Rahman,Bijoy Kundu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ME^2FDiff单模型架构，通过注意力条件化的谱域扩散瓶颈精炼与多尺度专家增强特征融合，解决治疗后胶质瘤MRI分割中瓶颈表示过载与缺乏迭代精炼的问题，在BraTS 2024上取得单模型最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 治疗后胶质瘤分割困难：手术与放化疗造成切除腔、水肿、纤维化等结构改变，影像表现改变且易与肿瘤复发混淆。现有分割架构存在两大局限：(1) 瓶颈来自最深编码器阶段，单一表示需同时服务尺度与外观差异极大的多个子区域；(2) 单次前向传播输出分割结果，缺乏精炼机制。

Method: 提出单模型架构ME^2FDiff，包含两个核心模块：①注意力条件化的谱域扩散块（attention-conditioned spectral diffusion block）精炼瓶颈，采用图像条件化的隐扩散过程，含空间预注意力门控（spatial pre-attention gate）与谱融合块（其时间步自适应带通滤波器在每个噪声水平选择信息量丰富的频带）；②多尺度专家增强特征块（multiscale expert-enhanced feature block），通过专家选择的共享 token 将中间编码器尺度融合进瓶颈，无需辅助损失即保证均衡利用。

Result: 在BraTS 2024治疗后胶质瘤数据集上，ME^2FDiff在所有单模型基线中于每个肿瘤子区域均取得最优（全肿瘤Dice 91.23%、IoU 84.52%、HD95 2.13 mm），并以约三分之一的推理开销在两项重叠指标上超过三专家集成。与同等条件重训练的最新SOTA方法相比，以所有竞争模型中最少的参数量保持最强性能。

Conclusion: 单个紧凑网络即可吸收通常需借助集成或更大架构才能获得的专业化能力，验证了扩散式瓶颈精炼与专家增强多尺度融合在治疗后胶质瘤分割中的有效性。

Abstract: Automated segmentation of post-treatment glioma from MRI is essential for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, yet remains difficult. Surgery and chemoradiotherapy cause structural changes in brain like resection cavities, edema, and fibrosis, that alter imaging appearance and mimic tumor recurrence. Contemporary segmentation architectures attain high accuracy with two limitations. First, the bottleneck originates from the deepest encoder stage, so one representation must serve sub-regions that differ widely in size and appearance. Second, they produce the segmentation in a single forward pass with no mechanism for refinement. We propose ME^2FDiff, a single-model architecture, addressing both. An attention-conditioned spectral diffusion block refines the bottleneck. It uses the image-conditioned latent diffusion process with two processes: a spatial pre-attention gate and a spectral fusion block whose timestep-adaptive bandpass filter selects the informative frequency band at each noise level. A multiscale expert-enhanced feature block fuses the intermediate encoder scales into the bottleneck through expert-selected shared tokens, guaranteeing balanced utilization without an auxiliary loss. On the BraTS 2024 post-treatment glioma dataset, ME^2FDiff achieves the best results on every tumor sub-region among all single-model baselines (91.23% Dice, 84.52% IOU, 2.13 mm HD95 on whole-tumor) and surpasses a three-expert ensemble on both overlap metrics at roughly one-third of its inference cost. Against recent state-of-the-art methods retrained under identical conditions, it maintains the strongest performance with the fewest parameters of any competing model. These findings demonstrate that a single, compact network can absorb the specialization, usually sought through ensembling or larger architectures.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放集全景基准只针对单帧或单视角，全景跟踪基准又假定闭集类别，因此无法评估"未知目标能否在同步多相机序列中被一致分割与跟踪"，缺乏衡量真实开放世界整体感知能力的评测平台。

Method: 构建 WayPOP 基准：以真实 Waymo PVPS 序列为基础，从 Objaverse 引入多样化、taxonomy 之外的 3D 资产，将其以固定 3D 位置插入场景，并借由标定好的车载相机在自车与周围交通移动过程中渲染，从而获得时间一致、跨视角一致的全景标注及辅助 LiDAR 距离观测。数据含约 670 个精选资产、980 条唯一未知目标轨迹、21,300 张相机图像上的 53,452 条未知目标 mask 标注。评测协议定义从视图独立的开放集全景分割到完整全景开放集全景跟踪的任务层级，采用 known/unknown PQ 与 (w)STQ 指标，并对具代表性的开放集与开放词汇分割方法叠加时间与跨相机关联进行基准测试。

Result: 基准测试显示，现有开放集与开放词汇分割方法在真正开放集场景下表现存在显著局限：未知目标的鲁棒定位以及跨时间、跨视角的身份关联仍是主要难题，方法性能明显下降。

Conclusion: WayPOP 填补了多相机开放集全景跟踪评测的空白，表明开放世界整体感知的关键瓶颈在于未知目标的定位与跨时序/跨视角身份一致性关联，为后续研究提供了标准化基准与明确方向。

Abstract: Holistic perception for autonomous agents requires reliably segmenting and associating scene elements across time and camera views, including objects outside a fixed semantic taxonomy. Existing open-set panoptic benchmarks focus on individual images or views, while panoramic tracking benchmarks assume closed-set taxonomies. Consequently, these benchmarks do not evaluate whether unknown objects can be consistently segmented and tracked across synchronized multi-camera sequences. We introduce WayPOP, a panoramic open-set panoptic tracking benchmark built on real Waymo PVPS sequences augmented with diverse out-of-taxonomy 3D assets from Objaverse. Inserted objects are placed at fixed locations in the 3D scene and rendered using calibrated vehicle-mounted cameras as the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic move, providing temporally and cross-view consistent panoptic annotations and auxiliary LiDAR range observations. WayPOP contains approximately 670 curated assets instantiated as 980 unique unknown-object tracks, yielding 53,452 unknown-object mask annotations across 21,300 camera images. Our evaluation protocol defines a hierarchy of tasks from view-independent open-set panoptic segmentation to full panoramic open-set panoptic tracking, using known/unknown PQ and (w)STQ metrics. We benchmark representative open-set and open-vocabulary segmentation methods with temporal and cross-camera association. Our results reveal substantial limitations of current methods in truly open-set scenarios, highlighting robust unknown-object localization and identity association across time and views as major open challenges.

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GREP，一个以"三层评估哲学"为核心的场景评估智能体，自主发现问题、收集证据并给出评分与报告；与人类多数偏好一致率达87%，且其报告可反向提升场景质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的家具房间生成虽能选取并摆放资产，但评估仍局限于特定视角或预定义问题，无法反映场景整体质量，缺乏统一、全面的评价范式。

Method: 核心是评估重心的转移：从"定义具体问题"转向建立三层评估体系——(1)基础物理有效性：场景是否满足物理约束；(2)视觉连贯性：物体在尺度、风格与构图上的兼容性；(3)人类使用逻辑（最高层）：物体布局是否符合日常人类习惯。在此原则指导下，评估智能体自主、自适应地从场景上下文识别问题、收集证据，并输出评分与报告。

Result: (1)与人类多数偏好一致率达87%，显著优于基线评估器；(2)GREP报告经场景精修可提升场景质量，而仅给分或无反馈基线则出现轻微下降；(3)分析表明，随着规划能力提升，GPT-5.6 Sol等近期模型可从依赖pipeline与harness转向挑战其指导与约束，但仍缺乏解决由此产生冲突的能力。

Conclusion: 自上而下、分层级的评估哲学加自主证据收集，是实现可靠、可解释场景评估的有效路径；更强的模型不仅应擅长规划，还需更灵活地适应外部指导与约束，以解决规划与约束之间的冲突。

Abstract: Recent LLM-centric advances can generate attractive furnished rooms by selecting and arranging assets. Yet evaluation remains limited to specific perspectives or predefined questions, failing to reflect overall scene quality. To address this pressing need, we introduce GREP. Its core is a focus shift from defining specific questions to establishing a three-tier evaluation philosophy: basic physical validity checks whether a scene obeys physical constraints; visual coherence concerns compatibility in object scale, style, and composition; and, at the highest level, human-use logic requires object arrangements to align with everyday human habits. Guided by these principles, an evaluation agent autonomously and adaptively identifies issues from scene context, gathers evidence, and produces scores and reports. This supports scene-specific issue discovery and reliable judgments. Experiments show that (1) GREP achieves 87% agreement with human majority preferences, substantially outperforming baseline evaluators. (2) GREP reports improve scene quality through refinement, whereas score-only and no-feedback baselines show slight declines. (3) GREP suggests that as planning ability improves, recent models such as GPT-5.6 Sol can move from relying on pipelines and harnesses to challenging their guidance and constraints, but still lack the ability to resolve the resulting conflicts. Stronger models are therefore expected not only to plan well, but also to adapt to external guidance and constraints more flexibly. Project page: https://han-808.github.io/GREP/

</details>

*Jing-Ze Liang,Wei-Jie Xiao,Zi-Han Cao,Yang-Dong Li,Tian-Yi Hu,Liang-Jian Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReTailor：仅优化轻量残差特征调节模块（Feature Tailor）的实时序贯跨传感器自适应框架，结合内容感知patch选择与滚动残差自举，在自监督物理约束下高效缓解全色锐化模型的跨传感器性能退化。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recent pansharpening models achieve strong fusion performance on trained sensors, yet often generalize poorly to unseen sensors. Existing cross-sensor adaptation is limited by target-sensor retraining, which requires target-sensor training pairs and a dedicated training stage, and by per-image zero-shot adaptation, which is computationally expensive due to whole-network optimization for each test image. To address these problems, we propose ReTailor, a real-time sequential cross-sensor adaptation framework. Only a lightweight residual Feature Tailor is rapidly optimized under self-supervised, physics-aware constraints to correct cross-sensor shifts without modifying the well-learned fusion prior. For efficient and effective deployment, ReTailor combines content-aware patch selection, which identifies a few informative patches per image for optimization at negligible cost to improve both quality and efficiency, with rolling residual bootstrap, which inherits sensor-related knowledge across the image stream to further improve quality. Extensive experiments on cross-sensor adaptation settings show that ReTailor mitigates cross-sensor degradation both effectively and efficiently. Moreover, we compare ReTailor with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a widely used method for fine-tuning, to demonstrate the advantages of our approach. We further evaluate the core principle of ReTailor on two additional remote sensing tasks: super-resolution pansharpening and image segmentation, where it consistently improves performance. In general, ReTailor provides a highly effective and efficient strategy for deploying pansharpening models under real-world cross-sensor degradation, while also offering useful insights into managing cross-sensor degradation in other remote sensing tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/JingZe-Liang/ReTailor .

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 整理并讨论了开源数据集与安全关键应用，收集的海事数据集发布于 https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets 并定期更新；同时指出了该领域的开放挑战与未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 以视觉为核心、辅以多传感器融合是提升受限能见度下MSV态势感知与导航能力的有效路径；该综述为智能船舶导航与智能水上运输系统研究提供了技术脉络、数据资源与研究方向参考。

Abstract: Marine surface vehicles (MSVs) have attracted considerable attention for their commercial, scientific, and military applications. Owing to their favorable performance-to-cost ratio, shipboard cameras are widely used to detect and recognize potentially hazardous situations across diverse operational scenarios. However, visual perception is inevitably degraded by restricted conditions, including irregular motion of the imaging platform, adverse weather, and long imaging distances. To improve situational awareness and navigation capabilities, complementary sensors, such as the automatic identification system (AIS), radar, and light detection and ranging (LiDAR), etc., have become essential shipboard equipment. Multi-sensor fusion can provide richer perceptual information and help ensure navigational safety of MSVs in restricted visibility. This article reviews recent progress from intelligent vision to vision-centered multi-sensor fusion for newcomers and researchers in intelligent ship navigation and intelligent waterborne transportation system (IWTS). After introducing the generation of quality-degraded images in restricted visibility, we will review intelligent vision methods for four key issues, i.e., shipboard video stabilization, visual perception enhancement, object detection and tracking, and navigable area segmentation. We then examine vision-centered multi-sensor fusion methods, including infrared-visible image fusion, radar-vision fusion, LiDAR-vision fusion, AIS-vision fusion, and other multi-sensor fusion scenarios. Open-source datasets and safety-critical applications are also summarized and discussed. Finally, we highlight open challenges and future research directions. The collected maritime datasets are available at https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets and will be regularly updated.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字人电商视频生成需同时保持产品外观、人物身份与整体风格。现有可支持多参考图的模型采用通用条件方案，未显式区分产品与人物条件的非对称角色，导致生成结果偏向单一参考，出现产品形变、身份漂移或"单参考坍缩"。

Method: 1) 双时空槽注入：VAE 分别编码产品图与人物图，将其隐特征置于 DiT 序列的首尾边界，实现序列级条件分离与定向注入；2) 掩码引导的区域加权损失：对产品区、人脸区及产品-人脸重叠区加强监督；3) 图像条件 dropout：使单一模型支持双图、仅产品、仅人物三种生成模式；4) 构建 10K 电商视频数据集用于训练。

Result: 实验结果表明 DualCast 取得较强性能（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模产品与人物条件的角色差异，可在序列级与损失层面降低角色歧义与特征竞争，从而提升数字人电商视频生成中产品保真与身份一致性。

Abstract: Digital human e-commerce video generation requires preserving product appearance, human identity, and overall video style during dynamic demonstrations. Although recent models support multiple reference images, their general conditioning schemes do not explicitly distinguish the asymmetric roles of "what is presented" and "who presents it." Consequently, generated videos may favor a single reference, resulting in product distortion, identity drift, or single-reference collapse. To address this issue, we propose DualCast, a role-addressed dual-image conditioning framework for video generation. By explicitly modeling the distinct roles of product and human conditions, DualCast reduces role ambiguity and feature competition between references. First, a dual-spatiotemporal slot injection mechanism VAE-encodes the product and human images separately and places their latent features at the front and rear boundaries of the DiT sequence, enabling sequence-level condition separation and directed injection. Second, a mask-guided region-weighted loss strengthens supervision over product, face, and product-face overlap regions, improving generation fidelity in critical areas. Third, image condition dropout enables a single model to support dual-image, product-only, and human-only generation. In addition, we construct a curated dataset of 10K e-commerce videos for model training. Experimental results demonstrate the strong performance of DualCast.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: DualControlNet联合合成高分辨率土地利用图与卫星影像，以应对多模态、可控性与验证三方面挑战；在奥兰多与芝加哥超4万个配对瓦片上训练，并采用土地利用、空间一致性与图像质量三类指标进行评估。

Abstract: Various land-use models characterize land-use patterns and facilitate scenario planning. However, existing models are largely predictive, forecasting transitions based on numeric data without synthesizing new land-use maps from simple text prompts. Meanwhile, generative AI in urban systems remains unimodal, weakly controllable, and evaluated mostly by generic image quality rather than domain-specific metrics. To address these gaps, we introduce DualControlNet, a generative land-use model that jointly synthesizes high-resolution land-use maps and satellite imagery, addressing multimodality, controllability, and verification challenges. Trained on over 40,000 paired tiles from Orlando and Chicago, DualControlNet is evaluated using land-use, spatial consistency, and image quality metrics. Relative to unimodal baselines, DualControlNet improves land-use diversity consistency by 62.8% and building coverage ratio consistency by 16.3%, more than doubles cross-modal spatial consistency, and triples visual quality. Scenario-based experiments demonstrate that DualControlNet supports sustainable development through multidimensional controls, increasing density and diversity, and responding to text prompts like "high-density development." Overall, this work advances land-use modeling via a multimodal, controllable, and verifiable generative framework, lowering technical barriers and enabling intuitive exploration of urban futures.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角一致感知通常依赖视频或标定多视角采集，成本高、多样性差；而单目数据规模大且便宜易得，因此希望仅用单图像语义分割监督来获得多视角一致的分割能力。

Method: 1) 构建 Feature Puzzles 流程：利用图像裁剪（crop）与几何变换（geometric transformations）生成多视角一致的伪标签；2) 引入轻量、即插即用的网络，结合现有预训练3D基础模型已学到的多视角一致图像特征与上述伪标签进行分割；3) 框架支持来自单视图或多视图的多种提示（prompts），并可扩展到开放词汇3D分割。

Result: 在单图像监督下，前馈模型在 NVOS 上取得最佳 mIoU；在 SPIn-NeRF 与 ScanNet++ 上相较使用逐场景优化或域内多视角训练的基线仍具竞争力；并展现出向开放词汇3D分割的零样本迁移能力。

Conclusion: 单图像语义分割监督结合几何变换伪标签与预训练3D基础模型特征，足以实现高效、灵活且支持多提示与开放词汇扩展的多视角一致分割，无需昂贵的视频或标定多视角数据。

Abstract: Humans can easily recognize the same objects across different viewpoints of a 3D scene, whereas teaching models such multi-view-consistent perception typically requires videos or calibrated multi-view captures, which are considerably more expensive and less diverse than large-scale monocular data.~In this paper, we introduce Feature Puzzles, a novel framework for learning multi-view-consistent segmentation using only single-image semantic segmentation supervision. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective pipeline that constructs multi-view-consistent segmentation pseudo-labels through image cropping and geometric transformations. We further introduce a lightweight, plug-and-play network that leverages the multi-view-consistent image features learned by existing pretrained 3D foundation models and the generated pseudo-labels to perform multi-view-consistent segmentation. Importantly, our flexible framework supports various types of prompts provided from one or multiple views and can be readily extended to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Under this single-image supervision, our feed-forward model achieves the best mIoU on NVOS, remains competitive on SPIn-NeRF and ScanNet++ against baselines using per-scene optimization or in-domain multi-view training, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Visual comparisons are available on our project page: https://featurepuzzles.github.io/

</details>

*Mengqi Huang,Wenchuan Wang,Zhendong Mao,Yijing Tu,Zhike Liu,Luoni Wang,Ning Tong,Xiaoxiao Sheng,Tianyu Huang,Xuecheng Qi,Yongdong Zhang*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖参考图引导控制与身份感知条件，专注于提升静态人脸对齐；但仅优化静态身份对齐会与时间可控性产生根本性张力，在大姿态变化与多段连续动作下常导致身份漂移或动作被抑制。

Method: Chronos包含三个组件：(1) Semantic Prompt Anchoring，自适应精炼用户提示；(2) Visual Frame Anchoring，将条件转化为视觉落地的关键帧锚点以提供视觉引导；(3) Metric-Guided Candidate Routing，通过多维评估从异构生成器中挑选最高质量视频。

Result: 大量评估验证了方法优越性，在ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge的Track 1与Track 2均取得第一名。

Conclusion: 将单段人脸身份保持与多段连续动作生成纳入统一时序表述是有效路径；语义、视觉双重锚定加多生成器候选路由可同时兼顾身份保真与动作可控性。

Abstract: Identity-preserving video generation aims to synthesize high-quality and visually realistic videos from textual and visual conditions while faithfully maintaining the subject's identity across diverse motions. Prior methods have extensively introduced reference-guided control signals and identity-aware conditioning to improve facial alignment from reference images. However, improving static identity alignment alone creates a fundamental tension between identity fidelity and temporal controllability, which frequently causes identity drift or motion suppression under large pose variations and multi-segment sequential actions. To address this, we propose Chronos, a framework that unifies single-segment facial identity preservation and multi-segment sequential action generation under a common temporal formulation. Specifically, Chronos integrates Semantic Prompt Anchoring to adaptively refine the user prompt, Visual Frame Anchoring to transform conditions into visually grounded keyframe anchors for visual guidance, and Metric-Guided Candidate Routing to select the highest-quality videos from heterogeneous generators via multi-dimensional evaluation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the superiority of our approach, which achieved first place in both Track 1 and Track 2 of the ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge, demonstrating its effectiveness across both facial identity preservation and sequential action generation settings.

</details>
