*Ahmed Jaheen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在1345张CBIS-DDSM恶性视图上检验三种CNN的可视化解释图（Grad-CAM、Integrated Gradients、遮挡图）在致密乳腺中是否更差地定位病灶；未校正差距明显，但病例构成（主要是钙化更多）解释了约一半以上差距，仅遮挡图保留显著的平均−0.56 bit差距；结果表明应报告校正前后的密度差距并加入显著性/病灶依赖控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显著性图常被当作乳腺X线分类器"看的是癌"的证据，但其在致密乳腺（会遮蔽病灶）中的有效性从未被检验。作者旨在验证解释图在致密乳腺中定位病灶是否更差，并剖析其原因（影像难度 vs. 病例构成 vs. 模型本身）。

Method: 在1,345张CBIS-DDSM恶性视图上，对三个CNN生成的Grad-CAM、Integrated Gradients与遮挡（occlusion）图，用两项指标评分：峰值是否落在病灶内，以及经随机水平归一化的病灶-背景显著性比（单位bit，+1表示翻倍）。随后做病例构成校正（如组织类型、钙化比例），并引入两类对照：仅基于图像的"显著性/conspicuity"图与模型对致密乳腺病灶的依赖程度。

Result: 未校正差距较大：Grad-CAM峰值命中致密病灶44%、非致密58%。病例构成（主要为致密乳腺中钙化更多）解释了各项差距的约一半或更多；校正后仅遮挡图仍保留显著的平均−0.56 bit差距。对照结果亦指向分类器本身：未校正差距大于纯图像显著性图的差距，且模型对致密乳腺病灶的依赖更弱。

Conclusion: 显著性图的乳腺密度差距部分是病例构成造成的伪差异，部分是模型真实行为所致。建议按分类器分别报告密度差距（校正前与校正后），并辅以显著性图与病灶依赖度两类对照，以避免把解释图当作无条件可信的证据。

Abstract: Saliency maps, offered as evidence that mammography classifiers use the cancer, are untested in dense breasts, which can hide cancers. We tested whether they locate cancers worse there, and why. On 1,345 malignant CBIS-DDSM views, we scored three CNNs' Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients and occlusion maps by whether their peak hits the lesion and a chance-normalized lesion-to-background saliency ratio (bits; +1 doubles it). Unadjusted gaps were large: Grad-CAM peaks hit 44% of dense vs. 58% of non-dense lesions. Case mix, chiefly more calcifications in dense breasts, explained about half or more of each gap. Occlusion kept a significant average of -0.56 bit gap. Controls also implicate the classifiers: unadjusted gaps exceeded an image-only conspicuity map's, and models relied less on dense-breast lesions. We recommend reporting density gaps before and after case-mix adjustment, per classifier, with conspicuity and lesion-reliance controls.

</details>


### [42] [DecoupAttn: Decoupled Sparse Attention for Training-Free Acceleration of Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05917)
*Yanjin Li,Bingbing Qiu,Qiang Huang,Rui Qian,Yanfeng Li,Jian Wang,Xiaoying Tang,Mingda Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DecoupAttn，一种解耦式稀疏注意力范式：用语义聚类对全部 key 做补偿、用按位置离线固定的一小部分块做精确注意力纠错，并引入率失真目标 Distortion Budget 进行预算分配与 Reassign Cache 缓存漂移修正，实现免训练的少步视频扩散 Transformer 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步视频扩散 Transformer 的稀疏注意力存在三大问题：每步去噪都需重新识别关键块带来识别开销；稀疏预算按统一或局部指标分配而非最优；掩码/聚类复用失效导致跨步误差累积。

Method: 观察到被跳过块的残留误差在每个 key 都被补偿后会相互抵消，据此提出 DecoupAttn：语义聚类补偿所有 key，精确注意力仅在按位置离线固定一次的少量块上纠错；引入 Distortion Budget（率失真目标）在时间步、层、头之间分配精确计算以最小化补偿在最终 latent 中留下的失真；并提出 Reassign Cache，每步将漂移的 key 重新指派到缓存质心并刷新补偿，同时预算块保持固定。方法免训练：少量校准片段离线编译一套方案，推理仅用标准块稀疏核加一个融合补偿核。

Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；仅表明该方案可减少识别开销、实现跨时间步/层/头的失真最优预算分配，并缓解跨步误差累积。

Conclusion: DecoupAttn 以“聚类补偿全部 key + 固定少量块精确纠错”的解耦范式重构稀疏注意力，配合 Distortion Budget 与 Reassign Cache，作为一种免训练方案加速少步视频扩散 Transformer，代码将在投稿后释放。

Abstract: Sparse attention accelerates few-step video diffusion transformers by computing a few key blocks exactly and compensating for the rest. However, existing sparse attention still faces key challenges, including identification overhead from finding critical blocks at every denoising step, suboptimal budget allocation that sets sparsity budgets uniformly or by local metrics, and cross-step error accumulation as reused masks or clusters go stale. Observing that the errors left on skipped blocks cancel each other once every key is compensated, we propose DecoupAttn, a new paradigm of decoupled sparse attention: semantic clusters compensate every key, and exact attention corrects their error on a few blocks fixed once offline by position. To support this paradigm, we introduce Distortion Budget, a rate-distortion objective for budget allocation that places exact computation across timesteps, layers, and heads where it removes the most distortion that compensation leaves in the final latent. Built on this budget, we further propose Reassign Cache, in which each step reassigns the drifting keys to cached centroids and refreshes compensation while the budgeted blocks stay fixed. Moreover, DecoupAttn is training-free: a few calibration clips compile one plan offline, and inference runs standard block-sparse kernels with one fused compensation kernel. Our code will be released after submission.

</details>

*Yanfan Zhu,Junchao Zhu,Ruining Deng,Shilin Zhao,Yu Wang,Yaohong Wang,Yuechen Yang,Chongyu Qu,Zhengyi Lu,Juming Xiong,Mengmeng Yin,Yihan Wang,Andrew J. Rauch,Haichun Yang,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3D Banff病灶评分框架，通过序列切片配准、跨深度肾小球身份重建与3D炎症细胞计数，将肾移植活检的肾小球炎评分从2D扩展到3D，并验证其一致性与临床相关性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Banff评分基于单张全切片并采用"最严重切片"规则，但病灶分布本质上是三维的，当炎症在切片间变化时，2D评估可能导致评分不稳定。

Method: 提出3D Banff病灶评分框架：对齐序列切片、跨深度重建肾小球身份、在3D下整合炎症细胞计数；设计三种评分策略——Compatible、Volumetric、Deduplicated Volumetric；以肾小球炎（g评分）为示例指标应用于多切片同种异体肾移植活检。

Result: 3D Banff g评分在切片间一致性更高；在半自动设置下，Volumetric策略与临床生物标志物的相关性优于传统2D评分。

Conclusion: 3D体积化定量具有潜在附加价值，3D感知的Banff评分对肾移植病理学具有应用前景。

Abstract: Quantifying glomerular inflammation in kidney-transplant biopsies is traditionally performed on single whole-slide sections using the Banff "most-severe section" rule, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of lesion distribution. This 2D based assessment might lead to instability when inflammation varies across slices. This paper reports a feasibility study examining the technical feasibility and clinical relevance of extending Banff scoring into three dimensions. To this end, we propose a 3D Banff lesion-scoring framework that aligns serial sections, reconstructs glomerular identities across depth, and integrates inflammatory-cell counts in 3D under three scoring strategies: Compatible, Volumetric, and Deduplicated Volumetric. In the experiments, glomerulitis (g-scores) was used as an example Banff metric and applied to multi-section renal allograft biopsies. Our findings indicate that 3D Banff g-scores are more consistent across sections and, under the semi-automatic setting, the Volumetric strategy correlates more strongly with clinical biomarkers than traditional 2D scores. These results show that 3D volumetric quantification offers promising added value, underscoring the potential benefit of 3D-aware Banff scoring for kidney transplant pathology.

</details>


### [44] [Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05927)
*Donggeun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的模态感知专家剪枝框架MAEP，通过单次前向将专家重要性按模态分解，用ΔH度量与低注意力视觉token信号实现全局专家排序剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE-MLLM中专家参数占模型体积90%以上，但每token仅激活少数专家；现有专家剪枝方法对所有token统一聚合重要性，忽视了同一专家在视觉与语言处理中承担的角色差异。

Method: 免训练框架：单次前向中按模态分解专家重要性；提出ΔH（Delta-H Output），以移除专家后MoE输出的变化衡量重分配感知的重要性；以低注意力视觉token作为视觉侧剪枝信号（其专家重要性排序跨数据集稳定）；文本侧重要性作为保留信号、视觉侧作为剪枝信号，跨层全局排序专家。

Result: 在三个MoE-MLLM上于多模态与文本基准测试，多数多模态基准优于模态无关基线，纯文本任务保持竞争性；BF16专家权重减少约27 GB（约占总内存47%），使约58 GB模型全权重可装入单张40 GB GPU。

Conclusion: 模态感知的专家重要性分解是MoE-MLLM高效压缩的有效方向，可在几乎不损多模态性能的前提下显著降低显存占用，实现单卡部署。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to scale capacity efficiently, but expert parameters dominate memory even though only a few experts are activated per token: they account for over 90% of model size in modern MoE-MLLMs (e.g., 54 GB out of about 58 GB in BF16 for InternVL3.5-30B-A3B and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B). Expert pruning has emerged as an effective compression strategy, but existing methods aggregate importance uniformly across tokens, ignoring that the same expert may serve different roles for vision versus language processing. To address this, we propose MAEP (Modality-Aware Expert Pruning), a training-free framework that decomposes expert importance by modality in a single forward pass. MAEP introduces (1) Delta-H Output ($ΔH$), a redistribution-aware metric measuring the MoE output change when an expert is removed, and (2) low-attention vision tokens as a vision-side pruning signal that is dataset-stable: its expert-importance ranking remains stable across different datasets. Text-side importance serves as a preservation signal while vision-side importance serves as a pruning signal, and experts are ranked globally across layers. Experiments on three MoE-based MLLMs across multimodal and text benchmarks show that MAEP outperforms modality-agnostic baselines on the majority of multimodal benchmarks while remaining competitive on text-only tasks, reducing the BF16 expert weight footprint by about 27 GB (about 47% of total memory) so that the full weight footprint of an approximately 58 GB model fits within a single 40 GB GPU. Code is available at https://github.com/nota-github/MAEP.

</details>


### [45] [FLINT: Coupling Proximal Initialization and Bounded Stochasticity for Flow-Matching Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05945)
*Junseo Bang,Daewon Choi,Dong Ju Mun,Se Young Chun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示扩散/流匹配逆问题求解中"轨迹空间"与"源空间"两类方法本质耦合，提出统一稳定性界与两阶段框架FLINT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配后验采样求解器分轨迹空间与源空间两条独立路线，多数工作将其视为互不相关的设计选择，缺乏对二者关系的理论刻画，导致优化冗余与性能不稳定。

Method: 理论推导统一稳定性界，以乘性包络连接初始化接近度与累积采样随机性；辅以两项经验观察（源优化充分性区间、初始化优势易被过度随机性侵蚀）。据此提出FLINT两阶段框架：阶段一以流形约束的近端目标在少数迭代内获得高保真初始点；阶段二在有界随机性调度下进行引导采样。

Result: 在多种逆问题中，FLINT取得最先进的感知质量与具竞争力的失真指标，同时保持更优计算效率。

Conclusion: 轨迹空间与源空间方法并非独立，应联合设计；适度源优化配合随机性约束即可接近性能上限，为高效后验采样提供理论与实践依据。

Abstract: Flow matching models have emerged as a dominant paradigm for generative posterior sampling in imaging inverse problems. Existing solvers follow two distinct lines of work: trajectory-space methods, which refine sampling dynamics from random initial noise, and source-space methods, which optimize the initial noise itself. While most prior work treats these as independent design choices, we show that they are inherently coupled. We derive a unified stability bound that links initialization proximity and cumulative sampling stochasticity through a multiplicative envelope, complemented by two empirical observations. First, we identify a sufficiency regime in which a moderately optimized proximal source initialization is enough to attain the performance plateau, rendering exhaustive source-space optimization unnecessary. Second, this initial advantage is fragile: it is eroded by excessive stochasticity accumulation during guided sampling, necessitating a mechanism that bounds the cumulative noise injection. These findings motivate FLINT, a two-stage framework that operationalizes this coupling. FLINT establishes a high-fidelity starting point via a manifold-constrained proximal objective in only a few iterations, then performs guided sampling under a bounded stochasticity schedule that helps prevent erasure of the initialization advantage. Across diverse inverse problems, FLINT delivers state of the art perceptual quality and competitive distortion metrics while maintaining superior computational efficiency.

</details>


### [46] [CLEAR: Color-Texture Latent Alignment for Single Image Reflection Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05969)
*Tu Vo,Sheir A. Zaheer,Chan Y. Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLEAR：确定性的单步、非迭代潜空间框架，用预训练潜扩散先验加物理引导分离器与混合特征对齐模块（HFAM），解决SIRR中跳连回传导致反射边缘复现的问题，在六个真实基准上取得最佳平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练生成先验的潜空间恢复方法，习惯把退化输入的高频特征通过跳连喂回解码器来恢复细节。这对模糊、噪声、雾等退化有效（输入细节基本属于场景），但SIRR中反射是叠加的第二层结构化内容，直接复用跳连会在锐化图像的同时把反射边缘带回；此外潜空间压缩还带来色偏与细节损失。

Method: 提出CLEAR（Color-Texture LatEnt Alignment）：以预训练潜扩散骨干作自然图像先验，采用确定性、单时间步、非迭代推理。包含两部分：(1) 物理引导分离器，围绕透射-反射-残差的成像形成模型组织预测，一次前向输出各层的粗潜表示；(2) 混合特征对齐模块（HFAM），将输入派生的跳连视为受污染的层混合特征，用与干净透射对齐的颜色查询对其高频内容进行校正，该查询由输入特征自身在GT特征监督下学习得到，从而保留透射一致的纹理并抑制带反射色彩的细节。

Result: 在六个真实世界基准上，CLEAR在保真度与感知指标的综合平均上最优；在所有数据集上取得最低LPIPS；在最难的基准上增益最大。

Conclusion: 对SIRR而言，不应无条件复用输入的高频跳连；将跳连显式建模为受污染的层混合特征并加以颜色-纹理对齐，可在单步确定性潜框架下兼顾保真度与感知质量。

Abstract: Single Image Reflection Removal (SIRR) seeks to recover the transmitted scene from a photograph captured through glass. Recent latent restoration methods use pretrained generative priors, but many recover detail by feeding high-frequency features from the degraded input back into the decoder. This works for degradations such as blur, noise, or haze, where input detail mostly belongs to the scene. It is less suitable for SIRR, where reflections add a second structured layer: directly reusing the input's skip connections can sharpen the image while also bringing reflection edges back. Latent compression also introduces color drift and fine-detail loss.
  We propose CLEAR (Color-Texture LatEnt Alignment for Single Image Reflection Removal), a deterministic, single-timestep, non-iterative latent framework that uses a pretrained latent diffusion backbone as a natural-image prior. A physics-guided separator organizes the prediction around the transmission, reflection, and residue formation model and outputs coarse layer latents in one forward pass. The Hybrid Feature Alignment Module (HFAM) then treats input-derived skips as contaminated layer-mixture features. It rectifies their high-frequency content with a clean-transmission-aligned color query, learned from the input features themselves under ground-truth feature supervision, keeping transmission-consistent texture while attenuating reflection-colored detail. CLEAR achieves the best average across fidelity and perceptual metrics on six real-world benchmarks and the lowest LPIPS on every dataset, with the largest gains on the hardest benchmarks.

</details>


### [47] [PathoS2VD: From 2D Histopathology to Pseudo Z-Stack Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05974)
*Jiamu Wang,Keunho Byeon,Ji-Uk Kim,Jin Tae Kwak,Heounjeong Go*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出生成式框架，从病理z-stack数据学习z轴形态先验，用I2V潜扩散模型由单张2D切片合成伪z-stack，并结合保先验混合微调策略适配大规模临床数据，提升前列腺癌分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 诊断病理学长期依赖二维薄切片，而组织本身具有三维形态结构；单张切片仅捕获单一焦平面，z轴方向的重要形态线索被丢弃，限制了人工判读与计算分析中的组织表征能力。专用三维容积成像成本高、难以大规模获取。

Method: 1) 以图像到视频（I2V）潜扩散模型（LDM）为核心，从病理z-stack数据中学习z轴形态先验；2) 训练模型从单张2D图像合成伪z-stack，目标为生成跨相邻焦平面的合理形态变化，而非重建真实组织体；3) 提出保先验混合微调（prior-preserving mixture fine-tuning）策略，在无原生z-stack采集的大规模临床数据集上实现域适配，同时保留已学先验。

Result: 实验显示合成的伪z-stack具有真实的跨平面形态连续性，且相较传统2D表征在前列腺癌分类下游任务上取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 从有限z-stack数据中学习可迁移的z轴先验，可为常规病理图像补充互补形态信息，是一种低成本、实用的表征增强途径。代码已开源（PathoS2VD）。

Abstract: For decades, diagnostic pathology has relied on thin two-dimensional (2D) tissue sections, despite biological tissues exhibiting inherently three-dimensional (3D) morphological organization. Because a single section captures only one focal plane, important morphological cues along the z-axis are inevitably discarded, limiting tissue representation for both human interpretation and computational analysis. In this work, we propose a generative framework that learns z-axis morphological priors from pathology z-stack data, offering a cost-effective alternative to dedicated volumetric imaging, and transfers this knowledge to conventional single-plane histopathology. Specifically, an image-to-video (I2V) latent diffusion model (LDM) is trained to synthesize a pseudo z-stack from a single 2D image, capturing plausible morphological variations across adjacent focal planes rather than reconstructing physical tissue volumes. To enable deployment on large-scale clinical datasets without native z-stack acquisition, we further introduce a prior-preserving mixture fine-tuning strategy that adapts the model to new domains while retaining the learned z-axis morphological prior. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the synthesized pseudo z-stacks exhibit realistic cross-plane morphological continuity and consistently improve downstream prostate cancer classification compared with conventional 2D representations. Our results suggest that learning transferable z-axis priors from limited z-stack data provides a practical way to enrich routine pathology images with complementary morphological information. Code: https://github.com/QuIIL/PathoS2VD.

</details>


### [48] [Clips2Story: Training-Free Video Storyboarding and Editing Using Multimodal Retrieval-Embedded Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05992)
*Junnuo Wang,Weihan Xu,Hao-Wen Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的LLM流水线Clips2Story，从无序碎片化视频片段池中按用户关键词检索片段、由LLM筛选并编排为带连接旁白的可编辑故事板，最终合成短视频；并构建基于100个长视频、跨5类题材、打乱时序的合成评测集验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频编辑者常面对大量碎片化素材，需挑选并组织成连贯叙事；但现有视频编辑与摘要方法多假设源视频时序有序、以保留原叙事与时间结构为目标，难以处理无时序的片段池与关键词驱动的创作需求。

Method: 免训练、基于LLM的流水线：1）对每个片段提取文本化多模态描述子，并据此检索与关键词最相关的候选片段；2）将候选片段的文本描述交给LLM，由其筛选排序生成可编辑故事板并撰写连接性旁白；3）拼接所选片段并为旁白检索配图，合成输出视频。评测方面，从5类题材的100个长视频出发，用场景切换检测模型切分为短片段并打乱以去除时序，构建合成评测数据集。

Result: 客观评测与定性示例表明，Clips2Story能有效检索关键词相关片段并生成连贯故事板；人工评测显示其在叙事连贯性、关键词对齐度与整体真实感上均优于强基线。

Conclusion: 无需训练即可将无序片段池组织为关键词对齐的连贯短视频，为碎片化素材的自动化叙事编排提供了可行方案；但评测依赖合成数据集与VLM/LLM描述质量，真实创作场景的泛化性仍有待验证。

Abstract: Video editors often work with large collections of fragmented footage and must select and organize relevant clips into a coherent story. However, many existing video editing and summarization methods assume a temporally ordered source video and aim to preserve its original narrative and temporal structure. In this paper, we introduce Clips2Story, a training-free, LLM-based pipeline that enables users to create keyword-specified short videos from a pool of video clips. Given a pool of clips and a user-specified keyword, we first extract text-based multimodal descriptors for each clip and retrieve the clips most relevant to the keyword. We then provide the textual descriptors of these candidate clips to an LLM, which selects and arranges them into an editable storyboard with connective narrations. Finally, we assemble the selected clips and retrieve accompanying visuals for the narrations to compose the output video. To evaluate the proposed pipeline, we construct a synthetic evaluation dataset from 100 long-form videos across five genres by segmenting each video into short clips using a scene-change detection model and shuffling the resulting clips to remove their temporal order. Through objective evaluation and qualitative examples, we demonstrate that Clips2Story can effectively retrieve keyword-relevant clips and compose coherent storyboards based on user-specified keywords. Human evaluation further shows that Clips2Story outperforms a strong baseline in terms of narrative coherence, keyword alignment, and overall realism.

</details>


### [49] [FedIA: Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations for Federated Prompt Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05994)
*Xuanjing Zhang,Qi Guo,Yanan Qiao,Yong Han,Junge Bo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FedIA：将联邦提示学习中的个性化从“客户端级”推进到“实例级”，通过实例感知的跨模态表征生成与自适应全局-局部融合提升异构联邦场景下的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 FPL 方法采用“全局共享提示 + 客户端本地提示”的范式，但本地提示对同一客户端内所有样本固定使用，且全局/局部提示以输入无关的固定方式组合；由此忽略了客户端内部样本间的显著视觉差异，无法按输入自适应调节共享知识与个性化知识的比重。

Method: FedIA 框架包含三步：(1) 以全局文本提示作为客户端不变的语义锚点，为每个候选类别筛选最相关的图像 patch，抑制干扰区域；(2) 用筛选出的视觉证据条件化生成实例感知的局部文本表征；(3) 设计自适应全局-局部融合模块，针对每个“图像-类别”对校准局部与全局文本表征的贡献。

Result: 在域偏移、病态标签偏斜与 Dirichlet 标签偏斜三种设置下均优于 FPL 基线，相对最新基线最大精度提升为 1.44%–4.37%；消融与分析验证了实例感知表征生成与自适应全局-局部融合的互补作用。

Conclusion: FedIA 在保留跨客户端共享语义知识的同时，把 FPL 的个性化粒度由客户端级下移至实例级，为异构联邦场景下视觉-语言模型的高效适配提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Federated Prompt Learning (FPL) enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision-Language Models across decentralized clients without exchanging raw data. To cope with cross-client heterogeneity, existing FPL methods typically pair a globally shared prompt with a client-specific local prompt. However, this design personalizes only at the client level: the same local prompt is applied to all samples of a client, and the global and local prompts are combined in an input-agnostic, fixed manner. Consequently, it overlooks the substantial visual variations among samples within the same client and cannot adjust the balance between shared and personalized knowledge to each input. To address these limitations, we propose Federated Prompt Learning with Instance-Aware Cross-Modal Representations (FedIA), an FPL framework that learns instance-aware cross-modal representations. Specifically, FedIA first uses global text prompts as client-invariant semantic anchors to select image patches most relevant to each candidate class, suppressing distracting regions. The selected visual evidence then conditions the generation of instance-aware local text representations. Finally, an adaptive global-local fusion module calibrates the contributions of local and global text representations for each image-class pair. In this way, FedIA shifts personalization in FPL from the client level to the instance level while preserving the semantic knowledge shared across clients. Extensive experiments under domain shift, pathological label skew, and Dirichlet-based label skew show that FedIA outperforms FPL baselines, with maximum accuracy gains of 1.44\%-4.37\% over the latest baseline across the three settings. Ablation studies and analyses further verify the complementary contributions of instance-aware representation generation and adaptive global-local fusion.

</details>


### [50] [Intra-Architecture Source Attribution for Stable Diffusion: A New Task with Benchmark Dataset and Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06000)
*Ashutosh Dayal,Mallika Garg,Debashis Sen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出新任务IntrAA-SD：在同架构、仅微调不同的Stable Diffusion模型间进行图像来源归因，并构建14万张SDXL微调模型图像基准数据集及基于风格条件MoE的基线框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像来源归因数据集与系统多针对源模型的架构指纹检测，无法区分共享同一骨干、仅因微调而不同的模型（如Juggernaut XL、RealVis XL等SDXL微调版本），这一现实需求尚未被覆盖。

Method: 构建首个IntrAA-SD基准数据集（14万张图，来自SDXL不同微调版本，含域内与分布外提示词）；提出基线框架：冻结CLIP骨干提取图像风格并对MoE进行门控，MoE处理来自高分辨率LoRA适配DINOv2网络的微调痕迹特征。

Result: 在自建数据集上以归因准确率评估基线方法，并开展消融实验；所用微调模型、提示策略与数据集构建细节均有详述。

Conclusion: 同架构微调模型间的来源归因是可定义且可基准化的新问题，风格条件MoE结合LoRA-DINOv2痕迹特征构成有效基线，数据集与代码已开源。

Abstract: Designing systems that attribute a generated image to its source model has lately become a major area of AI research. Most existing datasets and systems related to image source attribution are targeted towards the detection of architectural signatures of the source models. Distinct from this, focusing on stable diffusion, we introduce a novel task, IntrAA-SD, Intra-Architecture source Attribution for Stable Diffusion, where the source models to be differentiated share the same architectural backbone and differ only due to fine-tuning. The proposed task aligns with the emergence of fine-tuned generators having the same architecture, like Juggernaut XL and RealVis XL, which are fine-tuned versions of Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL). We provide a first-of-its-kind $140$K-image benchmark dataset containing images generated from different fine-tunes of SDXL, along with in-domain and out-of-distribution prompts. We also provide a baseline framework for IntrAA-SD, which leverages a style-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts network. It uses a frozen CLIP backbone to capture the image style and gate the MoE, which processes fine-tuned trace features from a high-resolution LoRA-adapted DINOv2 network. The fine-tuned models used, the prompting strategies considered, and the formation details employed in the novel dataset are elaborated. Our baseline intra-architecture source attribution method is evaluated in terms of attribution accuracy on our dataset, and ablation studies are also performed. Code and dataset is available at https://github.com/mallikagarg/IntrAA-SD.

</details>


### [51] [MotoVerse: A Benchmark for Predictive Perception of Motorized Two-Wheelers in Dense Unstructured Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06007)
*Varun A. Paturkar,Shankar Gangisetty,C. V. Jawahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MotoVerse基准，面向两轮机动车（MTW）自车视角的预测性感知，含949个机动片段、3.1万+交通参与者轨迹标注（其中1.6万+为MTW），定义ERMA（自车机动预判）与TATP（交通参与者轨迹预测）两项任务，并附带MTW专用挑战分类体系用于挑战感知评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MTW在全球南方个人出行中占主导，但在自动驾驶与ADAS的预测性感知研究中被严重忽视；现有基准缺乏密集非结构化交通、自车视角与MTW特定挑战的覆盖。

Method: 构建自车视角机动片段数据集并进行轨迹标注；提出MTW特化挑战分类（动态自车运动、弱交通结构、上下文遮挡）；评测传统预测模型、通用VLM、驾驶专用VLM及视觉-语言-动作模型，含零样本与LoRA适配对比。

Result: (i) 视频骨干在前五分之一机动时段即达到接近全观测精度，零样本VLM则需观测大部分机动过程；(ii) 零样本VLM（通用或驾驶专用）在两任务上接近简单基线，LoRA适配显著提升机动预判但轨迹预测仍落后传统模型；(iii) 自车运动是难度主因——左转时误差最高，动态自车运动下误差上升，静态基线亦然。

Conclusion: MotoVerse为更安全、更鲁棒的智能两轮车预测AI提供具挑战性的基准，数据与评测代码已开源。

Abstract: Motorized Two-Wheelers (MTWs) dominate personal transport across much of the Global South, yet remain largely overlooked in predictive perception research for autonomous driving and ADAS. We introduce MotoVerse, a benchmark for predictive perception from an MTW's ego-centric perspective. MotoVerse comprises 949 maneuver clips collected in dense, unstructured traffic and trajectory annotations for over 31,000 surrounding road agents, including over 16,000 MTWs, enabling two complementary tasks: Ego-Rider Maneuver Anticipation (ERMA) and Traffic Agent Trajectory Prediction (TATP). Each clip is further annotated with an MTW-specific challenge taxonomy comprising dynamic ego-motion, weak traffic structure and contextual occlusion, enabling challenge-aware evaluation. We benchmark established conventional prediction models, general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs), driving-specific VLMs and vision-language-action models. Our experiments reveal three key insights: (i) video backbones reach most of their full-observation accuracy from the first fifth of a maneuver, whereas zero-shot VLMs need most of the maneuver to be observed; (ii) zero-shot VLMs, whether general-purpose or driving-specific, largely remain close to simple baselines on both tasks; a preliminary LoRA study shows that adaptation lifts anticipation sharply but leaves trajectory prediction behind conventional models; and (iii) the rider's own motion drives forecasting difficulty: for every model, including a static baseline, errors are highest during left turns and rise under dynamic ego-motion. We believe MotoVerse will serve as a challenging benchmark for safer and more robust predictive AI for intelligent two-wheelers. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/VarunIIITH/MotoVerse.

</details>


### [52] [ChanSFormer: A Channel Agnostic Vision Transformer for Multi-Channel Cell Painting Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06015)
*Jingwei Zhang,Srinivasan Sivanandan,Dimitris Samaras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ChanSFormer，用解耦的空间-通道注意力和独立通道CLS token替代可学习通道嵌入，实现真正的通道无关高内容多通道图像骨干，兼顾通道身份与跨通道交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高内容多通道成像（Cell Painting、遥感等）通道异构且实验配置不断演化，现有通道自适应ViT依赖全局自注意力和可学习通道嵌入，只能处理已知通道；应对新通道时要么丢弃嵌入失去通道身份，要么逐通道独立处理而丧失跨通道交互。

Method: ChanSFormer：以解耦的空间-通道注意力取代刚性通道嵌入，并为每个通道设置独立的CLS token，从而原生保留通道特异身份与跨通道信息流；该token设计还支持更具信息量的自监督表征学习与基于表征的通道采样，且保持通道无关性。

Result: 在CHAMMI、JUMP-CP与So2Sat上评测：JUMP-CP分类准确率较SOTA提升3.93%–4.27%；自监督跨数据集迁移在同任务上最多提升2.72%；解耦注意力降低通道×空间序列长度的二次复杂度，吞吐提升55%–313%。

Conclusion: ChanSFormer以解耦注意力与独立通道CLS token实现通道无关且可扩展的多通道视觉骨干，在准确率、迁移性与计算效率上均优于现有方法，适用于生物成像与遥感等多通道场景。

Abstract: High-content multi-channel imaging, from Cell Painting assays to remote sensing, is central to modern scientific pipelines. Because these channels are highly heterogeneous and experimental configurations frequently evolve, a practical vision backbone must be fundamentally channel-agnostic. Current channel-adaptive vision transformers rely on global self-attention with learnable channel embeddings, which can be computed only for previously known channels. Attempts to overcome this limitation of new channels either discard the embeddings, losing channel identity, or process each channel independently, thereby eliminating critical cross-channel interactions. To address this, we introduce ChanSFormer, an efficient Vision Transformer that replaces rigid embeddings with disentangled spatial-channel attention and individual channel CLS tokens. This architecture natively preserves both distinct channel identities and cross-channel information flow. Furthermore, the individual channel class token design unlocks more informative feature representations for self-supervised learning and enables representation-based channel sampling while remaining channel-agnostic. We evaluate ChanSFormer on two biology multi-channel datasets, CHAMMI, JUMP-CP and a satellite dataset, So2Sat. Experimental results show that ChanSFormer outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 3.93%-4.27% on JUMP-CP in classification accuracy. It also demonstrates exceptional cross-dataset transferability under a self-supervised setting, outperforming previous methods by up to 2.72% in accuracy in the same classification tasks. Furthermore, the disentangled attention reduces the quadratic complexity of channel-by-spatial sequence length of the global attention baseline, thus improving throughput by 55%-313%. Code is available at https://github.com/cvlab-stonybrook/ChanSFormer.

</details>


### [53] [METRIC-GS: Selective Metric-Scale Estimation for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06020)
*Sooyeun Yang,Jongseong Brad Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出METRIC-GS——一种面向真实室内照片的选择性尺度估计器：从3DGS重建自身的语义内容中读取尺度，并在证据不足时显式弃权（abstention）作为路由信号。在47个ScanNet++场景上，单独估计将启发式平均误差从21.1%降至16.6%（其实际作用的28个场景上为9.3%，约11秒/场景）；仅将弃权样本路由给MASt3R，可在减少60%调用量的同时达到全量运行的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS重建继承SfM的任意尺度单位，无法直接测量或用于放置AR内容，必须外部提供尺度。现有两类标准方案在真实拍摄中均不稳定：分位数地板-天花板启发式误差27%，度量深度对齐在三个网络上误差达35-71%，因此需要一个在证据充分时可靠、证据不足时能拒绝并转交重型模型的尺度估计方案。

Method: 冻结的2D教师模型通过可见性感知投票（visibility-aware voting）为高斯打语义标签；对建筑与家具类（门、桌、地板-天花板间距）的实例级尺寸先验进行鲁棒最大似然融合；以inlier-mass检验将稀疏证据转化为显式弃权，并作为路由至重型度量模型（MASt3R）的切换条件。配置在公开评测前冻结。

Result: 47个ScanNet++场景（激光真值）上，估计器单独将平均误差由21.1%降至16.6%，作用场景为9.3%，约11秒/场景；MASt3R单独估计更准（9.9%），但仅路由弃权样本即可在减少60%调用量下匹配全量精度。可见性感知投票使可作用场景由16增至28且部署精度不变。在自有13段手机/无人机拍摄上（MASt3R自身配准门控失败12次），系统对可作用的5段全部改善、无退化。此外，某前馈度量模型在其训练混合内部基准上得2.3%，在未见数据上为28-35%，说明已发表的度量尺度数字属最优情况而非部署估计。

Conclusion: 选择性（拒绝）机制与精度同等重要：显式弃权可低成本地将困难样本路由至重型模型，形成"轻量估计+按需重算"的混合配置。同时，论文强调基准内在性能与分布外性能存在数量级差距，提示度量尺度评估应报告部署条件下的表现。

Abstract: A 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstruction inherits arbitrary units from structure-from-motion, so it cannot be measured or used to place AR content until someone supplies a scale. Both standard recipes are fragile on real captures: on five indoor scenes with tape-measured ceilings, a quantile floor-to-ceiling heuristic errs by 27% and metric-depth alignment by 35-71% across three networks. We present METRIC-GS, a selective scale estimator for real indoor photographs: it reads the scale off the reconstruction's own semantic content and, just as importantly, refuses when the evidence is thin. A frozen 2D teacher labels Gaussians by visibility-aware voting; instance-level size priors for architectural and furniture classes (doors, tables, the floor-to-ceiling gap) are fused by a robust maximum-likelihood step; and an inlier-mass test turns thin evidence into an explicit abstention that doubles as a router to a heavyweight metric model. On 47 ScanNet++ scenes with laser ground truth, with a configuration frozen before public evaluation, the estimator alone cuts the heuristic's mean error from 21.1% to 16.6% (9.3% on the 28 scenes it acts on) at ~11 s per scene. MASt3R remains the more accurate standalone estimator (9.9%), but routing only our refusals to it matches running it everywhere with 60% fewer invocations; this selective hybrid is the configuration we advocate. Visibility-aware voting raises the scenes the estimator can act on from 16 to 28 at unchanged deployed accuracy. Applied unchanged to 13 phone and drone captures of our own, on which MASt3R fails its own registration gate 12 times, the system improves all five captures it acts on and degrades none. We also report that a current feed-forward metric model scores 2.3% on a benchmark inside its training mixture and 28-35% on captures it has never seen: a published metric-scale number is a best case, not a deployment estimate.

</details>


### [54] [USI-Brain: Enhancing Underwater Spatial Intelligence via Spatial Data-Driven Vision-Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06040)
*Zhiliang Zhu,Zhiqiang Zhao,Xie'an Jiang,Yingxin Lai,Kangye Zheng,Dawei Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出水下空间数据引擎构建4.27M QA语料，训练USI-Brain并引入UPR整流器，在USI-Bench等基准上平均提升5.76–7.63分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下空间推理依赖目标边界与几何线索，但散射、颜色失真和低能见度使其被遮蔽；现有水下数据以图像、标注和深度图形式提供的是碎片化监督，难以支撑视觉语言模型。

Method: 构建空间数据引擎：通过图像增强、基于2D与几何辅助的问题生成、专家过滤，将视觉外观与目标级几何关联，产出覆盖五类能力组的4.27M QA对；据此训练USI-Brain，并提出水下先验引导整流器（UPR），对视觉特征施加门控修正。

Result: USI-Bench以6,525条留出QA评估15项任务指标；相较Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，USI-Brain与USI-Brain+UPR平均分别提升5.76与7.63分（百分制带符号差）。消融显示：关闭UPR时几何辅助监督使深度与排序提升4.8/6.1分；在训练数据匹配下UPR使场景描述提升18.0分。评估均使用原始图像。在NautData、UWBench、MarineEval上，32项指标中28项取得最佳或并列最佳。

Conclusion: 几何辅助监督与UPR门控修正可有效注入水下空间先验，且无需推理时的增强输入；模型权重与USI-Bench将开源。

Abstract: Underwater spatial reasoning depends on object boundaries and geometric cues that are obscured by scattering, color distortion, and low visibility. Existing underwater resources capture these cues through images, annotations, and depth maps, but provide fragmented supervision for vision-language models. We present a spatial data engine that connects visual appearance with object-level geometry through enhancement, 2D and geometry-assisted question generation, and expert filtering. It produces 4.27M QA pairs across five capability groups. We use this corpus to train USI-Brain and introduce an Underwater Prior-guided Rectifier (UPR) that applies gated corrections to visual features. USI-Bench evaluates the resulting capabilities with 6,525 held-out QA pairs. On its 15 task metrics, USI-Brain and USI-Brain + UPR improve over Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by 5.76 and 7.63 points on average, respectively, using signed differences on 100-point scales. Ablations show that geometry-assisted supervision improves depth and ordering by 4.8 and 6.1 points with UPR disabled, while UPR adds 18.0 points in scene description under matched training data. Both variants use raw images at evaluation. Across NautData, UWBench, and MarineEval, USI-Brain achieves the best or joint-best score on 28 of 32 metrics. Model weights and USI-Bench will be released at https://github.com/SKY-Zhu-91/USI-Brain.

</details>


### [55] [UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06042)
*Jingbo Lin,Zhilu Zhang,Fan Li,Renjing Pei,Wenbo Li,Hang Xu,Hongzhi Zhang,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniRestorer++ 提出基于多粒度退化建模的可扩展统一图像复原框架，将容量扩展与退化专门化耦合，并构建 CDD-50 基准验证其近对数线性的扩展规律与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一图像复原缺乏可靠的扩展（scaling）策略：单纯加深加宽主干会导致性能饱和；而基于退化感知的专门化方案依赖准确的退化估计，在分布外与真实场景输入上易受估计误差影响。

Method: 提出多粒度退化建模框架：渐进细化退化分组并引入组专属专家，使容量增长与专门化同步；采用退化估计路由选择根到叶路径，粒度估计路由在该路径上选择层级以平衡专门化与鲁棒性；构建空间稠密退化表示图，实现面向空间非均匀退化的区域感知路由；并建立 CDD-50 基准（50 类退化，从单退化到五重退化）。

Result: 在评估的模型规模范围内呈现约对数线性的 PSNR 增长趋势；相比朴素 MoE 扩展，在分布外与真实数据上取得更强的扩展收益；在多个基准上达到 SOTA，并在真实图像上展现零样本泛化与少样本迁移能力。

Conclusion: 多粒度退化建模是一种有效且可扩展的统一图像复原范式，通过层级化专家与双重路由机制兼顾专门化与鲁棒性，为统一复原模型的规模化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. We propose UniRestorer++, a scalable framework based on multi-granularity degradation modeling. It progressively refines degradation groups and introduces group-specific experts, coupling capacity growth with specialization. Degradation-estimation-based routing selects a root-to-leaf path, while granularity-estimation-based routing chooses a level along that path to balance specialization and robustness. Spatially dense degradation representation maps further enable region-aware routing for spatially non-uniform corruptions. We develop CDD-50, a benchmark covering 50 degradation categories from single to penta-degradation. Experiments show approximately log-linear PSNR trends over the evaluated model-size range and stronger scaling gains on out-of-distribution and real-world data than vanilla MoE scaling. UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images. Code: https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus

</details>


### [56] [DeepfakeGenome: Toward Next-Generation Deepfake Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06046)
*Shunli Wang,Xinyu Zhou,Yandan Zhao,Wenbin Liang,Taiping Yao,Ke-Yue Zhang,Zhiyuan Yan,Shouhong Ding,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeepfakeGenome (DFG) 深度伪造检测与归因基准，含100种伪造算法、约200万图像，规模为已有DFA基准的4–100倍，并设计4种评测协议（含检索式归因范式），通过2000+实验得出10条结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIGC可生成高逼真伪造人脸，威胁人脸安全；现有Deepfake检测与归因研究存在二分类性能饱和、数据集与算法多样性不足、评测协议不完善等问题，严重制约实际应用。

Method: 构建DeepfakeGenome基准：100种人脸伪造算法、共200万图像；设计4种面向实际应用的评测协议，其中提出基于检索的归因范式，其指标更契合黑名单注册机制的主动防御场景，并据此探究深度伪造归因任务的性能上限。

Result: 数据集规模较先前DFA基准扩大4–100倍；完成逾2000次实验评测，归纳出10条有洞察力的发现，并揭示归因任务的性能天花板。

Conclusion: DFG为深度伪造归因研究提供了大规模、多样化且评测协议更贴近实战的基准平台，可为该领域带来新见解；代码与基准已公开。

Abstract: In recent years, AIGC technologies are capable of generating hyper-realistic forged facial images, posing severe threats to facial security safety. To tackle these challenges, early Deepfake research primarily centered on real-fake classification. Recently, growing efforts have been devoted to the Deepfake Attribution (DFA) of generated content. Nevertheless, existing research on Deepfake detection and attribution faces saturated performance in binary classification, limited diversity in datasets and algorithms, and imperfect evaluation protocols, which severely impede practical application. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive deepfake detection and attribution benchmark named DeepfakeGenome (DFG). It contains 100 facial forgery algorithms and 2M images in total, achieving 4x to 100x larger than prior DFA benchmarks. We further design 4 protocols for practical evaluation, including a novel retrieval-based attribution paradigm. Unlike previous open-set evaluation metrics, the proposed retrieval metrics are more aligned with the real-world active defense situation of blacklist registration mechanisms. Based on these elaborate designs, we investigate the performance ceiling of deepfake attribution task. Over 2k experimental evaluations are conducted, and 10 insightful findings are derived. We believe this work can provide new insights into the DFA research field. The Code and Benchmark of DFG are avaliable on https://huggingface.co/spaces/DeepfakeGenome/DFG_Page.

</details>


### [57] [RI-Prune: Relation and Information Aware Visual Token Pruning for Multi-Image Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06047)
*Dongjin Lee,Eunju Lee,Jinhee Jang,Yoonji Lee,Youngbin Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对多图视觉语言模型（LVLMs）视觉token预算激增的问题，作者通过因果探针证明基于注意力的剪枝信号在多图推理中是弱代理，进而提出无需训练、无需注意力的预解码器选择器RI-Prune，在多个多图基准与三种骨干上取得更优的压缩-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs扩展到多图输入后视觉token预算大幅膨胀，视觉token剪枝从"效率可选项"变为"实际必需"。然而现有剪枝方法多面向单图，依赖注意力导出的显著性信号估计token重要性；该设计迁移到多图场景表现差：多图基准性能显著下降、存在强位置偏置、且随输入图像数量增加而丧失判别性注意力信号。

Method: 1）设计两个互补的因果探针 Leave-One-In 与 Leave-One-Deletion，分别通过将单个token恢复进置零的视觉序列、或从完整序列中移除该token来度量token重要性，以检验注意力选出的token是否真正重要。2）提出 RI-Prune：一种training-free、attention-free的pre-decoder多图视觉token选择器，在projector输出上计算三个信号——查询相关性、与紧凑逐图原型的跨图对应性、图内代表性——并进行z-normalized组合打分，最后执行均衡的逐图Top-K选择以保留跨图像信息。

Result: 因果探针显示，基于注意力的剪枝器相对随机选择仅有边际增益，说明注意力是多图推理中视觉token重要性的弱代理。RI-Prune在多个多图基准和三个LVLM骨干上，相比既有剪枝方法实现了更强的token削减与任务性能权衡，在激进token预算下优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 注意力中心的重要性估计不适用于多图token剪枝；从projector输出中融合查询相关性、跨图对应与图内代表性、并配合逐图均衡Top-K的选择策略，是一种有效且无需训练的多图视觉token压缩方案，尤其在低预算条件下表现突出。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently been extended to handle multiple input images, but this extension dramatically increases the visual token budget, making visual-token pruning not merely an efficiency option but a practical necessity. Existing visual-token pruning methods, primarily designed for the single-image setting, rely on attention-derived saliency signals to estimate per-token importance. However, this attention-centric design transfers poorly to the multi-image regime: it causes substantial performance degradation on multi-image benchmarks, suffers from strong positional bias, and loses discriminative attention signals as the number of input images increases. To test whether attention-selected tokens are truly important for multi-image reasoning, we conduct two complementary causal probes Leave-One-In and Leave-One-Deletion, which measure token importance by restoring individual tokens to a zeroed visual sequence or removing them from the full sequence. Attention-based pruners provide only marginal gains over random selection, showing that attention is a weak proxy for visual-token importance in multi-image reasoning. Motivated by this gap, we propose Relation and Information Aware Pruning (RI-Prune), a training-free, attention-free pre-decoder selector for multi-image visual token pruning. RI-Prune scores each visual token using a z-normalized combination of three signals computed from projector outputs: query relevance, cross-image correspondence with compact per-image prototypes, and intra image representativeness. By integrating these signals, RI-Prune performs balanced per-image Top-K selection to preserve information across input images. Across multiple multi-image benchmarks and three LVLM backbones, RI-Prune achieves a stronger trade-off between token reduction and task performance than prior pruning methods, particularly under aggressive token budgets.

</details>


### [58] [SVGFaith: A Two-Layer Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Text-to-SVG Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06048)
*Guotao Liang,Haitao Zhou,Biao Liu,Huanxuan Liao,Lingfeng Qiao,Qian-Wen Zhang,Qian Yu,Di Yin,Xing Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SVGFaith 两层元评估框架，揭示现有栅格化图像–文本指标在细粒度提示词忠实度上的短板，并提出可解释逐点度量 SVGFaith-Score。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到 SVG 系统常用栅格化后的图像指标评估，但这些分数能否反映细粒度提示词忠实度尚不清楚，需要系统性的元评估来诊断指标缺陷。

Method: SVGFaith-Diagnostic 构建 1,842 个受控对比对，覆盖八个能力维度，均分为"同一提示、两张渲染"与"同一渲染、两段描述"两个方向；SVGFaith-Arena 收集 1,327 条真实生成输出的人工标注比较。另提出 SVGFaith-Score：领域微调分解器将提示词解析为原子视觉需求的依赖图，VQA 模型判定每项需求是否满足，并在前置需求得分低时对其折扣，输出可解释的逐项分数。

Result: 在 Diagnostic 上 CLIP 等四个图文嵌入指标在物体同一性上成对准确率≥0.789，但空间关系与属性绑定仅≤0.672（随机为 0.5）。SVGFaith-Score 在 Arena 与 Diagnostic 两个方向上均显著优于全部九个基线，包括 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 评判模型。

Conclusion: 栅格图像指标存在细粒度忠实度盲区；基于需求依赖图的可解释逐点度量能更准确、更透明地评估文本到 SVG 生成的提示词忠实度。

Abstract: Text-to-SVG systems are commonly evaluated by applying raster-image metrics to rasterised outputs, yet whether these scores capture fine-grained prompt faithfulness remains unclear. We introduce SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework in which the more faithful candidate of each pair is determined by construction or by human judgment. SVGFaith-Diagnostic contains 1,842 controlled contrastive pairs across eight capability axes, split evenly between two directions: two renderings compared against one prompt, and two descriptions compared against one rendering. SVGFaith-Arena contains 1,327 human-annotated comparisons of real generator outputs. On SVGFaith-Diagnostic, CLIP and three other image--text embedding metrics reach at least 0.789 pairwise accuracy on object identity but at most 0.672 on spatial relations and attribute binding, where chance is 0.5. We further introduce SVGFaith-Score, an interpretable pointwise metric. A domain-tuned decomposer turns each prompt into a dependency graph of atomic visual requirements, a visual question answering model scores whether each requirement is satisfied, and a requirement's score is discounted when its prerequisites score low. In addition to the overall score, the per-requirement scores show which requirements are judged unsatisfied and which inherit discounts from their prerequisites. SVGFaith-Score significantly outperforms all nine baselines, including a Qwen3.5-122B-A10B judge, on Arena and in both Diagnostic directions. Code and data: https://github.com/Yukinonooo/SVGFaith.

</details>


### [59] [TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06061)
*Jiaao Yu,Yanjian Zhang,Haoyang Jiang,Guillaume Wisniewski,Nadi Tomeh,Shijie Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TouchéWorld，将手势驱动的连续手部动作交互整合进相机可控的视频世界模型，并构建联合相机-手部控制数据、参数高效适配方案与TouchéBench评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型支持通过相机导航探索生成环境，但缺乏细粒度的手部动作交互通道，无法与探索中遇到的人与物体进行连续交互。

Method: 以初始图像与场景描述提示为条件，生成受时间对齐的相机与手部控制约束的视频；通过标注补全、一致性过滤、时间对齐从异构自我中心视频构建联合相机-手部训练数据；在预训练相机可控世界模型上，以参数高效适配融合空间手部骨架条件与数值手部运动特征；采用因果适配与少步蒸馏实现块级在线生成，使用户可依据生成视觉反馈更新控制。

Result: 构建了联合相机-手部控制训练数据与在线块级生成能力，并提出TouchéBench，用于评测手部运动跟随、相机-手部协调、在线交互及物体响应。

Conclusion: TouchéWorld为在生成式世界中研究连续探索与手部驱动交互提供了完整框架。

Abstract: Recent video world models allow users to explore generated environments through camera navigation. Continuous hand motion provides a fine-grained action channel for interacting with the people and objects encountered during exploration. We present TouchéWorld, a framework that integrates gesture-driven interaction into a camera-controlled video world model. Given an initial image and a scene-description prompt, the model generates video conditioned on temporally aligned camera and hand controls. We construct joint camera--hand training data from heterogeneous egocentric videos through annotation completion, consistency-based filtering, and temporal alignment. Building on a pretrained camera-controlled world model, we combine spatial hand-skeleton conditioning with numerical hand-motion features through parameter-efficient adaptation. Causal adaptation and few-step distillation support chunk-level online generation, allowing users to update their controls based on generated visual feedback. We further introduce TouchéBench to evaluate hand-motion following, camera--hand coordination, online interaction, and object response. Together, these components establish a framework for studying continuous exploration and hand-driven interaction within generative worlds.

</details>


### [60] [RouTex: Multi-reference 3D Texture Generation by Reprogramming Rotary Position Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06070)
*Chengyang Li,Yang Liu,Jiale Zhang,Qiang Rao,Wei Zhang,Taicheng Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RouTex——基于in-context DiT的多参考图3D纹理生成框架，利用3D RoPE的空间寻址能力实现参考图到视图的显式对应，并配合双粒度注意力（DGA）达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图3D纹理生成已较成熟，但以多视图参考图为条件的纹理合成仍鲜有研究；而该能力对消除未观测区域（unobserved regions）的表面歧义至关重要。

Method: 核心洞察：原生3D Rotary Position Encoding（RoPE）本身具备空间寻址能力。据此提出Positional Routing（PR），沿空间与语义维度重编程3D RoPE，在不引入额外参数的前提下建立显式的参考-视图对应关系。为高效执行该路由，设计Dual-Granularity Attention（DGA）：逐视图局部注意力保证细粒度纹理保真，全局联合注意力（作用于去重后的参考）保证跨视图一致性。

Result: 大量实验表明RouTex在多参考3D纹理生成任务上取得新的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 通过无参数的RoPE位置路由与双粒度注意力，RouTex有效利用多视图参考信息解决未观测区域歧义，在纹理保真度与跨视图一致性两方面均优于现有方法。

Abstract: While single-image 3D texture generation has advanced significantly, conditioning texture synthesis on multi-view reference images remains largely under-explored, despite its necessity for resolving surface ambiguity in unobserved regions. In this paper, we propose RouTex, a novel multi-reference 3D texture generation framework based on in-context Diffusion Transformers (DiT). Our key insight is that native 3D Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) inherently possesses spatial addressing capabilities. We introduce Positional Routing (PR) to reprogram 3D RoPE along spatial and semantic dimensions, establishing explicit reference-to-view correspondence without introducing additional parameters. To execute this routing efficiently, Dual-Granularity Attention (DGA) combines per-view local attention for fine texture fidelity with global joint attention over deduplicated references for cross-view consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouTex achieves new state-of-the-art performance in multi-reference 3D texture generation.

</details>


### [61] [SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06083)
*Peiran Wu,Fangfei Gou,Zhaoxi Mu,Changhao Zhang,Jian Liu,Weiqiang Wang,Yuntao Wang,Yuanchun Shi,Junxiao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SleuthVLM：不直接"听"音频的纯 VLM 智能体框架，先把语音转写为文本，由 VLM 自主推理长视频，在 4 个 omni 基准上取得 75.0% 平均准确率（+2.6 高于 Gemini 3.8 Flash），Video-MME-v2 达 77.8%，并以开源 27B VLM 超越所有开源 omni 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 omni 模型依赖"采样帧 + 音频"联合单轮处理，进展主要由扩大模型规模与 omni 训练数据驱动。作者质疑：模型是否必须直接听到音频？并进一步怀疑多模态对齐式数据扩张能否解决长视频理解瓶颈。

Method: 构建基于 VLM 的智能体 harness（agent harness）：语音经 ASR 转写为文本进入上下文，VLM 不直接接收音频；不预设固定工作流，由智能体自主"侦查"（sleuth）视频——自主规划检索、定位与多轮取证。评测覆盖 4 个 omni 基准（视频最长 90 分钟）及 Video-MME-v2，并对比 Gemini 3.8 Flash 与开源 omni 模型。

Result: 平均准确率 75.0%，较 Gemini 3.8 Flash 提升 2.6 点；Video-MME-v2 排行榜第一（77.8%）；搭配开源 27B VLM 时超过所有开源 omni 模型。

Conclusion: 三点结论：SleuthVLM 优于"一瞥式"直接看听模型；瓶颈不在"听觉"，而在智能体能力；omni 理解需要更强的 agentic 能力，而非单纯更多 omni 对齐数据。为 omni 视频理解提供一个简单有效的起点：需要更好的智能体，而非更大的"会听"模型。

Abstract: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. On four omni benchmarks with videos up to 90 minutes, SleuthVLM achieves the best average accuracy: \textbf{75.0%}, 2.6 points above Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it also tops the Video-MME-v2 leaderboard with \textbf{77.8%}; with an open-source 27B VLM, it beats all open-source omni models. We draw three findings: SleuthVLM beats a model that glances; hearing is not the bottleneck, agentic ability is; omni understanding needs better agentic ability, not just more omni data for modality alignment. So we provide a simple but effective starting point for doing omni video understanding. Omni understanding needs better agents, not just bigger models that hear.

</details>


### [62] [GeoBiaset: A Counterfactual Benchmark for Demographic Bias in World-Level Geolocalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06085)
*Niccolò Niccoli,Silvia Dani,Marco Mistretta,Andrew D. Bagdanov,Marco Bertini,Lorenzo Seidenari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出首个衡量地理定位模型受图像前景人物"表观种族"影响的基准 GeoBiaset（9,541 张图像，配对七类种族的反事实编辑，真值坐标固定），并引入 POPI 指标量化模型对人口学扰动的鲁棒性。实验发现，当插入与场景不匹配群体的人物时，SOTA 地理定位与多模态大模型的洲级性能下降 16–47%；存在地标时模型偏向地标，缺失时注意力转向人脸特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界级图像地理定位日益重要，但其模型偏差理解不足。已有工作仅指出数据集粗粒度不平衡（如某些城市缺席训练集、模型在富裕地区表现更好），却无人考察驱动这些差异的视觉线索，尤其缺乏对人口学因素影响的受控测量手段。

Method: 构建 GeoBiaset 基准：以带地理标签的背景图像为基础，生成覆盖七类种族的反事实前景人物编辑，保持真值坐标不变，共 9,541 张图像；通过受控掩码实验排除遮挡与背景漂移的解释；提出 Person-Origin Perturbation Indicators (POPI) 新指标，衡量预测是否被拉向插入群体所关联区域；并结合有无地标对比分析与梯度加权热图进行机制探究。

Result: 对先进地理定位模型与多模态大语言模型的评估显示，插入人口学不匹配群体的人物导致洲级性能下降 16–47%；掩码实验表明遮挡与背景漂移不能完全解释性能退化；有地标时模型优先关注地理地标，地标缺失时注意力转向人脸特征。

Conclusion: 地理定位模型存在可测量的视觉线索层面偏差，人脸等非地理线索会误导预测；POPI 与 GeoBiaset 为诊断与缓解此类偏差提供了标准化工具，提示需在模型设计与数据构建中抑制无关人口学线索的干扰。

Abstract: World-level image geolocalization is an increasingly important task, yet the biases of current models remain poorly understood. Prior work has identified coarse dataset imbalances noting, for instance, that some cities are absent from training sets and that models tend to perform better in wealthier regions. However, no one has yet examined which visual cues drive these disparities. To do so, we introduce GeoBiaset, the first benchmark designed to measure how geolocalization models are influenced by the apparent race of a person inserted into the image foreground. The dataset consists of 9,541 images, pairing existing geotagged background images with counterfactual edits spanning seven races, holding the ground-truth coordinates fixed. Controlled masking experiments show that occlusion and background drift do not fully explain geolocalization degradation. Alongside the benchmark, we introduce the Person-Origin Perturbation Indicators (POPI), novel metrics that quantify model resilience to these demographic perturbations by measuring whether predictions are pulled toward the region associated with the inserted group. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art geolocalization and multimodal large language models reveals a 16-47% drop in continent-level performance when a subject from a demographically mismatched group is inserted. A landmark versus no-landmark analysis and gradient-weighted heatmaps show that models preferentially attend to geographic landmarks when present, but shift attention to facial features in their absence.

</details>


### [63] [STARE: Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06089)
*Kento Tokura,Ryosuke Korekata,Daichi Yashima,Kei Katsumata,Kanon Amemiya,Miyu Goko,Komei Sugiura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STARE，一种融合视觉与场景文本线索的多模态检索方法，用于服务机器人依据自由形式指令取送日常物品，并通过跨语言视觉提示增强场景文本理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人需根据自由形式指令检索并搬运日常物品，指令可能引用视觉特征与场景文本；难点在于同时理解物体视觉特征、空间关系以及环境中嵌入的场景文本，属多模态理解问题。

Method: STARE利用视觉与文本线索响应自由形式指令；引入Crosslingual Visual Prompt提升场景文本解释能力；并对指令中命名实体与其对应物体之间的复杂关系进行建模。

Result: 在GoGetIt与TextCaps-test两个新基准（真实室内/室外图像、涉及物体操作与导航的指令）上，STARE在标准多模态检索指标上优于所有基线；零样本迁移条件下的真机实验中总体成功率达80%。

Conclusion: 融合场景文本与视觉线索的多模态检索可有效支撑自由形式指令驱动的机器人取物任务，并在检索与真机实验中均取得良好表现，具备零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: In this study, we focus on service robots that retrieve and transport everyday objects based on free-form instructions that may refer to visual features and scene text. This is challenging because it requires a multimodal understanding of the visual features and spatial relationships of objects, as well as scene text embedded in the environment. To address this, we propose Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects (STARE), which leverages visual and textual cues in response to free-form instructions. STARE introduces Crosslingual Visual Prompt to enhance scene text interpretation, and models the complex relationships between named entities in the instructions and their corresponding objects. We evaluate STARE using two novel benchmarks, GoGetIt and TextCaps-test, both of which consist of real-world indoor/outdoor images and instructions involving object manipulation and navigation. The results show that STARE outperforms all baseline methods on standard multimodal retrieval metrics. Furthermore, in physical experiments conducted under a zero-shot transfer setting, STARE achieves an overall success rate of 80%. Our project page and code are provided in the Supplementary Materials.

</details>


### [64] [Drift-adaptive Representation Preservation for Domain-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06093)
*Hyunmin Kong,Gyutae Oh,Jitae Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文观察到域增量学习中遗忘在域与类别间不均匀且无法仅由训练顺序解释，提出以"表征漂移"（过去概念当前表征相对固定锚点的偏差）作为遗忘风险的可测代理，并用其驱动巩固损失与原型构建；借助JEPA在不存储原始数据的前提下测量漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉模型虽具强通用表征，但在DIL中输入分布序列变化时，适应新域会损害旧域性能。作者发现遗忘在域与类别间并非均匀，且不能仅用训练顺序解释，因此需要对每个"域-类别"概念单独追踪，按实测风险而非假设重要性来分配保持力度。

Method: 核心信号为表征漂移：过去概念当前表征与固定锚点的偏差，作为遗忘风险代理。该漂移承担两个互补作用：(1) 巩固损失对高漂移的"域-类别"对施加更强的保持约束；(2) 原型构建中降低高漂移域的权重，以减少其对类别参考的影响。为在不存储原始数据情况下获得该信号，改造JEPA架构：对每个域-类别对仅在骨干特征空间存储紧凑上下文摘要，并重新通过已学到的context-to-target关系推算，从而测得相对固定锚点的漂移。

Result: 在DomainNet、Office-Home、CORe50与CDDB-Hard四个基准上，方法均取得较强的精度-遗忘平衡；训练内存显著低于精度相当的方法，且在所有对比方法中存储开销最小。

Conclusion: 按实测表征漂移分配保持力度是一种有效且数据高效的DIL策略；结合JEPA的紧凑上下文摘要存储，可在无需回放原始数据的条件下实现精度-遗忘-存储的良好折衷。

Abstract: Pretrained vision models provide strong general-purpose representations, but in Domain-Incremental Learning (DIL), where the input distribution changes sequentially, adapting to new domains often degrades performance on previously learned ones. We observe that forgetting is not uniform across domains and classes and is not explained by training order alone. This motivates us to track each past domain-class concept individually. We use representation drift, defined as the deviation of a past concept's current representation from a fixed anchor, as a measurable surrogate for forgetting risk. The measured drift then serves two complementary roles. A consolidation loss assigns stronger preservation to high-drift pairs, while prototype construction down-weights highly drifted domains to reduce their influence on the class reference. Preservation is thus allocated by measured drift rather than assumed importance. To obtain this signal during training without storing past raw data, we repurpose a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA). For each domain-class pair, we store only a compact context summary in the backbone feature space and rerun it through the learned context-to-target relation to measure its drift from the fixed anchor. Across DomainNet, Office-Home, CORe50, and CDDB-Hard, our method sustains a strong accuracy-forgetting balance on every benchmark, using substantially less training memory than accuracy-competitive methods and the smallest storage among compared methods.

</details>


### [65] [Many Pixels, One Composition: Self-Supervised Spectra for Specimen-Level Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06096)
*Eleftheria Tetoula-Tsonga,George Arvanitakis,Theodoros Giannakas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文探究高光谱成像能否预测地表样本的元素组成，将其建模为监督回归任务；采用像素级自监督预训练编码器+冻结编码器上训练轻量注意力回归头，在测试样本上显著优于传统光谱匹配/解混基线及同等容量的均值光谱监督模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证高光谱（HS）成像作为预测地表实物样本元素组成的可行手段，并针对HS立方体与元素表征配对数据构建有效的监督回归方案。

Method: 基于公开样本数据集（每样本含HS cube与元素表征），先用自监督方式在像素级训练编码器；随后冻结编码器，将同一标本的多组表示与其元素标签配对，监督训练一个轻量、基于注意力的回归头；并与传统光谱匹配、光谱解混基线、均值光谱监督模型及全模型微调进行对比。

Result: 在测试样本上显著优于传统光谱匹配与解混基线；也优于容量相近的基于均值光谱的监督学习模型；全模型微调在显著更高模型容量下取得最强性能。

Conclusion: 高光谱成像可用于元素组成回归预测；像素级自监督表征加轻量注意力回归头是高效有效的方案，进一步提升性能需依赖全模型微调与更大容量。

Abstract: Can hyperspectral (HS) imaging be used to predict the elemental composition of physical specimens found on the Earth's surface? We approach this problem as a supervised regression task, using an open dataset of specimens, each comprising a HS cube and elemental characterization. In particular, we train an encoder in a self-supervised fashion that operates on pixel-level; then freeze the encoder and train a lightweight attention-based regression head in a supervised manner, by pairing many representations of a given specimen with its corresponding elemental label. In test specimens, our approach significantly outperforms traditional spectral matching and unmixing baselines. It also outperforms supervised learning models based on the mean spectrum (of similar model capacity), while full model fine-tuning achieves the strongest performance, at substantially higher model capacity.

</details>


### [66] [XuanJian-DINOSAR: A SAR Foundation Model Based on Global and Local Semantic Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06105)
*Chunxiao Wu,Huixin Huang,Jialei Pan,Qiang Liang,Tao Wu,Cheng Wu,Long Huang,Yuanji Li,Qiang Cheng,Aifang Liu,Linghao Xia,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 XuanJian-DINOSAR：基于全局-局部语义一致性的SAR基础模型，通过DINO自蒸馏+iBOT局部掩码建模+KoLeo正则，并新增面向SAR斑点噪声的局部语义一致性分支，在36万+ SAR图像上适配DINOv2，多个下游分类/检测任务取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR自监督预训练需可迁移表征，但存在光学-SAR域间差距与斑点噪声扰动，表征稳定性受限；主流MIM方法依赖像素重建或预定义算子，对斑点敏感；对应空间位置的跨视角语义与扰动稳定性联合建模研究不足。

Method: 构建36万+公开SAR目标切片、检测图像与场景图像数据集；以光学预训练DINOv2为底座做自监督适配，融合DINO全局语义自蒸馏、iBOT局部掩码建模与KoLeo特征分布正则；引入面向SAR强度统计与相干成像特性的局部语义一致性分支：共享几何变换生成空间对齐的教师弱视图与学生强视图，对学生视图施加强度变换与Gamma乘性斑点扰动，用余弦一致性损失对齐对应位置patch token；该目标与DINOv2多裁剪训练的跨区域、跨尺度语义一致性互补。

Result: 在多个下游分类与检测数据集上，多数评价指标达到SOTA，验证所学表征的泛化性与可迁移性。

Conclusion: 全局与局部语义一致性联合建模可有效提升SAR表征对斑点与辐射扰动的稳定性及跨域迁移能力，为SAR基础模型提供可行范式。

Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery enables transferable representations, but the optical-SAR domain gap and speckle perturbations limit representation stability. Most SAR foundation models use masked image modeling (MIM) through pixel reconstruction or structural feature prediction, which is sensitive to speckle or relies on predefined operators. Joint modeling of cross-view semantics and perturbation stability at corresponding spatial locations remains underexplored. We propose XuanJian-DINOSAR, a SAR foundation model based on global and local semantic consistency. We curate over 360K publicly available SAR target chips, detection images, and scene images spanning diverse targets, scenes, and sensors, and adapt an optically pre-trained DINOv2 model to SAR through self-supervised learning. The framework combines DINO global semantic self-distillation, iBOT local masked modeling, and KoLeo feature-distribution regularization to learn globally discriminative and locally structure-aware representations. We introduce a local semantic consistency branch tailored to SAR intensity statistics and coherent imaging characteristics. Shared geometric transformations produce spatially aligned teacher weak views and student strong views. Intensity transformations and Gamma multiplicative speckle perturbations are applied to student views, while a cosine consistency loss aligns patch tokens at corresponding locations, promoting stability under radiometric perturbations. This objective complements the cross-region and cross-scale semantic consistency of DINOv2 multi-crop training, jointly enforcing global and local semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple downstream classification and detection datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on most evaluation metrics, validating the generality and transferability of the learned representations.

</details>


### [67] [Semantic Prior-Guided Incomplete Cross-Modal Retrieval with Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06113)
*Jiali Chen,Ruitao Pu,Yingke Chen,Dezhong Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPIRN框架，以固定语义先验为一致性参考，首次联合解决跨模态检索中的模态缺失与标签噪声双重问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态检索（CMR）需学习共享表示以弥合模态语义鸿沟，但真实数据采集的动态性与不一致性导致模态严重缺失；现有不完整CMR方法遵循标签驱动范式，过度依赖类别标注作为语义基准，而标签噪声难以避免且常与模态缺失共存，构成双重挑战。

Method: SPIRN以固定语义先验作为鲁棒表示学习、噪声标签处理与缺失模态补全的一致参考，包含四个模块：Semantic Priors Guidance（SPG）建立稳定的类别级语义空间；Quality-aware Robust Learning（QRL）动态评估样本质量，区分干净与噪声样本并通过反向学习处理噪声；Prior-guided Global Label Calibration（PGLC）修正被污染的标注以获得精炼监督；Confidence-driven Selective Imputation（CSI）从跨模态记忆库中恢复缺失模态，并以递增阈值过滤不可靠补全。

Result: 在四个常用基准数据集上，于同时涉及模态缺失与标签噪声的多种场景中，SPIRN优于11种最先进方法。

Conclusion: SPIRN是CMR领域首个同时应对模态不完整与标签噪声双重挑战的框架，验证了语义先验引导范式的有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Cross-modal retrieval (CMR) aims to bridge the semantic gaps between modalities by learning shared representations. Unfortunately, due to the dynamism and inconsistencies in real-world data acquisition, multimodal datasets frequently encounter severe modality incompleteness. Existing incomplete CMR methods adhere to a label-driven paradigm, relying heavily on categorical annotations as the semantic benchmark. However, label noise is difficult to avoid and often coexists with modality incompleteness. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semantic prior-guided framework for incomplete cross-modal retrieval with noisy labels, termed SPIRN. Specifically, SPIRN uses fixed semantic priors as a consistent reference for robust representation learning, noisy-label handling, and missing-modality completion. Based on this reference, Semantic Priors Guidance (SPG) establishes a stable category-level semantic space, Quality-aware Robust Learning (QRL) dynamically evaluates sample quality to distinguish clean samples from noisy ones and handles noise via reverse learning, Prior-guided Global Label Calibration (PGLC) rectifies corrupted annotations for refined supervision, and Confidence-driven Selective Imputation (CSI) recovers missing modalities from a cross-modal memory bank while filtering unreliable imputations with an increasing threshold. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework to jointly tackle the dual challenges of modality incompleteness and label noise in the CMR community. Extensive experiments on four widely used benchmark datasets demonstrate that SPIRN outperforms 11 state-of-the-art methods in various scenarios involving both missing modalities and noisy labels.

</details>


### [68] [ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06120)
*Hanwei Liu,Huijia Zhang,Hanzhang Wang,Guangyu Liu,Hanbei Zhan,Linjie Hu,Bin Xiao,Xuan Zhou,Dong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReactWorld，一种由结构化交互预期引导的具身视频世界模型：在生成主干特征空间用交互响应场预测器预判参与者角色、未来运动响应强度与局部运动变化，并通过响应反馈适配器把预测位移转为对象特征增量与时间注意力位置偏置，实现交互预期与生成反馈闭环。RBench均分77.51（超PhysisForcing 3.29，九类全提升），EZS-Bench Domain 86.98、均分81.87。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身视频世界模型虽能预测机器人动作引起的场景变化，但生成的对象响应常与任务意图和接触动力学不一致；而具身场景中的关键响应往往集中于局部区域与特定时间区间，缺乏显式的交互级预见与引导。

Method: 受思维链推理启发引入结构化交互预期引导：1) 在生成主干特征空间中设置交互响应场预测器，显式刻画参与者角色、未来运动响应强度与局部运动变化；2) 响应反馈适配器以"输入预测局部动力学 vs. 输入置零局部动力学"时对象分支输出的差异构造对象特征增量；3) 将预测位移转换为时间注意力的位置偏置。两种机制分别引导逐帧对象特征更新与跨帧信息检索。

Result: RBench平均分77.51，较PhysisForcing提升3.29分，且在全部九类指标上均有提升；EZS-Bench上Domain得分86.98，平均分81.87。

Conclusion: 通过交互预期与生成反馈的结合，模型能够聚焦局部—短时的高价值响应区域，显著提升具身视频生成的物理一致性与任务一致性，验证了结构化交互先验作为生成引导信号的有效性。

Abstract: Embodied video world models predict scene changes caused by robot actions, yet generated object responses may remain inconsistent with task intent and contact dynamics. Critical responses in embodied scenes often concentrate in local regions and specific time intervals. Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, we introduce ReactWorld, an embodied video generation model guided by structured interaction anticipation. In the generation backbone's feature space, an interaction response field predictor anticipates how the interaction will unfold, explicitly describing participant roles, future motion response intensity, and local motion changes. A response feedback adapter forms increments to object features from the difference between the object branch's outputs with predicted and zeroed local dynamics inputs. It also converts predicted displacements into positional biases for temporal attention. These two mechanisms guide object feature updates and information retrieval across frames, respectively. Through interaction anticipation and generative feedback, ReactWorld achieves an average score of 77.51 on RBench, outperforming PhysisForcing by 3.29 points with improvements in all nine categories. On EZS-Bench, it achieves a Domain score of 86.98 and an average score of 81.87.

</details>


### [69] [RDT-3D: Resolution-Decoupled Training for High-Fidelity 3D Geometry Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06141)
*Jiale Zhang,Yang Liu,Chengyang Li,Jin Yuan,Qianxi Jia,Taicheng Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT)与原位对齐的Dual3D-300K数据集，解决高精度3D生成中训练-推理分辨率不匹配导致的细节退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真3D几何生成需兼顾全局结构一致性与细粒度表面细节。现有coarse-to-fine框架用RoPE对局部查询进行条件化，但存在训练-推理分辨率错配：训练时坐标引导与几何监督对齐，推理时却由粗空间坐标解码高分辨率几何，造成严重分布偏移并损害细节。

Method: 1) Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT)：将RoPE引导锚定在512分辨率，而在1536分辨率上进行几何监督，实现鲁棒的细节外推；2) Dual3D-300K：大规模成对数据集，包含300K水密3D点云，并在512与1536分辨率间显式对齐，以消除高分辨率数据瓶颈。

Result: 大量实验表明RDT显著改善尖锐几何区域的生成质量（如锐利边缘与细节区域），Dual3D-300K则为高分辨率3D生成提供可扩展基准。

Conclusion: 训练-推理分辨率错配是高精度3D生成被忽视的关键瓶颈；通过解耦RoPE引导分辨率与监督分辨率可有效恢复细节，且配套的成对高分辨率数据为后续研究提供标准化评测基础。

Abstract: High-fidelity 3D geometry generation requires maintaining global structural coherence alongside fine-grained surface details. While recent coarse-to-fine frameworks leverage Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) to condition local queries, we reveal a critical training-inference resolution discrepancy: coordinate guidance and geometric supervision are aligned during training, whereas inference decodes high-resolution geometry from coarse spatial coordinates. This mismatch introduces a severe distribution shift that degrades fine details. To overcome this, we propose Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT), which anchors RoPE guidance at 512 resolution while supervising geometry at 1536, enabling robust detail extrapolation. Additionally, to eliminate high-resolution data bottlenecks, we present Dual3D-300K, a large-scale paired dataset comprising 300K watertight 3D point clouds explicitly aligned across 512 and 1536 resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDT substantially improves sharp geometric regions, while Dual3D-300K offers a scalable benchmark for high-resolution 3D generation.

</details>


### [70] [PTQ4SAM3: Semantics-Preserving Post-Training Quantization for Segment Anything Model 3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06143)
*Xi Xiao,Yunbei Zhang,Lin Zhao,Janet Wang,Xinru Jiang,Yanshu Li,Chenrui Ma,Pan Wang,Tianyang Wang,Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Semantics-Preserving Quantization (SPQ)，通过校准加权、残差特征保留与视频记忆均值误差校正三项离线组件，缓解SAM 3量化后的"prompt-alignment drift"，在W4A8图像编码器下将RefCOCO Pr@0.5从42.1提升至72.5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAM 3虽支持文本提示分割与视频目标跟踪，但其内存与计算开销导致部署困难。训练后量化(PTQ)可降低成本，但量化模型易选错目标或在跨帧中丢失跟踪目标，作者将其定义为prompt-alignment drift；受控实验表明，扰动低方差特征方向会显著影响目标选择，说明概念敏感参数需要保护。

Method: SPQ包含三个组件：(1) 对概念敏感参数赋予更高校准权重；(2) 保留残差特征；(3) 校正视频记忆中的均值误差。校准使用固定文本概念引导，无需任务标注；三组件均离线运行，不增加推理算子。

Result: W4A8图像编码器下，SPQ相对PTQ4SAM将RefCOCO Pr@0.5由42.1提升至72.5，同时保持54.8 COCO mask AP；在LVIS、RefCOCO变体与SA-V上均取得一致增益；CLIP研究亦显示图像-文本检索性能改善。

Conclusion: 量化对提示对齐的破坏主要源于概念敏感参数与低方差方向，针对性校准加权、残差保留与记忆均值校正是有效且零推理开销的解决路径，SPQ在分割、跟踪与检索任务上通用有效。

Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) can segment objects from text prompts and track them across video, but its memory and computation costs make deployment difficult. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces these costs by using fewer bits. However, a quantized model can select the wrong object or lose track of its target across frames. We call this prompt-alignment drift. Controlled tests show that perturbing low-variance feature directions strongly affects target selection. We propose Semantics-Preserving Quantization (SPQ), which gives more calibration weight to concept-sensitive parameters, preserves residual features, and corrects the mean error in video memory. Fixed text concepts guide calibration without task annotations. All three components operate offline and add no inference operators. With a W4A8 image encoder, SPQ improves RefCOCO Pr@0.5 from 42.1 to 72.5 over PTQ4SAM while retaining 54.8 COCO mask AP. Experiments on LVIS, RefCOCO variants, and SA-V show consistent gains. A CLIP study also shows improved image-text retrieval.

</details>


### [71] [Grounding in the Dark: Text-Only Training for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06149)
*Divyanshu Mishra,Sabine Sternig,Rakshith Shetty,Erhan Gundogdu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 仅用文本视频描述训练纯文本LLM（Qwen3-8B+LoRA，基于CLIP/LLM2CLIP文本嵌入），推理时才输入视频，实现时序定位；并提出免训练的Nearest Entity Replacement（NER）缓解模态鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频-LLM通常依赖大规模成对视频-文本数据与精确时序标注，成本高昂。作者欲验证：不做视觉-语言预训练、训练阶段完全不接触成对视频数据，仅用文本化视频描述训练LLM，推理时再接收视频，能否完成时序定位，从而迈向无成对标注训练多模态模型。

Method: 构建134K样本、最多100个时间步的文本序列语料；用LoRA对Qwen3-8B微调，输入为CLIP或LLM2CLIP文本嵌入；在Charades-STA与QV-Highlights上评测且不使用两benchmark的视频训练。为弥合模态鸿沟，提出免训练映射NER：每帧由其最近文本实体嵌入的归一化均值表示，使推理输入贴近训练分布；与四类模态鸿沟基线对比。

Result: LLM2CLIP因文本编码器支持更长输入，对细粒度描述表征更好（Temporal-TextVid上61.54 vs 53.86 mtIoU），向视频迁移也更佳。直接以帧嵌入替换文本时，Charades-STA仅4.99 mtIoU、QV-Highlights 11.12，模态鸿沟显著。NER将结果提升至14.45与20.72 mtIoU，分别超过最强基线5.00与1.71个点。

Conclusion: 纯文本训练+测试时视频输入的设定可行，NER可实现从文本到视频的部分迁移；但更可靠的定位仍依赖文本与视觉表征更好对齐的编码器。

Abstract: Video-LLMs are typically trained on paired video-text data for temporal tasks, yet collecting precise temporal annotations and training on large-scale video datasets are both costly. We investigate whether a text-only LLM, with no vision-language pretraining, can be trained on textual video descriptions alone to perform temporal grounding and receive video only at inference time. This setting removes paired video data from training altogether and is a step toward training multimodal models without paired annotations. We generate a 134K-example corpus of textual sequences with up to 100 time steps, adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA on CLIP or LLM2CLIP text embeddings, and evaluate on Charades-STA and QV-Highlights without training on videos from either benchmark. LLM2CLIP, whose text encoder supports longer inputs, represents detailed descriptions better than CLIP (61.54 versus 53.86 mtIoU on Temporal-TextVid) and transfers them better to video. Still, replacing text with frame embeddings at inference yields only 4.99 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 11.12 on QV-Highlights, revealing a large modality gap. To bridge it, we propose Nearest Entity Replacement (NER), a training-free mapping that represents each video frame by the normalized mean of its nearest text-entity embeddings, so that the model receives the kind of input it was trained on. NER reaches 14.45 mtIoU on Charades-STA and 20.72 on QV-Highlights, outperforming the strongest of four families of modality-gap baselines by 5.00 and 1.71 points. NER thus enables partial transfer from text to video, while more reliable grounding will likely require encoders with better-aligned text and visual representations.

</details>


### [72] [DSRS: Teaching MLLMs to Perceive, Reason, and Segment in Complex Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06160)
*Sicen Guo,Zhengfei Song,Kuanhsun Chen,Xu Huang,Ping Zhong,Wei Ye,Shaoyi Du,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出驾驶场景推理分割任务DSRS及其基准数据集，并设计DSRS-Net，通过几何特征注入缓解MLLM因RGB单模态预训练导致的模态表征错配，提升驾驶场景推理分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理分割框架依赖具备广泛世界知识的MLLM，以类人方式提取语义并生成掩码，但缺乏场景特定（scene-specific）感知能力，难以应对驾驶场景中隐式指令、空间关系、潜在风险、复杂条件与交通规则理解等需求。

Method: 定义DSRS任务并构建专用基准数据集；提出DSRS-Net，在不破坏原有跨模态融合机制的前提下无缝注入几何特征，实现几何、上下文与语言特征的深度融合，从而缓解RGB-only预训练造成的模态表征错配。

Result: 在驾驶场景推理分割及多种公开数据集上的其他语言驱动分割任务中，DSRS-Net均取得优于对比方法的性能。

Conclusion: 场景特定感知是推理分割走向自动驾驶应用的关键；将几何信息纳入MLLM融合框架可有效补偿RGB预训练的模态偏差，并具备跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Existing reasoning segmentation frameworks typically employ multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with broad world knowledge to extract semantics in a human-like manner and generate corresponding segmentation masks. Nevertheless, these frameworks lack the necessary scene-specific awareness. This paper introduces driving scene reasoning segmentation (DSRS), a scene-specific task that requires models to interpret implicit instructions, infer spatial relations, detect potential risks, handle challenging conditions, and comprehend underlying traffic rules, ultimately generating accurate segmentation masks. Meanwhile, we establish a benchmark dataset to facilitate future research on the DSRS task. To pioneer this task, we propose DSRS-Net, a novel architecture with advanced reasoning segmentation capability for automated driving. Specifically, DSRS-Net seamlessly infuses geometric features for deeper reasoning segmentation, without compromising the original multimodal fusion mechanism. This strategy effectively mitigates the modality representation mismatch in MLLMs caused by RGB-only pretraining, while enhancing the integration of geometric, contextual, and linguistic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DSRS-Net in both driving scene reasoning segmentation and other language-driven segmentation tasks across various public datasets. The source code and dataset will be released upon publication.

</details>


### [73] [Reasoning-Aware Cross-Modal Association Unlearning in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06168)
*Xinghao Li,Chenchen Tan,Youyang Qu,Shujie Cui,Xingliang Yuan,Cunjian Chen,Chi Liu,Longxiang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Visual-Keyed Counterfactual Rebinding (VKCR)，一种参数高效的跨模态关联遗忘框架，使模型在指定视觉语境下抑制目标知识、在其他语境下保留同一知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态遗忘方法针对样本、概念或知识内容，未将知识与承载它的跨模态关联分离；在推理模型中，目标信息可能从最终答案消失却仍残留于中间推理，或被错误的替代知识替代，形成幻觉式再关联。

Method: VKCR：先将编辑定位到紧凑的、以关联为条件的参数子空间；再在任务输出处降低对指定目标的支撑；最后通过抑制目标承载或无支撑的续写、偏好有效的非敏感替代，对受影响的推理行为进行反事实重绑定。同时提出CLEAR-R与MLLMU-R两套评测。

Result: 实验显示VKCR显著降低图像条件的目标泄漏与幻觉式再关联（并在异构任务形式下成立），同时保持非敏感视觉推理能力与允许的纯文本知识访问。

Conclusion: 跨模态关联遗忘是一种独立且有价值的遗忘对象，参数高效的子空间定位加反事实重绑定可在不重训练的前提下实现关联级编辑，并兼顾遗忘效果与效用保持。

Abstract: Multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) integrate visual inputs with textual and parametric knowledge, allowing sensitive information to be accessed through cross-modal associations during reasoning. This raises privacy concerns when a visual input should no longer provide access to such information. Machine unlearning can remove this influence without retraining the model from scratch. However, multimodal unlearning methods mainly target samples, concepts, or knowledge content, without separating the knowledge from the cross-modal association through which it is accessed. In reasoning models, target information may disappear from the final answer while remaining in intermediate reasoning, or be replaced by incorrect substitute knowledge. We therefore study cross-modal association unlearning, where the forget target is a designated visual-to-knowledge association: the model should suppress target-bearing behavior under the designated visual context while preserving access to the same knowledge in permitted contexts. We propose Visual-Keyed Counterfactual Rebinding (VKCR), a parameter-efficient framework for cross-modal association editing. VKCR first localizes the edit to a compact association-conditioned parameter subspace. It then reduces support for the designated target at task outputs and counterfactually rebinds the affected reasoning behavior by discouraging target-bearing or unsupported continuations while favoring valid non-sensitive alternatives. We further introduce CLEAR-R and MLLMU-R to evaluate target leakage, hallucinated reassociation, reasoning preservation, and modality-specific utility. Experiments show that VKCR substantially reduces image-conditioned target leakage and hallucinated reassociation, including across heterogeneous task formulations, while preserving non-sensitive visual reasoning and permitted text-only knowledge.

</details>


### [74] [Rohbau3D-Semantics: Dense Semantic and Instance Labels for Point Clouds of Indoor Shell Construction Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06180)
*Lukas Rauch,Thomas Braml*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发布 Rohbau3D-Semantics 数据集，为既有 Rohbau3D 壳体施工现场激光扫描数据补充密集语义与实例标注，共 504 个点云场景、14 个测绘站点、17 个建筑构件类别加 1 个背景类，并提供全景/立方图派生脚本、基准划分与语义分割基线实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源存在缺口：合成室内数据集与由重建网格采样得到的基准缺乏真实激光扫描特性，而建筑施工现场专用数据集规模偏小。作者希望在二者之间搭建桥梁，提供保留真实扫描特性（非均匀采样、测量伪影、反射、精细几何细节）且标注密集的真实施工场景基准。

Method: 以地面激光扫描仪采集 14 个站点的 504 个点云场景，存储于扫描仪中心局部坐标系；采用人工逐点标注并辅以专家监督与全场景复核的质量控制流程；定义 17 个建筑构件语义类与 1 个背景类，并给出对象级实例标注；同时提供从 3D 数组导出几何对齐的全景图与立方图表示（颜色、LiDAR 反射强度、深度、表面法向、语义与实例标签）的脚本；给出基准数据划分与语义分割基线实验。

Result: 构建了保留真实扫描特性的高质量密集标注基准，包含完整采集流程、标注协议、质量控制与全景生成流程说明，并提供基准划分与语义分割基线结果。

Conclusion: Rohbau3D-Semantics 通过精确地面激光扫描、密集标注与多样化壳体施工场景，弥合了合成室内数据集、网格派生基准与小型施工专用资源之间的差距，可支撑 3D 场景理解、施工现场分析与多模态场景分析研究。

Abstract: We present the Rohbau3D-Semantics dataset, which adds dense semantic and instance-level labels to laser scans of the previously released Rohbau3D domain data from shell construction sites. The dataset comprises 504 point cloud scenes from 14 survey sites, each captured with a terrestrial laser scanner and stored in a scanner-centered local coordinate system. Unlike point clouds sampled from reconstructed meshes or synthetic building models, the data preserve the characteristic properties of real laser scanning, including non-uniform sampling, measurement artifacts, reflections, and fine geometric detail. Combined with manual labels, expert oversight during pointwise annotation, and full-scene review, this yields a high-quality benchmark for semantic scene understanding in complex built environments.
