To mitigate the prior information forgetting in the progressive training, we further introduce a learnable random variable Prior Compensation Factor (PCF) to explicitly measure the prior knowledge loss. We theoretically show that the PCF can be efficiently learned together with the model parameters by minimizing a reasonable upper bound of the objective function. The proposed CPC is further enhanced to estimate the prior information loss for each subtask and a new framework called Continual Prior Compensation++ (CPC++) with Fine-Grained Prior Compensation Factor (FGPCF) is finally developed. Our CPC and CPC++ frameworks are quite flexible and can be easily integrated with different HMP backbone models and adapted to various datasets and applications. Extensive experiments on three HMP benchmark datasets using multiple SOTA HMP backbones (PGBIG, siMLPe, MotionMixer, and LTD) demonstrate the effectiveness and flexibility of our frameworks.

</details>


### [109] [Dynamical State-Space Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06652)
*Woojun Lee,Hankyeol Kim,Pilsung Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DSSD，用时不变对角状态空间模型的阻尼振荡模态构造时间卷积核，并以该模型平稳协方差的Cholesky因子作为因果、可逆、逐帧方差保持的加噪算子，使扩散过程的腐蚀本身携带多尺度时间结构，从而在不改去噪器结构的情况下提升时序预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列/视频扩散预测普遍对每个未来帧施加独立噪声，把全部时间依赖交给去噪器学习，腐蚀过程本身不含时间结构，造成建模负担与归纳偏置缺失。直接使用状态空间模型对整段clip加噪存在初始化难题：首帧之前的状态不可观测，零状态初始化会使早期帧噪声弱于扩散调度规定。

Method: 1) 用稳定对角SSM的阻尼振荡模态（可学习衰减率与频率）构造时间核，刻画多时间尺度与振荡相关性；2) 采用该SSM平稳协方差的Cholesky因子作为时间算子，替代零状态滚动，等价于SSM的Kalman innovations形式；3) 证明该算子因果、精确可逆、逐帧噪声方差与标准扩散一致、在过程干净端退化为恒等；4) 去噪器改为预测时间相关噪声，采样每步先去除再加回时间混合。

Result: 在科学领域数据与机器人视频数据集上，DSSD优于共享同一去噪器的扩散基线；训练过程中学习到的模态演化表明时间算子能自适应各数据集的时间特性。

Conclusion: 将时间结构前移注入腐蚀过程本身是可行且有效的：以平稳协方差Cholesky因子作为时间算子可在保持标准扩散逐帧边缘分布与可逆性的同时，赋予扩散模型可学习、可适配的多尺度时序归纳偏置。

Abstract: Diffusion models for temporal prediction typically corrupt each future frame with independent noise, leaving temporal dependence entirely to the denoiser. We propose Dynamical State-Space Diffusion (DSSD), which learns the temporal structure of the corruption process itself. DSSD builds a temporal kernel from the damped oscillatory modes of a stable diagonal state-space model, whose learned decay rates and frequencies let the corruption capture multiple timescales and oscillatory correlations, while the denoiser architecture remains unchanged. Running this model on a finite clip, however, requires the state before the first frame, which is unobserved; starting from a zero state leaves the early frames with less noise than the diffusion schedule prescribes. We avoid this by using the Cholesky factor of the model's stationary covariance as the temporal operator. We prove that this operator is causal, exactly invertible, keeps each frame's noise variance equal to that of standard diffusion, and reduces to the identity at the clean end of the process, and that it is exactly the Kalman innovations form of the state-space model. The denoiser is trained to predict the temporally correlated noise, and sampling removes and reapplies the temporal mixing at each step. On scientific-field and robot-video datasets, DSSD outperforms diffusion baselines that share its denoiser, and the evolution of its learned modes during training shows that the temporal operator adapts to each dataset.

</details>


### [110] [CardioDrift: Automatic Cardiac Motion Tracking on a 3D Atlas Mesh via Shape-aware Coherent Point Drift with Slice Shift Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06664)
*Reza Akbari Movahed,Abuzar Rezaee,Shatha Alamri,Edmond S. L. Ho,Fani Deligianni,Ali Gooya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CardioDrift——一种全自动、基于图谱的概率框架，将受试者心脏运动表示在具有全局对应点的3D图谱网格上，通过泛化相干点漂移（CPD）联合配准多区域图谱表面，并内嵌切片偏移校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有心脏运动追踪方法分为两类：一类无跨受试者解剖对应，限制受试者间运动评估；另一类虽有全局对应点，但需耗时且易出错的半自动图谱拟合步骤。

Method: 将相干点漂移（CPD）公式推广，把多个心脏区域的图谱表面联合配准到整个心动周期内从cine CMR分割图提取的解剖对应轮廓；并将切片偏移校正嵌入同一概率模型，估计逐切片平移以抑制错位伪影。

Result: 在1301名随机选取的UK Biobank受试者及M&M数据集上评估，LV、Myo、RV的DSC分别为92.23±8.70%、82.11±7.56%、88.69±4.13%，在两个数据集的所有距离与重叠指标上均超过最强基线。

Conclusion: CardioDrift实现了全自动、基于图谱的心脏运动追踪，兼具全局解剖对应与切片偏移鲁棒性，精度优于现有基线。

Abstract: Automatic cardiac motion tracking from cine cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging is essential for quantifying myocardial motion abnormalities associated with cardiovascular disease. Existing methods fall into two groups: those that represent motion without anatomical correspondence across subjects and therefore limit inter-subject motion assessment; and those that represent motion with globally corresponding points, which typically require a time-consuming and error-prone semi-automatic step to fit a cardiac atlas to the subject space. To address these limitations, this study proposes CardioDrift, a fully automatic, atlas-based probabilistic framework that represents subject-specific cardiac motion on a 3D atlas mesh with globally corresponding points. The Coherent Point Drift (CPD) formulation is generalised to jointly register the atlas surfaces of multiple cardiac regions to the anatomically corresponding contours extracted from cine CMR segmentation maps throughout the cardiac cycle. Slice-shift correction is embedded in the same probabilistic model, estimating slice-wise translations that suppress the misalignment artefact limiting atlas-fitting accuracy. Evaluation on 1301 randomly selected UK Biobank subjects and the M&M dataset, CardioDrift attains Dice similarity coefficients (DSCs) of $92.23\pm8.70\%$, $82.11\pm7.56\%$, and $88.69\pm4.13\%$ for the left ventricle (LV), myocardium (Myo), and right ventricle (RV), exceeding the strongest baseline on every distance and overlap metric of both datasets.

</details>


### [111] [Sekai: Incremental Event Memory for Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06685)
*Zhengtao Liu,Jinrong Xu,Shiu-Hong Kao,Huixin Sun,Yicong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出新任务GRVS（目标集合随观测历史中查询相关事件动态变化）与基准Isekai（60视频、197查询、11类时序查询、12569打分点），并提出Sekai在线框架（EMR事件记忆推理器+MGD记忆引导解码器），取得50.33 J&F，超最强基线3.2点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线推理视频分割（Online RVS）普遍假设视频中目标集合固定不变，忽略了流式推理的本质属性：随着新事件出现，满足查询的对象会随时间改变。因此需要重新形式化任务，并建立可诊断的评测基准。

Method: 1) 定义GRVS任务：目标集合依赖观测视频历史中累积的查询相关事件，可随时间从空集演化为单/多目标，模型需持续维护目标有效性并定位当前帧中的有效目标；2) 构建Isekai基准：60个视频、197个查询、11类时序查询家族、12,569个打分点，目标集合按时间因果标注；3) 提出Sekai在线框架：Event Memory Reasoner（EMR）以结构化记忆维护查询相关事件与演化中的目标状态，Memory-Grounded Decoder（MGD）从记忆中识别有效目标并在当前帧定位。

Result: Sekai显著优于现有Online RVS方法，达到50.33 J&F，较最强基线提升3.2点；代码、示例标注与评测脚本已开源。

Conclusion: 将在线推理视频分割由"固定目标集"推广为"事件驱动的动态目标集"是必要且有效的任务扩展；显式的事件记忆与记忆引导解码是应对目标有效性演化的关键设计，Isekai为后续研究提供了诊断性评测平台。

Abstract: Online reasoning video segmentation (Online RVS) requires a model to segment query-referred objects as a video streams in, using only the frames observed so far. Existing formulations largely assume a fixed target set throughout the video, overlooking a fundamental property of streaming reasoning: as new events occur, the objects that satisfy a query may change over time. To address this, we propose a new task, Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation (GRVS), where the target set depends on query-relevant events accumulated over the observed video history. As new evidence accumulates, the target set can evolve from empty to one or multiple objects, requiring a model to continuously maintain target validity while localizing the valid objects currently in view. To evaluate GRVS, we build Isekai, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 videos and 197 queries across 11 temporal query families, with 12,569 scoring points whose target sets are causally annotated over time. We further propose Sekai, an online framework with two complementary components: an Event Memory Reasoner (EMR) that maintains query-relevant events and evolving target states in structured memory, and a Memory-Grounded Decoder (MGD) that identifies valid targets from this memory and localizes them in the current frame. Experiments show that Sekai significantly outperforms existing online RVS methods, achieving 50.33 J&F and improving over the strongest baseline by 3.2 points. Code, example annotations, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/zenastangbi/Sekai.

</details>


### [112] [Agent-Driven Generative Priors for Pathology Image Synthesis and Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06701)
*Sicheng Yang,Rui Tang,Haipeng Zhou,Hongqiu Wang,Zhaohu Xing,Jianda Ma,Lie Dai,Guang Yang,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三阶段框架，整合自动数据筛选、生成式表征学习与下游任务高效适配，缓解病理深度学习像素级标注稀缺问题，实现SOTA分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理深度学习受限于大规模像素级标注的稀缺与高成本；合成数据虽可缓解，但现有流程缺乏可靠质量控制，且与下游分析联系薄弱。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 构建病理智能体系统评估图像质量并过滤样本，从公开TCGA中筛选出TCGA-200K（217,030个切片）；(2) 在筛选数据上训练生成模型，其骨干除图像合成外学到可迁移的结构与语义表征；(3) 用轻量任务专用头将预训练生成骨干适配到语义分割，并构建PathSeg-380K（约38万细胞、12类别的专家标注分割数据集）。

Result: 在多个病理数据集上取得最先进的分割性能。

Conclusion: 将质量控制化的合成数据生成与生成式表征迁移统一起来，可有效支撑病理下游分析，代码已开源。

Abstract: Deep learning methods for pathology are constrained by the limited availability and high cost of large-scale pixel-level annotations. Synthetic data can alleviate this limitation, but existing pipelines often lack reliable quality control and remain weakly connected to downstream analysis. To address these issues, we propose a three-stage framework that integrates automated data screening, generative representation learning, and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. First, we develop a pathology agent system to assess image quality and filter samples, resulting in TCGA-200K, a dataset containing 217,030 pathology patches selected from the public TCGA repository. Second, we train a generative model on the screened data. In addition to image synthesis, its backbone learns structural and semantic representations that can be transferred to downstream tasks. Third, we adapt the pretrained generative backbone to semantic segmentation using a lightweight task-specific head. We further introduce PathSeg-380K, a semantic segmentation dataset with expert annotations for approximately 380,000 cells across 12 cell types. Experiments on multiple pathology datasets show that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/script-Yang/Agent-GenPath.

</details>


### [113] [Coupled Scene Graph Anticipation: When With-Constraint Recall Hides Structural Inconsistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06738)
*Zeno Nongmaithem,Anushttha Srivastava,Anshit Sinha,Apoorv Sisodia,Suman Chowdhury,Prerana Mukherjee,Rajesh P. Barnwal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出 CoupledSGA，通过关系交互图与结构一致性损失让同一实体的关系在连续时间场景图预测中相互耦合，并揭示现有 With-Constraint 评测协议无法反映一致性约束的收益，建议同时报告 No-Constraint 指标与矛盾率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间 SGA 用独立 Neural ODE 演化每个 subject-object 对，导致共享实体的关系在积分过程中互不影响，且无法阻止同一对出现互斥谓词（如"sitting on"与"standing on"）的矛盾预测。

Method: 构建 Relationship Interaction Graph，在 ODE 向量场内部引入图注意力实现关系耦合；并基于互斥谓词矩阵设计结构一致性损失 L_SC。同时对该损失的梯度性质与 With-Constraint 评测协议进行理论分析。

Result: 在 Action Genome 上，两轮 warm-up 后启用 L_SC 使 R@20 从 42.21% 降至 35.18%，No-Constraint 矛盾率从 45.92% 降至 4.07%（匹配预算下 40.48% vs. 44.78% SceneSayerODE）。理论上证明了 With-Constraint 的 R@K/mR@K 在组内胜出谓词及其分数固定时不变，且 L_SC 梯度依赖预测分数而非真值标签。

Conclusion: CoupledSGA 是研究测试平台而非 SOTA：With-Constraint 召回只能体现结构一致性约束的代价，无法体现其收益。对约束谓词共激活的方法，应同时报告 No-Constraint 结果与矛盾率。

Abstract: Scene Graph Anticipation (SGA) predicts object relationships in future video frames. Continuous-time SGA models evolve each subject-object pair with an independent Neural ODE, so relationships sharing an entity cannot influence one another during integration, and nothing prevents mutually exclusive predictions, such as "sitting on" and "standing on", for the same pair. We introduce CoupledSGA, which links such relationships through a Relationship Interaction Graph with graph attention inside the ODE vector field, and adds a Structural Consistency Loss ($\mathcal{L}_{SC}$) based on a matrix of mutually exclusive predicates.
  Developing CoupledSGA revealed a limitation of the evaluation protocol. With-Constraint evaluation keeps one predicate per group for each subject-object pair, so its R@K and mR@K cannot capture the within-group violations targeted by $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$: we prove they are unchanged whenever each group's winning predicate and its score are held fixed. We further show that the gradient of $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ depends on predicate scores rather than ground-truth labels: for two-predicate rules it amplifies the ordering the model already holds, and when all scores in a group are equal it suppresses predicates in more exclusion rules more strongly, explaining why the penalty can lower recall while improving consistency.
  On Action Genome, activating $\mathcal{L}_{SC}$ after two warm-up epochs reduces R@20 from 42.21% to 35.18% while lowering the No-Constraint contradiction rate from 45.92% to 4.07% (matched-budget R@20: 40.48% CoupledSGA vs. 44.78% SceneSayerODE). CoupledSGA is a testbed, not a state-of-the-art claim: With-Constraint recall captures the cost of enforcing structural consistency but not the improvement. We recommend reporting No-Constraint results alongside a contradiction rate for methods that constrain predicate co-activation.

</details>


### [114] [TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06741)
*Ruikang Li,Zixuan Chen,Jiarui Wu,Mingde Yao,Yiyuan Zhang,Yujin Wang,Hanming Deng,Lewei Lu,Tianfan Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TailSteer：仅作用于去噪轨迹末端的最终阶段训练框架，抑制多轮编辑中的累积漂移，同时保留基座模型的生成与编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单轮编辑性能强并不保证多轮交互可靠：编辑输出被反复复用，微小非预期改动会累积成严重视觉漂移。现有缓解手段（多轮数据训练、跨轮 rollout、专用推理期机制）要么改变预训练先验，要么难以扩展到基础模型。

Method: 提出最终阶段训练框架 TailSteer，原则是让早期去噪动态贴近基座模型，将保持性修正集中在轨迹尾部以压制细粒度偏差。修正项从编辑器自身的 on-policy 去噪 rollout 中学习，以未改动的源内容作为保持参考，无需人工标注的真值编辑对。

Result: 在 FLUX、SenseNova、Qwen 系列上，15–20 轮编辑中显著降低累积漂移，同时在大量文生图与单图编辑基准上基本保持基座模型性能。

Conclusion: 长程编辑鲁棒性可通过 TailSteer 在基础模型上“解锁”，而非重新学习其已有能力；为多轮编辑稳定化提供了一种轻量、末段干预式的训练范式。

Abstract: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drift is often mitigated through training on multi-turn data or cross-turn rollouts, potentially altering pretrained priors, or through specialized inference-time mechanisms that are difficult to scale to foundation models. We introduce TailSteer, a final-stage training framework that improves multi-turn robustness while retaining the generative and editing capabilities acquired through earlier training. TailSteer follows a simple principle: keep early denoising dynamics close to those of the base model and concentrate preservation corrections near the trajectory tail, where fine-grained deviations can be suppressed. These corrections are learned from the editor's own on-policy denoising rollouts, using unchanged source content as a preservation reference without requiring curated ground-truth editing pairs. Experiments across the FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen families show that TailSteer substantially reduces cumulative drift over 15-20 editing turns while largely preserving base-model performance on extensive text-to-image and single-image editing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that long-horizon editing robustness can be unlocked in foundation models after TailSteer, rather than by relearning their existing capabilities.

</details>


### [115] [EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06748)
*Yequan Bie,Dengyang Jiang,Zhixuan Chen,Xiaozhuan Liang,Haoxuan Che,Quande Liu,Xi Chen,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"视野外因果演化"新问题，构建EvoWorld（VLM世界大脑+分段自回归渲染器）及数据集/基准，显著提升事件条件因果演化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式视频模型作为视觉世界模拟器，强于渲染逼真像素而非推理世界应如何演化；缺乏显式世界状态维护与事件后果推理机制，常产生视觉合理但行为静态或因果不一致的输出。

Method: 提出Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution问题：渲染事件、推理其对世界状态的后果、在外视野外持续演化中呈现因果合理结果。给出基线EvoWorld：脑-渲染器协作框架，VLM作"世界大脑"观察生成片段、维护演化世界表征并推理状态转移，分段自回归视频渲染器将其视觉实现；并构建EvoWorld-Data与EvoWorld-Bench用于训练与评测事件实现、因果反应、重访一致性。

Result: 实验表明EvoWorld在事件条件因果演化上显著优于近期模型，同时保持视觉质量与一致性。

Conclusion: EvoWorld为推理引导的、超越当前视野的自主世界演化建立了参考基准点。

Abstract: Generative video models are increasingly used as visual world simulators, yet their primary strength lies in rendering plausible pixels rather than reasoning about how a world should evolve. Coherent world evolution requires more than visual fidelity: when an event occurs, a model must infer its consequences for the entities in the world and then render the resulting state. For example, after a wild beast appears, the model should not only depict the wild beast, but also infer whether a nearby person should flee, take cover, or fight back based on the realized scene. Existing diffusion-based video models lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining world state and reasoning over such event-conditioned consequences, often producing visually plausible but behaviorally static or causally inconsistent outputs. To make this reasoning gap concrete and measurable, we propose a new problem, Out-of-Sight Causal Evolution, which requires a model to render an event, reason about its consequences for the evolving world state, and reveal a causally plausible outcome as the world continues to evolve, even out of sight. As a baseline reference solution, we introduce EvoWorld, a brain-renderer collaboration framework in which a vision-language model serves as the world brain: it observes generated segments, maintains an evolving account of the world, and reasons about plausible state transitions, while a segment-autoregressive video renderer realizes them visually. We further introduce EvoWorld-Data and EvoWorld-Bench for training and evaluating event realization, causal reactions, and revisit consistency. Experiments show that EvoWorld substantially improves event-conditioned causal evolution over recent models while preserving visual quality and consistency, establishing a reference point for reasoning-guided, autonomous world evolution beyond the current field of view.

</details>


### [116] [Route First, See Later: Enabling Vision Agents to Reason Scientifically by Separating Routing Policy from Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06760)
*Shubhabrata Mukherjee,Jeffrey Donatelli,Daniela Ushizima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZETA 是一种将路由策略与动作执行解耦的可扩展科学视觉智能体架构，通过先解析意图再调用专用视觉工具，实现路由正确性与下游执行的独立评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学图像分析多工具架构将意图解释与视觉执行混为一谈，无法区分失败源于推理错误（误路由）还是感知失败（无效工具执行），缺乏可审计性，导致智能体在高风险科学自动化中不可靠。

Method: 提出 ZETA 架构，显式解耦路由策略与动作执行；在调用专用视觉工具前先解析科学意图，将测量视为基于显式几何的确定性操作而非生成式输出；并在固定合法动作接口的前提下，开展首个隔离路由策略规范的受控研究，以 51 条零样本科学意图查询为基准评估。

Result: 显式路由语义可显著提升路由准确率，尤其在语义相邻的动作边界处，但提升幅度因模型而异。对 Qwen 3.8，分割路由准确率从 6.2% 提升至 75.0%，检测路由准确率从 60.0% 提升至 100%。

Conclusion: ZETA 的执行轨迹使路由决策与下游产物可分别观测，为区分意图选择错误与视觉执行失败提供依据，是部署可靠科学视觉智能体所需的关键基础设施。

Abstract: Scientific image-analysis workflows require agents to select among diverse capabilities like description, detection, counting, and segmentation. Current multi-tool architectures conflate intent interpretation with visual execution, masking whether a failure arises from flawed reasoning (misrouting) or failed perception (invalid tool execution). This lack of auditability renders agents unreliable for high-stakes scientific automation. We introduce ZETA, an extensible architecture that operationalizes the decoupling of routing policy from action execution. ZETA resolves scientific intent before invoking specialized visual tools, treating measurement as a deterministic operation grounded in explicit geometry rather than generative output. This architecture exposes the "black box" of agent decision-making, allowing routing correctness and downstream execution to be evaluated as independent failure modes.
  To our knowledge, we provide the first controlled study in scientific vision-agent routing that isolates explicit routing-policy specification while holding the legal action interface fixed. Evaluation on a zero-shot benchmark of 51 scientific-intent queries shows that explicit routing semantics can substantially improve routing accuracy, particularly at semantically adjacent action boundaries, although improvements vary across models. For Qwen 3.8, explicit routing-policy specification improves segmentation routing accuracy from 6.2% to 75.0% and detection routing accuracy from 60.0% to 100%. ZETA's execution traces make routing decisions and downstream artifacts separately observable, providing a basis for distinguishing intent-selection errors from visual execution failures. ZETA establishes the necessary infrastructure to isolate execution errors from interpretive ones, a critical requirement for deploying reliable scientific vision agents.

</details>


### [117] [Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06770)
*Jiawei Zhang,Rizhao Cai,Dayan Guan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向城市管理的细粒度无人机遥感评测基准UMBench，发现现有MLLM依赖场景级先验而忽视细粒度视觉证据，并提出免训练的"证据优先"思维链方法加以改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度视觉推理对城市管理中的遥感应用至关重要，但在多模态大模型（MLLM）评测中仍研究不足；现有模型倾向依赖场景级先验，忽略关键细粒度视觉证据。

Method: 构建UMBench基准：基于无人机（UAV）图像，覆盖交通监测、城市建设、环境质量、灾害预警等多项城市管理任务；并提出evidence-first chain-of-thought方法，以免训练（training-free）方式引导模型优先检查细粒度视觉证据。

Result: 在UMBench上的评测显示当前MLLM普遍依赖场景级先验、忽视细粒度证据；所提方法可同时提升开源与商业MLLM在UMBench上的性能。

Conclusion: UMBench揭示了MLLM在细粒度城市遥感推理上的不足，证据优先思维链是一种无需训练、通用有效的改进策略。

Abstract: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.

</details>


### [118] [Semantic Residual Vector Quantization for Sign Language Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06781)
*Chang Liu,Ke Han,Niccolò Biondi,Gloria Isotton,Elisa Ricci,Davide Talon,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出语义残差向量量化(SRVQ)框架,将手语生成显式分解为"语义→运动学"两级过程,在单一量化器中实现从手语内容到精细关节运动的层级编码,在CSL-Daily与Phoenix-2014T上R@1达82.3和70.3,分别超越此前SOTA 30和46个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语生成需同时决定"表达哪些手语"和"如何精确实现"(手型、轨迹、表情、身体协调),而现有基于姿态的系统与仅做重建的运动tokenizer将这两类决策纠缠在一起,生成器缺乏显式的、与文本对齐的中间目标。

Method: 提出语义残差向量量化(SRVQ):SRV量化器学习层级结构,第一残差层编码手语内容,后续残差层细化姿态、手型、轨迹与身体协调,全部在单一量化器内完成,无需独立语义表示或外部规划阶段;采用词感知条件化的层级码生成,由掩码语义生成器预测语义码,再由运动学生成器补全残差码以合成完整SMPL-X运动。

Result: 在共享文本-运动嵌入空间中以检索与FID评估,并结合标准几何指标;CSL-Daily与Phoenix-2014T上R@1分别为82.3与70.3,较此前SOTA提升30与46个点。

Conclusion: 通过残差量化构建显式的语义-运动学层级中间表示,可在单一框架内解耦"签什么"与"怎么签",显著提升手语生成性能。

Abstract: Sign language generation (SLG) maps written sentences into signing motion while preserving both lexical content and fine-grained articulation. This requires a model to decide what signs should be expressed and to realize them through precise handshape, trajectory, facial expression and body coordination. Existing pose-based systems and reconstruction-only motion tokenizers often entangle these two decisions, leaving the generator without an explicit text-aligned intermediate target for what to sign before refining how to sign it. To address this issue, we introduce Semantic Residual Vector Quantization (SRVQ), a framework for SLG that frames generation as a two-level process moving from semantics to kinematics. The newly introduced SRV Quantizer learns a hierarchy in which the first residual level encodes sign content and subsequent levels refine pose, handshape, trajectory, and body coordination, all within a single quantizer and without separate semantic representations or external planning stages. Through word-aware conditioning for hierarchical code generation, a masked semantic generator predicts semantic codes and a kinematic generator completes the residual codes for full SMPL-X motion synthesis. We evaluate using retrieval and FID in a shared text-motion embedding space, alongside standard geometric metrics. On CSL-Daily and Phoenix-2014T, SRVQ achieves R@1 of 82.3 and 70.3, outperforming the previous SOTA by 30 and 46 points, respectively.

</details>


### [119] [VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06796)
*Yihong Luo,Tianyu Pang,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出速度对抗蒸馏（VAD）框架，并据此构建VA-TDM，实现少步扩散/流生成的高质量轨迹分布匹配，在文生图与文生视频任务上达到SOTA四步生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步蒸馏虽能高效生成，但仅用少数采样步保持质量困难。基于score distillation的分布匹配方法依赖准确跟踪学生分布，而少步采样中间步骤中学生score难以估计，常用估计器所刻画的分布与更新学生所用分布可能不一致。

Method: 利用flow matching中学生采样过程构造的速度场作为更灵活的监督信号：学习一个critic比较学生与教师速度场，将二者分歧转化为学习反馈，即速度对抗蒸馏（VAD）；VAD统一了score distillation、Fisher匹配与矩匹配，并解释现有启发式MMD更新、导出新训练目标。进一步提出VA-TDM，沿学生轨迹对部分去噪过程施加监督，即轨迹分布匹配，并结合转移感知的在线速度学习与双形式VAD监督。

Result: VA-TDM在学习少步生成器上表现强劲，在多种骨干网络上于文生图与文生视频均取得SOTA四步性能，并可有效扩展至33B MiniMax-H3；VA-TDM-H3显著优于少步Fast-H3，按人类偏好更接近原始多步H3。

Conclusion: 以速度场为核心的对抗式分布匹配是少步蒸馏的有效范式，VAD提供统一理论视角，VA-TDM通过轨迹级监督与在线速度学习大幅提升少步生成质量并具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: Few-step distillation offers efficient generation with diffusion and flow models, but preserving quality with only a few sampling steps remains challenging. Distribution-matching methods via score distillation provide a strong foundation, yet they rely on accurately tracking the student's changing distribution. At intermediate generation steps in few-step sampling, student-score estimation can be difficult, and commonly used estimators may describe a different distribution from the one used to update the student. Flow matching allows a more flexible approach to supervision through velocity fields constructed from the student's sampling process. Building on this perspective, we introduce Velocity Adversarial Distillation (VAD), which uses a learned critic to compare student and teacher fields and turn their disagreement into feedback for learning. VAD unifies score distillation, Fisher-based matching, and moment matching, also explaining existing heuristic MMD updates and delivering new training objectives. We further develop VA-TDM, which follows trajectory distribution matching: providing supervision for partial denoising along the student trajectory. Beyond this, VA-TDM combines transition-aware online velocity learning and dual-form VAD supervision across intermediate student transitions. Extensive results show that VA-TDM is powerful for learning few-step generators, achieving state-of-the-art four-step performance in both text-to-image and text-to-video generation across various backbones and scaling effectively to 33B MiniMax-H3. In particular, our VA-TDM-H3 notably outperforms the few-step Fast-H3 and is closer to the original many-step H3 according to human preference.

</details>


### [120] [Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06817)
*Juncheng Ma,Jiaxin Li,Jiankai Tu,Bo Liang,Guodong Lv,Yufan Deng,Junzhe Tang,Liangzhu Yang,Chen Bian,Zicong Cao,Baohao Zhu,Jianxin Bi,Tengfei Yan,Yinyuan Zhang,Kewei Zhang,Xinglong Chen,Kaiqi Chen,Duomin Wang,Xiaotian Tang,Liang Tan,Li Li,Yuan Xu,Haosen Yang,Yuqi Wang,Jingfei Xia,Songyan Huang,Zhiyang Dou,Zhen Dong,Enze Xie,Tat-Seng Chua,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全开源的第一人称人类视频预训练方案 Open-HumanScale，将预训练规模扩展到5万小时，揭示数据时长与下游机器人成功率的对数线性缩放律，并据此构建世界-动作模型 HumanWAM 系列，实现仿真与真机上的强泛化与零样本目标适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称人类视频是可扩展的操作先验来源，但把原始数据规模转化为可泛化的机器人策略，缺乏严谨的数据筛选与训练配方，也缺乏对"纯人类数据预训练究竟如何随规模收益"的定量认识。

Method: 构建 Open-HumanScale-50K 语料（带手部运动与自然语言密集标注），并公开数据筛选与预训练流程；通过闭环仿真评估系统研究纯人类数据预训练，拟合出预训练时长—下游成功率的对数线性缩放律；据此训练仅用5万小时人类视频的 HumanWAM-Vanilla（世界-动作模型），并进一步提出视觉目标条件化的 HumanWAM-Goal 进行人-机器人混合数据联合预训练。

Result: HumanWAM-Vanilla 经机器人后训练后，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上 Clean2Clean 达 92.08%、Clean2Random 达 68.88%，RoboDojo 上平均成功率 14.17%、平均进度分 19.00。HumanWAM-Goal 混合数据缩放带来跨仿真与真实基准的零样本泛化，将 RoboTwin 2.0 提升至 92.70%（Clean2Clean）与 84.60%（Clean2Random）的 SOTA 水平；真机上展现涌现的具身上下文学习，无需参数更新即可适应未见视觉目标。

Conclusion: 人类第一人称视频预训练存在可预测的收益缩放规律，且人-机混合数据预训练可显著突破泛化上限；作者开源语料、数据处理与预训练管线、模型权重、推理代码及仿真评测套件，以支持具身智能中可复现的规模化研究。

Abstract: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanScale, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanScale-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.

</details>


### [121] [Context-Aware Autoregressive Image Generation for Emerging Reasoning Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06838)
*Jixuan Ying,Haoyu Liu,Timing Yang,Tingyu Zhu,Predrag Neskovic,Anand Bhattad,Cihang Xie,Zeyu Zheng,Alan Yuille,Feng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出上下文感知的自回归图像生成框架（Saccades-AR），让模型依据全局上下文与当前局部信息动态决定下一个token的生成位置，而非使用预定义或启发式顺序，从而提升结构鲁棒性与指令遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归图像生成的生成顺序多为预定或启发式（next-patch、随机顺序、特定尺度一步生成），会使模型忽略图像中的重要结构依赖，限制结构鲁棒性与推理能力。

Method: 提出上下文感知自回归生成框架：由模型基于全局上下文和当前局部信息动态确定下一个token的位置，使生成过程自适应图像结构与语义依赖；可适用于masked AR与scale-wise AR等不同范式。

Result: 在不同图像AR范式（masked AR、scale-wise AR）上显著提升结构鲁棒性；并观察到涌现的推理特性：模型能更好理解复杂语义指令，生成更忠实于给定引导的图像。

Conclusion: 生成顺序是图像自回归建模中关键但未被充分探索的因素，上下文感知解码可解锁更强的推理感知视觉生成能力。

Abstract: Autoregressive image generation has recently emerged as a competitive visual generation paradigm, yet its generation order is often predefined or heuristic, such as next-patch prediction, random-order prediction, or one-step generation for specific scales. We observe that these strategies can cause models to overlook important structural dependencies in images, thereby limiting both structural robustness and reasoning capability. In this work, we propose a context-aware autoregressive generation framework, where the model dynamically determines the next token location based on global context and current local information. Rather than following a fixed or random order, our method allows the generation process to adapt to image structure and semantic dependencies. Extensive experiments show that context-aware generation significantly improves structural robustness across different image AR paradigms, including masked autoregressive and scale-wise autoregressive models. Beyond quantitative improvements, we further observe emerging reasoning properties: the model can better understand complex semantic instructions and generate images that more faithfully follow the given guidance. These findings suggest that generation order is a critical yet underexplored factor in image autoregressive modeling, and that context-aware decoding can unlock stronger reasoning-aware visual generation capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/Hpesojyjx/Saccades-AR.

</details>


### [122] [Same Layout, Different Count: What Number Words Do Past Ten in Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06840)
*Liang Yue,Eric A. Vance*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究五款开源文生图模型在“约十个物体”之后的数字词遵从能力：小数量可遵从，超阈值后计数由初始噪声的低频结构决定，数字词无法在去噪中形成清晰方向；并提出以同噪声测试区分“松散遵从”与“完全忽略”的评测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型常被要求生成指定数量的物体，但大数量（如十二、二十五）时是否真正遵从数字词缺乏系统分析；同时传统精确匹配或相对误差指标难以区分模型是“松散遵从”还是“完全忽略”数量指令，需要更可靠的评测手段。

Method: 固定物体与起始噪声，逐项改变单一变量，在五款开源模型（含SD3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、FLUX.2 [klein]、Qwen-Image等）上做受控实验；由不知请求内容的受试者对3,088张图像计数；分析起始噪声的粗/细频段对构图与数量的作用；将数量以“加噪网格”形式注入初始潜变量；比较精确匹配、相对误差与同噪声测试等指标。

Result: 模型存在“遵从上限”（reach）：SD3.5-M与FLUX.1-dev在十余后即停止遵从，FLUX.2 [klein]与Qwen-Image可松散遵从至25。超过上限后，起始噪声的粗分量决定构图但不决定数量：仅重绘高于1/8图像频率的细噪声即可保持布局，且使数量偏移达改变数字词效果的约三分之二。数字词仍可进入去噪器并作用于前几步，但不产生明确方向。以加噪网格形式呈现数量时，59%图像可被人识别出计数，而仅用文字告知时为4%。超过十个后，精确匹配几乎无法区分松散遵从与忽略，相对误差甚至偏好常量猜测16；同噪声测试（每物体少量请求）可有效区分两者。

Conclusion: 大数量生成中数字词的控制力有限且受起始噪声结构主导，现有计数评测指标失效；建议采用同噪声受控测试评估数量遵从，并提示需在潜变量层面显式编码数量信息。

Abstract: Ask SD3.5-Medium for twelve of an object and then, from the same starting noise, for twenty-five. The picture keeps its layout, but the count changes about as much as it would under a new random seed, and in no consistent direction. We study what number words do once a request passes about ten objects, in five open text-to-image models. Holding the object and the starting noise fixed, we change one thing at a time, and people who never see the request count 3,088 of the images. Every model follows the number for small crowds, but only up to a point, its reach: SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following it soon after ten, while FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image follow it loosely up to twenty-five. Beyond SD3.5-M's reach, the coarse part of the starting noise fixes the composition of the picture but not how many objects it holds: redrawing only the noise finer than an eighth of the image keeps the layout as well as a new number does, and already moves the count two-thirds as far. The number word still reaches the denoiser and acts in its first steps, but nothing we tried gives it a clear direction. Shown instead as a noised grid in the starting latent, the count is drawn: people find it in 59% of images, against 4% when it is only told. Past ten, an exact-match score barely separates a model that follows the number loosely from one that ignores it, and a relative-error score can even prefer a constant guess of sixteen. A same-noise test with a few requests per object tells them apart.

</details>


### [123] [Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06844)
*Yingying Yan,Jiaqi Tang,Wei Wei,Qianzhou Wang,Lei Zhang,Jianmin Chen,Yuyang Xia,Botong Geng,Jinjian Wu,Qifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DGP（动态门控通路），在ViT各层与LLM各层之间建立全连接路由，由每个LLM层根据自身语义状态动态门控对视觉层粒度的偏好，以解决MLLM中视觉信息"接在哪里"的关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流MLLM将固定的单层视觉表示注入LLM，并把所有LLM层视为单一消费者，忽视不同层对视觉粒度需求的差异；现有多层融合方法或在编码端压缩层级特征，或依赖预定义的稀疏/层级连接，无法建模ViT与LLM层级间的自适应跨层交互。

Method: DGP（Dynamic Gated Pathways）：在每一ViT层与每一LLM层之间构建all-to-all连接，每个LLM层以自身语义状态为条件动态门控其对各视觉层的偏好，实现自适应跨层视觉路由。基于LLaVA-1.5-7B与13B实现。

Result: 相较LLaVA-1.5-7B基线取得一致提升（SQA^I +4.2、MM-Vet +3.3、VizWiz与LLaVA^W各+3.1），并在多数基准上超过现有多层视觉融合方法；逐层路由分析表明不同LLM层确实按需选择不同视觉粒度。

Conclusion: 动态门控通路既有效又可解释：LLM层对视觉粒度的需求存在分层差异，全连接+动态门控的自适应路由优于固定单层注入与预定义连接方案。

Abstract: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.

</details>


### [124] [Trainspotting: Learning Object-Centric 3D Reconstruction from Found Photos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06849)
*Hanyu Chen,Noah Snavely*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Trainspotting 数据集（12,068 个对象、311,886 张来自 Wikimedia Commons 的照片），并系统重建相机位姿、多视图立体深度与对象掩码，揭示现有前馈重建模型在"移动对象"和"多实体共享设计"两类场景下严重失效，同时证明在该数据集上微调 VGGT-Ω 可显著提升位姿、深度与几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈重建模型主要训练于单次采集（single-session）的对象图像，其中仅视角变化而对象与环境基本固定；而公共照片档案中的"found photos"具有跨年份、跨环境、跨相机、甚至跨物理个体的多视图特性，分布差异导致 SOTA 模型在真实场景（in-the-wild）对象中心照片集上表现不佳。作者希望构建能反映这种数据分布的数据集并加以改进。

Method: 构建 Trainspotting 数据集：从 Wikimedia Commons 收集 12,068 个对象、311,886 张照片，对每个对象进行三维重建以获取相机位姿、多视图立体（MVS）深度和对象掩码；按对象类型划分为三种设定——固定于单一地点、在多地点间移动、以及被多个物理个体共享的设计。基于该数据集评测近期前馈重建模型，并在其上微调 VGGT-Ω。

Result: 评测显示现有前馈模型在"移动对象"与"共享设计"两类设定下失败最为严重；在 Trainspotting 上微调 VGGT-Ω 后在留出对象上的相机位姿、深度和三维几何显著提升，在独立的 NAVI in-the-wild 基准（每个对象拍摄于不同环境）上也观察到类似改进，而在传统基准上的性能基本保持不变，表明改进不牺牲原有能力。

Conclusion: 跨采集、跨环境、跨物理个体的"found photos"是前馈三维重建模型的重要失效维度，Trainspotting 提供了针对该分布的规模化基准与训练资源；通过在该数据上微调可有效提升 in-the-wild 泛化性且不损害传统基准表现，为对象中心重建的数据驱动改进提供了可行路径。

Abstract: State-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections. They are trained largely on single-session object captures whose images vary in viewpoint while the object and its environment remain nearly fixed. Public photo archives contain a different form of multi-view data. They hold found photos of the same object or design: photos taken independently by many people across years, environments, cameras, and sometimes physical units. In this work, we introduce Trainspotting, a dataset of 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos from Wikimedia Commons. We reconstruct each object to recover camera poses, multi-view stereo depth, and object masks. We categorize the objects into three regimes: objects fixed at one site, objects that move between sites, and designs shared by many physical units. Evaluating recent feedforward reconstruction models on Trainspotting shows that they fail most severely in the last two regimes. Fine-tuning VGGT-$Ω$ on Trainspotting significantly improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on held-out objects. We observe similar improvements on the independent NAVI in-the-wild benchmark, which contains photos of each object in different environments. Performance on conventional benchmarks remains largely unchanged.

</details>


### [125] [Visual Token Routing: Learning to keep tokens that matter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06854)
*Pranjal Aggarwal,Sean Welleck*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VTR（视觉Token路由）通过联合训练的轻量时空路由器，动态决定每个图像区域的视觉token是否进入语言模型，在保持性能的同时减少2.5-5.8倍视觉token，显著降低计算机使用智能体的推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）在长程任务上已超越人类水平，但计算成本高昂，限制了其在长程任务和视频游戏等实时场景的应用。关键瓶颈在于每张截图被表示成数千个视觉token，在长交互历史中累积成超长上下文。作者观察到：大部分视觉token要么与下一步动作语义无关，要么在相邻截图间存在时间冗余。

Method: 提出Visual Token Routing（VTR）联合训练框架，学习保留动作预测所需信息的稀疏视觉表示。具体做法是：将视觉语言模型与一个轻量级时空路由器联合训练；路由器检查当前及上一张截图中每个图像区域，判断其视觉token是否进入语言模型；采用自适应损失优化路由器，在尽可能减少视觉token数量的同时最小化性能损失。

Result: 仅用2000步训练，VTR在OSWorld、CUA-World和视频游戏动作预测任务上达到全分辨率模型水平，视觉token减少2.5-5.8倍；推理成本最高降低3.3倍，prefill速度最高提升2.9倍；在OSWorld上比降低图像分辨率及其他token丢弃基线最高优12.8个点。

Conclusion: VTR使计算机使用智能体仅处理所需的视觉token，以极小计算成本支撑长程任务与实时应用。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. In VTR, we train the vision-language model together with a lightweight spatio-temporal router that examines each image region in the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. We optimize the router using an adaptive loss to keep the number of visual tokens as small as possible while minimizing performance degradation. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction, while using 2.5-5.8x fewer visual tokens. These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3x and speed up prefill by up to 2.9x. VTR also outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Overall, VTR enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need, allowing them to be used in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost. Code and models are available at https://pranjal2041.github.io/vtr

</details>


### [126] [CounterFactual Retrieval for Evidence-Aware Individual Animal Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06864)
*Ankit K. Upadhyay,Aleksandr Algasov,Ekaterina Nepovinnykh,Fedor Zolotarev,Tuomas Eerola,Heikki Kälviäinen,Charles V. Stewart,Lukas Picek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出反事实前景检索（CFR）评估协议，通过全图、仅前景、仅捷径三种视图把单一检索分数转化为“证据画像”，并发布约0.5M掩码覆盖34个数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动物个体识别评估仅报告检索精度，无法说明匹配依据是动物本身特征还是与身份相关的背景/轮廓捷径，缺乏证据层面的可解释性。

Method: CFR在同一查询-图库任务下构建三种视图：全图（标准检索性能）、仅前景（前景支撑的检索）、仅捷径（背景或轮廓可恢复的身份信号），并配套掩码生成与评估代码。

Result: 将检索分数分解为证据画像：原始图像上的性能、仅保留动物时的性能留存比例、去除动物后仍可恢复的身份信号量；同时发布34个数据集约0.5M掩码。

Conclusion: CFR把评估从单一精度指标转向证据归因，可揭示依赖身份相关捷径的模型行为，为基准与基础模型的可复用评估提供更可靠的诊断工具。

Abstract: Automated identification of individual animals is moving from small curated studies toward shared benchmarks and reusable foundation models. This progress is useful, but current evaluation leaves the evidence behind a match unresolved, i.e., high retrieval accuracy does not show whether a model used animal features or identity-correlated shortcuts. We address this with Counterfactual Foreground Retrieval (CFR), an evidence-aware evaluation protocol. CFR evaluates the same query-gallery task under different views: full image, foreground-only, and shortcut-only. The full-image measures standard retrieval performance; the foreground-only measures foreground-supported retrieval; and shortcut-only view measure how much identity signal is recoverable from background, or silhouette. This turns a retrieval score into an evidence profile: how well the model performs on the original images, how much of that performance remains when only the animal is visible, and how much identity signal remains recoverable when the animal is removed. We release around 0.5M masks for 34 datasets and code for mask generation and CFR evaluation.

</details>


### [127] [PixelSpline: Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution via Endpoint-Anchored Shared Pixel Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06870)
*Wanqi Yuan,Nianyi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种连续时空视频超分框架，结合长上下文编码、连续高分辨率特征提升和端点锚定的PixelSpline，以单条连续运动轨迹替代双向独立运动建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续时空视频超分方法仅从两个端点帧推断运动，且对两个运动方向独立建模，易受对应关系歧义与轨迹不一致的影响。

Method: 1) 长上下文编码，利用长程观测获得更可靠的端点表示；2) 连续高分辨率特征提升，直接在目标HR网格上构建细节外观特征；3) 端点锚定的PixelSpline，将每个像素的运动显式建模为两端点共享的单条连续轨迹，并据此将端点颜色扭曲生成粗中间帧，同时对齐HR特征用于残差重建。

Result: 在多种空间与时间上采样设置下的实验表明，该框架在质量与效率之间取得了良好的折衷。

Conclusion: 通过长上下文与端点锚定的连续轨迹建模，可缓解运动歧义与轨迹不一致问题，实现较优的质量—效率平衡。

Abstract: Existing continuous space-time video super-resolution methods often infer motion from only two endpoint frames and model the two motion directions independently, making them vulnerable to ambiguous correspondence and inconsistent trajectories. We introduce a continuous STVSR framework that combines long-context encoding, continuous HR feature lifting, and an endpoint-anchored PixelSpline. Long-range observations provide more reliable endpoint representations, while continuous upsampling constructs detailed appearance features directly on the requested HR grid. PixelSpline explicitly models each pixel's motion as a single continuous trajectory shared by both endpoints. Using this trajectory, our method warps endpoint colors into a coarse intermediate frame and aligns the HR features for residual reconstruction. Experiments across spatial and temporal upsampling settings demonstrate that the proposed framework offers a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [128] [Procedural Adversarial Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06890)
*Jack Nugent,Jia Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文研究程序化对抗学习(PAL)框架，提出Simple-PAT算法，在程序生成器的控制参数空间进行零阶优化以按需生成困难样本，并构建PAL-Dojo测试集，显著降低最坏情况误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络在计算机视觉任务中能取得很低的平均误差，但在看似简单的场景上仍会失败。要减少这类失败，首先需要找到它们，而这些失败样本未必存在于固定数据集中。

Method: 提出PAL框架，以极小极大训练与对抗评估的方式在程序生成器的输入空间中搜索困难实例；程序生成器是可解释程序，将低维控制参数（布局、光照、姿态等）映射为渲染图像及其标签。核心算法Simple-PAT在该参数空间中使用零阶优化，按需提出对抗训练样本；同时构建PAL-Dojo，包含面向表面法线估计、图像分割和人体姿态估计的高效程序生成器。

Result: 在聚合查询量为50M的跨模型黑盒对抗者设置下，Simple-PAT相比标准训练将最坏情况误差降低几何平均3.15倍，相比最强鲁棒训练基线降低2.63倍。

Conclusion: 在可解释的程序生成器参数空间中搜索困难样本并进行按需对抗训练，是提升模型鲁棒性、减少最坏情况失败的有效途径；代码已开源。

Abstract: For many computer vision tasks, neural networks can be trained to produce a low average error, yet they still fail on seemingly simple scenes. Reducing these failures requires first finding them, but they may not be in a fixed dataset. We study procedural adversarial learning (PAL), a framework of minimax training and adversarial evaluation which searches the input space of a procedural generator for difficult instances. The procedural generator is an interpretable program mapping a low-dimensional vector of control parameters (e.g. layout, lighting, pose) to a rendered image and its label. We introduce the Simple-PAT algorithm, which uses zeroth-order optimization in the procedural generator's parameter space to propose adversarial training samples that are generated on demand. We also create PAL-Dojo, a collection of efficient procedural generators for surface normal estimation, image segmentation, and human pose estimation. Against a cross-model black-box adversary with 50M aggregate queries, Simple-PAT reduces worst-case error by a geometric mean of 3.15x compared to standard training and 2.63x compared to the strongest robust training baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/procedural-adversarial-learning.

</details>


### [129] [Occlusion for Free: Detecting Occlusion from the Disagreement Between Two Monocular Distance Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06899)
*Chibueze Praise Onyenweaku,Toyibat Adele,Sikirulahi Opeyemi Abdulkareem,Obed Honour Eje*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 仅用单目管线已有的表观高度与单目度量深度两个估计值的相对大小，即可无监督、无遮挡标签地估计行人遮挡程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遮挡估计通常依赖部署场景中几乎不存在的遮挡标注；作者还发现深度融合、遮挡模拟增广、注意力三种常规架构手段均未提升分布外检测性能，且德国道路训练的检测器在尼日利亚拉各斯街头场景精度下降一半，说明"无需本地标注的信号"在基准未覆盖场景中更有价值。

Method: 利用两个相机-only管线已有量：检测框表观高度基本不受遮挡影响（框仍覆盖整个人），而单目度量深度会被遮挡物拉近（框内最近表面主导深度图）。只比较二者的排序关系，故无需焦距、身高或深度尺度，前提是深度模型误差近似为纯增益（可在无标签下检验）。

Result: KITTI 重度遮挡检测 AUC 0.909（含漏检行人的全部标注样本为 0.888）；无需训练与遮挡标签；非距离代理：固定距离带内 AUC 0.894–0.925，而真实距离单独接近随机。CARLA 合成场景（有实测可见度）达 0.819，距离单独为 0.644。

Conclusion: 遮挡可从已有距离估计的排序中读出；无需本地标注的信号在基准未代表的场景中更具价值。

Abstract: Knowing that a pedestrian is occluded is useful to a robot even when the detector cannot recover the hidden pixels, but occlusion estimators are normally trained on occlusion annotations that deployment settings rarely have. We show that occlusion can be read off two distance estimates a camera-only pipeline already computes. Apparent height is largely unchanged by occlusion, because the detected box still spans the whole person; monocular metric depth is pulled toward the occluder, because the nearest surface inside the box is what a depth map reports. Only their ordering matters, so no focal length, stature, or depth scale is needed, provided the depth model's error is close to a pure gain, a condition that can be checked without labels. The score detects heavy occlusion on KITTI with AUC 0.909 (0.888 over all annotated pedestrians, including those the detector misses), requires no training and no occlusion labels, and is not a proxy for range: within fixed distance bands it holds AUC 0.894-0.925 while true distance alone sits near chance. On synthetic CARLA scenes with measured visibility it reaches 0.819, against 0.644 for distance alone. We arrived here after measuring three standard architectural responses to occlusion, depth fusion, occlusion-simulating augmentation, and attention, none of which improved detection outside its training distribution in the configurations we tested, and after finding that a detector trained on German roads loses half its accuracy on self-annotated street scenes in Lagos, Nigeria. Signals that need no local annotation are worth more in settings that benchmarks do not represent.

</details>


### [130] [Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06901)
*Yiwen Chen,Qiqi Hou,Jisoo Jeong,Yinhao Zhu,Huaizu Jiang,Amir Said*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JEPA式世界模型仅靠分布正则无法保证控制所需信息，作者识别出"静态坍缩"失效模式，并提出运动引导对比正则（以光流相似度作软对比目标）加以抑制，在OGBench-Cube与LIBERO-Object显著提升规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA风格世界模型在不重建观测的条件下学习动作条件潜动力学，但分布正则（如SIGReg）只能约束整体分布，无法确保表征保留控制所需信息。作者发现一种"静态坍缩"失效：编码器保留的是随episode变化、时间上可预测的静态内容（如背景身份），却压制了与操作相关的状态变化；由于静态内容在时序上易预测而在episode间多样，该失效可在SIGReg等正则下持续存在。OGBench-Cube受控实验显示，仅引入随机背景即可显著降低规划性能，而操作任务本身未变。

Method: 提出运动引导对比正则（motion-guided contrastive regularization）：将预测的潜转移与同episode中候选观测的转移进行比较，使静态背景身份难以用于区分动作结果；以光流相似度构造软对比目标，令运动相似的候选获得相似监督；与潜预测损失及SIGReg联合优化，促使表征保留episode内状态区分度及相近转移间的相似性。

Result: OGBench-Cube（随机背景）规划成功率由LeWM的52%提升至78%；LIBERO-Object由14%提升至54%；在另外四个视觉控制基准上性能相当。

Conclusion: 分布正则不足以防止静态坍缩，显式引入运动引导的对比监督可有效保留控制相关信息，并在不牺牲其他基准性能的前提下显著提升视觉控制中的规划表现。

Abstract: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.

</details>


### [131] [From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06918)
*Weichen Fan,Haiwen Diao,Penghao Wu,Siyuan Hu,Ziqi Huang,Tianqi Liu,Mingze Sun,Ziyi Wang,Zhongang Cai,Hanming Deng,Quan Wang,Lei Yang,Lewei Lu,Fangzhou Hong,Zhaoxi Chen,Dahua Lin,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无编码器结构的视觉-语言-动作框架NEO-VLA，让动作策略直接访问逐层演化的视觉表示，而非固定编码器输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型默认"先用视觉编码器压缩感知、再进行动作推理"，但操作任务往往依赖局部几何、边界、深度与细微状态变化等恰易被抽象压缩丢失的信号。因此质疑：动作策略应继承固定的视觉端点，还是直接访问持续演化的视觉计算？

Method: NEO-VLA采用结构上无独立视觉编码器的架构：图像由轻量patch卷积层tokenize，与语言在骨干网络中联合演化；流匹配（flow-matching）动作专家可从不同深度的指令条件化视觉表示中提取特征。并通过受控对比、全量微调与层级探针实验分析架构差异。

Result: 受控对比下，原生（无编码器）架构持续优于编码器基线；全量微调可缩小但不能消除差距，单纯扩大规模亦无法弥补。层级探针显示动作关键信号常在最终视觉表示之前达到峰值。在多种操作场景与分布偏移下，NEO-VLA取得更强、更鲁棒的控制性能。

Conclusion: 具身控制受益于跨计算层级的视觉表示访问，而非固定编码器输出；"感知先压缩、再推理"的默认前提值得重新审视。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [132] [Discourse Analysis of Legislative Bill Discussions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05381)
*Isaac Rudnick,Nipun Das,Foaad Khosmood*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出端到端流水线，从立法委员会听证会记录中解析修辞结构，并给出修辞结构文法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 立法听证会具有人类可识别的独特结构与逻辑，但以往多被当作独立现象而非其转录文本进行分析；深入理解听证会有助于分析民主机构中的工作与权力关系、提升立法话语分析与民主问责。

Method: 构建端到端流水线解析立法委员会听证会的修辞结构；提出修辞结构文法；在100场听证会、逾2000条标注话语的随机子集上，用两种话语片段分类器评估流水线，其中逻辑回归分类器采用基于文法的输出掩码与话语标签平滑。

Result: 数据集中55.21%的加州州法案讨论可用该文法解析；基于逻辑回归、带文法输出掩码与标签平滑的分类器优于更复杂模型，对真实话语片段标签取得52.8%的F1值。

Conclusion: 文法化、轻量化的方法可有效解析立法听证修辞结构，为立法话语分析与民主问责提供可扩展工具。

Abstract: Legislative hearings are distinct communication events with their own human recognizable structure and logic, yet they have been analyzed as distinct phenomena beyond their transcripts. Understanding legislative hearings at a deeper level is a major step in analyzing the work and power relationships within democratic bodies. In this work, we present a novel end-to-end pipeline for parsing rhetorical structures from legislative committee hearings with the goal of improving legislative discourse analysis and democratic accountability. We also propose a rhetorical structure grammar and find that 55.21% of California state bill discussions in our dataset can be parsed with this grammar. We evaluate our pipeline with two utterance section classifiers on a random subset of over 2,000 annotated utterances corresponding to 100 hearings. We find that a logistic regression-based classifier with grammar-based output masking and utterance tag smoothing outperforms more complex models, achieving an F1 score of 52.8% against our ground truth discourse section labels.

</details>


### [133] [DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: A Verdict-Anchored Pipeline for Generating Fact-Checking Articles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05382)
*Hoang Thanh Thanh Truong,Shuyu Tian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个四阶段流水线，从声明、原始判定与抓取文档自动生成完整事实核查文章，在 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 3 中平均分0.428，9支队伍中排名第3（基线0.272）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚假信息传播速度快于人工事实核查者撰写解释性文章的速度，需自动化生成事实核查文章。

Method: DS@GT ARC 团队的四阶段流水线：1) 清洗噪声证据；2) 检索并聚类相关来源；3) 以原始事实核查判定为条件，用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 生成文章；4) 通过确定性后处理恢复行内引用。

Result: 平均得分0.428，在9支队伍中排名第3；基线平均分0.272。

Conclusion: 以原始判定为条件、结合证据清洗与检索聚类及确定性引用恢复的流水线可显著优于基线，代码已开源。

Abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkthat-2026-task3.

</details>


### [134] [CCDWIKI: Decoupling Case Formulation from Response Generation in Longitudinal CBT Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05383)
*Mingwen Zhang,Ruiyang Song,Qinying Wang,Yuchen Wang,Changsheng Ma,Minqiang Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CCDWiki：将纵向心理治疗建模为“证据驱动的假设裁定”，以可变条目记录临床假设及其支持/反驳证据，生成简洁指导注入未修改的治疗语言模型，无需重训练即可提升概念化与干预质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBT需要结构化的认知概念化（情境—自动思维—情绪—行为），治疗师需持续进行证据裁定以区分暂定假设与确证结论。现有对话系统仅靠检索历史或静态画像追踪会话，缺乏编码“认识论状态”的表征能力，导致暂定解释被过早固化为事实，从而偏置后续干预。

Method: 提出CCDWiki，作为即插即用的顾问模块：将每个临床假设编码为可变条目，绑定支持性证据与矛盾性证据；跨会话累积数据，强化被支持条目、保留暂定条目、撤回被反驳假设；最终将概念化提炼为简洁指导，提供给未经修改的治疗语言模型。

Result: 实验表明，在概念化质量与干预质量两方面均有显著提升，且无需对主干模型进行重训练。

Conclusion: 显式表征假设的证据状态可有效缓解“暂定结论被过早具体化”的问题，为治疗对话系统提供轻量、可插拔且不改动主干模型的改进路径。

Abstract: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) demands more than empathic validation, requiring instead a structured formulation of the interplay among situations, automatic thoughts, emotions, and behaviors. Therapists formalize this interplay through a Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram, where maintaining longitudinal coherence necessitates continuous evidential adjudication to separate tentative hypotheses from established findings. Current dialogue systems track conversational history via retrieval or static profiles but lack the representational capacity to encode epistemic status. Consequently, provisional interpretations are often prematurely reified as established facts, inadvertently biasing downstream interventions. Addressing this limitation, CCDWiki is introduced as a plug-and-play advisor conceptualizing longitudinal therapy as evidence-grounded hypothesis adjudication. The approach encodes each clinical hypothesis as a mutable entry bound to corroborating and contradicting evidence. Across sessions, accumulating data strengthens supported entries, preserves provisional ones, and retracts contradicted assumptions. The resulting formulation distills into concise guidance for unmodified therapeutic language models. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in both conceptualization and intervention quality without requiring backbone retraining.

</details>


### [135] [Human-like cross-language generalisation in deep neural speaker embeddings and its acoustic foundations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05384)
*Tianze Xu,Xiyang Li,Xiaoming Jiang,Volker Dellwo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用粤语–英语双语语音考察18个主流深度说话人嵌入模型能否跨语言泛化，并将其与人类评分和声学特征进行比较，发现嵌入的跨语言泛化与人类行为、声学线索加权模式高度平行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言泛化是深度神经网络可泛化性的核心问题之一，而说话人嵌入能否跨语言泛化、这种泛化与人类语音感知及声学结构的关系尚不明确。

Method: 采用粤语–英语双语语音，构建语内（同语言）与跨语言两种条件；从18个SOTA说话人嵌入模型提取相似度，并与人类主观评分及声学特征通过线性混合模型和表征相似性分析（RSA）进行比较。

Result: 嵌入表现出跨语言泛化能力，且与人类行为大体平行：既能准确进行身份辨别，也对语言切换敏感；该泛化依赖基本共享的声学线索并带有语言敏感性的加权，与人类模式一致。

Conclusion: 研究为跨语言语音相似性加工中"人–机对齐"提供了汇聚性证据，表明深度说话人嵌入的跨语言泛化在行为与声学层面均可与人类感知相对应。

Abstract: Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. This study examined whether deep neural speaker embeddings generalise across languages and how such generalisation relates to human perception and acoustic structure. Using Cantonese--English bilingual speech presented in within- and cross-language conditions, we derived similarity from 18 state-of-the-art models and compared it with human ratings and acoustic features using linear mixed models and representational similarity analysis. Embeddings exhibited cross-language generalisation that broadly paralleled human behaviour, reflecting accurate identity discrimination and sensitivity to language switching. This generalisation relied on largely shared acoustic cues with language-sensitive weighting, mirroring human patterns. Together, these findings provide converging evidence for human--machine alignment in cross-language voice similarity processing.

</details>


### [136] [Same Origin, Different Verdicts: Text Production Conditions Confound Machine-Generated Text Detection in Russian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05385)
*Stanislav Kirichenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在俄语语料(1882篇文档,含四通道机器生成部分与标注"来源规整度"的档案人类部分)上,固定"来源"这一变量,测量生产条件对"机器相似度"得分的贡献;用四种操作化指标(固定权重指数、训练分类器、开放模型零样本指标、判官模型)对比,发现四者在任务模式变化下方向不一致,表明检测得分是特定测量系统与语料的属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器生成文本检测被用于会对作者产生代价的判定场景,但"来源"是生产过程属性,并非文本的可观测属性;而人类的写作条件会朝与生成模型相同的方向推动文本特征。既有检测评估未将"生产条件"与"来源"解耦,因此需要固定来源、单独量化生产条件的贡献。

Method: 构建俄语语料1882篇:机器部分由四个生成通道(各对应一个模型族)在三种任务模式、45个任务下生成;人类档案部分在阅读前预先标注来源规整度等级。核心对比在机器语料内部进行——成对文本由同一模型、同一任务生成,仅任务措辞不同。机器相似度用四种操作化:数据收集前即固定权重的可解释指数、训练分类器、开放模型的零样本指标、判官模型。研究方案及程序2–4的规格在程序1结果之后、运行之前确定。

Result: 四种程序出现分歧:改变任务模式使四者得分均发生偏移,但三者呈负向偏移、判官模型呈正向偏移,且四个置信区间均不覆盖零。该分歧在修正语料缺陷与嵌套验证后依然存在。仅使用来源标识符的基线在其可定义的13个分组划分上中位AUROC达1.0000;移除强调标记即可使一个高置信度的"机器"判定翻转为"人类",而全文一字未改。

Conclusion: 机器相似度得分并非文本的固有属性,而是特定测量系统与特定语料的属性;它们同时反映数据收集、重复、格式与预处理决策,而非仅反映语言风格。因此检测结论的外推性受限于测量配置,来源标识符等表面线索可造成近乎完美的伪判别。

Abstract: Automated detection of machine-generated text is applied where the verdict carries a cost for the author, yet origin is a property of the production process, not an observable property of the text. The conditions under which a text is produced push it in the same direction in which a generative model is presumed to push it. This study measures the contribution of these conditions while origin is held fixed. The Russian-language corpus of 1882 documents comprises a machine part, generated by four generation channels (each backed by its own model family) across 45 tasks in three task modes, and an archival human part annotated for source regimentation level before the texts were read. The primary contrast is computed within the machine corpus: both halves of a pair are generated by the same model for the same task and differ only in task wording. Machine-likeness is measured by four operationalisations: an interpretable index with weights fixed before data collection, a trained classifier, a zero-shot metric on an open model, a judge model. The main result is disagreement between procedures: changing the task mode shifted the scores of all four, but three gave a negative shift, the judge a positive one, and none of the four intervals covers zero. The comparison plan and the specifications of procedures 2-4 were fixed after the result of procedure 1, before procedures 2-4 ran; the disagreement survived correction of a corpus defect and of the nested validation. A baseline on the source identifier alone reaches a median AUROC of 1.0000 on the thirteen group splits where it is defined, and removing emphasis markers flipped a confident machine verdict to human without changing the full text by a single character. The scores are properties of a specific measurement system and corpus: they reflect data collection, repetition, formatting, and preprocessing decisions as well as linguistic style.

</details>


### [137] [SRRM: A Retrieval-Reconstruction Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Context Memory in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05386)
*Christopher Alberto Hamonangan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出轻量可复现基准SRRM（Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory），联合评估定向检索与全局信息重建，并引入记忆保持率指标MPR；实验表明SLM的长上下文重建能力随上下文增长衰退远快于检索精度，且增大参数量未必提升长上下文记忆保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLM日益部署于消费级硬件，但其在逐步增长上下文中的信息保持能力认识不足；现有基准以检索导向任务为主，难以判断检索成功是否等同全面的长上下文记忆保持，需揭示仅检索评估所掩盖的互补记忆行为。

Method: 构建SRRM基准，由Targeted Retrieval（定向检索）与Global Information Reconstruction（全局信息重建）两类任务联合评估；提出基准级指标MPR量化检索与重建表现的关系；采用合成数据集，在Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B上测试，上下文负载从10条到100条事实陈述。

Result: 随上下文信息增加，重建性能下降速度显著快于检索准确率；Qwen2.5-1.5B取得最高检索准确率（86.7%）、重建性能（45.7%）与MPR（0.53），优于更大的Qwen2.5-3B（分别为72.2%、18.5%、0.26）。

Conclusion: 仅凭检索无法刻画长上下文记忆保持；参数规模增大不必然改善长上下文记忆保持；SRRM为系统评估长上下文记忆提供可复现、可扩展的基准，并揭示检索评估框架下隐藏的互补记忆行为。

Abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed on consumer-grade hardware, yet their ability to preserve information across progressively longer contexts remains insufficiently understood. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate retrieval-oriented tasks, providing limited insight into whether successful retrieval reflects comprehensive long-context memory preservation. To address this limitation, this paper introduces Simple Retrieval-Reconstruction Memory (SRRM), a lightweight and fully reproducible benchmark that jointly evaluates Targeted Retrieval and Global Information Reconstruction. This study also proposes the Memory Preservation Ratio (MPR), a benchmark-level metric that quantifies the relationship between retrieval and reconstruction performance. SRRM was evaluated using a synthetic dataset on three Qwen2.5 models (0.5B, 1.5B, and 3B parameters) across context loads ranging from 10 to 100 factual statements. Experimental results show that reconstruction performance deteriorated substantially faster than retrieval accuracy as contextual information increased, indicating that retrieval alone is insufficient to characterize long-context memory preservation. Among the evaluated models, Qwen2.5-1.5B achieved the highest retrieval accuracy (86.7%), reconstruction performance (45.7%), and MPR (0.53), outperforming the larger Qwen2.5-3B model (72.2%, 18.5%, and 0.26, respectively). These findings demonstrate that increasing parameter count does not necessarily improve long-context memory preservation. Overall, SRRM provides a reproducible and extensible benchmark for systematically evaluating long-context memory while revealing complementary memory behaviors that remain hidden under retrieval-only evaluation frameworks.

</details>


### [138] [AI-Driven SaaS Platform Integration: AI Express for Unified Generative AI Services with Pay-As-You-Go Credit Systems and Scalable Microservice Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05389)
*Deepit Sapru*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AI Express 是一个按使用付费的 SaaS 平台，将文本生成、图像合成、代码辅助等多类生成式 AI 能力整合到统一界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生成式 AI 生态碎片化，文本、图像、代码等能力需分别订阅，导致成本高且工作流被打断。

Method: 构建统一的 SaaS 平台，采用 pay-as-you-go 计费，集成核心代码审查器（评估 GitHub 仓库）、文本生成网站、脚本生成、语法检查、数据分析、去水印等工具，并提供单一无技术门槛的访问界面。

Result: 摘要未给出量化评测结果，仅描述平台所涵盖的功能集合与整合方式。

Conclusion: 该平台以统一、按需付费、低门槛的方式整合多类生成式 AI 工具，有望降低使用成本并减少工作流割裂。

Abstract: Generative AI is currently fragmented, with separate subscriptions required for text generation, image synthesis, and code assistance, leading to high costs and workflow disruptions. AI Express is a SaaS platform that consolidates these capabilities into a unified pay-as-you-go service. The platform provides a range of AI tools, including a Core Code Reviewer that evaluates GitHub repositories, a Text-to-Website generator that converts text into fully functional websites, script generation, grammar checking, data analysis, and watermark removal, all accessible through a single interface without requiring technical expertise.

</details>


### [139] [When to Ask, When to Answer: Strategic Clarification for Ambiguous Reference Resolution in Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05517)
*Ibrahim Khebour,Nikhil Krishnaswamy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究“策略性澄清”问题：在指代游戏中，当澄清问题的答案能缩小候选指代集合时是否应当提问。基于SIMMC 2.1构建可控测试环境，记录每个歧义指代被解决所需提问次数，比较基线LLM与常见后训练方法的行为，并提出BACE方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类指代消歧是协作过程，会在提问能实质性改变结果时才提出澄清问题；而LLM存在“过早作答”偏差，倾向给出确定的单轮回答而非多轮澄清。现有方法缺乏对“何时提问、问几次”这一策略性决策的系统刻画。

Method: 从SIMMC 2.1数据集构造受控测试环境，标注每个歧义指代成功解析所需的问题数量；在此环境上评估基线LLM行为及常见后训练方法在“提问澄清”与“尝试直接指代”之间的选择；提出BACE（Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking），一种构建在冻结LM主干之上的轻量级动作选择器，通过信念感知评判与认知状态追踪进行动作选择。

Result: BACE相比GRPO、ArCHer等方法，能更稳定地选择最优的澄清问题数量，即在需要澄清时提问、在无需澄清时作答，减少过早作答。

Conclusion: 策略性澄清是LLM指代消歧中的关键能力，轻量级、外挂于冻结主干的动作选择方法可在不微调大模型的前提下更可靠地实现最优澄清策略。

Abstract: For humans, referential disambiguation is a collaborative process involving clarification questions asked when they will meaningfully change the outcome. However, large language models (LLMs) have been shown to be biased toward premature answering, preferring definite single-turn responses over more clarification exchanges. In this paper, we study the problem of "strategic clarification" -- asking clarification questions in a reference game when their answers will narrow the set of candidate referents. We construct a controlled test environment from the SIMMC 2.1 dataset that records how many questions each ambiguous reference needs to be successfully resolved, and examine how baseline LLM behavior and common post-training methods ask clarifying questions vs. attempt to answer the referent. We also propose BACE (Belief-Aware Critic with Epistemic tracking), a lightweight action chooser method on top of a frozen LM backbone, and show that BACE more consistently chooses the optimal number of clarifying questions than methods such as GRPO and ArCHer.

</details>


### [140] [Rewrite, Then Veto: Rewriter-Agnostic Edit Gating for LLM-Based Post-OCR Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05539)
*Jorge Ramón Fonseca Cacho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出EditVeto：在全文LLM改写后加一个0.6B参数的veto gate，按字符对齐切分差异块，逐块决定保留或回退，从而在不伤害已正确文本的前提下修复OCR错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能修复历史文档的含噪OCR转录，但也会把本来正确的文本改错。oracle分析表明：给定真实错误位置时，逐span生成反而不如不纠正；而"先全文改写、再否决其编辑"更有效，因此需要设计一个后置的编辑否决机制。

Method: 将全文改写结果与OCR输入做字符级对齐，把差异切分为块；用0.6B参数的gate对每个块决定保留或回退。gate由两个Qwen3模型的改写数据训练，在八个HIPE-OCRepair-2026测试集上以冻结方式评估，并对未见过的重写模型、竞赛公开输出、重训练的LoRA场景做检验。

Result: 在五个重写器（含两个训练未见）上全部改进：加权cMER下降0.0026-0.0044，preference score提升0.15-0.25（配对bootstrap，p≈0.0002）。对竞赛公开输出，四个队伍中三个cMER下降，但冠军run反而升高（0.0050→0.0065）。第二次披露测试中，重训练gate仍能改进LoRA重写器（cMER -0.0011至-0.0021），其门控编辑的集成达cMER 0.0069、preference 0.928，提升主要来自微调与集成而非门控。第三次补充测试中，未改动的gate改进零样本Qwen3.8-27B（cMER 0.0114→0.0108），但仅改进其LoRA版的preference score。

Conclusion: 仅用公开模型与数据，该方法落后于冠军（0.0050），与第二名（0.0071）持平，优于其余已公开run；显示门控式编辑否决是稳健且可迁移的OCR后处理策略，但相对领域预训练方案仍有差距。

Abstract: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. The rewrite is character-aligned to the OCR input, its differences are split into blocks, and a 0.6B-parameter gate keeps or reverts each block. An oracle analysis motivates the design: given the true error locations, per-span generation is worse than no correction, whereas vetoing a full rewrite's edits helps. Trained on rewrites by two Qwen3 models and evaluated, frozen, on the eight HIPE-OCRepair-2026 test sets, the gate improves all five rewriters tested, two of them unseen in training: weighted cMER falls by 0.0026-0.0044 and the preference score rises by 0.15-0.25 (paired bootstrap, p ~ 0.0002 each). On published competition outputs it lowers cMER for three of four teams but raises it for the winning run (0.0050 to 0.0065). In a second, disclosed test look, a retrained gate still improves LoRA-tuned rewriters (cMER -0.0011 to -0.0021), and an ensemble of their gated edits reaches a cMER of 0.0069 and a preference score of 0.928, mostly through fine-tuning and pooling rather than gating. Built only on public models and data, it is behind the winner (0.0050) and tied with the second-ranked run (0.0071), both from the only team using domain pre-training, and ahead of all other published runs. A third, secondary look shows the unchanged gate improving zero-shot Qwen3.8-27B (cMER 0.0114 to 0.0108) but only the preference score of its LoRA-tuned version.

</details>


### [141] [RAGCompass: Generalizable Retriever Routing via Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05596)
*Valentin Six,Mufei Li,Dongqi Fu,Yinglong Xia,Hong Li,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RAGCompass 通过"阅读检索到的段落集合本身"来为每个查询选择最合适的检索器，从而在未见检索器和未见语料上保持路由能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同检索器各有优劣，没有一个检索器对所有查询都最优，因此需要按查询-段落选择最优检索器；但现有路由器依赖查询特征和固定检索器池，对未见检索器无输出、在新语料上失效。

Method: 以检索到的段落集合为输入，将不同检索器/语料的段落直接可比；对比式微调一个 reranker 对齐各证据集所产生的答案（贡献主要增益），另加一个小的比较头（带来中等提升），二者均无检索器特定参数。

Result: 相对最佳固定检索器，答案 F1 提升 28%，并优于融合基线、三个 query-only 路由器以及提示的 8B 语言模型。

Conclusion: 在未见语料、检索器或阅读器下，RAGCompass 保留大部分增益，而 query-only 基线退化到最佳固定检索器或更低，说明基于段落内容的路由更具泛化性。

Abstract: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. We contrastively fine-tune a reranker against the answer each evidence set produces, which accounts for most of the gain; a small comparison head adds a moderate improvement, and neither component has retriever-specific parameters. RAGCompass improves answer F1 by 28% relative to the best fixed retriever, and outperforms fusion baselines, three query-only routers, and a prompted 8B language model. Generalization experiments show that RAGCompass keeps most of its gain under an unseen corpus, retriever, or reader, while query-only baselines fall to the best fixed retriever or below.

</details>


### [142] [Contextual Pictograms for Repairing Multilingual ASR Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05637)
*Mariana Hernandez,Hector Luna,Carlos Bruno,Luis Ricardo Santos,Elena Simoes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种融合多候选转写、回放与语境校验图标的语音转写纠错界面，并用平衡实验检验图像反馈能否帮助听者恢复说话者意图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音转写错误在竞争性词假设不熟悉或视觉上相似时难以被识别，仅靠文本候选难以修复听者的误解。

Method: 界面设计：将替代转写（alternative transcripts）、音频回放与针对选定不确定概念的语境校验图标（contextually checked pictograms）相结合；初期支持法语与西班牙语的功能性话语。评估采用平衡设计（counterbalanced study）。

Result: 摘要为研究计划，尚未给出实证结果；预设测量指标为：图像反馈在文本候选之外的意图恢复增益、语义失配程度，以及额外交互时间。

Conclusion: 图标反馈可能超出纯文本候选的纠错效果，但不恰当图像可能强化错误理解；需同时量化语义失配与时间成本，以判断该设计的净收益。

Abstract: Speech transcription errors can be difficult to recognize when competing word hypotheses are unfamiliar or visually similar. We describe an interface that combines alternative transcripts, replay and contextually checked pictograms for selected uncertain concepts. The system will initially support French and Spanish functional utterances. A counterbalanced study will assess whether pictorial feedback helps listeners recover the speaker's intended action beyond text alternatives alone. We will also quantify semantic mismatch and additional interaction time, since an inappropriate image can reinforce the wrong interpretation rather than repair it.

</details>


### [143] [Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents: A Stage-Resolved Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05720)
*Yanru Xiao,Yingwei Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建受控搜索实验框架，研究结果顺序、既往工作记录与初始假设如何影响LLM智能体的搜索行为与最终答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索能帮助LLM智能体纠错，但其起始条件可能决定它们找到并使用哪类证据；作者希望区分顺序效应、文档构成差异与上下文长度等混淆因素。

Method: 借鉴认知偏差范式，固定问题与文档集合，设计匹配控制组以分离顺序效应与文档构成差异、失败经历效应与上下文长度效应；在10个模型、1000个合成搜索世界中追踪查询、检索文档、文档打开情况及最终答案，并辅以探索性干预。

Result: 主动搜索时最终答案对初始证据顺序比全文提供时更敏感；死胡同历史相较匹配中性历史降低策略切换，效应超出上下文长度；错误假设下分阶段测量可区分"检索/打开不足"与"打开反证据后仍持续"的错误；打开反证据更频繁可能伴随准确率下降，而准确率提升时打开行为变化很小。

Conclusion: LLM智能体的搜索结果显著受初始条件影响，且证据暴露与答案修正之间存在解耦现象。

Abstract: Search can help LLM agents correct mistakes, but their starting conditions may shape which evidence they find and use. Drawing on cognitive-bias paradigms, we develop a controlled search harness to examine result order, records of prior work, and initial hypotheses while holding each question and document collection fixed. Matched controls distinguish order effects from differences in document composition and the effects of failed work from context length. Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, we track queries, retrieved documents, document openings, and final answers. Our comparisons suggest that final answers are more sensitive to initial evidence order during active search than when all evidence is supplied in full. Dead-end histories can reduce strategy switching relative to matched neutral histories, indicating an effect beyond context length. Under wrong hypotheses, stage measurements distinguish reduced retrieval or opening from errors that persist after counter-evidence is opened. Exploratory interventions show that opening counter-evidence more often can coincide with lower accuracy, while accuracy can improve with little change in opening.

</details>


### [144] [Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05731)
*Yuanchen Bei,Zhining Liu,Tianxin Wei,Weizhi Zhang,Zhichen Zeng,Philip S. Yu,Hendrik Hamann,Jingrui He,Hanghang Tong*

Main category: cs.CL
