TL;DR: 提出 Pro-Memory 记忆框架，将"维持未来意图"与"决定何时/如何实现"解耦，以支持 LLM 智能体的前瞻性记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆系统多为回溯式（保存与检索过去信息），而主动型智能体还需前瞻性记忆：保留面向未来的意图，并在合适时机无需显式请求即实现。关键难点在于：记起正确意图不等于在正确时机行动——相关观察可能要求等待，而更晚的线索才使同一意图可执行。

Method: 受人类前瞻性记忆认知理论启发，Pro-Memory 将意图维持与实现决策分离：(1) 保存待办目标并与其支撑证据关联；(2) 依据原始目标与激活条件评估新观察；(3) 与智能体当前行动协调，判断合适的贡献方式；(4) 根据已实际发出的动作或问题已解决的证据更新意图状态；(5) 增设经验记忆，将已完成回合的反馈蒸馏为未来决策指导。

Result: 在覆盖延迟意图任务与开放式主动协助的两个基准上，跨多个 LLM 主干模型，相对代表性记忆方法在主动任务性能上取得一致提升，同时限制了不必要的干预。

Conclusion: 前瞻性记忆的核心在于意图维持与时机判断的分离建模；Pro-Memory 通过状态化意图与经验蒸馏，可在提升主动性的同时控制误触发，为主动型智能体记忆设计提供可行范式。

Abstract: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. It further updates intention states based on actions actually issued or evidence of resolution, while an experience memory distills feedback from completed episodes into guidance for future decisions. Experiments on two benchmarks spanning delayed-intention tasks and open-ended proactive assistance demonstrate consistent improvements in proactive task performance over representative memory approaches across multiple LLM backbones, while limiting unnecessary interventions.

</details>


### [145] [How Well Can Large Language Models Impersonate Individual Authors? A Comparative Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05771)
*Harshit Gupta,Shunichi Ishihara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估六个主流大模型（Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus、GPT 5.2、GPT 5.2 Pro、DeepSeek 3.2、Grok 4.1 Fast）的作者身份模仿能力，发现整体模仿困难，Gemini 3 Pro 的"高模仿度"实为对训练文本的逐句复制，而非真正的风格迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型可使文本撰写者伪造他人写作风格，对文本取证（forensic text analysis）构成风险；但现有评估多关注"像不像"，缺乏对"真实风格模仿"与"直接文本复用"的区分，也未系统考察影响模仿成败的因素与嵌入空间的宏观模式。

Method: 以短篇产品评论为语料（控制个体写作风格内部一致性高）；设计两种 in-context prompt：极简指令 prompt 与含显式 stylometric 指导的复杂 prompt；以基于余弦距离的 distance-to-training 指标量化模仿效果，并结合嵌入分布可视化；补充重叠分析（检测句子/短语复用）与因子分析（训练集一致性、作者独特性等预测因子）。

Result: 多数模型的作者模仿效果有限；Gemini 3 Pro 表面上模仿最强，但重叠分析显示其大量复制、复用训练文本的句子与短语，程度远超人类作者的正常重叠水平；因子分析表明训练集一致性是最稳健的模仿成功预测因子，作者独特性不具备可推广的预测力；全局嵌入可视化显示各模型生成文本多落在与目标人类训练簇分离的区域，呈现模型特有的词汇与短语偏好。

Conclusion: 作者身份模仿对多数 LLM 仍具挑战性，"高相似度"可能源于文本复用而非风格模拟；文本取证中须严格区分真实风格模仿与直接抄袭式复用，并将重叠分析、训练集属性与嵌入空间结构纳入评估框架。

Abstract: This study investigates the authorship impersonation capacity of six widely used large language models (LLMs): Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Opus, GPT 5.2, GPT 5.2 Pro, DeepSeek 3.2, and Grok 4.1 Fast. The evaluation was conducted using short product review texts selected to ensure high within author consistency in individual writing style. Two types of in context prompt were designed: a simple prompt with minimal instruction and a complex prompt incorporating explicit stylometric guidance for mimicry. Authorship mimicry was evaluated using a cosine distance based distance to training metric, supplemented by visual analyses of embedding distributions. The results indicate that authorship impersonation remained challenging for most LLMs, with Gemini 3 Pro showing the strongest apparent mimicry performance. However, subsequent overlap analysis revealed that Gemini 3 Pro extensively copied and reused sentences and phrases from the training texts, at levels far exceeding those observed among human authors. Follow up factor analyses showed that training set consistency was the most robust predictor of mimicry success across models, whereas author distinctiveness did not generalise as a reliable predictor. Global embedding visualisations further revealed a consistent macro level pattern: for most models, generated texts occupied regions of the embedding space that were largely separated from the corresponding human training clusters. This indicates limited convergence towards target author style and suggests the presence of model specific lexical and phraseological preferences. The findings highlight the importance of distinguishing genuine stylistic imitation from direct textual reuse and have implications for the forensic analysis of textual evidence involving potential LLM enabled impersonation.

</details>


### [146] [Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05803)
*Xiaozhe Ji,Renfen Hu,Hai Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出 PinyinBench 基准，结合行为评测、逐层探针与激活引导三种方法，系统考察 17 个纯文本与多模态语言模型对汉字音韵知识（声母、韵母、声调、多音字）的掌握、表征与可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型对汉字音韵知识的掌握程度、表征形式与使用方式尚不清楚；单一行为评测无法揭示内部表征与因果作用，需要多方法联合评估。

Method: 构建 PinyinBench 受控基准，覆盖同音字、音韵特征（声母、韵母、声调）与多音字；对 17 个纯文本及多模态 LM 进行三类互补分析：行为评测、逐层线性探针、激活引导（activation steering）因果干预。

Result: 行为上模型对声母、韵母掌握较强（前沿模型 DS-v4-flash 在无共享音韵特征的配对同音判断中得分 90%+），但仅声调不同的配对准确率骤降至 72%；探针显示声调在嵌入层即高度可解码且随层小幅提升，而音段信息初始可解码性较低、随深度显著提升；激活引导显示音段表征能系统性地影响生成，声调作用明显更弱；含音频的训练提升了音韵（含声调）的可解码性，却未带来引导效果的相应改善。

Conclusion: 音段信息与声调信息具有不同的表征与功能轮廓，声调更难被访问与操控；理解 LM 的语言知识需结合行为评测、探针与因果干预三类方法。

Abstract: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Probing reveals that tone is highly decodable from embeddings and improves modestly across layers, whereas segmental information starts less decodable and improves substantially with depth. Activation steering shows that segmental representations can systematically influence generation, while tone exhibits much weaker effects. Furthermore, audio-bearing training improves phonological decodability, including tone, without corresponding improvements in steering effectiveness. Together, these findings reveal distinct representational and functional profiles for segmental and tonal information, with tonal information much harder to access and manipulate, demonstrating the necessity for combined evaluation, probing, and causal intervention for understanding linguistic knowledge in LMs.

</details>


### [147] [Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05804)
*Hao Cheng,Zhiyu Yang,Bo Ma,Hanzhang Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了推理期专家失活（禁用）的四种实现方式（移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化、非归一化重路由），并结合权重和模型揭示其性能影响取决于训练时的路由权重规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理期专家失活会同时改变token路由和专家权重，但不同实现方式的影响及其与训练规则的关系尚不清楚，需要在大规模指令微调模型上系统对比并建立理论解释。

Method: 在四个模型家族的五个指令微调检查点（外加一个基础OLMoE检查点）上，对相同的禁用专家集合，比较四种失活实现：移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化、非归一化重路由；并提出一个"权重和"模型，将专家贡献损失和分支尺度变化与训练时的权重规则联系起来。按基于激活的排序禁用一半专家，并扩展到活跃专家数量变化的分析。

Result: 在使用原始路由概率训练的模型中，剩余专家重归一化导致最高困惑度；在使用归一化权重训练的模型中，非归一化重路由导致最高困惑度。保留训练规则时困惑度为完整基线的1.4至73倍，规则不匹配时为14至28,740倍。任务结果因评估类型而异：在OLMoE上，四种实现下GSM8K严格匹配准确率均降至零。OLMoE实验支持进一步预测：额外重归一化带来的困惑度惩罚随激活专家数减少而增大。

Conclusion: 专家失活的性能影响主要由训练时的路由权重规则与失活实现是否匹配所决定，规则不匹配会造成数量级更大的退化；该结论由权重和模型与活跃专家数扩展实验得到一致支持。

Abstract: Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.

</details>


### [148] [Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05814)
*Shuli Jiang,Khushbu Pahwa,Yuting Zhang,Yi Zhang,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"人类决策容量分配"问题：在咨询机会与预算有限时，LLM agent 应在哪些决策上咨询人类。作者提出 Consultation Value Distillation (CVD)，用 Monte Carlo executor rollout 离线估计咨询价值并蒸馏为轻量预测器，实现部署时无需 rollout 的预算化分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 自动化复杂任务的能力快速提升，但人类决策容量并不随之扩展；同时许多场景中人类仍不可或缺（提供私有上下文、权威或 agent 无法获得的判断）。因此需要决定在有限预算下把人类咨询资源分配到哪些决策上。核心难点在于咨询价值依赖于执行者（executor）：同一人类输入对不同下游 agent 的收益不同。

Method: 将问题形式化为预算约束下的咨询价值估计与分配问题。CVD 采用 Monte Carlo executor rollout 离线估计咨询价值，并将其蒸馏为轻量预测器用于预算化分配；支持联合价值学习（joint）与延续感知（continuation-aware）价值学习，部署阶段无需基于 rollout 的价值估计。

Result: 在五种批处理与三种序列设置、两个前沿 executor 上，CVD 通过联合与延续感知价值学习改进了分配；独立咨询价值在若干设置下仍具竞争力。CVD 在适用场景中总体优于直接提示与 Value of Information；在显著减少 rollout 监督时仍保持稳健；并能以较低搜索成本实现近乎无损的近似分配。

Conclusion: 咨询价值是一个 executor 依赖的量，可通过离线 rollout 估计 + 蒸馏预测的方式在部署时高效实现预算化人类咨询分配；CVD 提供稳健且低成本的近似分配方案，同时独立价值估计在部分场景仍是强基线。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.

</details>


### [149] [TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05827)
*Baohang Li,Xiaocheng Feng,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出TandemBench——1,200道多智能体烹饪协作场景的决策基准，要求模型在给定全局信息与候选团队计划中选择最优方案，并通过成对变体验证"是否还存在更优安排"。评测40个原生决策模型与10个通用语言模型：最佳原生模型决策准确率仅62.50%，最优性验证接近随机水平，且部分模型无论是否已给出最优方案都倾向报告"存在更优替代"，说明单看决策准确率会掩盖系统性判断错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路由、动作选择等任务中的决策模型通常只在预定义选项间做选择；多智能体协作中，决策涉及分工、资源交换与并行执行，协调质量直接决定目标能否完成。现有基准多评测单智能体或仅考察选项内的选择准确率，缺乏对"是否应超出给定选项去寻找更优方案"这一元决策能力的检验。

Method: 构建TandemBench：1,200道多智能体烹饪场景问题，模型输入完整全局信息与候选团队计划，参考答案通过实际执行与精确搜索获得。任务分两类：从候选中选出最优计划；以及成对变体（保留或移除最优计划）下判断是否存在更优安排。共评测40个原生决策模型与10个通用语言模型。

Result: 最佳原生决策模型决策准确率为62.50%；原生决策模型在最优性验证任务上接近随机猜测；成对测试显示部分模型在任何条件下都声称存在更优替代，与最优方案是否已包含在候选中无关。

Conclusion: 仅凭团队计划的决策准确率会掩盖模型在"判断给定选项是否已含最优安排"上的系统性错误；多智能体决策评测需引入成对对照与最优性验证，才能暴露此类偏差。数据集与评测代码已公开。

Abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Native decision models remain close to chance in optimality verification. Paired tests reveal that some report better alternatives regardless of whether an optimal plan is already present. These findings show that team-plan decision accuracy alone can conceal systematic errors in judging whether the supplied options contain an optimal arrangement. The dataset and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/lililibaohang/TandemBench.

</details>


### [150] [CARTBench: Rubric-Based Evaluation of Shopping Advice for Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05862)
*Yuqin Dai,Zhanwei Zhang,Honghui Yang,Zhouheng Yao,Yueqi Zhang,Jingyu He,Chaoyang Shi,Fanding Wei,Boyuan Pan,Kai Xu,Yao Hu,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出CARTBench，针对多轮对话购物助手评测中的数据稀缺和标准难统一问题，从17个零售领域构建带时间戳的对话与1,603条商品记录，并基于理想回复原则提炼案例专属评分量表，进而提出原则引导的CART提示策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM购物助手已能在多轮对话中推荐商品，但可靠评测面临两大障碍：一是数据稀缺（缺乏真实复杂场景数据），二是评价标准难以统一（开放式推荐质量难以客观度量）。

Method: 构建CARTBench基准，覆盖"复杂且含时间线的模糊请求"（CART）：从真实商业购物需求中整理17个零售领域案例，配对带时间戳对话与1,603条商品记录；从成功成交订单中人工筛选优质回复，蒸馏出"Ideal Response Principles"，据此制定案例专属量表和Principle-Guided CART Prompting结构化推荐策略；基准含1,328条专家标注标准，分为Core、Excellence、Safety三类。

Result: 在冻结量表下的首次全量评测中，评估7个旗舰商用API模型（含GPT-6.1-Sol、Claude-Opus-5）与35B+参数开源模型共10个：3个模型Core得分超过90%，但无一在Excellence上超过45%。

Conclusion: 揭示了从"理解需求"到"执行高质量购买建议"之间的能力鸿沟（understanding-to-execution gap），并诊断出模型在商品证据与未解决需求上的共性失败，其与需求变化和关键未知信息相关。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. The experimental benchmark contains 1,328 expert-annotated criteria across Core, Excellence, and Safety. To answer the CART question, we evaluate 7 flagship commercial API models, including GPT-6.1-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, and 35B+ parameters open-weight models. In the first full-suite evaluation under the frozen rubrics, 3 of 10 models exceed 90% on Core, while none exceeds 45% on Excellence. Therefore, we identify an understanding-to-execution gap between required behavior and high-quality purchase advice. To examine these limitations, we diagnose shared failures in product evidence and unresolved needs, linked to changing requirements and decisive unknowns. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Da1yuqin/CARTBench.

</details>


### [151] [When Does Better Confidence Improve a Knowledge-Graph Audit?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05877)
*Zehao Lin,Kai Chen,Xixuan Hao,Erenkai Zhu,Chunyu Li,Helan Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究“更好的误差预测为何难以带来审计收益”这一差距，提出可修复性、选择余地（selection headroom）与标签有效性三个分析维度，将非自适应审计建模为预算约束下的覆盖问题，并用结构质量 Δ^cl 界定一阶保标量规划的遗憾上界；在 Re-DocRED 上通过模拟理想修复与冻结确认实验，量化联合规划与独立规划的残余误差差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 置信度估计被用于引导 LLM 构建知识图谱中的人工复核，但提升误差预测质量往往对审计效果帮助有限。作者希望解释这一“预测改进—审计收益”之间的脱节，并厘清误差预测之外的瓶颈来源。

Method: 将非自适应审计形式化为预算约束的覆盖（budgeted covering）问题，刻画最小决策相关误差统计量，并以结构质量 Δ^cl 给出保标量一阶规划方法的遗憾界；在 Re-DocRED 的五个抽取配置与两个跨文档图上，针对与基准对齐的标签模拟理想修复，随后在测试集上做冻结确认，并在 500 篇哈希选取的训练文档上复现。

Result: 在留出跨文档图上，误差率×扇出（error-rate × fan-out）队列相较同动作的联合模型多留 3.98–4.74 个百分点的误差；向该联合规划器开放共享动作，可使其残余误差相对自身仅事实计划降低 0.89–1.43 个百分点（点估计）。联合模型与独立块模型的等价性结论尚不确定；通用 LLM 验证在每套留出集上改善了四分之三的模型-预算配置；LLM 裁决还识别出可能的基准遗漏。

Conclusion: 审计收益的瓶颈更多在于可修复性与动作空间的可达性，而非单纯误差预测精度；规划建模与误差统计刻画可解释并界定这一差距，标签有效性亦需经由 LLM 裁决予以检验。

Abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. We study this gap through repairability, selection headroom and label validity. Modelling non-adaptive auditing as budgeted covering, we characterise the minimal decision-relevant error statistics and bound the regret of scalar-preserving first-order planning by a structural mass $Δ^{\mathrm{cl}}$. We simulate ideal repair against benchmark-aligned labels for five extraction configurations and two cross-document graphs on Re-DocRED, followed by frozen confirmation on test and replication on 500 hash-selected training documents. On the held-out cross-document graphs, an error-rate $\times$ fan-out queue leaves 3.98-4.74 percentage points more errors than a joint model with the same actions. By comparison, opening shared actions for that joint planner reduces residual errors by 0.89-1.43 points relative to its own fact-only plans, in point estimates. Equivalence between joint and independent-block models remains inconclusive. Generic LLM verification improves three of four model-budget configurations on each held-out set. LLM adjudication identifies possible benchmark omissions.

</details>


### [152] [Information-Matched Auditing of Conversational Emotion-Shift Forecasting: A Leakage-Safe Evaluation Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05895)
*Bin Wen,Dai-Qiao Zhang,Tien-Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个信息匹配、防泄漏的审计协议，用于对话情绪转移预测的公平比较；结果显示"可部署"与"oracle"两种条件下基线对比结论相反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话情绪转移预测中的模型比较易被三类因素扭曲：学习模型获丰富特征而转移基线只拿到噪声或缺失的当前情绪标签、超参数预算不一致、目标轮信息泄漏进表示。

Method: 设计信息匹配、泄漏安全的审计协议，包含显式承诺点、可执行的因果性检验、四配置等预算验证搜索、种子-对话感知推理；在4个文本语料、6类因果模型族、2种特征来源敏感性配置上测试，区分"可部署"（train-only当前情绪分类器）与"oracle"（双方给金标签）两种条件，并附8项泄漏检查表及PR-AUC、校准、严格话语局部特征控制、同人自我转移预测、未来访问剂量-反应检验。

Result: 可部署条件下学习模型在4个主语料上均优于预测标签基线；DailyDialog增益经72次比较Holm校正后仍显著（最佳ROC-AUC增益+0.167，校正p=.0144）。信息匹配的金标签条件下，基线在IEMOCAP仍有竞争力、在MELD更强，但所有模型在DailyDialog均保持大幅优势。

Conclusion: 先前结论差异主要源于信息不对等与泄漏，而非模型能力；未来比较需在明确的部署/诊断条件下进行并配合泄漏审计。

Abstract: Comparisons in conversational emotion-shift forecasting are easily distorted when a learned model receives rich features but its transition baseline is given a noisy or unavailable current-emotion label, when hyperparameter budgets differ, or when target-turn information enters the representation. We present an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol that closes these gaps with an explicit commitment point, executable causality tests, equal four-configuration validation searches, and seed-dialogue-aware inference. Applying it to six causal model families on four text corpora and two feature-source sensitivity configurations shows that a deployable train-only current-emotion classifier feeding the transition baseline yields a different verdict than an oracle diagnostic where both sides receive gold current emotion. Under the deployable condition, learned models improve over the predicted-label baseline on all four primary corpora; DailyDialog gains are large and survive a 72-comparison Holm correction (best ROC-AUC gain = +0.167, adjusted p=.0144). Under matched gold information, the baseline remains competitive on IEMOCAP and stronger on MELD, while every model retains a large DailyDialog advantage. We additionally report precision-recall AUC, calibration, a strictly utterance-local feature control, same-person self-shift forecasting, and a future-access dose-response test. An eight-item leakage checklist accompanies the protocol. Code, raw seed predictions, and reporting artifacts are available from the corresponding author upon request.

</details>


### [153] [Selective, Risk-Controlled Emotion Forecasting in Conversation: From a Persistence Barrier to Departure Detection with Conformal Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05896)
*Bin Wen,Dai-Qiao Zhang,Tien-Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出"预测下一情感状态取值"在状态可观测的实验设定下是一个困难且不可靠的目标，提出将任务重构为"选择性偏离预测"：预测对话中情感何时偏离持续性，并配合延迟加权指标、泄漏防护协议和承诺策略；用对话级保形风险控制为承诺预测的期望损失提供有界保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话情感预测普遍把任务定义为预测下一情感状态的数值，但在状态可观测的测试平台上发现该目标难以被冻结编码器改进、且严重依赖历史状态是否可直接观测，因此需要更可学习、可部署的任务形式化。

Method: 在双人语料的效价-唤醒-优势（VAD）轨迹上进行对照：以重复说话人自身上一状态作为持续性基线，比较冻结编码器修正、状态空间滤波、以及基于估计锚点的直接预测器；随后将任务重设为选择性偏离预测，引入延迟加权指标、防泄漏协议和随偏离率切换的承诺策略，并用对话级保形风险控制约束承诺预测的期望损失。

Result: 持续性基线难以被冻结编码器修正显著超越，状态空间滤波器则可超过；一旦历史状态需被估计而非观测，持续性基线会退化到直接预测器之下。偏离时机在四套语料中的三套可学习，在基础率最高的语料上接近随机水平。十二种配置下保形风险控制的期望损失目标全部达标，但代价是弃权——在最难语料上覆盖率与告警召回率急剧下降；一个语言模型的置信度作为排序信号失效，另一个有效，属模型依赖的失败，尚不能归因于模型家族或规模。

Conclusion: 对话情感数值预测的核心困难在于目标本身；较有前景且可部署的替代是"何时偏离持续性"的选择性预测，辅以延迟加权评价与保形风险控制，但保证以弃权换取，在困难语料上代价显著；模型置信度的可用性存在未解释的模型依赖性。

Abstract: Forecasting emotion in conversation is increasingly framed as predicting the next emotional state's value. We show this targets a hard quantity in a state-observed testbed and propose a learnable, deployable reformulation instead. On valence-arousal-dominance trajectories from a dyadic corpus, repeating a speaker's own previous state sets a persistence baseline that no frozen-encoder correction meaningfully improves upon and a state-space filter exceeds; the floor requires the historical state to be observed, since an estimated anchor collapses persistence below a direct forecaster. What survives is the timing of a departure from persistence, learnable on three of four corpora and near chance on the highest-base-rate corpus, a negative result we report. We recast the task as selective departure forecasting: a lead-time-weighted metric with a leakage protocol, and commitment policies whose best choice switches with the departure rate. A dialogue-level conformal risk control bounds the expected loss of committed predictions, meeting the target in all twelve configurations tested, though the guarantee is bought through abstention, with coverage and alarm recall falling sharply on the hardest corpus. One tested language model's confidence fails as a ranking signal where another succeeds, a model-dependent failure not yet attributable to family versus scale. Code and result logs are available from the corresponding author upon request.

</details>


### [154] [Familiar letters, not related languages, let unseen languages into a shared space of meaning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06006)
*Yuliang Liu,Xinyu Wang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 字形熟悉度而非语言亲缘性，是未见语言进入多语言模型共享语义空间的关键；将无翻译语言转写为熟悉文字可提升其跨语言检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界上大量语言有书面文本却几乎无平行翻译数据，模型能否仅凭未翻译文本习得一种新语言尚不明确；且"相关语言"与"熟悉字母"两个因素通常共现，难以区分何者起决定作用。

Method: 提出GlyphMind：无分词器的视觉Transformer，将文本作为像素读取，使同一句子可呈现于任意文字系统；在27种书写系统的互译对齐任务上预训练，并在从未见过的未翻译老挝语上进行适配测试。

Result: 在未翻译老挝语上，英文翻译检索成功率是最强简单基线的7倍；将老挝语改写为不熟悉字母后无法进入共享空间（尽管其近亲泰语在预训练中）；桑塔利语在源自印地语的熟悉天城文下可进入，而在其本族文字下不可。

Conclusion: 字形熟悉性是未见语言融入多语言语义空间的决定因素，转写为熟悉文字或可让多语言模型接纳无翻译数据的语言。

Abstract: Hundreds of languages have written text but almost no translations, and whether a model learning one from untranslated text builds on a related language or familiar letters is unclear: they usually coincide. Here we show that familiar letters, not a related language, let an unseen language into a shared space of meaning. GlyphMind, a tokenizer-free vision transformer that reads text as pixels and lets any sentence be shown in any script, was pretrained to align translations across 27 writing systems. Adapted on untranslated Lao, a language and script it had never seen, it retrieved English translations seven times as often as the strongest simple baseline. Rewritten in unfamiliar letters, Lao did not enter although its close relative Thai was in pretraining; Santali, which had none, entered in Devanagari, familiar from Hindi, but not in its own script. Transliteration into familiar scripts may thus open multilingual models to languages without translations.

</details>


### [155] [Holistic Parallel Supervision for Expressive Speech to Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06010)
*Hao Zhang,Ismail Rasim Ulgen,Bismarck Bamfo Odoom,Rui Liu,Zihan Zhang,Berrak Sisman,Philipp Koehn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种构建整体平行监督数据的策略，将专业配音与多语言语音转换结合，使源语音与目标语音在内容、韵律、时间对齐和说话人身份上同时匹配，并据此训练端到端系统 DirectS2ST，在英德、英西翻译上显著提升表现力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音到语音翻译（S2ST）数据集很少能在内容、韵律、时间与说话人身份四个维度上同时对齐源语音与目标语音，导致系统只能依赖间接条件或迁移机制来获得表现力，缺乏直接监督。

Method: 提出训练数据构建策略：利用专业配音提供内容、韵律与时间上的人工对应关系，再用多语言语音转换减少说话人失配，从而获得整体平行监督；并基于该监督开发端到端方法 DirectS2ST，直接从源语音预测完整的目标语音表示。

Result: 在英德与英西翻译实验中，整体平行监督使所有被评估的表现力 S2ST 系统均有提升；DirectS2ST 在内容、韵律、时间、说话人相似度和人工评分的表现力上取得最大增益。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个针对表现力 S2ST 中整体平行监督的系统性研究，表明联合对齐的多维监督是提升翻译表现力的有效途径。

Abstract: Expressiveness is central to speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), yet existing datasets rarely align source and target speech jointly in content, prosody, timing, and speaker identity. Consequently, current systems often rely on indirect conditioning or transfer mechanisms. To obtain this supervision, we introduce a training-data construction strategy that combines professional dubbing, which provides human-performed correspondence in content, prosody, and timing, with multilingual voice conversion to reduce speaker mismatch. We evaluate this supervision using existing expressive S2ST systems and DirectS2ST, an end-to-end method developed in this work that predicts the complete target-speech representation directly from source speech. Experiments on English-German and English-Spanish show that holistic parallel supervision improves expressive realization across all evaluated systems. DirectS2ST exhibits the largest gains in content, prosody, timing, speaker similarity, and human-rated expressiveness. To our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic investigation of holistic parallel supervision for expressive S2ST.

</details>


### [156] [When Every Choice Is Correct: A Causal Study of Numerical Preference in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06025)
*Hongnian Huang,Hongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 以"1到30任选一个整数"这一数值选择任务作为受控场景，结合扰动探测与梯度归因定位神经元并做激活干预，追踪一次性pre-answer编辑（17→15）如何在后续层与token上持续影响输出，揭示"相同局部贡献"因下游计算不同而产生不同最终效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型在1–30内选数时所有整数都合法，却偏爱特定答案，这一现象提供了一个边界清晰、可干预的受控对象，用来研究偏好信息如何在层间与token间被处理、以及早期干预的影响如何被后续计算传递和改变。

Method: 采用扰动探测（perturbation probing）与梯度归因筛选候选神经元并进行激活干预；在选定Qwen3-4B案例中，比较pre-answer编辑（把17改为15）与原始运行的差异；随后用选择性缓存替换与注意力输出替换，将早期影响分解到具体注意力头上；再通过保持后续MLP输出为编辑运行值（MLP clamping）检验下游计算对效应差异的调节作用；并在18个上下文上做回溯性估计，以及在不同措辞的prompt上做稳健性检验。

Result: 编辑后两个运行的首位输出均为1，第二位数字由17变为15；替换单个注意力头输出或联合替换其余头输出，均产生相似的即时读出贡献并能恢复17，但对7与5的最终log-odds效应不同；将后续MLP输出钳制在编辑运行值后，该效应差距由0.119 nat降至0.0025 nat。18个上下文的回溯性估计能捕捉大部分概率变动，但错过所选答案的切换；prompt测试中有一个留出prompt保留影响但未切换答案，12种新措辞中仅1个满足reader/MLP检验，其中联合MLP钳制同样缩小两种reader效应差距，答案仍为17。

Conclusion: 数值选择是一个研究持久状态与条件性下游处理的可控案例：局部干预的即时贡献相似，但最终效应取决于后续MLP等下游计算；回溯性估计不足以解释答案切换，且效应可被prompt措辞解耦。作者明确指出这些结果不构成自然数值偏好的来源或完整电路解释。

Abstract: When a language model chooses a number between 1 and 30, every integer in the range is valid, yet the model can favor particular answers. We use numerical choice to study how preference is processed across layers and tokens. Perturbation probing and gradient attribution nominate neurons for activation interventions. In a selected Qwen3-4B case, a pre-answer edit changes 17 to 15 while both runs first emit 1. After the edit ends, selective cache and attention-output replacements trace part of its continuing influence on the second digit. Replacing one attention head's output or the other heads' outputs jointly produces similar immediate readout contributions; both interventions restore 17 but have different final log-odds effects on 7 versus 5. Holding later multilayer perceptron (MLP) outputs at their values from the edited run without either replacement reduces this effect gap from 0.119 to 0.0025 nat. Later computation therefore changes how similar local contributions affect the continuation. Retrospective estimates across eighteen contexts capture much of the probability movement but miss the selected answer switch. Prompt tests also separate influence from answer changes: one held-out prompt retains influence without switching, and only one of twelve fresh wordings qualifies for the reader/MLP test; there, joint MLP clamping again reduces the gap between the two reader effects while the answer remains 17. These results use numerical choice as a controlled case for studying persistent state and conditional downstream processing; they do not establish the origin or a complete circuit of natural numerical preference.

</details>


### [157] [Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06043)
*Daniel Huang,Qi He,Shaoxiong Duan,Yingjie Li,Qiao Cheng,Yitao Duan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Confucius4-R2T2 稳定前缀流式 ASR 模型，在后训练阶段以新定义的最长稳定前缀（LSP）为标签微调 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B，实现永不修改历史输出的低延迟流式识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式语音识别越来越多被下游机器（翻译器、语音智能体）逐 token 消费，若 token 事后被修改则造成返工或错误动作。现有流式 ASR 精度、延迟与输出稳定性难以兼顾，需要一种"输出即最终"的流式方案。

Method: 在 1,500 小时中英音频上对 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 做后训练，冻结预训练音频编码器与投影层；核心是提出最长稳定前缀（LSP）概念，并证明其在前缀序下单调、与全音频输出一致、且在"等价于某个完整早期输出"的标签中最大；用 LSP 标签学习，无需任何架构改动即可把全上下文模型转为稳定前缀流式模型。

Result: R2T2 的流式识别质量接近基座模型的全上下文水平，同时输出文本稳定、发射延迟低；收益可泛化到后训练语言之外，验证了从全上下文 ASR 到稳定流式的可行路径。模型权重与代码已开源。

Conclusion: 以 LSP 为监督目标的后训练是构建稳定前缀流式 ASR 的实用且通用的范式，可在不改架构的前提下兼顾准确率、低延迟与输出不可回改性。

Abstract: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.

</details>


### [158] [Adapting Qwen3 to Tajik from 0.6B to 8B: Lower Text Loss Did Not Mean Better Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06062)
*Tohir Saidzoda,Madina Abdusalomzoda,Nasimjon Rajabov,Akhrorkhon Ikromov,Komron Giyosiev,Abubakr Abdullozoda,Amin Jalilov,Jonibek Kishvarov,Rahmonali Sharipov,Mariyamkhon Shodyeva*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 塔吉克语小规模LoRA适配器虽降低Qwen3全部尺寸（0.6B–8B）的文本损失0.60–1.45 nats/token，却不提升阅读理解；唯有8B上约3.75亿token的继续预训练带来Belebele +9.9分，经SFT后的主模型e3较Qwen3-8B高11.4分（英文MMLU -1.2分）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"低困惑度/低文本损失是否等于真正的语言理解"这一常见假设，并系统记录塔吉克语（低资源语言）适配训练的收益与失败。

Method: 以Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B为基座，在塔吉克语新闻与书籍上训练小型LoRA适配器；8B上追加约375M token原始塔吉克语继续预训练并进行监督微调，得到主模型e3；对15个训练模型及其5个起点模型（2025年6月至10月）在2026年用同一评测框架、配对置信区间打分，并如实记录数据处理与工程缺陷。

Result: LoRA使各尺寸文本损失下降0.60–1.45 nats/token，但Belebele上1.7B与8B不变、4B下降3.7分；0.6B上升4.2分但接近随机水平，且伴随答案字母偏好漂移，不视为理解提升。8B继续预训练后Belebele +9.9分，SFT后e3较Qwen3-8B高11.4分，英文MMLU仅-1.2分（排除>3.3分的损失）。将同等重配方用于Qwen3-0.6B-Base，books-only预训练后文本损失接近8B模型，但选择题仍近随机、英文MMLU下降7.6分。

Conclusion: 文本损失与下游理解能力解耦：小LoRA带来的困惑度增益不转化为阅读理解；显著收益需依赖大规模继续预训练加监督微调，且低容量基座无法靠重配方弥补。研究同时强调公开记录失败（训练记录丢失、思考模式数据缺乏推理、后期分支数据无文档、4-bit发布不含transformer层）对可复现性的重要性。

Abstract: Small LoRA adapters trained on Tajik news and books lowered Qwen3's Tajik text loss at every size we tried, from 0.6B to 8B, by 0.60 to 1.45 nats per token, but none of them improved Tajik reading comprehension where it can be measured. On Belebele the 1.7B and 8B adapters left accuracy unchanged and the 4B adapter lowered it by 3.7 points; at 0.6B the score rose by 4.2 points but sits near chance and coincides with a change in which answer letter the model prefers, so we do not read it as understanding. At 8B, continued pretraining on about 375 million tokens of raw Tajik text was followed by a Belebele gain of 9.9 points. After a further supervised fine-tuning stage, our main model, e3, is 11.4 points above Qwen3-8B on Belebele; its English MMLU changed by -1.2 points, and a loss larger than 3.3 points is excluded. The same heavy recipe applied to Qwen3-0.6B-Base brought its text loss close to that of the 8B model after books-only pretraining, while its multiple-choice answers stayed near chance and its English MMLU fell by 7.6 points. We report 15 trained models and their 5 starting models from June to October 2025, scored in 2026 on one harness with paired intervals, and we report what went wrong: lost training records, a thinking-mode dataset with almost no reasoning in it, later branches whose training data was never documented, and a 4-bit release that contains no transformer layers.

</details>


### [159] [ProcessPrefBench: Evaluating Cross-Task Transfer of Individual Process Preferences from Naturalistic Human-AI Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06065)
*Yiwen Yang,Guanming Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出过程偏好基准 ProcessPrefBench：检验单轮对话中显露的用户过程偏好能否在后续任务未被重述时影响助手输出；显式利用历史可提升偏好实现度，但会显著增加伪造证据的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然对话中，用户的纠正、请求与自述蕴含可复用的"过程偏好"信号（证据标准、深度、分析侧重、流程、交付形式）。现有工作多关注静态指令遵循，未系统考察偏好跨对话的迁移与适用性，即任务本身不再重述该偏好时助手能否正确调用。

Method: 基于两名知识工作者三个月自然对话构建 66 个 source–target 案例，分别对源证据充分性与目标适用性进行人工判定；源片段经预筛选，使基准聚焦"偏好应用"而非"检索"。设置三种提示条件：仅目标、全历史、蒸馏偏好（祈使式表述）。采用目标特定 0–2 分 rubric 评估偏好实现度，并设任务门控标记严重失败（如伪造证据）。

Result: 相较仅目标提示，全历史与祈使式蒸馏偏好提示分别使偏好实现度提升 0.204 与 0.244 分（0–2 量表），蒸馏相对全历史无稳定优势。伪造证据失败率由仅目标条件的 5.8% 升至全历史的 10.1% 与祈使式提示的 10.4%。

Conclusion: 对话中学习存在内在张力：引用历史交互可改善偏好实现，却同时诱发伪造证据；仅靠偏好蒸馏不足以化解该权衡。未来助手设计需在遵循用户过程偏好的同时保障事实可靠性。

Abstract: In natural human-AI dialogue, users' corrections, requests, and self-descriptions carry reusable signals about how they want work to be done. These signals reveal individual process preferences, user-specific standards for evidence, depth, analytical focus, procedure, and delivery. We ask whether a preference revealed in one dialogue can shape an assistant's later answer when the task does not restate it. ProcessPrefBench uses three months of natural dialogues from two knowledge workers to build 66 source-target cases separately judged for source evidence and target applicability. Sources are preselected, so the benchmark tests application rather than retrieval. We test three models with target-only, full-history, and distilled-preference prompts. Target-specific 0-2 rubrics score preference realization, and a task gate flags severe failures. Compared with target-only prompting, full-history and imperative distilled-preference prompting raise preference realization by 0.204 and 0.244 points on the 0-2 scale, respectively, with no reliable advantage from distillation. Fabricated-evidence failures rise from 5.8% under target-only prompting to 10.1% under full-history and 10.4% under imperative prompting. ProcessPrefBench highlights a tension in learning from dialogue, where drawing on prior interactions can improve preference realization yet also invite fabricated evidence. We hope it helps build assistants that honor a user's process preferences without sacrificing factual reliability.

</details>


### [160] [Overview of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval Task: Cross-modal Claim Verification in Scientific Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06090)
*Xanh Ho,André Greiner-Petter,Florian Boudin,Yun-Ang Wu,Sunisth Kumar,Tian Cheng Xia,Hiba Akbi,Tim Schopf,Akiko Aizawa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍 NTCIR-19 的 SciClaimEval 试点任务：用论文中的表格与图表验证其自身科学声明，并指出单独判断单一声明-证据对仍是未解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学声明需由其所在论文的表格、图表证据支撑，但缺乏标准化评测；已有基准多依赖专门构造的证据，而非真实论文中的原生证据。

Method: 构建数据集：180 篇机器学习、自然语言处理与医学论文的真实声明，配以对比式证据（一张支持版、一张最小改动的不支持版）。设两个子任务：判断证据是否支持声明；在两种证据版本中选择支持者。14 支队伍提交 177 个运行结果，多数基于多模态大模型，采用提示与多阶段推理而非任务特定微调。

Result: 子任务一最佳系统达到 98.1% 配对准确率，但前六名均依赖对比对；单独评估每个声明-证据对的最佳系统低 24.3 个百分点。精心设计的开源权重模型流程可媲美专有模型。22 支队伍注册，为 NTCIR-19 任务中最多。

Conclusion: 对比设定下性能接近饱和，但实际应用中针对单一证据的声明验证仍为开放问题；开源与专有模型在良好流程下差距可弥合。

Abstract: This paper presents an overview of \emph{SciClaimEval}, a pilot task at NTCIR-19 on verifying scientific claims against the tables and figures of the papers in which they appear. Our dataset pairs authentic claims from 180 papers in machine learning, natural language processing, and medicine with contrastive versions of their tables and figures, one supporting the claim and one minimally modified so that it does not. The task comprises two subtasks: deciding whether a piece of evidence supports a claim, and selecting which of two evidence versions does. Twenty-two teams registered, the highest number among NTCIR-19 tasks, and 14 submitted 177 runs. Most systems built on multimodal large language models, relying on prompting and multi-stage inference rather than task-specific fine-tuning. On the first subtask, the best systems reached 98.1\% pair accuracy, but all six top-ranked systems relied on the contrastive pairs; the best system that judged each claim-evidence pair on its own scored 24.3 points lower. Open-weight models, embedded in carefully designed pipelines, matched proprietary ones. Yet verifying a single claim against its evidence, the setting that matters in practice, remains an open problem.

</details>


### [161] [The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06116)
*Mehmet Murat Huyut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在固定模型权重的条件下，测试四种开源模型在五种智能体"执行框架（harness）"下的银行合规表现：整体合规正确率仅87.3%–92.1%波动，但单一模型内框架差异可达11.5个百分点，足以使其排名从第一跌至最后；同模型合规审查器可将违规率从9.6%降至6.4%且不增加过度拒答；26%的违规伴随着"口头否认已执行动作"的客户消息，说明合规审计应基于动作日志而非对话记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银行对语言模型的验证通常针对模型本身，但实际部署的是"模型＋执行框架"系统：框架决定模型看到什么、能调用哪些工具、谁审核其行为。论文要检验在模型保持不变时，该框架是否会改变模型对银行行为规则的遵守程度，并质疑"以模型为验证单元"和"以对话为审计对象"这两项默认做法。

Method: 构建模拟零售银行环境，11类规则家族改写自欧盟消费信贷、支付、投资者保护、数据保护与反洗钱条款；156个预注册案例。4个开源权重模型 × 5种执行框架（单次结构化决策流水线、ReAct式工具循环、策略仅可经检索获得的循环、带长程良性客户记忆的循环、带同模型合规审查器的循环）。共3120个两轮对话回合，全部依据实际执行的工具调用轨迹进行确定性评分，违规与过度拒答分别计数；另做探索性分析，使用两个LLM评判器加盲法人工核验。

Result: 汇总各模型后，框架仅将正确率在87.3%–92.1%之间移动；但模型内差异显著：某模型最优与最差框架相差11.5个百分点，足以使其在四模型排名中从第一降至最后，而另一模型的框架效应不可检测；模型×框架交互效应仅为提示性而非结论性。同模型合规审查器将违规率从9.6%降至6.4%，且未提高过度拒答率，与预注册预期相反。涉及日期运算的规则在所有框架下均失败。探索性分析显示26%的违规同时伴有"否认已执行动作"的客户回复，仅看对话记录会被记作正确的拒绝。

Conclusion: 模型风险管理的验证单元应是"模型—框架对"而非单一模型；行为合规测试应读取动作日志而非对话文本，因为对话层面的表述可能掩盖已执行的有害动作。

Abstract: Banks validate language models, but they deploy systems: a model inside a harness that decides what it sees, which tools it can call and who checks its actions. We test whether that harness changes compliance with banking conduct rules when the model is held fixed. Four open-weight models each ran five harnesses (a pipeline that makes one structured decision, a ReAct-style tool loop, a loop in which the policy is reachable only through search, a loop with a long benign customer memory, and a loop with a same-model compliance reviewer) on 156 pre-registered cases in a simulated retail bank whose 11 rule families paraphrase EU consumer-credit, payments, investor-protection, data-protection and anti-money-laundering provisions. Every one of the 3120 two-turn episodes was scored deterministically from the executed tool trace, with violations and over-refusals counted separately. Pooled across models the harness moved the correct-case rate only between 87.3% and 92.1%, but within a model it mattered a great deal: for one model the spread between its best and worst harness was 11.5 percentage points, enough to move it from first to last place among the four models, while for another the harness made no detectable difference; the model x harness interaction itself was suggestive rather than conclusive. The same-model reviewer cut violations from 9.6% to 6.4% without raising over-refusals, contrary to our pre-registered prediction. Rules that require date arithmetic failed in every harness. In an exploratory analysis with two LLM judges and a blind human check, 26% of violations were accompanied by a customer message that denied the action the agent had just executed, which a transcript-only review would record as a correct refusal. For model-risk management the unit of validation should be the model-harness pair, and conduct testing should read the action log, not the conversation.

</details>


### [162] [Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06133)
*João Eduardo Batista,Emil Vatai,Mohamed Wahib*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出免训练的"组合稀疏注意力"加速混合注意力LLM中剩余的全注意力层：每层仅关注滑动窗口、固定前缀与固定预算的Top-k相关token，窗口大小与预算由多目标搜索逐层确定；在3个家族6个模型（4B–397B）的21个长上下文数据集上保持基线精度，64k/256k解码最高提速1.26x/2.22x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全注意力层使生成长度越长单token成本越高，长上下文解码变慢；混合模型虽以线性注意力替换多数全注意力层，但残留的少量全注意力层在长上下文下仍主导解码开销。

Method: 无需训练、无需改权重，对剩余全注意力层施加组合稀疏注意力：每层同时关注近期token滑动窗口、钉住的固定前缀、以及上下文中固定预算的最相关token；窗口大小与预算按层通过多目标搜索算法确定。

Result: 在3个模型家族、4B–397B参数的6个混合模型上，搜索所得配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持基线精度；64k/256k解码加速：Qwen3.5-4B上1.26x/2.22x，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上1.20x/2.23x，Ornith-1.0-397B上1.16x/2.06x。

Conclusion: 逐层组合稀疏注意力可在零训练、零权重修改下消除混合架构中全注意力层的长上下文解码瓶颈，实现精度无损的显著推理加速，具备跨模型家族与规模的可迁移性。

Abstract: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.

</details>


### [163] [AssameseLM-E2B: An Open-Weight Assamese Language Model for Efficient Consumer-Grade Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06170)
*Pragyan Phukan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向低资源阿萨姆语的2B模型AssameseLM-E2B及其指令微调版E2B-it，基于Gemma-4架构扩展字节级BPE词表并采用Hybrid LoRA持续预训练与SFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在低资源语言上因分词低效、生成不稳定与语言干扰而性能下降，需在受限算力下构建可本地部署的阿萨姆语模型。

Method: 基于Gemma-4架构，扩展字节级BPE词表以降低分词开销；采用参数高效持续预训练（Hybrid LoRA）后接多领域平衡数据的监督微调，提升指令遵循与RAG能力。

Result: FLORES-200上BPB为0.7488，RAG总体得分96.7%，对抗性不可答提示拒答准确率100%；分词开销较2B–3B多语基线降低近500%。基线存在接受-产出解耦、罗马化阿萨姆语生成退化及孟加拉文字误同化等问题。

Conclusion: 参数高效适配可在有限算力下构建具备实用能力、可本地部署的低资源语言模型。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in high-resource languages, their performance often degrades in low-resource languages due to tokenization inefficiencies, generative instability, and linguistic interference. This paper presents AssameseLM-E2B and its instruction-tuned variant, AssameseLM-E2B-it, a 2-billion-parameter model adapted specifically for low resource Assamese language. Built upon the Gemma-4 architecture, the model incorporates an expanded byte-level BPE vocabulary to reduce tokenization overhead by nearly 500% compared with multilingual 2B--3B baselines. We employ a parameter-efficient Continual Pre-Training (CPT) pipeline with Hybrid LoRA, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on a balanced, multi-domain dataset to enhance instruction-following and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities.
  Evaluation demonstrates a Bits-per-Byte (BPB) score of 0.7488 on FLORES-200, alongside an overall RAG score of 96.7% and 100% refusal accuracy on adversarial unanswerable prompts. Comparative analysis reveals significant limitations in general-purpose baselines, including receptive-productive decoupling, generative degradation on Romanized Assamese, and unintended Bengali script assimilation. These results demonstrate the potential of parameter-efficient adaptation for developing capable, locally deployable language models for low-resource languages under constrained computational resources.

</details>


### [164] [Editing Large Language Models with Geometry-Aware Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06185)
*Bingqing Liu,Wei Liu,Jun Wang,Xiaobo Sun,Yuhua Li,Ruixuan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出几何感知的知识编辑框架GEdit，基于低秩加对角(LR+D)因子模型建模FFN隐表示的内在低秩结构，通过低秩正则化保护核心知识子空间、自适应正则化按编辑难度调节约束强度，在大规模编辑场景下同时提升编辑成功率与预训练知识保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识编辑方法忽视知识表示空间的几何结构，导致两个局限：无法区分哪些预训练知识应优先保留（核心vs非核心），也无法判断哪些新编辑本身困难（难vs易）。

Method: GEdit构建于低秩加对角(LR+D)因子模型，刻画Transformer FFN隐表示的内在低秩结构；包含两个互补机制：(1) 低秩正则化，对低秩核心知识子空间施加定向保护；(2) 自适应正则化，依据每条编辑请求的可编辑性动态调整正则强度——对困难编辑放松约束以保证编辑成功，对容易编辑收紧约束以更好保留预训练知识。

Result: 在GPT2-XL、GPT-J、LLaMA-3-8B上进行大规模编辑实验，涵盖mini-batch与最多10,000次连续更新的完全顺序编辑设置，GEdit在编辑成功率与知识保持两方面均持续且显著优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: 显式引入知识表示空间的几何结构（核心/非核心子空间区分与编辑难度自适应）可有效缓解知识编辑中"编辑成功"与"知识保持"的权衡，并具备大规模、顺序编辑下的可扩展性。

Abstract: Knowledge editing has become a key technique for updating knowledge in large language models. However, existing methods neglect the geometric structure of the knowledge representation space, leading to two key limitations: they cannot distinguish which pre-trained knowledge should be preferentially preserved (core vs. non-core) nor which new edits are inherently difficult (hard vs. easy). To address this, we propose GEdit, a geometry-aware framework built on a Low-Rank Plus Diagonal (LR+D) factor model that captures the intrinsic low-rank structure of Transformer FFN hidden representations. GEdit features two complementary mechanisms. First, the low-rank regularization applies targeted protection on a low-rank core knowledge subspace. Second, the adaptive regularization dynamically adjusts the regularization strength based on each edit request's editability: relaxing constraints for hard edits to ensure success, and tightening them for easy edits to better preserve pretrained knowledge. Extensive experiments on GPT2-XL, GPT-J, and LLaMA-3-8B under large-scale editing scenarios, including both mini-batch and fully sequential editing settings with up to 10,000 continuous updates, show that GEdit consistently and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both editing success and knowledge preservation.

</details>


### [165] [Loop Before You Leap: What Recurrent Depth Can and Cannot Buy in Data-Limited Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06206)
*Daichi Hotta,Yohei Kobashi,Takeshi Kojima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文检验循环（权重共享层复用）能否弥合多模态模型在BabyLM挑战中落后于纯文本基线的差距。结果显示循环可提升纯文本BLiMP表现，但无法缓解多模态训练带来的约3.8分下降，数据与呈现方式变化是主要成因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型在BabyLM挑战中常低于纯文本基线，作者希望验证"额外的循环计算"（不增加参数与数据、仅复用层）能否缩小这一差距。

Method: 同一实现下比较标准Transformer与循环（looped）Transformer，100M词预算，主条件各3个随机种子；图像用冻结DINOv2编码为单一特征向量作前缀token；字幕词计入预算，故多模态训练同时改变语言数据；并设预注册的纯文本对比及探索性的"循环侧无图像"对照。

Result: 预注册纯文本对比中，12层堆叠重复4次在同等推理算力下比标准48层Transformer高5.4个BLiMP百分点；但多模态训练在两种架构下均使BLiMP准确率降约3.8分，循环无明显缓解；无图像对照比纯文本基线低5.7分；加入视觉前缀平均提升1.85分，但3个种子下该对比不确定。诊断测试表明模型确实使用了视觉信息。

Conclusion: 语言数据及其呈现方式的变化是性能下降的主要来源；循环计算不能弥合多模态差距；视觉信息虽被模型利用，但在单向量接口下其对语法泛化的贡献仍不确定。

Abstract: Multimodal models have often scored below text-only baselines in the BabyLM Challenge (Klerings et al., 2024; Takmaz et al., 2025). We test whether additional recurrent computation helps close this gap. Recurrence increases computation by reusing layers without adding parameters or training data. Using a single implementation, we compare standard and looped Transformers under a 100M-word budget, with three seeds per main condition. Each image is represented by one feature vector from a frozen DINOv2 encoder, used as a prefix token. Caption words count toward the budget, so multimodal training also changes the language data. In a pre-registered text-only comparison, a 12-layer stack repeated four times exceeds a standard 48-layer Transformer by 5.4 BLiMP percentage points at matched inference compute. However, multimodal training lowers BLiMP accuracy by about 3.8 points in both architectures, with no clear mitigation from recurrence. An exploratory loop-side no-image control, trained with the multimodal language data and batching schedule, scores 5.7 points below the text-only baseline. Adding the visual prefix raises accuracy by 1.85 points on average, but this contrast is uncertain with three seeds. These results suggest that changes in language data and its presentation are a major source of the drop. Diagnostic tests show that the models use visual information; its contribution to grammatical generalization remains uncertain under this single-vector interface.

</details>


### [166] [Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06238)
*Umair Mehmood Imam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Zuse 是三个决策模型（4B/9B/27B），在冻结开放权重基座上训练低秩适配器与指针头，面向27种欧洲语言；27B在11个来源的开发集上达87.5%准确率、汇总ECE 0.016。分析表明校准误差按任务而非语言结构化，可自动化比例与机会校正技能相关更强，跨语言泛化上限由基座模型决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有决策模型（读取文档并对固定选项集输出概率，而非生成文本）多在2026年出现，但均未在英语之外报告结果；作者希望检验该设计在多语言、多任务条件下的行为。

Method: 在冻结的开放权重基座上训练低秩适配器（LoRA）与指针头，构建4B/9B/27B三档模型，覆盖27种欧洲语言；在排除于训练之外的11个来源、9个任务组、27种语言的欧洲评测套件（兼作开发集并用于模型选择）上评测，并进行校准、自动化覆盖与跨语言泛化的后验分析。

Result: 27B模型达87.5%准确率，汇总期望校准误差0.016（按来源加权0.035）。校准误差主要由任务而非语言决定：26种语言的平行阅读与主题题上置信差距与采样噪声相当，跨来源则在-0.07至+0.09间波动，知识类任务过度自信、可接受性判断欠自信，单一温度无法同时校正。5%误差预算下可自动化比例与机会校正技能的秩相关（0.97）高于与原始准确率的相关（0.91）。210种语言中，同规模内更换训练运行最多改变约2分，而基座文档语言列表之外的语言在各规模下落后23–28分。英语公开套件上Zuse落后于Jev与Kev（含同基座的Kev模型）。另报告两个数据构建陷阱：主题体系间的标签词冲突，以及注入式增强学到的捷径。

Conclusion: 决策模型设计可跨语言跨任务有效工作，但其校准、自动化价值与语言覆盖边界分别由任务、技能指标与基座模型决定，而非由训练语言或训练运行主导；多源训练数据构建存在标签冲突与捷径学习两类隐患，且英语性能仍不及同类竞品。

Abstract: Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.

</details>


### [167] [Mass Producing Training Data with Surprising Side Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06324)
*Yaowen Ye,Jacob Steinhardt,Sarah Schwettmann,Cassidy Laidlaw*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出自动发现"具有意外副作用的训练数据集"(DSSE)，用LLM裁判将三个目标(诱发目标行为、读起来像普通后训练数据、令人类审计者惊讶)可操作化，并通过演化搜索、强化学习和潜隐学习来搜索高分数据集，最终产出覆盖8种行为、共6,575个DSSE的集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练数据会在训练域之外对语言模型行为产生意外副作用(如不安全代码数据诱发广泛失准、过时鸟类名称诱发19世纪人格)。但此类现象仅存在数十个孤立案例，且均由人工构造或偶然发现，难以系统研究其泛化规律。

Method: 定义DSSE的三条准则：(1)能诱发目标行为；(2)文本读起来像普通后训练数据；(3)对阅读数据的人类审计者具有惊讶性。每条准则用LLM裁判实现量化评分，再通过演化算法、强化学习与潜隐学习(subliminal learning)搜索高分数据集；随后用留出(held-out)指标重新打分与过滤，保证数据集质量。

Result: 流程产出覆盖8种行为的6,575个DSSE，其中许多能跨模型家族与规模泛化；自动化指标与ML研究者的判断具有一致性；前沿模型在预测副作用方面优于人类。

Conclusion: 该工作为研究训练数据的泛化副作用提供了规模化测试床，并为在模型部署前预测训练副作用奠定基础。

Abstract: Training data can have unexpected side effects on language model behavior outside the training domain: insecure code data can induce broad misalignment, and outdated bird names can induce a 19th-century persona. Understanding such generalization is hard because only dozens of isolated examples exist, each constructed by hand or discovered by accident. We propose automatically discovering such datasets with surprising side effects (DSSEs). We define three objectives for DSSEs: they should (1) elicit a target behavior, (2) read like ordinary post-training data, and (3) be surprising to human auditors reading the data. We operationalize each with LLM judges, and search for high-scoring datasets via evolution, reinforcement learning, and subliminal learning approaches. After re-scoring and filtering with held-out metrics, our pipeline produces a collection of 6,575 DSSEs across 8 behaviors, many of which generalize across model families and sizes. We find our automated metrics track ML researchers' judgments, and frontier models outperform humans at predicting side effects. These datasets form a testbed for studying generalization and lay the groundwork for predicting training side effects before model deployment. Explore them at https://dsse.transluce.org.

</details>


### [168] [Training-Free Character-Length Control in Summarization with Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06371)
*Steffen Castle,Nils Feldhus,Christopher Ebert,Leonhard Hennig,Sebastian Möller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DELTA：一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的免训练推理时方法，通过在每步去噪时估计期望字符长度并动态增删掩码位置，实现精确字符长度控制的摘要生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标题生成、文章预览等任务要求摘要严格贴合固定字符长度。自回归LM难以精确控制字符长度：基于训练的方法需任务特定微调，零样本提示只能近似满足长度约束。

Method: DELTA（Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm）为训练免费的推理时算法，适用于现成掩码扩散LM：在每个去噪步骤估计当前序列的期望字符长度，并动态插入或移除掩码位置，将生成过程导向目标长度。无需微调。

Result: 在三个摘要基准上，相较基线将字符长度误差降低一个数量级，同时在自动评估与人工评估中均保持有竞争力的摘要质量。

Conclusion: 掩码扩散LM可通过推理时的期望长度估计与掩码位置动态调整实现精确字符长度控制，兼具免训练、即插即用与质量保持的优势。

Abstract: Summarization with a fixed character length is important for tasks such as headline and article preview generation, where text must fit an exact space. Autoregressive language models (LMs) struggle with precise character-length control: training-based methods require task-specific fine-tuning, while zero-shot prompting strategies achieve only approximate compliance. We propose DELTA (Diffusion Expected Length Targeting Algorithm), a training-free inference-time method for masked diffusion LMs that estimates expected character length at each denoising step and dynamically inserts or removes masked positions to steer toward a target length. DELTA requires no fine-tuning and is designed for off-the-shelf masked diffusion LMs. Across three summarization benchmarks, it reduces character-length errors by an order of magnitude compared to baselines while maintaining competitive summary quality in both automatic and human evaluation.

</details>


### [169] [Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06384)
*Jatin Agrawal,Radhika Mamidi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对Jev、Clef Flash和Perplexity Decider三类类型化决策模型进行了受控审计，揭示其对呈现方式（位置、标识、署名、背书、决策框架、评分规则）存在显著敏感性，且可重复性、呈现鲁棒性与人类对齐是评估器的三种独立属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型化决策模型以结构化选择、分数和概率支持低成本自动化评估，但其结果可能受输入呈现方式影响，需系统检验这种敏感性对评估可靠性的威胁。

Method: 在6个数据集（共9,000条多重标注的幽默、有用性、摘要条目）上，通过改变位置、标识、署名声明、背书、决策框架和评分量表等干预手段（保持文本内容不变），在原生选择与分数两种接口下收集了702,000条判断。

Result: Jev在摘要任务上第二位置概率优势达6.11个百分点；反转读者背书使Perplexity在40.40%的配对中改变所选幽默文本；拒绝式框架使Clef的摘要判断与人类偏好一致性下降23.36个点；评分格式会改变分数水平但常保留排序。

Conclusion: 可重复性、呈现鲁棒性和人类对齐是评估器彼此独立的属性，可靠使用需针对评估流程所依赖的决策与分数解释进行验证。

Abstract: Typed decision models offer structured choices, scores, and probabilities for low-cost automated evaluation. We present a controlled audit of presentation sensitivity in Jev, Clef Flash, and Perplexity Decider across native choice and score interfaces. Across six datasets with 9,000 multiply annotated humor, helpfulness, and summarization items, we collect 702,000 judgments under interventions that vary positions, identifiers, authorship claims, endorsements, decision framing, and rating rubrics while preserving the evaluated texts. Jev's second-position probability advantage reaches 6.11 percentage points on summaries; reversing reader endorsements changes Perplexity's selected humor text on 40.40% of pairs; and rejection framing reduces Clef's summary agreement with human preferences by 23.36 points. Rating formats also shift score levels while often preserving rankings. Across these findings, repeatability, presentation robustness, and human alignment emerge as distinct properties of an evaluator. Reliable use therefore requires validating the decisions and score interpretations on which an evaluation pipeline depends.

</details>


### [170] [Where Should a KV-Cache Repair Budget Go? Distractor Structure and Contextual Compatibility in Non-Prefix Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06397)
*Yuxing Peng,Zhiqing Tang,Weijia Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 非前缀KV缓存复用中，小预算修复应花在答案承载块（target）上而非其他块，并通过“上下文兼容性”机制重算target的KV来获得收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非前缀KV缓存复用将检索块独立编码后拼接缓存，会丢失上下文依赖的问答能力（丢失19–100%），但修复预算有限，需确定预算该投在哪些块上。

Method: 跨3个7B-8B模型、4个数据集（对话记忆、开放域QA、API文档），围绕答案承载块（target）变化其他块，比较修复少量非target块、重算target、插入全prefill KV、问题注意力选择、检索器选择及InfoFlow式重排序（5%预算）等策略。

Result: 重算target对复用缓存优于插入其全prefill KV（7/7设置），尽管重算KV仍远离全prefill KV；问题注意力在至多18.8%开发问题上选中target；检索器命中更高，重排其top块后重算在6/9开放域QA与API文档设置中显著优于InfoFlow式重排；对话记忆上重算块从未显著优于按设置选定的token级选择器。

Conclusion: 修复预算应集中于答案承载块，其收益来自上下文兼容性而非KV数值逼近；检索器+重排重算在多数QA/API场景有效，但在对话记忆场景token级选择器更适用。

Abstract: Non-prefix KV-cache reuse encodes retrieved chunks independently and concatenates their caches. To find where a small repair budget should be spent, we vary the chunks around the answer-bearing one (the target) across three 7B-8B models and four datasets of dialogue memory, open-domain QA and API documentation. Reuse loses 19-100% of the context-dependent questions that full prefill answers, and it loses more when the other chunks are of the same kind as the target. Because the recoverable damage is spread over these other chunks, restoring a few of them recovers little, and the budget is better spent on the target. This works through contextual compatibility: recomputing the target against the reused cache beats inserting its full-prefill KV in all seven settings tested, although the recomputed KV stays far from the full-prefill KV. Question attention over reused caches, however, selects the target in at most 18.8% of development questions. A retriever finds it more often, and recomputing its top chunk after moving it next to the question significantly beats InfoFlow-style reordering at the same 5% budget in six of nine open-domain QA and API-documentation settings. On dialogue memory, though, recomputing chunks never significantly beats the token-level selector chosen for each setting.

</details>


### [171] [Interpretable Text Embeddings Based on Hierarchical Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06402)
*Kohei Oda,Po-Min Chuang,Kiyoaki Shirai,Natthawut Kertkeidkachorn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出构建层次化 yes/no 问题的方法用于 QA-based 文本嵌入，通过用浅层对齐问题替换深层问题减少人工检视量，在保持任务性能的同时提升可解释性，并揭示浅层问题在问题数受限时性能更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 QA-based 文本嵌入虽具良好可解释性与任务表现，但需人工检视大量问题；且问题数量与合适问题粒度之间的关系研究不足。

Method: 递归聚类、对比提示（contrastive prompting）与问题对齐构建问题层次；层级越深问题越具体、数量越多；解释时用浅层对齐问题替换深层问题以减少人工检视量。

Result: 通用任务实验表明方法在保持任务性能的同时提升可解释性；在问题数量受限时，相同数量下浅层问题比深层问题获得更高任务性能。

Conclusion: 层次化问题构建可有效平衡可解释性与效率，并提示问题粒度与数量的权衡关系，为 QA-based 嵌入的实用化提供依据。

Abstract: QA-based text embeddings represent texts as vectors consisting of 1/0 answers to yes/no questions. Although these embeddings provide detailed information for interpretation and achieve high task performance, they often require humans to examine a large number of questions. Furthermore, the relationship between the number of questions and the appropriate level of question granularity has not been sufficiently studied. To address these challenges, we propose a method for constructing hierarchical questions for text embeddings. As the hierarchy deepens, questions become more specific and their number increases. During interpretation, we reduce the number of questions that humans need to examine by replacing questions at deeper levels with aligned questions at shallower levels. The question hierarchy is constructed through recursive clustering, contrastive prompting, and question alignment. Experimental results on general-purpose tasks show that our method improves interpretability while maintaining task performance. It is also found that, when only a limited number of questions are available, questions at shallower levels tend to achieve higher task performance than those at deeper levels, even with the same number of questions.

</details>


### [172] [Ruby-OPD: Enhancing Pronunciation Controllability and Accuracy for Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06403)
*Rui Hu,Xiaolong Lin,Zhenpeng Zhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出面向日语流匹配TTS的两阶段框架：以Ruby文本表示+正字扰动实现可控发音，并用On-Policy Distillation在无配对语音的纯文本语料上提升原始正字文本的发音准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日语为无分词语言，汉字与假名混写且多音字（polyphony）现象普遍，难以同时兼顾高发音准确率与细粒度可控性。传统级联式TTS经前端转音素，可控制发音但丢失表层正字中的词汇语义与韵律线索；近期零样本TTS直接以原始正字文本为输入，自然度提升但存在多音字错误且缺乏显式发音控制。

Method: 两阶段流匹配（flow-matching）TTS框架。第一阶段研究带正字扰动（orthography perturbation）的Ruby文本表示，联合保留表层字形与目标读音以实现可靠控制；第二阶段引入On-Policy Distillation（OPD），在大规模纯文本语料上、无需配对语音，提升原始正字文本下的发音准确率。

Result: 在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上，原始文本输入条件下取得97.13% Accuracy、2.02% Target PER、0.70% Sentence PER、4.21% Sentence CER，同时保持较强可控性。

Conclusion: Ruby表示与正字扰动结合可在保持自然度的同时实现显式发音控制，OPD使模型无需配对语音即可在原始正字文本上纠正多音字错误，从而弥合级联式系统与零样本端到端TTS之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Achieving both high pronunciation accuracy and fine-grained controllability remains a central challenge in Japanese text-to-speech (TTS), as Japanese is an unsegmented language mixing logographic Kanji and phonographic Kana with extensive polyphony. Traditional cascaded systems convert text into phoneme sequences via a front-end, ensuring pronunciation control but discarding lexical semantics and prosodic cues in surface orthography. Conversely, recent zero-shot TTS models directly consume raw orthographic text to improve naturalness, yet suffer from polyphone errors and lack explicit pronunciation control. To bridge this gap, we propose a two-stage framework for flow-matching TTS. First, we investigate Ruby text representations with orthography perturbation to jointly preserve surface forms and target pronunciations for reliable control. Second, we introduce On-Policy Distillation (OPD) on large-scale text-only corpora to enhance pronunciation accuracy on raw orthographic text without paired speech. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our model achieves 97.13% Accuracy, 2.02% Target PER, 0.70% Sentence PER, and 4.21% Sentence CER under raw text while retaining strong controllability.

</details>


### [173] [Twists and Turns: A Graph-Based Benchmark and Framework for Long-Term Memory in Exploration Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06414)
*Chongyuan Dai,Yaling Shen,Zirui Song,Junfeng Liao,Jinpeng Hu,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LExMem基准与LExGraph框架，将长期探索任务建模为图结构以评测与增强模型记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆研究聚焦事实回忆与更新，忽视探索任务中解法试错、修订与重启之间的关联性。

Method: 将探索过程建模为图，引入演化机制提升结构复杂度，构建224段对话、2018个问答的LExMem基准；并提出LExGraph，将对话增量组织为互连记忆节点，通过混合检索与邻居扩展进行证据检索。

Result: LExMem对现有检索式与记忆式系统构成显著挑战；LExGraph取得更优性能，并能有效泛化到外部基准。

Conclusion: 图结构是刻画长期探索记忆的有效视角，既支撑基准构建也指导记忆框架设计。

Abstract: Long-term problem-solving processes, such as scientific research and software development, proceed along an evolving trial-and-error trajectory toward a central goal. We term these \textit{exploration tasks}, which require models to remember not only facts but also how solutions are tested against intermediate outcomes and early attempts are continually revised or revived. However, existing long-term memory research focuses on factual recall and updates, overlooking the interconnected nature of exploration. We observe that exploration processes naturally form graphs, with branching approaches linked by revisions and reconsiderations. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{LExMem}, a graph-guided benchmark designed to evaluate \underline{\textsc{Mem}}ory in \underline{\textsc{L}}ong-term \underline{\textsc{Ex}}ploration tasks. We model exploration processes as graphs and introduce an evolutionary mechanism to increase their structural complexity, yielding 224 dialogues and 2,018 question-answer instances derived from graph structures. Building on the same insight, we propose \textsc{LExGraph}, a graph-based memory framework that incrementally organizes dialogues into interconnected memory nodes and retrieves evidence through hybrid retrieval and neighbor expansion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textsc{LExMem} poses a significant challenge to existing retrieval- and memory-based systems, whereas \textsc{LExGraph} achieves superior performance and generalizes effectively to external benchmarks. Codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/LExMem.

</details>


### [174] [EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06444)
*Yanli Wang,Zichen Bai,Tianyue Jiang,Kunming Shao,Junhao Shi,Xueqin Liu,Jinguo Sun,Muye Li,Tingting Bi,Yanlin Wang,Shaoqiang Zheng,Xuefei Diao,Zhuwei Zeng,Nan Duan,Peng Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 EvoGuard，成对技能选择器，单次前向即可在线判断新技能是否优于旧技能，缓解技能退化且低延迟低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体通过自然语言"技能"跨任务复用经验，但在线演化技能存在退化风险：离线批量更新后无检验地直接采纳会随时间恶化；用留出验证集检验又太慢太贵，无法每次更新都执行。

Method: 先迭代运行智能体构建技能池，并在私有测试集上为每个技能打效用标签；对技能两两配对，用拒绝采样只保留效用差距明显的配对；以两个标签 token 的 logits 训练选择器，学习判别更优技能。部署时单次前向完成决策。

Result: 相比"采纳每个新技能"，EvoGuard 在 ALFWorld 提升 11.0%、ScienceWorld 提升 5.9%、LiveCodeBench 提升 2.7%；决策速度显著快于私有测试集评估。

Conclusion: 将技能采纳转化为低成本成对偏好判别，可在在线场景有效抑制技能退化，兼顾效果与延迟。

Abstract: Skills let language agents reuse experience across tasks as natural-language documents. Recent work evolves skills from interaction, but existing methods have limitations when skills evolve online. Prior methods update a skill offline from a batch of trajectories collected over many tasks. Some then adopt the new skill without any check, which can degrade the skill over time. Others keep it only if it improves performance on a held-out validation set, which is too slow and costly to run after every update. We introduce EvoGuard, a pairwise skill selector that mitigates skill degradation at low latency and cost. We first run the agent iteratively to build pools of skills and score each skill on a private test set to obtain utility labels. We pair the skills and use rejection sampling to keep only pairs with a clear utility gap. The selector is trained on the logits of two label tokens to pick the better skill. At deployment it decides in a single forward pass, which is significantly faster than evaluation on the private test set. Compared with adopting every new skill, EvoGuard improves success by 11.0% on ALFWorld, 5.9% on ScienceWorld, and 2.7% on LiveCodeBench.

</details>


### [175] [ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06481)
*Jyotin Goel,Abhinav Arun,Tejas Prakash Agarwal,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ArcRAG：在推理时诱导查询局部图接口（节点标签、关系描述符、属性键），规划多跳遍历并以Cypher执行与修复；在MuSiQue/HotpotQA/TriviaQA上分别以"模式引导图"与"开放信息抽取图"两种构造成图并固定检索器配置，验证检索流程可跨构造迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GraphRAG的检索策略往往围绕自身构图流水线的结构特性设计（依赖特定schema、关系名），一旦构图方式改变是否仍有效缺乏检验；作者因此研究"跨构造可移植性"问题。

Method: 构建ArcRAG：推理时基于问题提及实体可达的标签/关系描述/属性键，诱导查询局部图接口，据此规划多跳遍历，生成Cypher并执行与修复；对三个数据集各建两类图（模式引导：类型化节点、封闭关系集、来源溯源；开放IE：无类型节点、自由文本关系），检索器配置固定不变；与构造无关的Direct-Cypher基线对比，并在两种图族上按重试与pass预算做逐阶段消融，另与既往GraphRAG报告结果比较。

Result: 查询时接口诱导使构造无关的检索器在构图变化时仍保持有效；但图构造方式仍影响绝对准确率。消融显示各阶段在重试/pass预算下的贡献差异。

Conclusion: 检索无需与图构造共同设计：接口诱导可解耦检索流程与构图细节，实现跨构造的可移植性，尽管构造质量决定绝对性能上限。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.

</details>


### [176] [LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06496)
*Zewen Zhan,Hui Lu,Xueyuan Chen,Huimeng Wang,Yikai Huang,Xixin Wu,Shiyin Kang,Bin Xia,Zhiyong Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文指出现有语音大模型多为离线处理，缺乏实时流式语音交互的基准与评测协议，因而构建 LibriSpeech-Real-QA 数据集与基准，并提出使预训练 SLM 具备流式目标词识别能力的建模方案与基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数语音大模型采用离线范式，需接收完整语音段后才开始响应；而真实应用中音频持续流入、需基于已接收音频块即时作答（如持续统计某名字被提及的次数）。当前缺乏面向实时语音交互的基准与评测协议。

Method: 基于 LibriSpeech 构建不同类型的实时问答对（LibriSpeech-Real-QA 数据集与基准），用于评测语音大模型能否在流式音频中识别目标词；评测多个主流实时商用模型；并探索多种建模设计，使预训练 SLM 能够完成该任务。

Result: 主流实时商用模型仍倾向于在语音回合结束后才作出响应；通过所探索的建模设计可让预训练 SLM 执行该流式目标词识别任务，并建立可靠基线。

Conclusion: 实时流式语音交互缺乏基准，本文提供的 LibriSpeech-Real-QA 数据集、基准与基线填补了这一空白，为后续实时语音交互研究提供评测与建模基础。

Abstract: Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person's name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. We construct different types of real-time question-answer pairs from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio. We evaluate several popular real-time commercial models and find that they still tend to respond only after the speech turn has finished. We demonstrate that we can enable a pretrained SLM to perform this task, where we explore several modeling designs and establish a solid baseline for future research.

</details>


### [177] [CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06501)
*Chenyang Le,Pei Zhang,Yuxiang Chen,Bing Han,Derek F. Wong,Baosong Yang,Yanmin Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于全模态LLM的端到端交错读写（interleaved read-write）同声传译框架，通过交错语音块与文本token实现KV cache全复用与无分段无限长流式推理，并用Actor-Critic自增强流水线学习最优读写策略，在句级与文档级基准上刷新质量-延迟Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based SimulST主要依赖prefix-incremental生成，存在冗余KV cache重计算问题，且需要外部VAD处理无界音频流，成为效率与部署瓶颈。

Method: 构建于全模态LLM之上：交替排列语音块与文本token，实现完整KV cache复用与免分段、无限长推理；提出Actor-Critic自增强流程——RNN-T Actor动态采样读写轨迹，LLM-based Critic以内在语义与延迟奖励评估路径，并将最优策略蒸馏回Actor，从而无需刚性离线对齐即可学习流式策略。

Result: 在句级（FLEURS、CoVoST2）与文档级（MuST-C、ACL 60/60）基准上，模型建立了新的SOTA质量-延迟Pareto前沿，显著优于现有级联式与静态对齐基线。

Conclusion: 该工作为SimulST提供了一条可原生流式、支持无限长推理的解决方案，其Actor-Critic自增强机制可替代对刚性对齐的依赖，推进同声传译在效率-质量权衡上的边界。

Abstract: Simultaneous Speech Translation (SimulST) requires balancing translation quality and latency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in offline translation, current LLM-based SimulST systems predominantly rely on prefix-incremental generation. This paradigm suffers from redundant Key-Value cache recomputation and necessitates external Voice Activity Detection to process unbounded streams. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework built upon an omni-modal LLM. By interleaving speech chunks and text tokens, our architecture achieves full KV cache reuse, natively supporting segmentation-free, infinite-length inference. Furthermore, to learn optimal streaming policies without rigid offline alignments, we introduce a novel Actor-Critic self-enhancement pipeline. An RNN-T Actor dynamically samples read-write trajectories, while an LLM-based Critic evaluates these paths via intrinsic semantic and latency rewards, distilling the optimal policy back to the Actor. Extensive experiments on sentence-level (FLEURS, CoVoST2) and document-level (MuST-C, ACL 60/60) benchmarks demonstrate that our model establishes new state-of-the-art quality-latency Pareto frontiers, substantially outperforming existing cascaded and static-alignment baselines.

</details>


### [178] [NaijaFacts: A Framework for Disentangling Language from Knowledge in Facts about Nigeria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06504)
*Zainab Afolabi,Nikita Kozodoi,Jack Butler,Babs Khalidson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Naija 基准，用尼日利亚本土专家编写、以官方统计为依据的事实与统计类问题（含英文、尼日利亚皮金语、约鲁巴语、伊博语、豪萨语五语版本）构建国别×语言矩阵，以区分"语言效应"与"知识效应"。结果显示知识效应占主导（英语提问下美国/英国准确率49–50%，尼日利亚仅20%），语言效应较小且与网络资源代表性相关；扩大模型规模无法弥补差距，且该模式在全部54个非洲国家上普遍成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非洲语言多语言基准多为将通用问题翻译为本地语言，仅衡量语言能力，无法反映模型是否掌握关于非洲的事实知识，缺乏区分语言能力退化与知识缺位的评测手段。

Method: 构建 Naija 基准：面向尼日利亚的事实性与统计性问题，由母语者撰写、以权威官方统计数据为依据，每题提供英文、尼日利亚皮金语、约鲁巴语、伊博语、豪萨语五语版本；对英国、美国的类似问题构造"国家×语言"矩阵，以分离语言效应（事实已知但低资源语言下降）与知识效应（各语言均缺失该事实）；评测8个前沿模型及尼日利亚适配模型，并将实验扩展至全部54个非洲国家。

Result: 知识效应占主导：英语提问下美国/英国准确率为49–50%，尼日利亚仅20%。语言效应较小且与网络代表性相关，从英文到约鲁巴语下降9个百分点（尼日利亚问题），在美国/英国问题上最高达24个百分点。规模无帮助：最强模型在英国和美国问题上达66–79%，但在尼日利亚统计类问题上均未超过31%。扩展到54个非洲国家后呈现相同格局——文化类96%、政治类98%，而统计类仅26%。

Conclusion: 非洲语言模型性能瓶颈主要源于知识缺失而非语言能力不足，且该差距跨国家普遍存在、不随模型规模缩小；需针对非洲事实知识构建本地化、权威依据的评测与数据资源。

Abstract: Multilingual benchmarks for African languages mostly translate generic questions into local languages, measuring linguistic competence but not whether models know facts about Africa. We introduce \naija, a benchmark of factual and statistical questions about Nigeria, authored by native speakers and grounded in authoritative official statistics, with every question available in English, Nigerian Pidgin, \yoruba, Igbo, and Hausa. Answering similar questions for the UK and US yields a country by language matrix that disentangles a language effect (the model knows the fact but degrades in a low-resource language) from a knowledge effect (the fact is absent in every language). Across eight frontier and Nigeria-adapted models, the knowledge effect dominates: English-query accuracy is 49--50\% for the US/UK but 20\% for Nigeria. The language effect is smaller and tracks web representation, degrading from English to \yoruba{} (9 points on Nigeria, up to 24 on US/UK questions). We find scale does not help: the strongest models reach 66--79\% on the UK and the US but none exceed 31\% on Nigerian statistics. Extending to all 54 African countries with our best performing frontier model shows the same profile continent-wide, 96\% on culture and 98\% on politics against 26\% on statistics, so the gap is not specific to Nigeria.

</details>


### [179] [Dialect Matters: A Dialect-Aware Baseline for Igala-English Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06517)
*Etuh E.,Eli. A. Jiya*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首次构建带方言标签的Igala–英语平行语料（1137句），并给出方言感知的机器翻译基线，证明混合方言训练是保证方言公平性的必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Igala作为低资源语言此前没有任何平行语料，且现有研究普遍忽视方言差异；作者希望填补数据空白，并首次量化方言变化对翻译性能的影响。

Method: 构建1137句Igala-English平行语料（899句训练），首次标注方言标签（Idah 459/40.4%、Ankpa 297/26.1%、Ibaji 160/14.1%、Other 187/16.4%、Ogugu 32/2.8%）；在Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul（78M）上微调，做epoch消融（8轮收敛、15轮过拟合）；对比混合方言训练与单一Idah训练的性能差异。

Result: 混合方言模型BLEU 11.66、chrF 46.69；仅Idah训练模型在Idah上13.2、在Ibaji上降至8.5，即Ibaji下降4.7 BLEU。同一英语句对应20–60种Igala表达形式。899句规模下的表现与非洲低资源文献的对数线性趋势一致。

Conclusion: 该工作提供首个Igala方言影响分析并建立公开基线，表明方言公平性需要通过混合方言训练实现，为后续低资源语言翻译研究提供数据与方法参照。
