Abstract: The massive permeability of intelligent systems in every sphere of human activities have greatly enhanced clarity, ease of work, and increased general global understanding which has significantly awaken the use of intelligent systems by all users. Intelligent systems greatly rely on precise dataset/corpus for the correctness of their output. Despite efforts by researchers to address Low-resource language in the Natural Language Processing (NLP), Igala still has zero parallel corpora despite efforts by researchers. We present a dialect-aware baseline for Igala-English machine translation, among first open systems and first with dialectal variation analysis. Our dataset of 1137 sentences (899 training) is first with dialect tags: Idah 459 (40.4%), Ankpa 297 (26.1%), Ibaji 160 (14.1%), Other 187 (16.4%), Ogugu 32 (2.8%). Same English yields 20-60 Igala forms. Mixed-dialect training achieves balanced BLEU 11.66 versus Idah-only model which drops 4.7 BLEU on Ibaji (13.2 on Idah, 8.5 on Ibaji), proving dialect fairness requires mixing. Fine-tuned from Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-mul (78M), epoch ablation shows convergence at 8 epochs and overfitting at 15. BLEU 11.66, chrF 46.69. Analysis shows 899 sentences on log-linear trend consistent with African low-resource literature. This work provides first dialectal impact analysis for Igala and establishes baseline for future work.

</details>


### [180] [When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06545)
*Wenhui Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 长时运行的LLM智能体在上下文压缩时用摘要替代历史，本文检验"交接摘要"是否会写入原始记录并不支持的权限或限制、这类句子是否改变后继实例行为，以及其来源。基于合成工具使用任务与真实权限账本，结合同快照重放与读者标注，发现不支持的"限制"句子占可读摘要的1.2%–2.4%，不支持的"授权"占0.1%–1.3%；中和虚假授权显著减少未授权操作；并通过改写系统提示中"某些操作需要审批"的表述，将不支持的限制从5.0%降至1.8%（开发集）、1.8%降至0.3%（留出模板）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的长程运行依赖上下文压缩，摘要会取代大部分历史记录；若摘要中混入记录不支持的权限/限制陈述，可能被后继实例当作事实执行。现有工作很少量化这类"交接摘要中的规范性幻觉"及其行为后果，也缺乏对其来源的诊断与缓解手段。

Method: 1) 构建带真值权限账本（ground-truth permission ledger）的合成工具使用任务；2) 由两个开放权重模型生成交接摘要，用两名AI读者仅对规则标记的留出摘要进行标注，识别"不支持的授权/限制"句子；3) 同快照重放（same-snapshot replay）：保持其余上下文不变，将这些整句替换为中性填充，重跑后继实例以估计因果效应；4) 预注册检验与事后检验区分；5) 通过替换系统提示中"Some actions need approval."为说明"要求来源"的版本做干预。

Result: 两名读者确认：两模型可读摘要中不支持的限制分别占1.2%与2.4%，不支持的授权占0.1%与1.3%。限制项：预注册重放检验不显著（p=0.58），事后追加的检验发现脆弱效应（p=0.027）。中和虚假授权使未授权操作从120次留出运行中的24次降至7次（事后；后续数据集48次中由17降至11）。多数开发期限制源于智能体先前"某动作需要审批"的推理（事后分析）。预注册检验中，将系统提示中"Some actions need approval."改为说明要求来源后，不支持的限制由开发摘要5.0%降至1.8%，留出模板上由1.8%降至0.3%（均p<10^-9），而账本要求的审批请求几乎不变。

Conclusion: 交接摘要确实会引入记录不支持的规范性陈述，且虚假"授权"对后继行为有可检测影响（限制项效应较弱且依赖事后检验）；其主要来源是智能体对"需要审批"的过度泛化推理，而提示措辞的微调可大幅削减此类错误且不损害必要的审批请求。研究强调预注册与重放设计对因果归因的重要性，并公开代码与数据。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

</details>


### [181] [Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06639)
*Joan C. Timoneda,Sebastián Vallejo Vera*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该章针对大语言模型（LLM）研究的核心可复现性问题，提出基于结果分布的概率性标准，并设计标准化提示脚本与误差结构分析，证明测量选择可逆转下游回归系数符号；最终提出开权重模型堆叠集成以在保持估计有效性的同时提升校正精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM输出具有概率性，且随模型与版本变化，对下游统计结果影响显著，导致研究难以复现，亟需界定并解决可复现性难题。

Method: 区分可重复性（replicability）、可复现性（reproducibility）与稳健性（robustness）；提出基于结果分布而非完全一致输出的概率性标准；引入标准化提示脚本；对编码器与解码器检验模型内变异；发展误差结构分析以诊断模型在何处出错及错误是否一致；使用三个数据集进行实证；采用基于设计的校正（design-based corrections）结合金标准标注子样本恢复有效性；提出开权重模型的堆叠集成（stacked ensemble）。

Result: 测量选择可逆转下游回归系数的符号；现有基于设计的校正在金标准子样本辅助下能恢复有效性，但牺牲估计精度；堆叠集成在校正步骤中提升精度同时保持估计有效性。

Conclusion: LLM研究应遵循概率性可复现标准，并通过误差结构诊断与模型集成在有效性与精度之间取得平衡，堆叠集成为兼顾二者提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.

</details>


### [182] [ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06706)
*Tianwei Zhang,Ivy Njoki Nyagwencha,Zahraa Dirani,Shalini Joshi,Scott A. Hale*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出社区主导的众包方法，在黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语和斯瓦希里语中构建了含3022条样本的ALTO数据集（结合主动学习标注），用于检测技术助长的性别暴力（TFGBV）；实验表明现有有害内容检测模型在ALTO上召回率低，微调后有所改善，但跨语言仍难以识别隐性伤害，斯瓦希里语错误率尤高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFGBV是一种普遍的网络伤害，以直接和隐蔽形式影响女性与性别少数群体。然而现有性别伤害检测模型与标注数据集主要由全球北方语言数据主导、并在该语境下训练，导致对黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语、斯瓦希里语等语言缺乏文化及语言上相关的资源与检测能力。

Method: 与约旦、法语西非和肯尼亚的民间社会组织（CSO）合作，采用社区主导的众包方式采集三种语言中文化、语言相关的TFGBV实例，并借助主动学习进行标注，构建小型但高性能的数据集ALTO（N=3022）；随后开展基准测试与微调实验评估现有有害内容检测模型。

Result: 现有有害内容检测模型在ALTO上的TFGBV召回率较差，经微调后有所提升；模型在三种语言中均常漏检隐性伤害，且斯瓦希里语的错误率明显更高。

Conclusion: 社区主导的众包与主动学习可在资源匮乏语言中以较小规模构建有效数据集；研究公开了标注分类体系、数据集与训练模型，以推动多语言TFGBV检测研究，并揭示隐性伤害检测与跨语言性能差异仍是关键挑战。

Abstract: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

</details>


### [183] [Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06715)
*Zohreh Abbasi Liasi,Batoul Hammoud,Anas Madkoor,Ehsaneddin Asgari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Rel-Bloom，一个受 Bloom 分类启发的受控多语言诊断基准（450 题、30 个 Wikidata 关系、5 个认知层级 × 3 种真实性条件），在 43 个模型、6 种语言、226,800 条预测上考察「证据条件下的关系推理」，发现模型能力提升并不等于能可靠推理给定关系证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 隐含假设语言模型能对上下文中陈述的关系进行推理，而非退回到预训练记忆的关联。作者希望在隔离条件下（事实直接给在 prompt 中、不依赖检索）专门检验这一「证据条件关系推理」能力，并考察其跨认知层级、跨真伪条件、跨语言的表现。

Method: 构建 Rel-Bloom 诊断基准：450 道多选题，源自 30 个 Wikidata 关系，每个关系在 5 个 Bloom 式层级（Remember、Understand、Apply、Analyze、Evaluate）与 3 种真实性条件（Factual、Counterfactual、Neutralized）下实例化。在 43 个模型、6 种语言、2 种多语言设置下共获得 226,800 条预测。

Result: 三大发现：(1) 所有受评开源模型系列从 Apply 到 Analyze 出现显著准确率跌落（Large Granite 组达 47.2 个百分点），但两个 Gemini 模型未出现；(2) Evaluate 项始终是瓶颈，Gemini 3.1 Pro 在其他四层级平均 99.5%，Evaluate 仅 60.7%；(3) 题目级与关系级难度排序跨语言高度一致，表明难度结构部分共享。此外，Counterfactual 上下文普遍难于 Factual；移除实体身份在某些模型机制下可提升高层级表现。

Conclusion: 更强的模型能力本身并不保证能可靠地对给定关系证据进行推理；高层级（Analyze/Evaluate）与反事实条件仍是系统性薄弱环节，且难度结构呈现跨语言共享特性。资源已公开于 Hugging Face。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.

</details>


### [184] [Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06789)
*Shaoliang Yang,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文检验"快速录用分类器可为更昂贵的评估器筛选修改稿"这一假设，发现分类器与两个文本预测器在原文排序上基本一致，但在"哪些改写会提高分数"上几乎没有一致性；在32位精度下，预测器在五选一中仅比随机选择高不到2分（满分100），因此修改筛选器必须针对实际目标评估器进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本接受/拒稿分类器常被设想作为前置筛选器，为更慢、更贵的评估器挑选值得评估的修改稿。该做法的隐含前提是：快速分类器与目标评估器对"哪些修改更好"的判断一致。作者要检验这一前提是否有实证支持。

Method: 以ICLR的198篇论文为对象，构建基于词与文档特征的分类器，并与两个已发布的、仅用文本、由同一30亿参数语言模型微调得到的录用预测器比较。对原文及经自动筛查（保证事实不变、论断强度不变、归属不变）的段落改写分别打分，比较模型排名；预先设定的检验使用较低数值精度，后处理阶段以完整32位精度重算已发布权重，并做五选一随机对照。

Result: 分类器与其中一个预测器在原文排名上高度一致，与另一个中度一致，但两者在"哪些改写会提升分数"上均无可检测的一致性。低精度下舍入误差主导了微小的分数变化；32位重算后编辑一致性仍接近零。每种预测器在每篇论文五个改写中择优时，平均原始分较随机选择高出不足2分（满分100）。

Conclusion: 一致性证据仅支持模型在原文层面的一致排名，不支持其在修改选择层面的可迁移性。结论受限于仅考察表述性改写和同一模型族的两个开源预测器，向高成本评估器的迁移尚未验证。修改筛选器应在其所排序的修改稿上、针对预期评估器进行校验，而非依据与代理模型的表面一致。

Abstract: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.

</details>


### [185] [Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06806)
*Nil-Jana Akpinar,Eugenia Kim,Natalie Isak,Amanda Minnich,Victoria Westerhoff,Matthew Dressman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文主张"测量风险而非伤害"：在单条AI回复层面检测8类构成心理伤害风险因素的可观测行为，并聚合信号以支持纵向监测。作者构建了47,062条AI回复、373,873条标签的合成多标签语料，比较嵌入分类器、直接LLM评判及其级联方案，最佳级联在人工标注留出集上宏平均P=0.86、R=0.76、F1=0.79，并在WildChat上将LLM评判调用量降低97.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与LLM交互造成的心理伤害难以直接监测：其往往在多次交互后才显现，且高度依赖用户个体的主观情境，缺乏可直接观测的伤害标签。因此需要一种可与潜在用户伤害区分开、仅依赖模型输出、可扩展的测量层。

Method: 将心理伤害风险操作化为8种可观测的AI回复行为；构建合成多标签语料（47,062条回复、373,873条标签），并进行定向人工标注用于验证与评估；对比三类检测器——基于嵌入的训练分类器、直接LLM评判、分类器-评判级联；所有检测器均与模型无关，仅作用于LLM输出，不访问内部状态；并在多个分布外的人机对话数据集上进行应用与评估。

Result: 在留出的人工标注数据上，最佳级联达到宏平均精确率0.86、召回率0.76、F1 0.79；在WildChat上相对直接评判将LLM调用量减少97.1%；在DelusionEval上，风险因素检出在对话内部呈聚集分布。

Conclusion: 回复层面的行为风险因素检测可作为纵向心理安全监测的可扩展测量层，且无需将可观测的AI行为与潜在的用戶伤害相混淆。

Abstract: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.

</details>


### [186] [LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06808)
*Lingfei Qian,Yan Wang,Xueqing Peng,Yupeng Cao,Yuechen Jiang,Zhuohan Xie,Anke Xu,Wenbo Cao,Jiarui Chen,Zehan Li,Jimin Huang,Alejandro Lopez-Lira,Yuehua Tang,Sophia Ananiadou,Jian-Yun Nie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 FinDendro 基准（2,226 条 1999–2026 年美国带日期事实），实证表明 LLM 的"知识截止声明""自我报告知否""按过去日期作答"等防泄漏手段均不可靠，主张以行为测量替代自报告来界定模型的时间知识边界，并据此选择回测窗口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 金融回测的有效性依赖于模型在预测时并不"已知"结果。实务中常用三种防泄漏措施：信任厂商声明的知识截止日期、直接询问模型是否知道、或指示模型以某个历史日期为视角作答。但三种措施的有效性均未被验证，若失效则训练窗口内的回测结果无法认定为无泄漏。

Method: 构建 FinDendro 基准，包含 1999–2026 年 2,226 条带日期的美国事实，涵盖月度宏观序列、月末股价与美联储决议。每条事实生成四类提示：数值问答、将候选值与"知道/猜测"声明配对但不给出日期的 Recall 与 Predict 题、以及带历史声明日期的 Predict 题。通过持续性与主导结果控制，将随机猜测准确率压至约 0.27，从而可分离真实知识、猜测与元认知自报告。

Result: 多数前沿模型存在知识自报告低估现象：GPT-5 在受控事实上答对 76%，却仅声称知道 38%，且在其声称"不知道"的事实中仍答对 61%。知识声明可越过实测知识边界，最多延伸约七个季度；声明历史日期能消除大部分"先前知道"的主张，但准确率不变。说明自报告、指令与厂商截止日期均不足以认证回测无泄漏。

Conclusion: 训练窗口内的金融回测不能靠自我报告、提示指令或声明的截止日期来证明无数据泄漏，需对模型时间知识边界进行行为化测量；FinDendro 为此提供了基准与流程，可依据实测事实性知识来选取回测区间。

Abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.

</details>


### [187] [SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06812)
*Man-Ling Sung,Hemanth Kandula,Jeff Ma,William Hartmann,Matthew Snover*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SAUCE：面向跨语言对话语音摘要的无参考、基于事实的评估流水线，通过对话与摘要间的蕴含关系衡量准确性与事实覆盖率，兼顾可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM及其语音应用评估需求增长，但缺乏明确终止目标的对话摘要在总结与评估上仍存挑战；现有黑盒LLM评估器或稠密嵌入指标缺乏可解释性，且难以捕捉转录/翻译错误导致的信息损失。

Method: 提出SAUCE无参考、事实驱动的评估流水线，将摘要评分映射到离散、可验证的事实上，通过对话与文本之间的蕴含（entailment）关系度量摘要准确性与事实覆盖率；与多种主流摘要指标进行对比。

Result: 相比流行摘要指标，SAUCE能有效捕捉转录与翻译错误带来的信息损失并识别残缺摘要；初步研究表明其与人工判断高度一致；可将评分定位到具体事实以指出幻觉或遗漏。

Conclusion: SAUCE具备内在可解释性，可帮助开发者系统刻画LLM行为，并为终端用户提供在噪声真实场景下核验摘要准确性的可操作工具。

Abstract: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.

</details>


### [188] [LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06835)
*Lele Yang,Muxi Diao,Zhonghao Yan,Jiankang Chen,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Wentao Zhang,Kongming Liang,Zhanyu Ma,Weiran Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LooM 在因果编码器-解码器结构下仅循环解码器层，并将全局记忆写入与 KV 缓存发布限制为“每 token 一次”，使循环 Transformer 的显存与缓存不随循环次数增长，同时支持 3–21 层执行的细粒度、可事后调整的深度预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环 Transformer 通过重复执行共享层提升有效深度，但存在三点阻碍落地的问题：显存随循环数增长；计算量只能以整块（whole-block）为步长调整；训练后循环次数难以更改。作者希望解决这三点，使“深度”成为部署时可自由选择的预算。

Method: 提出 LooM（Loop-invariant Memory）：(1) 在因果编码器-解码器（CED）中，仅循环第一个之后的解码器层；这些层读取按 token 写入一次的全局记忆；(2) 每个循环层的 KV 条目仅在首次访问该 token 时发布，因此缓存大小与循环数无关（loop-invariant）；(3) 各解码器层独立循环，从而支持 3–21 次层执行的任意预算；(4) 训练时随机采样预算，单模型覆盖全部预算，无需路由器（router）。

Result: 在足够循环次数下，LooM 在语言建模、零样本准确率与长上下文困惑度上均优于同数据训练的单次前向基线，且缓存大小相同。分析表明，训练时的预算分布决定了额外深度带来何种收益。

Conclusion: CED 是循环的自然场所：记忆只写一次，深度成为部署时可选的预算。LooM 以循环不变的显存代价换取灵活、可事后调节的有效深度。

Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.

</details>


### [189] [Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06839)
*Peidi Dong,Yunze Xiao,Yu-Lin Tsai,Yichen Zheng,Heyuan Huang,Weihao Xuan,Mark Dredze,Jen-tse Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TASC基准，评估LLM在多轮对话中识别并应用隐含时间约束的能力；13个模型仅在30.5%的违规场景中正确应用约束，且62.1%的失误发生在时间计算正确的情况下，揭示"时间推理"与"时间应用"之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM助手越来越多地参与涉及时间约束的日常任务，但用户在后续请求中往往不再重复这些约束，助手需自行识别并调整建议。现有评测缺乏对"对话中时间约束应用能力"的系统评估。

Method: 构建TASC（Temporal Action Safety in Conversation）基准：由128个模板生成3,418条输入，另设33个场景专门对比模型的"经过时间计算能力"与"该信息应用能力"；在13个模型上测试，并考察显式提供时间信息能否缓解失败。

Result: 在建议动作违反规则的案例中，助手仅30.5%的情况下考虑了时间约束，且很少出现多余警告；62.1%的应用失败发生在时间计算正确的前提下；显式给出时间仅能修复约一半的此类失败。

Conclusion: 模型存在明显的时间推理与时间应用之间的断裂（temporal reasoning–application gap），单纯提升时间计算不足以保障对话建议的安全性，需针对性改进约束跟踪与应用机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.

</details>


### [190] [Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06848)
*Austin C. Kozlowski,Avital Mintz,Madison Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文检验人格化提示是否改变LLM潜空间中的表征几何：在自由/保守政治人格条件下提取9000+词与33个语义轴的表示，发现词在语义轴上的投影及轴间对齐方式均被系统性改变，且方向与指定意识形态一致；且无persona训练的线性探针、SAE分类器与人工选词分类器在persona条件下对争议陈述的真性与道德性评分出现政治化偏差，说明常规提取的内部表征可能失真，威胁监测有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针与稀疏自编码器等LLM特征监测方法普遍假设特征是跨上下文一致的表征；但LLM能灵活采纳不同"人格/视角"，暗示其背后可能存在不同的概念关系系统。若该假设不成立，则基于固定表征的监测与安全评估可能失效。

Method: 对模型施加自由派与保守派政治人格提示，并设置两个中性基线；提取超过9,000个常见词与33个语义轴的表示，比较词在语义轴上的投影及语义轴之间的对齐关系；随后用三类无persona训练的读取器（线性探针、SAE分类器、基于人工选词表示构建的分类器）在persona条件下评估真性与道德性两个安全相关特征。

Result: persona条件化系统性地改变词到语义轴的投影及轴间对齐，且变化方向与指定意识形态一致；三类读取器在persona条件模型上产生分歧结果，并对争议陈述给出政治倾向性的真性与道德性评分。

Conclusion: 按常规方式提取的内部表征在模型采纳人格时可能呈现不同的几何关系，从而削弱基于探针与SAE的监测与安全评估的可信度。

Abstract: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.

</details>


### [191] [Balancing hierarchical representation and quantization: A performance trade-off in text embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06859)
*Kai Ponel,Marco Polignano,Erasmo Purificato,Aylin Julia Temizkan,Marco Levantesi,Giovanni Semeraro,Ernesto William De Luca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文实证基准研究了层次化文本嵌入（变长，1D/2D）与量化（32/8/二进制位）两种正交效率技术的交互作用，覆盖MTEB 38个任务、4个模型、每任务168种配置；结论是int8基本无损（≤1.5个百分点）且与fp32统计不可区分，二进制量化显著劣化；8倍降维+int8可实现32倍存储压缩并保留94.4%效果；未发现量化能加速端到端评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层次化嵌入（可变长度、多粒度表示）与低精度量化各自被用于提升嵌入模型计算效率，但二者是正交技术，此前缺少系统性的交互效应实证。作者希望量化回答：两者叠加时有效性如何折损、存储与推理时延各自如何变化，从而为工程选型提供依据。

Method: 在MTEB的38个任务上，用4个Transformer嵌入模型评测1D与2D层次化表示分别与float32、int8、binary三档量化的组合，每任务共168种配置。效率维度分开度量：理论单向量存储开销与端到端评估时间。统计上采用Friedman检验配合Nemenyi事后分析判断配置间差异显著性；评估时间仅测一次，故定位为指示性证据。结果按任务类别分别报告。

Result: int8量化与float32在配对分类与重排序任务上统计不可区分，总体效果损失至多1.5个百分点；binary量化在所有任务类别上均显著劣化。维度减半在m>16以上不可统计检出，而连续两次减半总可检出。8倍降维叠加int8带来32倍单向量存储压缩，效果保留94.4%。未发现量化缩短评估时间的证据，而从中间层采样可显著缩短时延。检索任务的性能衰减远快于其他类别。

Conclusion: 层次化嵌入与量化可有效叠加：以int8为主、配合一次性降维是兼顾存储与精度的稳妥配置，binary量化不建议采用；量化主要是存储/带宽收益而非时延收益，若需降低评估时延应考虑中间层采样等结构性手段。由于检索任务的敏感性最高，各结论须按任务类别分别适用，且时延结论因单次测量需进一步验证。

Abstract: Hierarchical text embedding models offer variable-length representations, while quantization reduces numerical precision; both aim to improve computational efficiency. This work is an empirical benchmark study of how these two orthogonal, already-established techniques interact. We evaluate 38 tasks from the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB) using four transformer-based embedding models, covering 1D and 2D hierarchical representations combined with 32-bit, 8-bit, and binary quantization, for 168 configurations per task. We report each efficiency dimension separately: theoretical per-vector storage and end-to-end evaluation time. Under a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, int8 quantization is statistically indistinguishable from float32 for pair classification and re-ranking and costs at most 1.5 percentage points overall, whereas binary quantization is significantly worse across every task category. Halving the embedding dimension once is not statistically detectable above $m=16$; two successive halvings always are. Combining an 8x dimensionality reduction with int8 yields a 32x reduction in per-vector storage at 94.4% of baseline effectiveness. Because evaluation times were measured once, we treat them as indicative: we find no evidence that quantization speeds up evaluation, whereas sampling from intermediate layers shortens it substantially. Retrieval degrades far faster than every other category, so we report findings per task category.

</details>


### [192] [SpecCompact: Accelerating LLM Agent Context Compaction with Slot-Parallel Semantic Speculative Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06876)
*Yulu An,Yifei Feng,Xiangyang Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SpecCompact：通过槽位并行语义推测加速LLM智能体的上下文压缩


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需通过上下文压缩（compaction）管理不断增长的交互历史，但用大模型摘要长历史会带来显著延迟，因此压缩需在信息保留与延迟之间权衡。作者观察到结构化摘要槽位在独立生成时仍能保留信息，据此寻求加速压缩的途径。

Method: 提出SpecCompact框架，基于槽位并行的语义推测（slot-parallel semantic speculation）：微调一个小型起草模型（drafter）并行生成各摘要槽位；目标模型逐行验证提议内容并修复被拒绝的部分，后续起草复用更新后的槽位前缀；并辅以系统优化以减少重复的上下文处理与模型调用。

Result: 在AppWorld与τ³两个基准、两种目标模型上，SpecCompact相对Hermes式摘要实现2.04–5.63倍压缩加速；独立的下游评测显示存在依赖模型与任务的性能权衡；在Hermes内开展的用户研究显示压缩速度中位数提升8.68倍。

Conclusion: 槽位并行语义推测可有效加速上下文压缩，在显著降低压缩延迟的同时保持信息保留，但下游性能存在模型与任务相关的权衡，需在具体应用中权衡取舍。

Abstract: LLM agents use context compaction to manage growing interaction histories, but summarizing long histories with large models can introduce substantial delays. Compaction therefore requires balancing information retention against latency. We observe that structured summary slots can retain information when generated independently. Based on this observation, we present SpecCompact, a framework that accelerates compaction through slot-parallel semantic speculation. SpecCompact fine-tunes a small drafter and generates slots in parallel. The target model verifies each proposed line and repairs rejected content, while subsequent drafting uses the updated slot prefix. System optimizations further reduce repeated context processing and model calls. Across AppWorld and $τ^3$ benchmarks with two target models, SpecCompact achieves $2.04$--$5.63\times$ compaction speedups over Hermes-style summarization. Separate downstream evaluations reveal model- and task-dependent performance trade-offs. A user study within Hermes further shows an $8.68\times$ median compaction speedup.

</details>

### [193] [Adaptive Virtual PIN-Button Recognition on Passive NFC Cards via Domain Adaptation and Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05719)
*Dickson Akuoko Sarpong,Hongzhi Guo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出无需修改商用NFC卡与ISO/IEC 15693协议的虚拟按键输入框架，通过多域自适应与保形预测实现可靠PIN输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动NFC卡广泛用于门禁与认证，但缺乏可靠的用户输入接口；基于射频的交互识别受卡片与读写器硬件差异导致的信号变化影响，识别可靠性不足。

Method: 构建12按键虚拟输入界面；提出联合学习对卡片域与读写器域不变交互表征的多域自适应框架；引入基于保形预测的模型无关不确定性量化，置信度不足时请求重新输入，通过时由读写器反馈即时确认；搭建基于SDR的ISO/IEC 15693测试平台，采用多款商用NFC卡与读写器配置。

Result: 域自适应使深度学习模型识别准确率由93.75%提升至95.42%，随机森林由85.00%提升至89.11%；结合保形预测后，在不同硬件配置下DL与RF平均识别准确率分别达96.85%与90.55%。

Conclusion: 多域自适应与保形预测可有效缓解硬件差异带来的信号变异性，在商用被动NFC卡上实现高置信度、可靠的虚拟按键交互。

Abstract: Passive Near Field Communication (NFC) cards are widely used for access control and authentication but provide no native interface for reliable user input. Radio-frequency (RF)-based interaction recognition offers a way to enable input on these cards, but hardware-dependent signal variations across cards and readers limit recognition reliability. This paper presents a practical virtual input framework that enables reliable PIN-button entry on passive NFC cards using a 12-button interface without modifying the commercial NFC card or the ISO/IEC 15693 communication protocol. We develop a multi-domain adaptation framework that jointly learns interaction representations invariant to both card and reader variations. To improve decision reliability, we introduce a model-agnostic uncertainty quantification framework based on conformal prediction that estimates recognition confidence. When confidence is insufficient, the system requests re-input; otherwise, accepted inputs are immediately confirmed through reader feedback, enabling reliable user interaction. A Software-Defined Radio (SDR)-based ISO/IEC 15693 testbed is developed using multiple commercial NFC cards and reader configurations. Experimental results show that domain adaptation improves recognition accuracy from 93.75% to 95.42% for the deep learning (DL) model and from 85.00% to 89.11% for the Random Forest model. Conformal prediction further enables adaptive high-confidence recognition, achieving average recognition accuracies of 96.85% and 90.55% for the DL and Random Forest models, respectively, across diverse hardware configurations.

</details>


### [194] [Agentic Wireless Optimization: Workflow Automation, Algorithm Design, and Multi-Timescale Network Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05887)
*Yuan Guo,Zixiang Ren,Ruihua Luo,Yilong Chen,Ya-Feng Liu,Xianghao Yu,Derrick Wing Kwan Ng,Jie Xu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文综述了基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体AI在无线通信优化中的应用，涵盖优化工作流自动化、算法设计以及多时间尺度网络运维三个层面，并通过多播波束成形与网络节能两个案例验证其性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线通信优化（信道容量刻画、传输方案设计、资源分配）传统上依赖大量专家知识和人工投入，尤其在高维/非凸问题、黑箱目标以及跨时间尺度耦合决策场景下难度突出。近期智能体AI（LLM智能体）具备推理、工具调用与数值反馈整合能力，为应对上述挑战提供了新契机。

Method: 提出智能体无线优化的系统性框架，包含三部分：(1) 工作流自动化——LLM智能体以闭环方式自动完成问题建模、代码生成、数值求解与结果验证；(2) 算法设计——组合与配置现有数值方法、改进基于学习的优化器，利用数值反馈提升非凸与黑箱问题的解质量及计算效率；(3) 多时间尺度网络运维——将耦合问题分解为相互依赖的子任务并协调求解，以满足网络级目标与服务需求。辅以多播波束成形案例与网络节能案例进行说明。

Result: 多播波束成形案例表明，由智能体开发的求解器带来性能增益，尤其在执行时间上优势明显；网络节能示例展示了智能体如何在多个时间尺度上协调基站动态激活、用户关联与波束成形。

Conclusion: 智能体AI可有效赋能无线优化流程，在自动化、算法设计与跨时间尺度协调方面具有潜力；文末进一步讨论了该方向的开放挑战与研究机遇。

Abstract: Optimization is fundamental to wireless communications, from characterizing channel capacity and designing transmission schemes to allocating network resources. However, conventional workflows require substantial expertise and manual effort, particularly for high-dimensional or nonconvex problems, black-box objectives, and interdependent decisions across time scales. Recent advances in agentic artificial intelligence (AI), particularly agents based on large language models (LLMs), offer new opportunities to address these challenges by integrating reasoning, tool use, and numerical feedback. This article presents an overview of agentic AI for wireless optimization, focusing on workflow automation, algorithm design, and multi-timescale network operations. First, LLM-based agents streamline optimization workflows by automating problem formulation, code generation, numerical solution, and result verification in a closed loop. Second, they facilitate algorithm design by combining and configuring existing numerical methods and refining learning-based optimizers, using numerical feedback to improve solution quality and computational efficiency for nonconvex and black-box problems. Third, they support multi-timescale network operations by decomposing coupled problems into interdependent subtasks and coordinating their solutions to satisfy network-level objectives and service requirements. A multicast beamforming case study demonstrates performance gains from agent-developed solvers, particularly in execution time, and a network energy-saving example illustrates how agents coordinate dynamic base station activation, user association, and beamforming across time scales. Finally, we discuss open challenges and research opportunities in agentic wireless optimization.

</details>


### [195] [Frequency-Frame Covariance for Reactive-Power Scalarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05913)
*Kai Sun*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出"频率-坐标协变性"(frequency-frame covariance)形式化框架，用于分析在非物理基频参考系下计算的视在功率/无功功率读数一致性，推导出必要的协变条件，并说明读数算子如何随波形表示一致变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测量得到的电压、电流波形可能被表示在频率与物理基频不同的参考系中；若读数算子未作一致变换，由这种频率移位坐标算出的无功功率读数会发生变化，产生看似矛盾的结果，因此需要明确其成立条件。

Method: 针对有限频谱、零均值、包含一个物理周期完整谐波信息的周期波形，构建频率-坐标协变公式；推导充要协变条件；分析频率相关谐波权重必须在物理谐波阶次而非相对帧标签上取值；将 derivative/Iliovici 读数分解为相对导数项与显式参考项；区分算子误差与投影保留物理分量变化引起的误差；并用三个解析案例（无记忆电阻的条件载波恢复、RLC 支路相对零处的物理频率加权、投影后精确无功标量与显著波形误差共存）加以说明。

Result: 获得充要协变条件；证明谐波权重须按物理阶次评估；给出 derivative/Iliovici 读数的两项分解；三个案例分别展示条件性载波恢复、相对零处的物理频率加权行为，以及投影后精确无功标量可能与较大波形误差并存。

Conclusion: 无功功率读数在频率移位坐标下的差异源于读数算子未随表示一致变换；只要满足协变条件并按物理谐波阶次加权，即可保证确定性计算的一致性。研究范围限于确定性计算一致性，不涉及仪器测量不确定度。

Abstract: Measured voltage and current waveforms may be represented in a reference frame whose frequency differs from the physical fundamental frequency. Reactive-power readouts calculated from such frequency-shifted coordinates may change if their readout operators are not transformed consistently. This paper presents a frequency-frame covariance formulation for finite-spectrum, zero-mean periodic waveforms with complete harmonic information over one physical period. A necessary and sufficient covariance condition is derived, requiring the readout operator to transform consistently with the waveform representation. Consequently, frequency-dependent harmonic weights must be evaluated at physical harmonic orders rather than relative frame labels. In particular, the derivative/Iliovici readout equals a relative-derivative contribution plus an explicit reference contribution. The formulation also separates readout-operator errors from errors caused by changes in the physical components retained by waveform projections. Three analytical cases illustrate conditional carrier recovery for a memoryless resistor, physical-frequency weighting at relative zero in an RLC branch, and the possibility that an exact reactive-power scalar can coexist with a substantial waveform error after projection. The scope is deterministic calculation consistency in frequency-shifted coordinates rather than instrument measurement uncertainty.

</details>


### [196] [Secrecy and Covertness Analysis of SWAN-Enabled Uplink EDMA-NOMA Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05965)
*Sagnik Bhattacharyya,Keshav Singh,Shiv Kumar,Chih-Peng Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文提出EDMA-NOMA-SC框架，将环境分割多址（EDMA）与NOMA、物理层安全结合，用于上行链路的保密与隐蔽通信，并采用分段波导捏合天线系统（SWAN）实现。在半解析框架下推导SOP、ASC、FAP、MDP、DEP与隐蔽速率，并经蒙特卡洛验证；结果表明该框架通常优于传统与EDMA基准方案，但过度分段会因段间干扰而恶化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EDMA可利用无线传播环境实现用户分离，是新兴多址范式；同时物理层安全（保密通信与隐蔽通信）对保护机密信息和用户隐私日益重要。作者希望在统一框架中同时融合EDMA、NOMA与物理层安全，提升上行系统的保密性与隐蔽性。

Method: 构建EDMA-NOMA-SC上行框架：采用分段波导使能捏合天线系统（SWAN），每段内保密用户与间歇激活的隐蔽用户通过NOMA共享传输资源，同时存在窃听保密传输并检测隐蔽通信存在的恶意监听者。建模中考虑距离相关阻塞、段间干扰、波导内衰减、非理想CSI（ipCSI）与非理想SIC（ipSIC），并建立半解析框架推导SOP、ASC、FAP、MDP、DEP与CR，用蒙特卡洛仿真验证精度。

Result: 半解析结果与蒙特卡洛仿真吻合良好；数值结果显示，由于缩短了用户到捏合天线的传播距离并引入波导内衰减，所提框架在保密性能与隐蔽速率上总体优于传统方案及基于EDMA的基准方案；但当段间干扰超过上述传播增益时，过多分段会降低性能。

Conclusion: EDMA与NOMA及物理层安全的融合在上行系统中具有可行性并能带来保密与隐蔽性能增益，分段（波导）设计是关键折中参数：适度分段有利，过度分段因段间干扰而有害。研究为EDMA-NOMA保密/隐蔽通信的系统设计提供了解析工具与设计准则。

Abstract: Environment division multiple access (EDMA) has recently emerged as a promising multiple-access paradigm by exploiting the wireless propagation environment for user separation, while physical-layer security, including secrecy and covert communication, is becoming increasingly important for protecting confidential information and user privacy. Motivated by these considerations, this paper proposes an EDMA-enabled non-orthogonal multiple access for secrecy and covert communications (EDMA-NOMA-SC) framework for uplink wireless systems. In the proposed framework, a segmented-waveguide-enabled pinching antenna system (SWAN) is employed, where a secrecy user and an intermittently active covert user share the same transmission resource through NOMA within each segment, while a malicious warden attempts to eavesdrop on the secrecy transmission and detect the presence of the covert communication. To capture practical operating conditions, distance-dependent blockage, inter-segment interference, in-waveguide attenuation, imperfect channel state information (ipCSI), and imperfect successive interference cancellation (ipSIC) are considered. Semi-analytical frameworks are developed to characterize the secrecy outage probability (SOP), average secrecy capacity (ASC), false alarm probability (FAP), missed detection probability (MDP), detection error probability (DEP), and covert rate (CR), with their accuracy verified through Monte Carlo simulations. Numerical results, including comparisons with conventional and EDMA-based benchmark schemes, show that the proposed framework generally achieves improved secrecy and covert-rate performance owing to reduced user-to-pinching-antenna propagation distances and in-waveguide attenuation. However, excessive segmentation can degrade performance when inter-segment interference outweighs these propagation benefits.

</details>


### [197] [Look Before You Move: Multimodal Sensing-Aided Trajectory and Beamforming Design for 6DMA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05989)
*Zeyu Hao,Wentao Yu,Lutz Lampe,Vincent W. S. Wong*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于多模态感知（RGB、LiDAR、GPS）的学习型6DMA轨迹与波束成形联合设计方法，在移动用户与动态环境下通过多步轨迹规划（滚动时域）提升最小速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有6DMA设计依赖先验信道知识选位姿，但新位姿的信道只能到位后才能估计，且表面移动速度有限导致下一步可达位姿受限，因此需要独立于位姿的感知信息来前瞻性地规划轨迹。

Method: 基站用RGB图像、LiDAR点云与GPS观测用户和周围物体（与表面位姿无关）；采用滚动时域控制在多个未来时步上设计6DMA轨迹且只执行首步；设计神经网络：以用户为中心的跨模态注意力与时序自注意力模块关联用户与场景及感知历史，表面-用户注意力关联各表面与用户；投影层保证位姿满足几何与运动学约束；图注意力模块沿基于导频的波束成形方向分配发射功率。

Result: 在CARLA驾驶仿真器与Sionna射线追踪下的评估显示，所提方案相较固定位置天线取得显著的最小速率增益；消融实验验证多模态感知与各注意力模块的贡献；结果表明提前多个时步设计轨迹的重要性，且在表面速度上限更紧时收益更大。

Conclusion: 多模态感知辅助的多步6DMA轨迹与波束成形联合学习设计可有效应对信道未知与运动受限问题；前瞻轨迹规划与多模态融合是性能增益的关键，速度约束越紧其价值越突出。

Abstract: Six-dimensional movable antenna (6DMA) technology allows a base station (BS) to adjust the three-dimensional (3D) positions and 3D rotations, i.e., the 6D poses, of its surfaces. Many existing 6DMA designs select the poses based on prior channel knowledge. However, the channels at a new pose can be estimated only after the surfaces have moved to this pose, and the limited movement speeds of the surfaces restrict the poses reachable at the next time step. To address these challenges, we propose a learning-based multimodal sensing-aided trajectory and beamforming design for multiuser 6DMA systems with mobile users and surrounding objects. The BS observes the users and surrounding objects with RGB images, LiDAR point clouds, and GPS positions, independently of the poses of the surfaces. Since a surface may need several time steps to reach a favorable pose, the BS designs a 6DMA trajectory over several future time steps and executes only its first step, following receding-horizon control. We propose a neural network, in which user-centric cross-modal attention and temporal self-attention modules relate each user to the scene and its sensing history, and surface-to-user attention relates each surface to the users. A projection layer keeps the poses feasible under the geometric and kinematic constraints, and a graph attention module allocates the transmit power along the pilot-based beamforming directions. Performance evaluations using the CARLA driving simulator and Sionna ray tracing (RT) demonstrate significant minimum-rate gains of the proposed design over fixed-position antennas. Ablation studies validate the contributions of multimodal sensing and the proposed attention modules to these gains. The results further highlight the importance of designing the trajectory several time steps ahead, which is more beneficial under tighter speed limits of the surfaces.

</details>


### [198] [SIM-Enabled Wave-Domain Processing in MIMO-OFDM Receivers: Architecture, Modeling, and Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05999)
*Zheao Li,Jiancheng An,Chau Yuen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于堆叠智能超表面（SIM）的波域线性接收机，将宽带MIMO-OFDM采样后的高维线性处理（信道缩短、CP去除与DFT分析、MIMO检测）物理前移至传播域，仅保留同步、控制、切片与译码为数字处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽带MIMO-OFDM传统接收机在采样后需进行高维线性处理，计算与能耗开销大；希望借助SIM的波域模拟计算能力把这些主导性线性运算从数字域迁移到传播域，以降低数字前端负担。

Method: 设计三级级联SIM功能段：SIM_1做信道记忆处理与能量集中意义下的信道缩短，抑制CP外有效拖尾；SIM_2利用有用窗记忆与分析傅里叶相位编码，实现CP去除与DFT分析（循环加窗OFDM匹配滤波）；SIM_3完成残余虚拟子载波MIMO线性检测。配置上采用分阶段框架：与numerology相关的OFDM分析器离线编译；与信道相关的记忆处理器与检测器在相干时间内通过架构感知的学习辅助控制进行配置。

Result: 数值结果验证了功能替换的有效性与链路性能：在CP充足条件下实现近乎无损替换，并对残余定时偏移与有效信道时延剖面扰动具有鲁棒性；在CP不足信道下，通过在OFDM分析前抑制CP外泄漏获得显著增益。

Conclusion: SIM可在波域物理实现OFDM接收链的主要线性运算，形成"波域线性接收+数字非线性/控制"的混合架构，在CP充足时性能近乎无损、CP不足时具备明显优势。

Abstract: This paper develops a wave-domain linear receiver for wideband MIMO-OFDM, where the main high-dimensional linear processing conventionally performed after sampling is physically shifted to propagation through stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs). The proposed receiver transforms receive-port waveforms into OFDM-domain symbols through three cascaded SIM-enabled functional sections. The first section, SIM_1, performs channel-memory processing and channel shortening in an energy-concentration sense, suppressing the out-of-cyclic-prefix (CP) effective tail before OFDM analysis. SIM_2 realizes CP removal and discrete Fourier transform (DFT) analysis as cyclic-windowed OFDM matched filtering by exploiting useful-window memory and analytical Fourier phase coding. SIM_3 implements residual virtual-subcarrier MIMO linear detection, completing the wave-domain linear receive chain up to symbol slicing. Synchronization, control, slicing, and decoding remain digital, while the dominant linear receive operations are moved to the wave domain. A staged configuration framework is developed: the numerology-dependent OFDM analyzer is compiled offline, whereas the channel-dependent memory processor and detector are configured over the coherence time using architecture-aware learning-assisted control. Numerical results validate both functional replacement and link performance, confirming nearly lossless replacement under CP-sufficient MIMO-OFDM conditions, with robustness to residual timing offsets and effective channel-delay-profile perturbations. Substantial gains under CP-insufficient channels are also demonstrated by suppressing out-of-CP leakage before OFDM analysis.

</details>


### [199] [Vertical Segmented Waveguide-Enabled Pinching Antenna (V-SWAN)-Assisted EDMA-NOMA Integrated Sensing and Communication Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06023)
*Arnav Hari,Sagnik Bhattacharyya,Keshav Singh,Meng-Lin Ku,Brijesh Kumbhani*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出垂直分段波导赋能捏合天线(V-SWAN)辅助的下行NOMA-ISAC EDMA框架，同时支持多用户通信与目标感知，并通过统计分析与仿真验证其优于H-SWAN与V-PASS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面用户、空中用户与感知目标共存且LoS/NLoS混合传播，需在同一框架下同时实现多用户通信与目标感知，并抑制同信道干扰、提升多用户传输效率；传统水平波导(H-SWAN)与单垂直捏合天线(V-PASS)在传播距离与波导内衰减方面存在不足。

Method: 沿分段垂直介质波导部署多个捏合天线(PA)，服务通信用户(CU)、空中用户(AU)与感知目标(ST)；建立通信与感知模型并给出SINR表达式；针对广义多用户、多PA场景推导CU的LoS/NLoS组合及AU、感知信道的LoS传播统计特性；基于统计特性推导分段中断概率与感知中断概率，并进行高发射SNR渐近分析；用蒙特卡洛仿真验证。

Result: 所提框架在分段中断概率、感知中断概率和分段和速率方面均优于传统H-SWAN与单垂直捏合天线系统(V-PASS)；蒙特卡洛仿真结果与解析结果高度吻合，验证了推导表达式的准确性。

Conclusion: V-SWAN通过缩短有效传播距离、降低波导内衰减实现EDMA，有效抑制同信道干扰并支持高效多用户传输，是NOMA-ISAC场景下兼顾通信与感知的可行方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes a vertical segmented waveguide-enabled pinching antenna (V-SWAN)-assisted downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) environmental division multiple access (EDMA) framework for simultaneously supporting multi-user communication and target sensing. In the proposed framework, multiple pinching antennas (PAs) are deployed along a segmented vertical dielectric waveguide to serve communication users (CUs), aerial users (AUs), and sensing target (ST). CUs are distributed on the ground, whereas AUs and ST are above the ground, where line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) propagation conditions coexist. In particular, SWAN provides an effective platform for realizing EDMA by reducing the effective propagation distance and in-waveguide attenuation, thereby suppressing co-channel interference and enabling efficient multi-user transmission. The communication and sensing model are formulated, followed by the corresponding SINR expressions. We formulate the statistical characterizations for the combination of LoS and NLoS propagation for CUs, and LoS propagation for AUs and sensing channels for generalized multi-user, multi-PA scenarios. Based on these statistical characterizations, the segment outage and sensing outage probabilities are derived and evaluated for the generalized framework. The asymptotic evaluation is also done at a high transmit signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to gain further insights. The results show that the proposed framework outperforms the conventional H-SWAN and single vertical pinching antenna system (V-PASS) in terms of segment outage probability, sensing outage probability, and segment sum rate. Monte Carlo simulation results closely match the analytical results, validating the accuracy of the derived expressions.

</details>


### [200] [AFDMA with Heterogeneous Post-Chirp Parameters: Supporting User-Specific Waveform Configurations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06063)
*Hengyou Kong,Xiaoli Xu,Zilong Liu,Yanqun Tang,Yong Zeng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究下行AFDMA框架下支持异构post-chirp参数的灵活波形配置，揭示传统离散chirp子载波分配在异构参数下产生交叉基泄漏，通过二次Gauss和刻画交叉投影，导出成对剩余类正交规则，并将带模约束的子载波分配问题降至剩余类层面，提出两阶段求解框架并证明其可行性/最优满载性质，仿真显示可消除BER地板与SINR上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AFDMA采用不相交的chirp子载波分配，当不同用户采用异构post-chirp参数时会破坏用户间正交性，导致交叉基泄漏落入用户已分配的chirp子载波，造成性能损失。因此需要一个能支持用户特定（异构）波形配置、同时保持用户间正交性的下行AFDMA框架。

Method: 1) 建立支持异构post-chirp参数的下行AFDMA框架；2) 分析用户特定离散仿射傅里叶变换（DAFT）基之间的交叉投影，将交叉投影元素表示为二次Gauss和，其二次系数取决于成对的post-chirp差值；3) 由此得到保证无泄漏的成对剩余类正交充分条件；4) 将带成对模约束的chirp子载波分配问题降维至剩余类层面；5) 设计两阶段框架：递归搜索可行代表分配，并确定性地分配其余剩余类；6) 证明问题要么不可行，要么存在最优满载解。

Result: 仿真表明：所提分配方案避免了传统局部化分配的BER地板与SINR上限，可达到接近单用户的BER性能；与采用共同最大post-chirp参数的常规AFDMA相比，在获得可比BER的同时降低了接收机复杂度。

Conclusion: 通过剩余类层面的正交性规则与两阶段分配设计，AFDMA可在异构post-chirp参数下保持用户间正交、实现灵活波形配置，并在BER、SINR及接收机复杂度方面优于传统方案。

Abstract: This paper investigates a downlink affine frequency division multiple access (AFDMA) framework supporting flexible user-specific waveform configurations with heterogeneous post-chirp parameters. The proposed framework is in sharp contrast to conventional disjoint chirp-subcarrier allocation, which may destroy inter-user orthogonality when users employ heterogeneous post-chirp parameters. Such a loss of orthogonality manifests as cross-basis leakage onto user-allocated chirp subcarriers, which we characterize by analyzing the cross-projection between user-specific discrete affine Fourier transform bases. Specifically, we express the cross-projection entries as quadratic Gauss sums whose quadratic coefficients depend on pairwise post-chirp differences. This yields a sufficient pairwise residue-class orthogonality rule that preserves inter-user orthogonality by satisfying the leakage-free condition. The resulting chirp-subcarrier allocation problem with pairwise modular constraints is reduced to the residue-class level. To solve this problem, we develop a two-stage framework that recursively searches for a feasible representative allocation and deterministically assigns the remaining residue classes. We prove that the problem is either infeasible or admits an optimal full-loading solution. Simulations show that the proposed allocation avoids the bit error rate (BER) floors and signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) ceiling of conventional localized allocation, achieves near-single-user BER, and provides comparable BER while reducing receiver complexity compared with conventional common-maximum-post-chirp AFDMA.

</details>


### [201] [EEG-based listened-language classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06161)
*Isaac Ariza,Lorenzo J. Tardón,Ana M. Barbancho,Isabel Barbancho*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该研究通过采集被试聆听五种语言句子的EEG信号并构建专用数据库，利用通道间能量差表征信号，采用bi-LSTM、LSTM与GRU进行语言区分与理解程度分类。五语言多分类准确率36.37%，理解程度三分类81.36%，母语/外语二分类89.09%，bi-LSTM综合最优。结果表明仅凭EEG即可反映语言理解水平，可用于监测语言学习曲线或评估失语症等患者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体自幼持续接触母语外的其他语言，但大脑对这些听觉刺激的响应机制尚不明确，缺乏可量化的语言理解评估手段。

Method: 设计实验记录被试聆听五种语言句子时的EEG信号，构建专用数据库；以EEG通道间的能量差作为特征表征，分别使用bi-LSTM、LSTM和GRU循环神经网络开展多类与二分类测试，比较不同场景下的识别性能。

Result: 五语言多分类准确率36.37%；理解/部分理解/未理解三分类达81.36%；母语与外语二分类为89.09%；bi-LSTM整体表现最佳。

Conclusion: 仅凭EEG信号分析即可获取个体的语言理解水平信息，可应用于监测新语言学习曲线，或评估失语症等患者的理解能力。

Abstract: From an early age, individuals are continuously exposed to other languages beyond their native tongue; however, the brain s response to these auditory stimuli remains unclear. To investigate this, an experiment was designed to record electroencephalography (EEG) signals from subjects listening to sentences in five different languages, and a specific database was built to enable performing classification tests to distinguish between different languages, and varying levels of language comprehension. By analysing the energy difference between the EEG channels to characterize these signals, different classification tests were conducted using bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (bi-LSTM), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural networks. The main objective is the analysis of the brain s response in two different scenarios: when the subject listens to sentences in different languages, and when the subject understands or misunderstands the meaning of a sentence. In tire multi-class classification involving sentences in five different languages, the accuracy attained is 36.37 %. However, in the multi-class classification between understood/understood part of the meaning/didn t understand, the accuracy attained reaches 81.36%. The results obtained for binary classification tests of understand native language or foreign language is 89.09 %. The bi-LSTM neural network achieved the overall best performance. These results demonstrate that the analysis of the EEG signals alone can give information regarding a person s language comprehension level, and can be used for monitoring the learning curve of a new language or to assess comprehension in patients with conditions such as aphasia.

</details>


### [202] [Sensing the Variation of Wireless Propagation Environment Based on Channel Knowledge Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06164)
*Haohan Li,Wence Zhang,Xiaoyan Shao,Xu Bao,Jing Xia,Yong Zeng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于信道知识地图(CKM)的结构变化感知框架，通过历史CKM与实时用户信道推断变化反射体，实现无线传播环境的结构变化感知与动态反射体定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G中通感一体化(ISAC)对高精度环境感知提出需求，而现有技术在感知环境变化方面能力有限，因此需要新方法来感知传播环境中的结构变化。

Method: 建立基于历史CKM与实时用户信道的数学模型以推断变化反射体；提出信息聚合的鲁棒两阶段反射点细化方案(IA-TS-RPR)，先用块坐标下降(BCD)与黎曼流形优化(RMO)做初估计，再在敏感区(SA)内用虚拟基站(VBS)聚类聚合并细化；并提出基于Hausdorff-最近邻准则与时间窗投票的环境变化感知方案(EVS-HC-TWV)，用Hausdorff距离将用户匹配到最相关CKM网格点(GP)，并用时间窗多用户投票提升对位置偏差的鲁棒性。

Result: 仿真表明IA-TS-RPR在用户定位误差下仍保持亚米级反射点定位精度，显著优于基于ToA、LMMSE和LS的方案；所提方案成功感知并定位动态反射体，具有较强泛化性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 基于CKM的两阶段反射点细化与Hausdorff最近邻加时间窗投票机制可有效实现无线环境结构变化感知，为ISAC高精度环境感知提供可行途径。

Abstract: With the evolution of sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) has raised the demand for high-precision environmental perception. To address the limited capability of existing techniques in sensing environmental variations, this work proposes a novel channel knowledge map (CKM)-based sensing framework that enables structural change sensing in the wireless propagation environment. By leveraging historical CKM data and real?time user channel, a mathematical model is formulated to infer the changing reflectors which represents the environment variations. Specifically, we propose the Information Aggregation Based Robust Two-Stage Reflection Point Refinement (IA-TS-RPR) scheme for reflection point (RP) estimation, which first uses block coordinate descent (BCD) and Riemannian manifold optimization (RMO) for initial estimation, then applies virtual base station (VBS) clustering for information aggregation in the sensitive area (SA) to refine the estimation. Furthermore, we propose an Environment Variation Sensing scheme based on the Hausdorff-Nearest Neighbor Criterion and Time-Window Voting (EVS-HC-TWV). Specifically, the Hausdorff distance is used to match each user to its most relevant CKM grid point (GP), and a time-window-based multi-user voting mechanism is further employed to improve robustness against positional deviations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed IA-TS-RPR scheme maintains sub-meter RP position estimation accuracy under user positioning errors, significantly outperforming the scheme based on time of arrival (ToA), linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) and least squares (LS). The proposed scheme successfully senses and localizes dynamic reflectors, showing strong generalizability and robustness.

</details>


### [203] [Continuous Wideband Multicarrier Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receiver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06181)
*Qihao Peng,Qu Luo,Maged Elkashlan,Cunhua Pan,Pei Xiao,George K. Karagiannidis,Trung Q. Duong,Jiangzhou Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究基于辅助（AUX）驱动的五能级Rydberg原子量子接收机（RAQR）的连续宽带OFDM接收，仅用单一微波本振，无需额外原子跃迁或本振频率梳。借助Floquet理论刻画有限信号-本振失谐下的动态原子响应，推导闭式RF-电转换表达式，建立等效多载波通信模型，揭示原子响应的频率选择性，并提出RAQR感知的ZF均衡。分析表明本振与AUX驱动通过缀饰态劈裂与能级移动影响原子响应，给出本振参考半功率跨度上界，并在无AUX强本振区证明带宽每加倍中心响应功率约下降18 dB。仿真验证模型并显示10 MHz以上显著的子载波相关幅相变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rydberg原子量子接收机作为新型接收前端，其原子响应具有本征频率选择性，传统基于准静态泰勒展开的分析在有限失谐宽带信号下失效，且现有方案依赖多跃迁或频率梳以实现宽带接收，缺乏对连续宽带OFDM接收的统一建模与均衡方法。

Method: 采用Floquet理论刻画有限信号-本振失谐下的动态原子响应，避免准静态泰勒展开；在弱探测、弱信号近似下由Lindblad主方程推导闭式RF-电转换表达式；据此建立等效多载波通信模型，分析子载波相关的幅相失真；设计RAQR感知的零迫（ZF）均衡；并解析分析本振与AUX驱动经由缀饰态劈裂与能级移动对原子响应的影响，推导半功率跨度上界。

Result: 仿真验证了解析响应模型的准确性，显示在超过10 MHz带宽内存在显著的子载波相关幅度与相位变化；解析结果给出本振参考半功率跨度上界，并证明无AUX强本振区带宽每加倍中心响应功率约下降18 dB；RAQR感知ZF均衡可实现可靠OFDM接收。

Conclusion: 基于Floquet的建模框架与AUX辅助五能级RAQR结构，可在单一微波本振下实现连续宽带OFDM接收，RAQR感知ZF均衡有效补偿原子频率选择性，表明RAQR具备作为未来无线通信宽带接收前端的潜力。

Abstract: This paper investigates continuous wideband orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) reception using an auxiliary (AUX)-assisted five-level Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (RAQR) with a single microwave local oscillator (LO), without requiring additional atomic reception transitions or LO frequency combs. By exploiting Floquet theory, the proposed framework characterizes the dynamic atomic response at finite signal-LO detunings without relying on a quasi-static Taylor expansion around the LO operating point. Specifically, closed-form radio-frequency (RF)-to-electrical conversion expressions are derived from the Lindblad master equation under weak-probe and weak-signal approximations. Building on these expressions, an equivalent multicarrier communication model is established, revealing the inherent frequency selectivity of the atomic response and the resulting subcarrier-dependent amplitude and phase distortions. RAQR-aware zero-forcing (ZF) equalization is developed to enable reliable OFDM reception. Furthermore, analytical results reveal how LO and AUX driving influence the atomic response through dressed-state splitting and energy-level shifts. An upper bound on the LO-referenced half-power span is derived, and an approximately $18$-dB reduction in center-response power per bandwidth doubling is established in the AUX-free strong-LO regime. Simulation results validate the analytical response model and reveal pronounced subcarrier-dependent amplitude and phase variations across over $10$~MHz, highlighting the potential of RAQRs as wideband receiving front ends for future wireless communications.

</details>


### [204] [Data-Driven Likelihood-Ratio Construction for Radar Detection via Bernstein Induction Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06192)
*Yuxin Xu,Jun Tang,Ting Bai*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Bernstein多项式模型(BPM)与Bernstein诱导算子(BIO)的数据驱动似然比构造框架，用离线构造的列随机矩阵将杂波密度权重映射为目标存在密度权重，避免在线积分计算，并可跨杂波分布复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 杂波统计未知时难以准确构造似然比：预设杂波模型可能无法描述实测数据，而计算目标存在密度需对物理诱导积分做昂贵的边缘化评估。

Method: 用纯杂波样本估计BPM权重；离线在同一Bernstein基下近似目标诱导响应，构造列随机矩阵，将杂波密度权重映射为特定SCR下的目标存在密度权重；再以矩阵混合刻画目标起伏。该矩阵库与杂波权重无关，可跨杂波分布复用。

Result: 在解析杂波模型仿真中，所得LR与检测概率同参考值吻合，非高斯情形在线计算时间更短；在实测海杂波注入合成目标回波的实验中，弱目标区检测概率优于所比较的基线方法。

Conclusion: BPM+BIO框架实现了无需在线重复评估物理诱导积分的LR构造，兼具离线可复用性与较弱目标检测性能优势。

Abstract: Accurate likelihood-ratio (LR) construction is challenging when clutter statistics are unknown. Prespecified clutter models may not adequately describe the observed data, and evaluating target-present densities may require computationally expensive marginalization. This paper proposes a data-driven LR construction framework based on a Bernstein polynomial model (BPM) and a Bernstein induction operator (BIO). The BPM weights are estimated from clutter-only samples, whereas the target-induced responses of the Bernstein basis densities are approximated offline in the same basis to construct column-stochastic matrices. These matrices map clutter-density weights to target-present density weights at specified signal-to-clutter ratios (SCRs), and mixtures of the matrices account for target fluctuations. For a fixed target model and basis representation, the matrix library is independent of the clutter-density weights and can be reused across clutter distributions. The resulting LR construction avoids repeated online evaluation of the physical-induction integrals. Simulations under analytical clutter models show close agreement with the reference LRs and detection probabilities, with lower online computation times in the non-Gaussian cases considered. Experiments using synthetic target echoes embedded in measured sea clutter further show improved detection probabilities relative to the evaluated baselines in the weak-target regime.

</details>


### [205] [ST-CGMDiff: Sparse-Conditioned Cross-Frequency Spatio-Temporal Latent Diffusion for Dynamic 3D Channel Gain Map Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06220)
*Tianxiang Li,Yilong Chen,Han Hu,Yong Zeng,Jie Xu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出ST-CGMDiff，一个时空隐扩散框架，用稀疏观测在统一模型中重建多频段、多接收高度的动态三维信道增益图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多局限于单频段、静态信道增益图（CGM）重建，而环境感知通信需要多频段、连续时隙下的动态三维CGM，且实测信道样本有限。

Method: 将给定发射机位置下某一接收高度的CGM表示为二维灰度图（像素为对应空间网格的平均信道增益）。框架联合编码当前稀疏观测、观测掩码、Tx/Rx的z坐标与载频作为空间条件；用频率条件化的ConvGRU从历史CGM提取因果信息，并用空间自适应融合机制平衡历史信息与当前观测；引入双向ConvLSTM建模所选Rx z层间的有序依赖；最后执行少步隐扩散并进行高分辨率残差精修。

Result: 摘要未给出量化结果，仅声称可生成空间保真度更高的CGM，并在单一统一模型中覆盖多载频与多接收高度。

Conclusion: 通过扩散生成模型结合时空条件建模与跨频率建模，可在有限测量下统一重建多频段动态三维CGM，为环境感知无线通信提供支撑。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient reconstruction of channel gain maps (CGMs) is essential for environment-aware wireless communications. Unlike prior works that focus on static CGMs at a single frequency band, this paper studies the construction of dynamic three-dimensional (3D) CGMs across multiple frequency bands over consecutive time slots, using limited channel measurements. Specifically, for a given transmitter (Tx) location, we represent the CGM at any given receiver (Rx) height as a two-dimensional (2D) grayscale image, where each pixel indicates the average channel gain over the corresponding Rx spatial grid cell. Accordingly, we propose ST-CGMDiff, a spatio-temporal latent diffusion framework that integrates sparse-observation conditioning and cross-frequency modeling to reconstruct dynamic 3D CGMs across multiple carrier frequencies and varying Rx heights within a unified model. In this framework, we jointly encode the input parameters, including the current sparse observations, observation masks, physical Tx and Rx z-coordinates, and carrier frequencies as spatial conditions. A frequency-conditioned convolutional gated recurrent unit (ConvGRU) then extracts causal information from previously constructed CGMs, while a spatially adaptive fusion mechanism balances historical information and current observations. Furthermore, bidirectional convolutional long short-term memory (BiConvLSTM) modules are introduced to capture the ordered dependencies among the selected Rx z-layers. Finally, we perform few-step latent diffusion followed by high-resolution residual refinement to generate the final CGM with improved spatial fidelity.

</details>


### [206] [Ambiguity Elimination via Successive Estimation in ISAC Systems with Reference Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06227)
*Ali Al Khansa,Sami Mekki,Giyyarpuram Madhusudan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种低复杂度的逐次估计策略，利用历史无模糊估计逐步消除PRS梳状结构导致的幽灵目标，无需额外参考信号即可实现无模糊感知并节省资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC系统复用5G NR的PRS进行被动目标探测时，梳状结构带来周期性模糊产生幽灵目标；现有方法需联合DMRS等额外参考信号消除幽灵，但复杂度高、感知开销大。

Method: 低复杂度逐次估计策略：先允许幽灵目标存在，再用历史无模糊估计逐步剔除。包含(1)匹配过程，将当前检测与历史真实目标关联；(2)模式偏差检测机制，在目标集合变化时触发回退到无模糊估计。推导了保证正确匹配的充分条件（目标速度、PRS梳状尺寸、子载波间隔、感知刷新率的函数），并据此提出联合优化感知与通信性能的参数选择策略。

Result: 数值结果表明，该方法实现无模糊检测的同时显著减少感知资源占用，相较SotA方法释放更多资源用于通信。

Conclusion: 通过重用历史无模糊估计可低成本消除PRS幽灵目标，所导出的充分条件与参数选择策略为ISAC系统资源优化提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems can efficiently reuse 5G New Radio (NR) reference signals to enable joint communication and passive target detection. Among these, the Positioning Reference Signal (PRS) is widely adopted for high-performance sensing activities. However, the PRS configuration, given by the comb structure, introduces periodic ambiguities, resulting in ghost targets. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by combining PRS with additional reference signals, such as the DeModulation Reference Signal (DMRS), effectively removing ghosts but at the cost of higher complexity and sensing overhead. This paper proposes a low-complexity successive estimation strategy that initially allows ghost targets but progressively eliminates them using historical ambiguity-free estimations. The method comprises a matching process to associate current detections with historical real targets, and a pattern deviation detection mechanism to trigger a fallback to ambiguity-free estimation when the target set changes. We derive a sufficient condition that guarantees the correct matching as a function of target velocity, PRS comb size, subcarrier spacing, and sensing refresh rate. Using this condition, a parameter selection strategy is proposed to jointly improve sensing and communication performance. Numerical results demonstrate that our method achieves unambiguous detection while significantly reducing sensing resources, thus releasing more resources for communication compared to State-of-the-Art (SotA) approaches.

</details>


### [207] [One ISAC Array, Two Worst Cases: Hardware Impairments in Beamforming and AoA Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06235)
*Xuan Chen,Luc Le Magoarou*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对波束扫描均匀线阵，将各天线增益、相位与位置误差对波束扫描与AoA估计的影响统一分解为天线相位误差的增益加权最小二乘拟合：倾斜分量使相关峰位移，残差分量则按空间谱从峰值抽取功率并散布到旁瓣。据此刻画了ISAC两功能的近不重叠最坏情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC中同一基站阵列既需对用户波束成形、又需估计其AoA，而阵元级增益、相位、位置误差会同时损害这两个功能；现有分析缺乏对两类功能受损机理的统一刻画，也难以指导双功能阵列的校准评估。

Method: 以波束扫描均匀线阵为对象，把阵列相关峰建模为有限高、有限宽并伴旁瓣的结构；对逐天线相位误差做增益加权最小二乘拟合，将误差分解为倾斜项与残差项，并用残差的空间谱解释功率从峰值向旁瓣的转移。分别推导波束成形与AoA估计的最坏情形，并分析随机误差与噪声的影响。

Result: 误差使相关峰位移、降低并展宽，同时相对抬高旁瓣。指向最强方向的波束仅受峰值降低影响；AoA估计则即使无噪也受峰位移影响，有噪时还受峰值降低与旁瓣影响。（1）波束成形最坏情形下AoA估计无偏；（2）定位最坏情形下波束成形增益损失很小，其最坏情形为两子阵交界处的单一缺陷，且相对主瓣宽度的误差不随天线数增加而下降。

Conclusion: ISAC两功能的最坏情形近乎不相交，因此双功能阵列的校准必须同时针对波束成形与AoA估计两项功能分别评估，而不能仅依据单一指标。

Abstract: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), the same base-station array beamforms toward users and estimates their angle of arrival (AoA). In this paper, we study how element-level gain, phase, and position errors affect both functions of a beam-scanning uniform linear array. Any array produces a correlation peak at the true angle, of finite height and width, surrounded by sidelobes. Impairments shift this peak, make it lower and wider, and raise the sidelobes relative to it. A single decomposition explains these three effects: the gain-weighted least-squares fit of the per-antenna phase errors splits them into a tilt, which shifts the peak, and a residual, whose power is taken from the peak and redistributed over the sidelobes according to its spatial spectrum. A beam steered toward the strongest direction suffers from the lower peak only, whereas the AoA estimate suffers from its shift even without noise, and also from the lowering and sidelobes with noise. The worst cases for the two ISAC functions are thus nearly disjoint, and we characterize both: the worst case for beamforming leaves the AoA estimate unbiased, and the worst case for localization loses little beamforming gain. The worst case for localization is a single defect at the junction between two subarrays, and its error, relative to the main-lobe width, does not decrease with the number of antennas. We also characterize random impairments and the effect of noise. In practical terms, our analysis shows that the calibration of a dual-function array must be assessed with respect to both functions.

</details>


### [208] [Ghost Target Elimination in 5G Reference Signals ISAC via Multi-static Multilateration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06236)
*Ali Al Khansa,Sami Mekki*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出仅使用PRS的多基地感知框架，利用空间分集在融合锚点端联合估计目标位置与模糊索引，无需额外参考信号即可消除梳状结构引起的鬼影目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRS的梳状结构带来周期性距离/多普勒模糊并产生鬼影目标；现有方法需联合DMRS等额外信号解模糊，增加了感知开销。作者希望在保持低接收机复杂度的前提下，仅用PRS完成无模糊感知。

Method: 不在各接收端本地去除鬼影，而是利用多基地观测的空间分集，将模糊解析推迟到融合锚点（fusion anchor）；锚点通过多节点多边定位（multilateration）联合估计目标位置与模糊索引。

Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法能可靠解析鬼影目标，在多种场景下检测性能优于基准方法，并通过仅用PRS传输显著提升资源效率。

Conclusion: 多基地空间分集+融合端联合解模糊是一种无需额外参考信号、低复杂度且高资源效率的ISAC感知方案。

Abstract: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems can reuse 5G New Radio (NR) reference signals to enable joint communication and environmental sensing. Among these signals, the Positioning Reference Signal (PRS) is particularly suitable for range and Doppler estimation. However, its comb structure introduces periodic ambiguities that generate ghost targets. Existing solutions resolve these ambiguities by combining PRS with additional signals such as the DeModulation Reference Signal (DMRS), which increases sensing overhead. This paper proposes a PRS-only sensing framework that resolves ambiguities using multi-static observations. Instead of removing ghosts locally at each receiver, the proposed method exploits spatial diversity and performs ambiguity resolution at a fusion anchor. The anchor jointly estimates target locations and ambiguity indices via multilateration across multiple sensing nodes. This approach eliminates the need for additional reference signals while maintaining low receiver complexity. Simulation results show that the proposed method reliably resolves ghost targets and achieves superior detection performance compared to benchmark methods across various scenarios, while significantly enhancing resource efficiency by enabling sensing using PRS-only transmissions.

</details>


### [209] [Interference-Aware Instantaneous Frequency and Amplitude Estimator for Multicomponent Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06347)
*Sylvain Meignen,Kévin Polisano*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种考虑时频面干扰的多分量信号瞬时频率估计方法：局部优化谱图窗函数、候选IF点生成、新型脊线检测与自适应样条拟合，兼顾交叉模态，并附带瞬时幅度与理想TF签名的估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多分量信号在时频面上常存在模态交叉与相互干扰，传统IF估计（固定窗谱图+脊线提取）在模态调制特性差异大或存在交叉时性能下降，需要一种能自适应孤立/干扰模态的估计框架。

Method: 1) 在TF域局部优化谱图窗以增强表示，分别适应孤立模态与干扰模态；2) 由局部优化产生候选IF点；3) 采用新型脊线检测方法将候选点聚合；4) 通过自适应样条拟合得到IF估计，并对交叉模态作专门处理。

Result: 所提IF估计方法优于现有先进技术，尤其在包含调制方式差异很大的模态的多分量信号上表现突出；额外可获得各模态瞬时幅度及信号理想TF签名的估计。

Conclusion: 局部窗优化+候选点聚合+交叉自适应样条拟合的统一框架，能在存在干扰与交叉时稳健估计IF，并顺带给出幅度与理想TF表示，具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel instantaneous frequency (IF) estimator for multicomponent signals (MCSs), that takes into account the potential presence of interference in the time-frequency (TF) plane. Our approach optimizes the spectrogram window locally in the TF domain to enhance signal representation, adapting to isolated or interfering modes. This optimization leads to the definition of candidate IF points, which are then gathered together using a novel ridge detection approach, and, finally, IF estimates are obtained by adapting a spline fitting procedure to the potential presence of crossing modes. An extra benefit of the proposed technique is that it also gives access to estimates of the instantaneous amplitudes of the modes, and thus to that of the ideal TF signature of the signal. The proposed IF estimation method compares favorably with state-of-the-art techniques especially on MCSs containing modes with very different frequency modulation.

</details>


### [210] [Vision-Aided Near-Field Channel Estimation for XL-MIMO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06375)
*Sachira Karunasena,Angel Lozano,Tom Drummond,Rajitha Senanayake*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出视觉辅助的近场宽带XL-MIMO信道估计框架，利用相机图像将候选位置限制在承载TX的物体上，结合网格内粗定位(V-CL)与离网格Nelder-Mead精化(V-NMR)重构信道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽带XL-MIMO中TX常处于基站阵列近场，球面波前使LOS信道同时依赖角度与距离；现有极域估计器需在整个覆盖区域对两参数采样，导致候选位置与导频数量巨大。

Method: 视觉辅助框架：由相机图像中承载TX的物体确定候选位置的局部小网格；on-grid的V-CL算法从最匹配接收导频的网格点得到粗估计；off-grid的V-NMR算法在连续角度-距离空间上精化并重构信道。

Result: 仿真表明所提算法精度高于宽带与窄带极域估计器，且所需导频数与候选位置数大幅减少。

Conclusion: 将视觉先验引入近场参数搜索空间可显著降低导频与网格开销并提升估计精度，为XL-MIMO近场信道估计提供高效方案。

Abstract: In wideband extremely large-scale MIMO (XLMIMO) systems, the transmitter (TX) is often in the near field of the base station array. The resulting spherical wavefront makes the line-of-sight channel depend on both the TX angle and distance. Existing polar-domain estimators sample both parameters across the entire coverage region, requiring many candidate positions and pilots. This paper proposes a vision aided framework that uses the object carrying the TX, as seen in a camera image, to restrict the candidate positions to a small grid on that object. An on-grid vision-aided coarse localization (V-CL) algorithm obtains a coarse estimate from the grid points that best fit the received pilots, and an off-grid vision-aided Nelder-Mead refinement (V-NMR) algorithm refines it over continuous angle and distance, from which the channel is reconstructed. Simulations show that the proposed algorithms achieve higher accuracy than both wideband and narrowband polar-domain estimators while requiring far fewer pilots and candidate positions.

</details>


### [211] [PARGAR: Pilot-Aware Graph Attention for Sparse-Pilot Neural OFDM Receivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06432)
*Sajedeh Norouzi,Mostafa Rahmani Ghourtani,Eric Samikwa,Torsten Braun*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出PARGAR（导频感知图注意力接收机），将OFDM资源网格建模为图以进行比特检测，图结构结合局部时频边与数据RE到选定导频RE的"导频锚点"连接，并研究基于近似相干时间/带宽的信道缩放锚点规则；在Sionna仿真下与DeepRx对比，稀疏导频场景中BER更低，密集导频下保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G NR与新兴6G系统的信道估计与符号检测依赖DMRS导频，其密度与位置同时影响接收可靠性与频谱效率。稀疏DMRS布局会增大导频观测与数据RE之间的时频距离，使纯局部处理的神经网络接收机难以有效利用导频信息，因此需要引入显式的导频感知归纳偏置。

Method: 将OFDM时频资源网格表示为图，用于端到端比特检测：边由局部时频邻接边与数据RE至选定导频RE的"导频锚点"链接共同构成；图注意力网络在该图上聚合特征。进一步提出按近似相干时间与相干带宽确定的信道缩放导频锚点规则。基于Sionna生成OFDM仿真数据，在SISO未编码设置下，于密集、双符号稀疏、单符号稀疏三种DMRS布局及信道失配场景中与CNN基线的DeepRx对比。

Result: 在部分稀疏导频场景中，信道缩放版PARGAR取得更低的BER；在密集导频配置下性能与DeepRx相当，保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 以图注意力形式显式注入导频感知结构先验，可缓解稀疏DMRS下导频与数据RE时频距离过大带来的信息利用困难，是一种在稀疏导频配置下提升神经接收机可靠性的有效途径；结论限于SISO未编码设置。

Abstract: Reliable channel estimation and symbol detection in 5G New Radio (NR), as well as emerging 6G radio systems, rely on demodulation reference signals (DMRS). The density and placement of these pilots on the orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) time--frequency resource grid affect both receiver reliability and spectral efficiency. Sparse DMRS layouts increase the time--frequency distance between pilot observations and data resource elements (REs), which can make pilot information harder to exploit with purely local processing. This paper proposes \textbf{PARGAR (Pilot-Aware Graph Attention Receiver)}, a graph-attention neural receiver that represents the OFDM resource grid as a graph for bit detection. The graph combines local time--frequency edges with pilot-anchor links from data REs to selected pilot REs, and we further study a channel-scaled pilot-anchor rule based on approximate coherence time and coherence bandwidth. Using Sionna-generated OFDM simulations, we evaluate \textsc{PARGAR} against DeepRx, a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based receiver, across dense, two-symbol sparse, and single-symbol sparse DMRS layouts under channel-mismatch scenarios. Under the considered SISO uncoded setup, channel-scaled \textsc{PARGAR} explicitly injects pilot-aware inductive bias and yields lower BER in selected sparse-pilot scenarios while remaining competitive under dense pilots.

</details>


### [212] [OSD-JSCC: Neural Joint Source-Channel Coding with One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06437)
*Shunpu Tang,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出OSD-JSCC，一个单步扩散、SNR自适应的神经联合信源信道编码框架，通过随机扩散状态接口、SNR条件特征调制与自适应时间步选择，在保证感知质量的同时大幅降低解码延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统JSCC以失真为优化目标导致重建模糊；引入扩散先验虽可提升视觉保真度，但迭代采样带来巨大解码延迟。因此需要一个兼顾感知质量与解码效率的方案。

Method: 1) 传输预训练VAE潜变量，经SNR条件的JSCC编解码器；2) 随机扩散状态接口：解码器预测高斯扩散状态而非干净潜变量，并提取图像特定语义token，采样状态保留空间结构并为单步精化提供初始化，语义token与SNR token共同引导重建；3) SNR条件特征调制与自适应时间步选择，联合适配潜变量传输与扩散精化；4) 三阶段训练策略，使用LoRA高效适配预训练扩散先验。

Result: 在Kodak和CLIC2020上，相较现有基于扩散的JSCC基线，LPIPS在Kodak下降约43%、CLIC2020下降约53%，解码延迟最高降低50.6倍。

Conclusion: OSD-JSCC以单步扩散实现高感知质量与高解码效率的JSCC图像传输，验证了SNR自适应设计与扩散先验轻量化适配的有效性。

Abstract: Neural joint source-channel coding (JSCC) enables efficient image transmission over noisy channels, yet distortion-optimized approaches often produce blurry reconstructions. While diffusion priors can enhance visual fidelity, their iterative sampling incurs substantial decoding latency. To address this limitation, we propose OSD-JSCC, an SNR-adaptive JSCC framework with a single diffusion step. Specifically, OSD-JSCC transmits pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) latents through an SNR-conditioned JSCC codec and incorporates two key designs. First, we introduce a stochastic diffusion-state interface that enables the JSCC decoder to predict a Gaussian diffusion state rather than a clean latent, while extracting image-specific semantic tokens. The sampled diffusion state preserves spatial structure and provides a good initialization for one-step refinement, whereas the semantic tokens, together with an SNR token, guide the reconstruction process. Second, we develop SNR-conditioned feature modulation and adaptive timestep selection to jointly adapt latent transmission and diffusion refinement to varying channel conditions. Furthermore, we adopt a three-stage training strategy with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to efficiently adapt the pretrained diffusion prior to the JSCC task. Extensive experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020 demonstrate that OSD-JSCC achieves superior perceptual quality and decoding efficiency.
