Numerical examples in linear and nonlinear elastodynamics demonstrate accurate full-field predictions without dynamic trajectory supervision. Comparative results show that INOS, evaluated zero-shot, achieves higher predictive accuracy than neural solver baselines trained on dynamic simulations. In addition, INOS delivers over 4,600$\times$ speedup in nonlinear simulations over sequential classical finite-element solvers. INOS natively accommodates changes in dynamic conditions and enables reuse of the pretrained operator across spatial and temporal discretizations. Further evaluation demonstrates a stable million-step rollout. These findings establish INOS as a reusable neural implicit solver for accurate, efficient, and robust dynamic modeling.

</details>


### [316] [Matched but Not Better: An Equivalence-Tested Benchmark of Quantum Machine Learning on Six Clinical Datasets and the QML-Health-READY Reporting Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05442)
*Mohammed Siraj B,Gousia Habib,Ruban S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过配对、等效性检验的比较框架，系统比较量子核SVM、变分量子分类器与五个调优经典模型在六个临床数据集上的表现，发现配置得当的量子分类器接近但未超越经典模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QML被广泛宣传用于临床预测，但与经典模型的比较很少采用配对设计或进行等效性检验，缺乏可信的证据基础。

Method: 比较QSVM（4量子比特、带宽调优）与VQC同五个调优经典模型，覆盖六个公开临床数据集；所有模型使用相同的四组件输入与25次交叉验证划分；采用校正重采样t检验评估配对AUROC差异，配合Holm校正的等效性检验（裕度±0.02与±0.05）及随机效应合并；并开展消融、噪声、有限采样数与实现缺陷分析；提出八领域报告框架QML-Health-READY。

Result: 量子模型均未显著优于任何经典对照。合并后QSVM较核匹配RBF-SVM低0.006 AUROC（95% CI: -0.017~+0.004），在±0.02内等效；VQC较最佳经典模型低0.007（95% CI: -0.019~+0.004）。QSVM在6个数据集中的4个于±0.05内与RBF-SVM等效，但在NHANES 2017-18上显著更差（-0.076）。经典平凡的产品态核与纠缠核表现相当。在退极化噪声p=0.01、每个核条目1024次采样下，QSVM的AUROC下降0.054（95% CI: 0.036~0.071）。未调优带宽导致AUROC接近随机（0.48–0.59）。

Conclusion: 正确配置的量子分类器接近但未超越调优经典模型；主要实际代价来自有限采样估计而非门噪声，而配置错误可能逆转结论；QML-Health-READY为可信主张界定报告要求。

Abstract: Background: Quantum machine learning (QML) is promoted for clinical prediction, but comparisons with classical models are rarely paired or tested for equivalence. Methods: We compared a quantum-kernel support vector machine (QSVM; 4 qubits, tuned bandwidth) and a variational quantum classifier (VQC) with five tuned classical models across six public clinical datasets. All models used identical four-component inputs and 25 cross-validation splits. Paired AUROC differences were assessed using a corrected resampled t-test, Holm-adjusted equivalence tests (margins: +/-0.02 and +/-0.05), and random-effects pooling. Ablation, noise, finite-shot, and implementation-fault analyses were conducted. We propose QML-Health-READY, an eight-domain reporting framework. Results: Neither quantum model significantly outperformed any classical comparator. Pooled across datasets, QSVM differed from the kernel-matched radial basis function (RBF) SVM by -0.006 AUROC (95% CI: -0.017 to +0.004), equivalent to +/-0.02. VQC differed from the best classical model by -0.007 (95% CI: -0.019 to +0.004). QSVM was equivalent to RBF SVM within +/-0.05 in four of six datasets but was significantly worse than the best classical model on NHANES 2017-18 (-0.076). A classically trivial product-state kernel performed as well as the entangling kernel. With depolarizing noise (p = 0.01) and 1,024 shots per kernel entry, QSVM AUROC decreased by 0.054 (95% CI: 0.036 to 0.071). Untuned bandwidth produced near-chance AUROC (0.48-0.59). Conclusions: Correctly configured quantum classifiers approached but did not exceed tuned classical models. Finite-shot estimation, rather than gate noise, was their main practical cost, while configuration errors could reverse conclusions. QML-Health-READY defines reporting requirements for credible claims.

</details>


### [317] [Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05506)
*Duc Anh Vu,Thong Nguyen,Hoang Pham,Ponhvoan Srey,Luu Anh Tuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OGC-DPO将每个(回复对, 目标)组合视为独立查询，用策略自身的隐式梯度度量信息量，并选取最能扩展各目标梯度覆盖的查询进行主动偏好学习，从而在多目标对齐中以相同标注成本取得更优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标对齐（有用性、无害性、诚实性等）通常需对每个目标单独做偏好判断，标注成本随目标数线性增长。现有主动偏好学习方法在多目标场景下缺乏目标感知的查询选择机制，或把冲突偏好视为有害而排除出训练数据，造成信息浪费。

Method: 提出OGC-DPO（Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO）主动学习框架：将每个(回复对, 目标)组合作为单独查询，通过策略模型自身的隐式梯度衡量其信息量，无需依赖外部奖励模型；随后选择能最大程度扩展各目标梯度覆盖的查询。

Result: 在不同目标数量的实验中，OGC-DPO在相同标注成本下优于现有主动偏好学习方法；进一步分析表明，信息量高的冲突偏好并非一律有害，反而能提供有用的策略训练信号。

Conclusion: 目标条件化、基于梯度覆盖的主动查询选择可有效降低多目标对齐的标注成本，并重新认识冲突偏好的价值——有信息量的冲突应被保留利用而非剔除。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverage. Empirical experiments across varying numbers of objectives demonstrate the effectiveness of OGC-DPO over existing active preference learning methods under the same annotation cost. Further analysis demonstrates that informative conflicts, rather than being uniformly harmful, provide a useful policy training signal.

</details>


### [318] [TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05515)
*Hemanth Ram,Sai Shankar Narasimhan,Shubhankar Agarwal,Sandeep Chinchali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CoCo 框架：用 LLM 将文本推理蒸馏为数值化的预测与置信度协变量，引导 TSFM 骨干网络，并用 LLM 自动标注真实时间序列构建可扩展多模态数据集，实现文本与数值预测的融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实时间序列数据中伴随新闻、报告与注释等文本信息，蕴含数值历史无法推断的预测信号。但 LLM 善解文本却缺乏数值精度，TSFM 数值准确却无法推理文本影响；同时缺乏大规模配对多模态数据集制约了相关研究。

Method: (1) 用 LLM 为真实时间序列自动生成文本标注，构建可扩展的合成多模态语料；(2) CoCo 框架中 LLM 输出数值化的预测协变量与置信度协变量来指导 TSFM 骨干；(3) 分阶段对齐：先用与协变量带来的预测性能提升挂钩的奖励，通过 GRPO 微调 LLM，再用对齐后 LLM 生成的协变量微调 TSFM。

Result: 在合成多模态语料上训练的模型可泛化到金融、经济、天气、交通与安全等真实基准；以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 为 LLM、Chronos2 为 TSFM 时，相较 SOTA TSFM 及 GPT-4o 等 LLM 预测器 MAE 最多改善 12%。代码、检查点与评测数据集已公开。

Conclusion: 通过将 LLM 的文本推理蒸馏为协变量并分阶段对齐 LLM 与 TSFM，可在数据受限条件下有效融合文本与数值信息，显著提升多领域时间序列预测性能，且合成数据具备向真实场景迁移的泛化性。

Abstract: Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in stages, first fine-tuning the LLM via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward tied to covariate-induced improvement in forecasting performance, and then fine-tuning the TSFM on covariates generated by the aligned LLM. Our experiments show that models trained on our synthetic multimodal corpus generalize to real benchmarks spanning finance, economics, weather, traffic, and security. Notably, CoCo with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the LLM and Chronos2 as the TSFM achieves up to 12% MAE improvement over state-of-the-art TSFMs and LLM forecasters, such as GPT-4o. Code, checkpoints, and the evaluation datasets are publicly available.

</details>


### [319] [The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05528)
*Elizabeth Hofer,Martin v. Mohrenschildt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出新核度量"Confidence Score"，度量真实标签编码与经核投影后标签之间的对齐度，容忍类内结构，预测分类精度的相关性优于现有核度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有核度量（如对理想核的对齐度）要求同类样本全部相似，这对于类内存在显著内部结构的分类任务过于严格，会误判适用于该类数据的核。

Method: 提出Confidence Score：不再对齐"理想核"，而是度量真实标签的某种编码与经核投影后的真实标签之间的对齐程度，使能保留类内结构的核获得高分。

Result: 在真实与合成数据集、多种核上的实验中，Confidence Score与分类精度的相关性高于若干已有核度量。

Conclusion: Confidence Score是一种更贴合分类任务特性、能预测核分类器精度的核度量，可用于核选择与超参数调优。

Abstract: Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. Through experiments, it is demonstrated that the Confidence Score exhibits a higher correlation with classification accuracy across a variety of kernels on both real-world and synthetic datasets, compared to select other kernel measures.

</details>


### [320] [Recasting Visual Language Models as EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Neurodiagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05538)
*Xin Zhou,Elena Sergeeva,Nan Bi,Wenyu Song,Lijun Yin,Hao Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文论证通用视觉语言模型（VLM）无需大规模EEG预训练，即可在临床神经诊断任务上以少样本方式竞争性地"视觉读取"EEG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG自动分析长期依赖任务专用的有监督模型，需专门标注数据；近来的"基础模型"范式则需依赖大规模无标注的模态专属数据做统一表征预训练，其表征质量受限于该领域数据可得性。作者因此追问：通用VLM能否像临床医生那样"看"EEG并对其进行解读。

Method: 将EEG信号以可视化方式呈现给通用VLM（不做大规模EEG预训练），在一组临床神经诊断任务上评测其零/少样本与微调适应能力，并与任务专用模型及专家基础模型进行跨任务、少样本自适应和模型规模扩展性方面的对比。

Result: 通用VLM在多项临床神经诊断任务上表现与专用模型相当；在少样本设定下跨任务自适应能力优于专家基础模型；并在模型规模扩展时呈现性能提升，而模态专属模型未能表现出这一趋势。

Conclusion: 通用VLM具备基于视觉方式进行EEG解读的潜力，可作为不依赖大规模模态预训练的通用分析范式，在少样本适应性与可扩展性上具有优势。

Abstract: Historically automated electroencephalography (EEG) systems was done using task-specific supervised models trained on purposely annotated data. A more recent modeling paradigm relies on creating a unified representation, or a 'foundation model', for multiple modality-specific tasks through large-scale domain-specific pretraining on the unannotated EEG signal. The quality of this unified representation directly depends on the availability of the modality-specific datasets. At the same time, generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) exhibit broad few-shot learning capacities as well as good fine-tuning adaptability to different visual and language tasks. Can VLMs learn how to read and interpret EEG visually, emulating to a degree the way human clinicians inspect the EEG patterns? In this work we make a case that they can: we show that generalist VLMs without large-scale EEG pretraining perform competitively across a collection of clinical neuro-diagnostic tasks, can adapt to different tasks in a few-shot learning setting better than specialist foundation models, and exhibit better performance with model scaling when modality-specific models fail to exhibit.

</details>


### [321] [FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05546)
*Ojaswi Sinha,Amin Farajzadeh,Animesh Yadav,Melike Erol-Kantarci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedSharp鲁棒去中心化联邦学习框架，节点维护前2b个模型、按坐标中位数偏差筛选可疑模型、对损失最低的b个候选取平均，并结合噪声自适应梯度范数正则与近端训练，解决噪声累积、拜占庭攻击与非IID漂移。100节点环形拓扑含33个拜占庭节点时，MNIST达93.5-94.9%，CIFAR-10达32.8-48.8%，显著超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DFL无中心聚合服务器，但面临数据异质性、拜占庭攻击与信道噪声三重威胁。作者指出：噪声随模型在节点间传播而累积，且在学习率衰减时愈发显著；累积噪声还会让拜占庭攻击者模仿诚实模型均值，从而利用基于损失的模型选择机制。现有单模型选择类方法难以应对。

Method: FedSharp（Screened, Hop-aware, Ranked, Proximal Averaging）：1）每个节点保留其前2b跳（2b个前驱）的模型，保证在至多b个拜占庭节点时至少有b个诚实候选；2）以坐标维度中位数偏差筛选可疑模型；3）对损失最低的b个候选模型取平均，将新鲜信道噪声方差降低为1/b；4）采用噪声自适应的梯度范数正则化与近端训练，抑制累积噪声与非IID漂移。

Result: 100节点环形拓扑、33个拜占庭节点、高斯与隐藏攻击、IID与非IID数据设置下：MNIST上FedSharp取得93.5-94.9%准确率，SOTA单模型选择基准仅29.4-38.1%；CIFAR-10上为32.8-48.8%，基准为10.0-30.5%。在MNIST上，FedSharp与无信道噪声的基准相比准确率差距约在1个百分点以内。

Conclusion: 通过候选窗口冗余、中位数筛选、低损失候选平均与噪声自适应近端正则的协同设计，FedSharp在强拜占庭比例、信道噪声与非IID数据并存条件下实现高鲁棒性与近无损性能，验证了"跳感知多模型选择+噪声感知训练"路线的有效性。

Abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. FedSharp screens suspicious models using coordinate-wise median deviations, averages the b lowest-loss candidates to reduce fresh channel-noise variance by a factor of b, and applies noise-adaptive gradient-norm regularization and proximal training to mitigate accumulated noise and non-IID drift. Experiments on a 100-node ring with 33 Byzantine nodes show that FedSharp achieves 93.5-94.9% accuracy on MNIST, compared with 29.4-38.1% for a state-of-the-art single-model-selection benchmark, and 32.8-48.8% on CIFAR-10, compared with 10.0-30.5%, across Gaussian and hidden attacks under IID and non-IID data. On MNIST, FedSharp also achieves accuracy within approximately one percentage point of the benchmark operating without channel noise.

</details>


### [322] [Support Vector Machines Directly Minimise KL Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05557)
*Ivan Silajev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文证明支持向量分类与回归的对偶目标均等价于两个高斯测度间的精确约束KL散度最小化，从而为SVM建立统一的概率信息论解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SVM基于几何间隔最大化，缺乏主流概率解释，因而与天然可比较、可组合的概率机器学习模型在理论上相互隔离。

Method: 通过数学推导，把支持向量分类与支持向量回归的对偶目标表示为两个高斯测度之间的带约束KL散度最小化；并考察去除域约束、施加L²正则后该散度形式能否还原核岭回归的目标函数。

Result: 证明SVC与SVR对偶均为精确的约束KL散度最小化问题；同一散度表述在去除域约束并施加L²正则后，可精确恢复核岭回归的目标函数。

Conclusion: SVM对偶直接最小化相对熵，为标准核机器提供统一的信息论模型，并为在概率论框架下统一更广泛的核算法奠定基础。

Abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. By demonstrating that SVM duals directly minimise relative entropy, our results provide a unified information-theoretic model for standard kernel machines and lay the foundation for unifying broader kernel-based algorithms under probability theory.

</details>


### [323] [Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05577)
*Manvendra Modgil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过三项预注册研究检验"自监督世界模型潜在空间围绕物理量组织"的说法，发现在2D衰减Navier-Stokes流上该说法基本不成立：预测能力不等于物理组织，且潜变量"包含什么"与"能否通过它控制什么"相互分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域内普遍声称自监督世界模型的潜空间会围绕物理量（如流体量）自发组织。作者希望以严格的预注册、留出数据一次性检验的方式，检验这一主张是否稳健成立。

Method: 在2D衰减Navier-Stokes流上进行三项预注册研究，各仅在密封的留出数据上测试一次。研究1：比较JEPA与同架构未训练网络、非物理线性动力学训练的JEPA、以及无时间的静态不变模型。研究2：比较普通自编码器与加入VICReg的自编码器，用无监督潜方向与enstrophy/vorticity的相关系数及线性可解码性评估。研究3：通过"路由"构造可操控方向（dials）——解码器仅经小型条件码获得整体尺度，另一通路携带退化的谱形状——并用无标签规则寻找响度dial与形状dial，同时设对照组。另做探索性实验比较监督方向的可操控性，并记录构建过程中的规则发现。约70 GPU小时（单张消费级GPU），全部预注册、偏差、代码与输出公开。

Result: 研究1：JEPA未通过预注册标准，未优于未训练网络（不支持）。研究2：普通自编码器最慢的无监督潜方向中enstrophy显著（最佳r 0.80–0.86 vs 未训练0.38；新种子、密封数据）；加入VICReg在每个比较中均降低该显著性（但vorticity未达预注册幅度），同时提升线性可解码性（部分支持）。研究3：8个训练模型中全部找到响度dial，5个新种子中3个找到形状dial（预注册门槛为4），两个对照均未出现形状dial（部分支持）。探索中，几乎完美读取谱形状的监督方向在操控时几乎不产生输出变化。

Conclusion: 潜变量"包含什么"与"能通过它控制什么"是分离的。响应性dial需按其对输出的效应而非数据方差来寻找；自监督世界模型围绕物理量组织的说法在这些严格检验中未获稳健支持。

Abstract: Self-supervised world models are often said to organize their latents around physical quantities. We test this on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow in three pre-registered studies, each tested once on held-out data. In Study 1, a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) trained to predict the flow fails the pre-registered criteria for organizing its latent around fluid quantities better than an untrained network of the same architecture (not supported); a JEPA trained on non-physical linear dynamics and a static invariance model that never sees time do as well or better. In Study 2, plain autoencoders that render the field make enstrophy prominent in their slowest unsupervised latent directions (best r 0.80-0.86 vs 0.38 untrained; fresh seeds, sealed data). Adding VICReg lowers this prominence in every comparison, though not by the pre-registered margin for vorticity, while raising the autoencoders' linear decodability (partially supported). In Study 3, we build steerable directions ("dials") by routing: the decoder gets overall scale only through a small conditioning code, while its other pathway carries a degraded copy of spectral shape. Label-free rules find a loudness dial in all 8 trained models and a shape dial in 3 of 5 fresh seeds on sealed data, against a pre-registered bar of 4; neither control shows a shape dial (partially supported). Across the studies, what a latent contains and what can be controlled through it come apart. In exploration, a supervised direction reading spectral shape almost perfectly moved nothing when steered. During the build, the loudness dial had to be found by its effect on the output (closest to a pure rescaling), not by data variance; for shape, a variance rule and an effect-constrained rule each worked in 3 of 5 seeds. The program used about 70 logged hours on one consumer GPU; all pre-registrations, deviations, code and outputs are public.

</details>


### [324] [Exploring the Privacy--Size Tradeoff for Differentially Private Self-Attentive Variational Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05582)
*Rohit Sadavarte,Dhruvi Kothari,Sparsh Gupta,Eric Van Oeveren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAVANT——首个结合注意力机制、VAE与DP-SGD的表格数据生成模型，并在隐私预算与数据规模的二维空间上与PrivBayes、MST对比，发现同等DP保证下数据越多效用越高，且其隐私-SGD在数据/预算权衡上更具优势，成员推断攻击未检测到泄漏信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据共享价值与隐私约束存在矛盾；DP合成数据是折中方案，但其效用同时取决于隐私预算ε与生成器可见数据量，而现有工作通常只单独考察ε，缺乏对二者联合的评估。

Method: 构建SAVANT：面向表格数据的自注意力变分自编码器，使用DP-SGD训练，首次将注意力、VAE与DP整合于同一表格生成模型；在两个公开数据集上，与两种边缘（marginal）机制PrivBayes、MST在隐私预算与数据集规模的联合网格上对比，以下游分类器在合成数据与真实数据上的效用损失为度量；并开展两项独立成员推断攻击，以实测零假设为基准判定。

Result: 在相同DP保证下，数据量增加总体上带来更高效用；对边缘机制而言，增加数据可吸收严格预算带来的大部分效用损失；噪声缩放论证表明DP-SGD以更差的速率用数据换取预算；两项成员推断攻击相对实测零假设均未发现总体成员信号。

Conclusion: 数据规模是与隐私预算同等重要的合成数据效用决定因素，应在联合维度上评估DP生成模型；SAVANT在效用与实证隐私上表现可行，且边缘机制在数据充足时可有效缓解严格预算的代价。

Abstract: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. We find that, under the same DP guarantee, more data generally means more utility. For the marginal mechanisms it absorbs most of what a strict budget costs, and a noise-scaling argument suggests DP-SGD exchanges data fo budget at a worse rate. Two independent membership-inference attacks, judged against a measured null, found no aggregate membership signal.

</details>


### [325] [C-GRPO: Conformal Group Relative Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05591)
*Arya Fayyazi,Seyedarmin Azizi,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CGRPO 用共形预测校准的自适应 rollout 停止阈值替代 GRPO 的固定 group size，在有限样本覆盖保证下将训练 rollout 减少 49–70%，同时保持甚至提升 pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 GRPO 使用固定 group size，对简单提示浪费算力、对困难提示探索不足；现有自适应预算方法停止规则为启发式，缺乏有限样本校准保证。

Method: 以任务特定的非一致性分数（nonconformity score）为基础，用共形阈值替代固定 rollout 预算：封闭式推理采用 APS 风格校准；执行型代码采用首次成功（first-success）分数；自动选择误覆盖率（miscoverage）；并进行周期性重校准（re-calibration）。理论上证明停止规则的有限样本覆盖性，并证明在策略单调改进下重校准使期望训练预算非增。

Result: 在数学、研究生级科学与代码生成六个基准上，相对固定预算 GRPO 平均减少 49–70% 训练 rollout，同时保持较强固定预算精度；在各数据集上于静态与动态基线中取得最强 pass@1；跨模型族迁移可节省最多 82% rollout。

Conclusion: 将共形校准引入 GRPO 的 rollout 预算分配，可在有统计保证的前提下显著提升训练效率且不损精度，并具备跨模型族可迁移性。

Abstract: Reasoning-oriented language model training increasingly relies on multiple on-policy rollouts, but standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) uses a fixed group size, wasting compute on easy prompts and under-exploring hard ones. Existing adaptive-budget methods alleviate this inefficiency, yet their stopping rules are heuristic and do not provide a finite-sample calibration guarantee. We propose CGRPO, which replaces the fixed rollout budget of standard GPRO with calibrated conformal thresholds over task-specific nonconformity scores, combining Adaptive Prediction Set (APS)-style calibration for closed-form reasoning, a first-success score for execution-based code, automatic miscoverage selection, and periodic re-calibration. We prove finite-sample coverage for the resulting stopping rule and show that, under monotone policy improvement, recalibration induces a non-increasing expected training budget. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, graduate-level science, and code generation, CGRPO reduces mean training rollouts by 49-70% relative to fixed-budget GRPO while retaining strong fixed-budget accuracy, achieves the strongest pass@1 among evaluated static and dynamic baselines on different datasets, and transfers across model families with up to 82% rollout savings.

</details>


### [326] [Relevance Propagation as Entropic Optimal Transport on Filippov Neural Networks: Sinkhorn Propagation and Region Relevance in Image Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05594)
*Olivier Gibaru,Eric Nyiri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将相关性传播（LRP）从启发式提升为单一变分问题的解：LRP是活动计算图上、对前向激活流的后向转移律零相对熵的无散流；LRP₀、LRP_z⁺、LRP_αβ 均由选择不同参考测度导出，并统一为节点权重可变的 LRPN_αβ。基于Filippov算子DAG与Clarke–Filippov广义梯度微积分，框架覆盖分段光滑/不连续架构，并把反向传播刻画为拉格朗日松弛的伴随方程；在ReLU与max-pooling网络上证明LRP₀等于Gradient×Input且折点处有显式跳跃，LRP_z⁺则连续。逐边取熵得到新规则Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation；对输入区域聚合时，非负参考的流给出证据归属的精确核算，条件流为Schrödinger桥。VGG-16上守恒恒等式达舍入精度，各规则在映射符号、偏置占比、忠实性、定位与类依赖性上可区分；ConvNeXt-Tiny上LRPN_αβ守恒输出且其Hebbian权重取得所测规则中最高的ABPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相关性传播（将网络预测逐层向后重分配）长期被视为启发式方法，缺乏统一的理论依据；各条规则（LRP₀、LRP_z⁺、LRP_αβ等）之间的内在联系与区别也未得到原则性解释。作者希望给出一个统一变分原理，使这些规则成为同一问题的不同实例，并推广到分段光滑乃至不连续架构。

Method: 将前馈网络形式化为Filippov算子构成的有向无环图，采用Clarke–Filippov广义梯度微积分；把LRP定义为活动计算图上相对前向激活流后向转移律零相对熵的无散流，对非负参考即为后向路径上Markov测度间的相对熵。通过选择不同参考测度导出LRP₀、LRP_z⁺、LRP_αβ，并统一为节点权重可变的LRPN_αβ；逐边取熵得到Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation；用拉格朗日松弛的伴随方程刻画反向传播；对输入区域聚合时给出精确核算，条件流解释为Schrödinger桥。

Result: 在ReLU与max-pooling网络上，LRP₀等于Gradient×Input并在折点处有显式跳跃，而LRP_z⁺保持连续。VGG-16上守恒恒等式成立至舍入误差，各规则可通过映射符号、输出留给偏置节点的份额、忠实性、定位与类依赖性加以区分；ConvNeXt-Tiny上LRPN_αβ守恒输出，其Hebbian权重在所测规则中取得最高ABPC。

Conclusion: 相关性传播并非启发式，而是相对熵意义下唯一变分原理的解，经典LRP规则均为其参考测度选择的特例，并可自然统一与推广（LRPN_αβ、Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation）。该测度论形式化兼容分段光滑与不连续架构，并将反向传播纳入同一拉格朗日/伴随框架；实验表明守恒性精确成立且规则间存在可度量差异，Hebbian加权的LRPN_αβ在ABPC上表现最佳。

Abstract: Relevance propagation, which redistributes a network's prediction backward through the layers, is usually treated as a heuristic. We show that it is the solution of a single variational problem: Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) is the divergence-free flow on the active computational graph of zero relative entropy to the backward transition law of the forward activation flow; for a non-negative reference, this is a relative entropy between Markov measures on backward paths. The rules LRP$_0$, LRP$_{z^+}$ and LRP$_{α,β}$ follow from this principle by the choice of a reference, and are instances of one rule, LRPN$_{α,β}$, whose weights may vary from node to node, for instance with the node's activity, in the spirit of Hebb's principle. The principle rests on a measure-theoretic formalization of feed-forward networks as directed acyclic graphs of Filippov operators, which covers piecewise-smooth and discontinuous architectures (e.g. hard-routed Mixture-of-Experts) with a Clarke-Filippov generalized-gradient calculus; it also characterizes backpropagation as the adjoint equation of a Lagrangian relaxation. On networks of ReLU and max-pooling nodes, LRP$_0$ is Gradient$\times$Input, with an explicit jump across a kink where LRP$_{z^+}$ stays continuous. Taking the entropy edge by edge yields a new rule, Sinkhorn Relevance Propagation. Aggregated over an input region, the flow of a non-negative reference tells, with exact accounting, which hidden units carry its evidence, the conditioned flow being a Schrödinger bridge. On VGG-16, the conservation identities hold to round-off, and the rules are told apart by the sign of their maps, the share of the output left to the bias nodes, faithfulness, localization and class dependence; on ConvNeXt-Tiny, LRPN$_{α,β}$ conserves the output and its Hebbian weights give the highest ABPC of the rules tested.

</details>


### [327] [RIDGE: State-Conditioned Reward Blending for Behavioral Coverage in Deep RL Game Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05601)
*AL Muqshith Mohammed Shifan,Kevin Christopher Chua,Ali Neshati,Loutfouz Zaman,Cristiano Politowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RIDGE：用状态条件化的奖励混合器+多头评论家实现单智能体多风格游玩，在Crafter上首次联合解决木阶合成/战斗分支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定人格奖励训练出的RL智能体行为单一（探索者饿死、生存者空图囤积），而为N种风格分别训练N个智能体成本高；在回合中途改变奖励组合又会遇到"切换稳定性困境"——PPO在非平稳奖励下性能退化。

Method: 提出RIDGE单一智能体架构，两项设计：(1)状态条件化混合器，由慢变状态变量计算经softmax归一化的sigmoid权重；(2)多头评论家，每个人格一个价值头，各自在其平稳信号上训练。

Result: 在Crafter四人格设定下，单个RIDGE智能体同时掌握木阶合成/战斗分支，任何固定人格基线都无法联合解决；锐度消融实验证实在状态条件化带来增益；结果为n=3种子的机制动态演示。

Conclusion: RIDGE以状态条件化混合绕开奖励非平稳困境，实现单智能体多风格游玩；扩大随机种子扫描留作未来工作。

Abstract: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Since each persona fixes its own reward, automated playtesting trains N agents for N styles. Changing reward composition mid-episode runs into the switching-stability dilemma: PPO degrades under non-stationary rewards. We present RIDGE, a single-agent architecture that sidesteps the dilemma with two design choices: a state-conditioned blender that computes softmax-normalized sigmoid weights from slow-moving state variables, and a multi-head critic that trains one value head per persona on its own stationary signal. On Crafter with four personas, one \ridge agent acquires both branches of the wood-tier crafting/combat split that no fixed-persona baseline solves jointly, and a sharpness ablation confirms state-conditioning drives the gain. We position these results as demonstrations of the blending mechanism's dynamics across n=3 seeds per condition; larger multi-seed sweeps remain future work.

</details>


### [328] [Transport along Local Annealing Paths: Wasserstein Geometry and Multimodal Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05605)
*Han Chen,Sifan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出分量式退火输运（CAT）方法：从模态信息混合参考出发对目标做精确混合分解，沿分量退火路径分别学习输运映射，以减少模态间质量转移、避免模式坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变分方法学习多峰采样的输运映射时易发生模式坍缩；常用的几何退火路径在Wasserstein空间中可能绕行很远——质量在模态间移动时路径长度远大于端点距离，从而拖慢种群优化。

Method: 分析退火路径几何与输运学习的联系（长路径减慢优化，足够规则的路径可实现快速收敛）；据此构造CAT：以模态信息驱动的混合参考分布出发，对目标做精确混合分解，沿分量式退火路径学习各自的输运映射，并单独估计分量权重；同时设计由"输运代价"引导的自适应退火调度。

Result: 理论上，即使所学流不精确，分量权重估计仍保持一致；实验上，在多峰合成分布与贝叶斯推断问题上，输运学习与采样效率均有提升。

Conclusion: 退火路径的几何性质是影响输运学习与采样效率的关键因素；通过分量分解和分量式退火来规避跨模态质量转移，可有效缓解模式坍缩并提速收敛。

Abstract: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. One way to mitigate this problem is to learn transport along a prescribed path of intermediate distributions defined by geometric annealing. We show that annealing can take a substantial detour in Wasserstein space: when mass moves between modes, the path can be much longer than the distance between its endpoints. We further link path geometry to transport learning, showing that long annealing paths can slow population optimization, while sufficiently regular paths permit rapid convergence. Motivated by these findings, we propose componentwise annealed transport (CAT) to reduce the need for mass transfer between modes. Starting from a mode-informed mixture reference, CAT constructs an exact mixture decomposition of the target and learns separate transport maps along componentwise annealing paths. We estimate the component weights separately and show that these estimates remain consistent even when the learned flows are inexact. We also develop adaptive annealing schedules guided by transport effort. Experiments on multimodal synthetic distributions and Bayesian inference problems demonstrate improvements in transport learning and sampling efficiency.

</details>


### [329] [On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05609)
*Yichen Wang,Yufa Zhou,Siqi Zhu,Haozheng Luo,Jingzhi Bao,Zhichao Liu,Zijun Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出多教师on-policy蒸馏(MOPD)虽在分布内(IND)近乎完美，但会掩盖分布外(OOD)能力整合的不完整，并提出几何修正与replay缓解OOD遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作以IND指标衡量(M)OPD效果，报告近完美蒸馏，作者怀疑这掩盖了监督分布之外的能力整合缺失，需系统性检验外推与组合泛化。

Method: 先在合成推理任务上做初步研究，再基于Qwen3在数学推理、代码、Agent、长上下文上评测外推与组合泛化；从教师能力与数据覆盖两个瓶颈入手联合缓解；以RL为基线分析更新几何（幅度、谱集中度、共享结构）；提出geometry-based patching与base-preserving replay。

Result: 外推设置下(M)OPD达教师IND的96.04–102.73%，但OOD比基座模型低2.45–16.25%；三种组合设置下MOPD提升IND，但组合任务OOD比最佳教师低18.19–24.34%；联合缓解两瓶颈可消除OOD遗忘并显示超越教师的潜力；(M)OPD平均OOD遗忘低于RL基线，更新更小、谱更集中、多教师共享结构更强。

Conclusion: (M)OPD存在能力整合盲点，IND高分不代表泛化能力继承，需显式支持OOD保持与泛化的蒸馏算法；提出的几何修正与replay可在基本保持IND的同时改善OOD。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. Although prior work reports near-perfect in-distribution (IND) distillation performance, we find that this can mask incomplete capability consolidation beyond the supervised distribution. A preliminary study on synthetic reasoning shows that OPD does not fully transfer teachers' generalization capabilities. We then extend this investigation to real-world tasks, evaluating extrapolative and compositional generalization across mathematical reasoning, coding, agent, and long-context capabilities using Qwen3 models. Across extrapolative settings, OPD and MOPD reach 96.04-102.73% of their teachers' IND scores. Yet their out-of-distribution (OOD) scores remain 2.45-16.25% below the base model's. Across three compositional settings, MOPD improves IND performance over the base model, but its performance on composed tasks as OOD remains 18.19-24.34% below that of the best teachers. To understand these gaps, we examine teacher capability and data coverage as two potential bottlenecks. Jointly alleviating these bottlenecks eliminates OOD forgetting in our experiments and suggests the potential for generalization beyond the teacher. (M)OPD also reduces OOD forgetting on average relative to its reinforcement learning (RL) baselines. Analysis of the associated update geometry reveals smaller and more spectrally concentrated updates on average than those of the RL baselines, along with greater shared update structure under MOPD. Motivated by these findings, we propose geometry-based patching and base-preserving replay to improve OOD performance while largely preserving IND performance. Our findings identify a blind spot in capability consolidation via (M)OPD, highlighting the need for algorithms that explicitly support OOD retention and generalization.

</details>


### [330] [LACS: Distribution-Sensitive Label-Agnostic Confidence Selection for Dynamic Data Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05616)
*Heejin Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出LACS（标签无关置信度选择器），一种基于最大预测置信度的训练期样本选择规则，用总体相对阈值（对数均值指数参考+边际）自适应地同时调整阈值与保留数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数​​据集训练下需决定哪些样本值得花费昂贵计算。固定配额需预先确定剪枝量，绝对置信度阈值依赖分数尺度，二者均不灵活，因此研究一种能自适应调整阈值与保留比例的总体相对替代方案。

Method: LACS以最大预测置信度为准则，选择时无需标签、无需逐样本梯度，移除分数处于对数均值指数（log-mean-exp）参考值加边际以上的样本。理论上刻画其对分数差与质量的敏感性，并推导精确的无剪枝条件；证明当0<ρ<1时移除比例不超过ρ且至少保留一个样本。由于分数无符号，可同时移除高置信正确与高置信错误的样本。评估涵盖神经训练、语言建模与提升方法共七种设置。

Result: 神经实验将反向传播激活行减少10–35%；CIFAR-10上反向行减少29%，准确率均值89.77%对全CE的89.82%。在匹配反向预算与优化器更新次数下，五种子平均比小批量训练高1.0个百分点、比随机选择高1.2个百分点。14个表格数据集上二次提升将平均测试误差从23.36%降至22.96%，完整训练重放约少用30%拟合行。RBF-SVM案例中耗时降低37%且误差略低。

Conclusion: 研究区分了“选择性计算削减”与“实际加速”：当前基于当前分数精确计算的神经实现需额外一次评分前向，故反向稀疏尚未转化为墙钟加速，但该开销属于执行方式选择而非选择规则本身的要求。

Abstract: Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. LACS removes examples at or above a log-mean-exp reference plus a margin. We characterize its sensitivity to score gaps and mass, and derive an exact no-pruning condition. For $0<ρ<1$, the removed fraction is at most $ρ$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Seven evaluation settings include neural training, language modeling, and boosting. Neural execution studies reduce backward-active rows by 10-35%; on CIFAR-10, 29% fewer backward rows accompany accuracy means of 89.77% versus 89.82% for full CE. At a matched backward budget and number of optimizer updates, LACS is 1.0 pp above small-batch training and 1.2 pp above random selection over five seeds. Across 14 tabular datasets, quadratic boosting reduces mean test error from 23.36% to 22.96%. Its full training replays use about 30% fewer fitting rows; these counters span a different horizon from validation-selected accuracy. In one RBF-SVM case study, elapsed time falls by 37% with slightly lower error. These findings separate selective-work reduction from realized acceleration: the current exact-current-score neural implementation uses an additional scoring forward, so its backward sparsity does not yet translate into wall-clock acceleration. This overhead is an execution choice rather than a requirement of the selection rule.

</details>


### [331] [Data-Efficient Scaling-Law Discovery for Recommendation Systems via Coupled Hyperparameter Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05643)
*John Martabano Landy,Louis C. Tiao,Yao Xuan,Luc Kien Hang,Rupinder P. Khandpur,Arvind M. Vepa,Srinidhi Raghavendran,Anirudh Agrawal,Xiaoyi Leo Liu,Jiang Liu,Peggy Yao,Alireza Vahdatpour,Djordje Gligorijevic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自动化系统 Axia，用"scaling layer"将排序模型架构参数分组映射到低维超-超参数空间，结合代理模型与后验采集准则替代穷举扫描，学习模型特定的复杂度-质量关系并给出不确定性感知的算力分配指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web 平台的大规模排序/推荐模型同样呈现幂律式 scaling 收益，但其架构异构，不像 LLM 那样有统一 scaling law；且传统穷举扫描成本过高，难以高效刻画任意排序模型的 scaling law。

Method: 1）scaling layer：将原始架构参数按语义分组，定义其协同变化方式，诱导从低维超-超参数空间到完整架构空间的映射；2）Axia 在其上拟合 scaling-informed 代理模型，用基于后验的采集准则选择配置，输出 Pareto 前沿并逐模型验证工作点；3）fleef-level 评估协议：固定代表性模型集、匹配试验预算，使各组件的改进可度量。

Result: 在 Meta 广告排序与检索系统的两个开发周期、共 34 次模型迭代中，平均获得 0.66% 的离线归一化熵改进与 0.36% 的累计在线提升。

Conclusion: Axia 以少量高信息量试验替代穷举扫描，可自动学习模型特定的复杂度-质量关系，并为异构模型生态中的算力分配提供不确定性感知的指导。

Abstract: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of LLMs. We address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. We introduce a scaling layer, which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary, inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. On top of it, Axia fits scaling-informed surrogates, selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion, and returns a Pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. A fleet-level evaluation protocol, computed on a fixed representative model set under matched trial budgets, makes refinements to either component measurable. Our contribution is an automated system that learns model-specific complexity-quality relationships and gives uncertainty-aware guidance for allocating compute across a heterogeneous model ecosystem. Across 34 model iterations in two development cycles on Meta's ads ranking and retrieval system, the workflow yielded a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.

</details>


### [332] [When Are Two SAE Latents the Same Feature?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05655)
*Alexandra Suvorikova,Ilgam Latypov,Anton Trukhan,Yuriy Dorn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于能量加权最优传输的稀疏自编码器(SAE)比较框架，统一刻画特征对应、字典整体差异与有限数据不确定性，并给出联合渐近推断与bootstrap置信带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较稀疏自编码器需要同时解决三个问题：特征之间的对应关系、整个字典层面的差异、以及有限评估数据带来的不确定性；现有方法缺乏将三者统一起来的框架。

Method: 在指定相似度几何下构建能量加权最优传输计划：同一计划同时定义字典级差异度量、将其分解为各隐单元贡献、并量化每个隐单元质量在对偶单元间的分布。刻画解码器相似度、激活相似度与一阶因果相似度之间的关系，并用理想化模型阐明"分裂"与"吸收"现象的解释。对固定训练好的SAE，在考虑激活相似度及同一批文档估计的两个能量边缘分布的情况下，推导传输代价与比例的联合渐近推断；采用联合文档bootstrap获得渐近有效的同时置信带。

Result: 在四个语言模型上的实验定位了跨随机种子的差异，并区分出依赖上下文的变化。

Conclusion: 该框架将特征对应、字典级差异与统计不确定性纳入统一的最优传输表述，并提供可验证的联合渐近推断工具，为SAE的可比性分析提供系统化方法。

Abstract: Comparing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) requires connecting feature correspondence, differences between whole dictionaries, and uncertainty from finite evaluation data. We develop a framework that connects these tasks through an energy-weighted optimal-transport plan under a specified similarity geometry. The same plan defines a dictionary-level discrepancy, decomposes it into latent contributions, and quantifies how each latent's mass is distributed across counterparts. We characterize relationships between decoder, activation, and first-order causal similarities; idealized models clarify the interpretation of splitting and absorption. For fixed trained SAEs, we derive joint asymptotic inference for transport costs and fractions, accounting for activation similarities and both energy marginals estimated from the same documents. A joint document bootstrap gives asymptotically valid simultaneous confidence bands. Experiments across four language models locate cross-seed discrepancy and separate context-dependent changes.

</details>


### [333] [Beyond Accuracy: Information-Theoretic Decoder Evaluation Under Latent Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05658)
*Tasha Kim,Benjamin Ballyk,Anson Lei,Ingmar Posner,Oiwi Parker Jones*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将脑-机器人辅助控制建模为POMDP，证明解码器可区分性是后悔界相变的边界，提出由混淆矩阵计算的最差配对Chernoff信息Γ_min与闭式后悔预测器U_id，揭示了相同准确率下9.6倍后悔差异的"准确率陷阱"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解码器评估沿用单试次分类准确率，忽视了辅助控制本质上是序贯过程：规划器需随时间整合间歇、含噪的解码输出。单步准确率仅是下游任务表现的代理指标，可能掩盖实际控制性能的巨大差异。

Method: 将脑-机器人控制形式化为POMDP；理论证明后悔随horizon的相变（目标对均可区分则有界，否则线性增长），证明最差配对Chernoff信息Γ_min设定该边界；推导可由任意混淆矩阵在O(K²)时间内计算的闭式后悔预测器U_id(C)；并在两个正交信息通道域及真实EEG数据（BNCI2014001被试5）上，用同信号控制实验加以验证。

Result: U_id能预测准确率无法解释的累积规划后悔；发现两个解码器在真实EEG上验证准确率同为35.1%，但留出集后悔相差9.6倍，而U_id可预测此差异；跨独立特征通道的解码器在同信号控制中证实U_id的优势。

Conclusion: 准确率不足以评估序贯辅助控制中的解码器；基于Γ_min与U_id的诊断工具可作为即插即用指标，用于传感器与解码器的评估和选择。

Abstract: A central challenge in assistive brain-to-robot control is decoding a user's latent intent from complex and noisy brain signals. Prior approaches evaluate decoders as single-trial classifiers with accuracy-based metrics, but this neglects the inherently sequential nature of assistive control. Since a planner must integrate intermittent, noisy decoder outputs over time, single-step accuracy can only be a proxy when predicting downstream task performance. We formalize brain-to-robot control as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), and prove that there is a sharp phase transition: regret is uniformly bounded across the horizon as long as pairs of goals are all decoder-distinguishable, but grows linearly otherwise. We show that a single channel statistic, the worst-pair Chernoff information $Γ_{\min}$ sets this boundary. Then, we derive a closed-form regret predictor $U_{\mathrm{id}}(C)$, that can be computed from any confusion matrix in $O(K^2)$ time. Across two domains spanning orthogonal information channels, we show that $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts cumulative planning regret beyond what accuracy can explain. We then highlight a pathological accuracy trap, in which two decoders have identical validation accuracy 35.1% on real EEG data (BNCI2014001 subject 5) but result in a difference of $9.6\times$ in held-out regret, which $U_{\mathrm{id}}$ predicts. Same-signal control confirms $U_{\mathrm{id}}$'s advantage with decoders that span independent feature channels. Ultimately, our work provides a drop-in diagnostic to evaluate and select sensors and decoders in sequential assistive control.

</details>


### [334] [Adaptive Domain Decomposition for Finite Basis Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05659)
*Sarah Helfert,Wanxin Chen,Amanda A. Howard,Panos Stinis,Alexander Heinlein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ADD-FBPINNs，将可分离POUNet与FBPINNs结合，实现数据驱动的自适应区域分解，提升PDE求解精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FBPINNs通过人工划分子域提升精度，但子域划分依赖用户先验、固定不变，难以匹配解的特征结构，导致精度受限。

Method: 用可分离Partition of Unity Network学习域划分，并与FBPINNs的有限基函数子域近似框架耦合，使子域划分随解的特征自动学习，获得稳定且具几何可解释性的分区。

Result: 在二维Helmholtz方程、含多尺度特征的二维Poisson方程及粘性Burgers方程上验证，精度优于固定域分解的FBPINNs。

Conclusion: 自适应、可学习且可解释的域分解能有效提升FBPINNs的求解精度，为PDE数值求解中的分区设计提供数据驱动方案。

Abstract: In this work, we present adaptive domain decomposition finite basis physics-informed neural networks (ADD-FBPINNs). The proposed method integrates Partition of Unity Networks (POUNets), a data-driven approach for learning domain partitions, with finite Basis physics-informed neural networks (FBPINNs) to perform more efficient domain decomposition and achieve more accurate approximations. FBPINNs improve upon the accuracy of standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) through user-defined subdivisions of the computational domain. By adapting the domain decomposition based on the solution's features using a separable POUNet, the framework can automatically learn partitions that are stable and can be geometrically interpretable. We test this approach on the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation, two-dimensional Poisson equation with multiscale features, and viscous Burgers equation and observe improved accuracy compared with FBPINNs with fixed domain decomposition.

</details>


### [335] [Revisiting Critic Estimation in Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05666)
*Jan Felix Kleuker,Koen Ponse,Aske Plaat,Thomas M. Moerland*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文系统对比SAC中六种critic变体，发现用回放轨迹片段训练λ-return critic可显著提升性能，而soft advantage与soft GAE并无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAC标准实现依赖Q函数的一步时序差分学习，其他critic设计选择（软优势、多步回报、回放数据训练多步critic）研究不足，作者希望系统厘清这些选择的影响。

Method: 固定策略目标，考察三种critic设计选择生成六种变体：(i)一步转移学习的优势critic、(ii)dueling-advantage critic、(iii/iv)on-policy学习的λ-return与soft GAE critic、(v/vi)基于回放轨迹片段学习的λ-return与soft GAE critic；在14个任务上做完整随机超参数搜索，将超参数视为算法一部分进行评测。

Result: 学习soft advantage替代soft Q-value未提升性能；soft GAE critic相对更简单的λ-return critic无额外收益；在回放轨迹片段上训练λ-return critic能提升性能，在连续控制任务上尤为明显，且无需重要性加权或trace cutting。

Conclusion: 将未经修正的多步目标在回放下有效的证据扩展到含熵项的完整soft λ-return；相关思想可推广至SAC之外的更广泛强化学习算法。

Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is a widely used deep reinforcement learning algorithm that combines entropy regularization with an actor-critic architecture. Standard implementations rely on one-step temporal-difference learning of Q-functions, yet alternative critic design choices remain underexplored. In this work, we revisit three such choices: learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values, the use of multi-step return targets, and the training of multi-step critics from replay buffer data. Keeping the policy objective fixed, we compare the six critic variants these choices generate: (i) advantage and (ii) dueling-advantage critics learned from one-step transitions, and $λ$-return and soft Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) critics learned either (iii, iv) on-policy or (v, vi) from replayed trajectory segments. Each variant is evaluated across an entire random hyperparameter search on fourteen tasks, treating the hyperparameters as part of the algorithm. Learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values does not improve performance, and the soft GAE critic adds nothing over the simpler $λ$-return critic. What does improve performance, most clearly on continuous control, is training a $λ$-return critic on replayed trajectory segments, even without importance weighting or trace cutting. This extends earlier evidence that uncorrected multi-step targets work well under replay to the full soft $λ$-return, entropy terms included. By design, the underlying ideas studied here extend beyond SAC, and our empirical findings aim to encourage their application to a broader class of reinforcement learning algorithms.

</details>


### [336] [CoReFlow: Consistency-Relaxed Flow Maps for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05715)
*Pengnan Chi,Zhiguo Zhang,Xiaoliang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CoReFlow（一致性松弛流映射）模型，利用流映射的一步生成能力实现高精度、低推理开销的概率交通预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率交通预测对智能交通系统（ITS）至关重要，但现有扩散/流类生成模型需多步采样、推理慢；且其设计面向复杂多峰分布，与条件交通数据分布的有限复杂度不匹配，导致性能不及确定性基线。

Method: 首次将流映射（概率流常微分方程的解算子）的一步生成能力引入交通预测；采用简洁训练目标，通过有限时间区间内的插值端点监督模型；不同于自蒸馏与 MeanFlow Identity 等保持轨迹一致性以建模多峰分布的方法，该目标以条件均值约束一致性。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上取得 SOTA 预测精度，优于近期基线；提供有竞争力的不确定性建模，并相较现有生成式基线降低推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过“松弛一致性 + 一步生成”的流映射范式，CoReFlow 在概率交通预测中兼顾精度、不确定性与推理效率。

Abstract: Probabilistic traffic forecasting is essential for reliable Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), as it captures uncertainties in complex road networks. Recent diffusion- and flow-based generative models have facilitated uncertainty modeling through a multi-step sampling process. However, beyond slow inference, this process is designed to capture complex multimodal distributions, which misaligns with the limited complexity of the conditional traffic data distribution, causing models to underperform deterministic baselines. To address this, we introduce the \underline{Co}nsistency-\underline{Re}laxed \underline{Flow} Map (CoReFlow) model, presenting the first effort to leverage the one-step generation capability of flow maps, known as solution operators of probability-flow ordinary differential equations. Besides, we improve accuracy using a concise training objective that supervises the model via interpolation endpoints over finite time intervals. Unlike existing methods (e.g., self-distillation and MeanFlow Identity) that maintain trajectory consistency to model multimodal distributions, our objective leverages conditional mean to restrict the consistency, thereby achieving higher accuracy in the probabilistic traffic forecasting task. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show CoReFlow achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy. It surpasses recent baselines, provides competitive uncertainty modeling, and reduces inference costs compared to existing generative baselines.

</details>


### [337] [Give the Drafter a Second Chance to Guess: Parallel Reconsideration for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05724)
*Hoang Anh Duy Le,Huibing Dong,Alireza Khadem,Ziteng Sun,Xiang Song,Yizheng Huang,Soroush Radpour,Anshumali Shrivastava,Ye He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Parallel Reconsideration：让草稿模型依据自身不确定性，对“犹豫”的猜测额外进行并行重审，将精炼候选加入原始草稿树，从而在几乎不增加延迟的情况下提升投机解码的接受率与加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的加速幅度取决于每个猜测的接受率。现有特征级草稿模型的共同设计缺陷是：无论 token 难易，都在单次前向中生成。目标模型拒绝的许多 token，恰是草稿模型自身不确定、而目标模型却能确定回答的部分，因此存在可挖掘的提升空间。

Method: 1) 以草稿模型自身的置信度/不确定性作为信号，识别“hesitant guesses”；2) 对这些不确定猜测追加额外前向 pass 进行重审，且该 pass 与单次草稿前向并行执行，延迟开销可忽略；3) 与训练配方协同设计（co-designed training recipe）；4) 服务端草稿算法将重审得到的猜测作为 refined candidates 追加到原始草稿树中，扩展候选覆盖。

Result: 在多种模型与基准上，相比基线平均提升接受长度 5.3%–10.2%，加速比提升 3.5%–9.2%。

Conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的并行重审机制，可在近零延迟代价下有效改善特征级草稿的质量与接受率，是一种与现有投机解码框架兼容的实用性优化。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference with a small drafter, whose per-guess acceptance rate determines the achievable speedup. Feature-level drafters share a design choice: every token, easy or hard, is drafted under a single forward pass. Many of the tokens the target rejects are ones the drafter is itself unsure about yet the target answers decisively. To address this, we introduce Parallel Reconsideration: guided by its own uncertainty, the drafter reconsiders its hesitant guesses with extra passes that run in parallel with the one-pass draft, adding negligible latency. A co-designed training recipe and serving-time drafting algorithm append these reconsidered guesses to the original draft tree as refined candidates. Across models and benchmarks, on average, Parallel Reconsideration improves over the baselines by 5.3% to 10.2% on acceptance length and by 3.5% to 9.2% on speedup.

</details>


### [338] [Do Language Models Know Which Constraints Belong Together?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05726)
*Junbo Jacob Lian,Kaixuan Chen,Hanzhang Qin,Huiling Chen,Chaoyu Zhang,Chung-Piaw Teo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究Dantzig-Wolfe重构中约束族的选择问题：当若干约束族只有联合施加才强化下界时，贪心式搜索会停在LP松弛。作者证明此情形需要覆盖数个（约k^w量级）的评估，并提出用预测（LP对偶前瞻与语言模型）配合分阶段搜索来大幅减少评估次数，构建了JointDW框架并在MIPLIB-NL上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dantzig-Wolfe重构的每个候选约束族都需一次列生成运行，成本高昂；而lot sizing、网络设计、设施选址中的经典不等式常表现为"零边际"群体——单个族不强化界，只有联合才强化。逐族添加的搜索会止步于线性松弛，因此需要理解这一选择问题的内在难度，并寻找能降低评估成本的信息来源。

Method: 1) 理论：证明当每次评估最多凸化k个族中的s个时，任何仅观测界的算法要找到隐藏的w族群体需约k^w量级的覆盖评估；预测若漏掉e个成员，成本降至Θ(k^e)，并用一种无需预知e的分阶段搜索实现，从而以"节省的评估数"度量预测者所知信息。2) 预测来源：一是基于最优LP对偶的单遍前瞻（可证对无共享变量的族群体是盲的）；二是用语言模型读取模型名称与文本。3) 系统JointDW：以分阶段搜索验证语言模型预测，并与对偶前瞻以有界损失交错结合。

Result: 在MIPLIB-NL中下界可改进的模型里，约四分之一存在仅联合强化界的族群体。在此类模型上，最强语言模型识别率与对偶前瞻相当；其预测依赖教科书模型的名称，且加入推理使同一模型准确率翻倍。在含干扰族的大型模型上，前瞻仅用三族的一次评估即可找到群体；仅给文本的语言模型很少能命名该群体，而给出全部系数的某一推理模型在几乎全部回答中都能指出它，并在族对情形下所需评估次数少于前瞻。

Conclusion: 约束族选择的"零边际群体"具有可证明的搜索下界，而预测可将其指数级降低，节省的评估量可衡量预测信息的价值。对偶前瞻受结构盲区限制，语言模型在文本与系数信息充分时表现强且可通过推理提升；JointDW以有界损失融合两类预测，为Dantzig-Wolfe重构中的族选择提供了理论刻画与实用方法。

Abstract: Dantzig-Wolfe reformulation strengthens the linear relaxation of a mixed-integer program by convexifying a chosen set of constraint families, and every candidate costs a column generation run. The choice is hard when families strengthen the bound only together, because a search that adds one family at a time then stops at the linear relaxation. The classical inequalities of lot sizing, network design and facility location rest on such zero-marginal groups. We prove that when each evaluation convexifies at most $s$ of $k$ families, any method that observes only bounds needs a covering number of evaluations, of order $k^w$, to find a hidden group of $w$ families, also on actual Dantzig-Wolfe relaxations. A prediction that misses $e$ members reduces the cost to $Θ(k^e)$, through one staged search that does not need to know $e$, so the evaluations a prediction saves measure what the predictor knows. We study two sources of predictions. A one-pass lookahead at an optimal LP dual is provably blind to groups whose families share no variable, and a language model reads the names and text of the model. JointDW verifies the prediction of the language model with the staged search and interleaves it with the lookahead at a bounded loss. Groups that strengthen the bound only jointly appear in a quarter of the MIPLIB-NL models whose bound can be improved. There the strongest language models identify them about as often as the lookahead, their predictions rest on the names for textbook models, and reasoning about doubles the accuracy of the same model. On larger models with distracting families, the lookahead finds the group in one evaluation of three families. Language models given only the text seldom name it, while one reasoning model given every coefficient names it in all but one answer and then needs fewer evaluations than the lookahead for pairs of families.

</details>


### [339] [RESHPart: Feedback-Reshaped Spectral Embedding for Hypergraph Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05729)
*Rongjian Liang,Zhuo Feng,Brucek Khailany*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FRESHPart：基于谱嵌入几何分析的反馈重塑框架，通过几何反馈与搜索反馈优化谱嵌入，显著提升超图划分质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可扩展Laplacian求解器已可用，但如何更有效地利用它们实现高质量超图划分仍是待解问题；投影式谱划分的有效性缺乏对谱嵌入几何结构的系统解释。

Method: 从谱嵌入几何视角重新审视谱超图划分：系统分析电路超图与受控合成(超)图，发现“射线状”嵌入结构；证明可通过Laplacian设计与超边重加权系统性地调控嵌入几何。据此提出FRESHPart——反馈重塑谱划分框架，利用Geometry Feedback与Search Feedback精炼嵌入，使其与投影式划分更好对齐。

Result: 在Titan23基准上，相对hMETIS平均割值降低13.09%（ε=2%）与25.21%（ε=20%），超过此前最佳报告结果（12.16%与22.53%）；单GPU上所有基准均在120秒内完成。

Conclusion: 谱嵌入的射线状几何结构可解释投影式划分的有效性，且该几何可通过Laplacian设计与超边重加权调控；FRESHPart据此实现更优割质量与高效运行。

Abstract: With scalable Laplacian solvers now available, the next frontier is to exploit them more effectively for high-quality hypergraph partitioning. In this work, we revisit spectral hypergraph partitioning from the perspective of spectral embedding geometry. Through a systematic analysis of circuit hypergraphs and controlled synthetic (hyper)graphs, we identify a ray-like embedding structure that helps explain the effectiveness of projection-based partitioning. We further show that the geometry of spectral embeddings can be systematically influenced through Laplacian design and hyperedge reweighting. Guided by these insights, we propose FRESHPart, a feedback-reshaped spectral partitioning framework that refines the spectral embedding through Geometry Feedback and Search Feedback, producing embeddings that are better aligned with projection-based partitioning. On the Titan23 benchmark, FRESHPart achieves average cut reductions over hMETIS of 13.09% at $ε=2\%$ and 25.21% at $ε=20\%$, surpassing the strongest previously reported results (12.16% and 22.53%, respectively), while completing every benchmark in under 120 s on a single GPU.

</details>


### [340] [Self-Supervised Learning of Universal Latent Spaces for Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05735)
*Sepehr Mousavi,Levi Lingsch,Siddhartha Mishra,Laura De Lorenzis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"函数自编码器"自监督预训练的解耦范式：将表示学习与算子学习分离，冻结的潜在空间可跨任务复用，在28个PDE任务上精度超越端到端SOTA，吞吐提升约一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子（neural operators）将函数表示与具体任务耦合，每遇新任务都需从标注数据重建低维近似空间，导致重复训练、依赖求解器与标签、数据效率低。受NLP/CV中自监督预训练使表示可共享的成功启发，作者希望把"表示学习"从"算子学习"中解耦出来。

Method: 提出函数自编码器（functional autoencoder），在实时合成的解析函数上自监督预训练——无需数值求解器、无需标签——使其能在任意点云上表示函数；训练后冻结其诱导的潜在空间并跨任务复用。该表示严格等变于平移、膨胀与幅值（translation, dilation, amplitude）。下游神经算子仅在缓存嵌入上训练。

Result: 在未见几何上可重构PDE解与自然图像；潜在空间整体可解码为有效场，保持物理场间距离序，测地线可插值物理演化，编辑方向可跨场迁移。流体、固体力学、声学及Helmholtz/Poisson方程共28个任务上，精度可超过端到端SOTA架构，吞吐最高提升约一个数量级，内存节省可使近两个数量级更大的模型在消费级GPU上运行；推理时潜在rollout快约一个数量级，分块推理可在单张消费级GPU处理超5亿点的函数。

Conclusion: 解耦的任务无关函数表示使神经算子训练仅需一次编码、在缓存嵌入上完成，兼具精度、效率与可解释的潜在结构，为大尺度PDE求解提供了可复用的表示基础。

Abstract: Neural operators fit their representation of functions to the task they are trained on, so every new task rebuilds a reduced space from labeled data. Following the self-supervised pre-training that made representations shareable in natural language processing and computer vision, we decouple representation learning from operator learning. A functional autoencoder is pre-trained on analytic functions synthesized on the fly, with no solver and no labels, to represent functions on arbitrary point clouds, and the latent space it induces is frozen and reused across tasks. The representation is exactly equivariant to translation, dilation, and amplitude, and reconstructs solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) and natural images on geometries it never saw. Being task-agnostic, the latent space can be interpreted in its own right. The whole space is used and decodes to valid fields, it preserves the ordering of distances between physical fields, its geodesics interpolate physical evolutions, and edit directions transfer across fields. With frozen representation maps, a dataset is encoded once and a neural operator is trained entirely on cached embeddings, which saves memory and training time. On 28 tasks in fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, acoustics, and the Helmholtz and Poisson equations, this paradigm can exceed the accuracy of state-of-the-art end-to-end architectures, with up to an order of magnitude higher throughput and memory savings that fit models nearly two orders of magnitude larger on consumer-grade GPUs. At inference, latent rollouts run up to an order of magnitude faster than regular rollouts, and chunked inference processes functions of over half a billion points on a single consumer-grade GPU.

</details>


### [341] [Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05744)
*Oche David Ankeli,Hassan Adelani Luqman,Theodora Ngozi Egbunike,Joshua Gottschalk,Bonaventure F. P. Dossou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在固定MMS-1B-FL102声学模型的条件下，用仅文本的4-gram KenLM解碼期融合（SF与DRA）可使豪萨语医疗ASR的WER从29.56%显著降至约23.3%，但相较通用LM的提升幅度有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 豪萨语等低资源语言的医疗领域语音数据稀缺，ASR系统对专业医疗词汇识别效果差；作者希望无需采集领域语音数据，仅靠文本资源实现领域自适应。

Method: 固定MMS-1B-FL102声学模型，采用两种解码期语言模型融合方法：Shallow Fusion（SF）与Density Ratio Approach（DRA）。医疗目标LM为在19,421句豪萨语健康句上训练的4-gram KenLM，DRA的源先验为75,372句通用领域LM。评测集为250条录制（25条经医师审核的提示语，10名说话人，覆盖尼日利亚北部六州），采用提示语不相交的五折交叉验证。

Result: SF与DRA分别将WER从29.56%降至23.55%和23.33%，均显著优于贪心解码（p < 0.001），两者间差异不显著（p = 0.423）。仅用通用LM的SF达到23.96% WER，说明医疗LM相对通用LM的额外增益有限。医疗术语错误率（MTER）在融合下亦有改善，但未确立明显的医疗领域优势。

Conclusion: 轻量级、仅文本的语言模型融合可在不额外采集领域语音数据的前提下改善豪萨语医疗ASR；但医疗专用LM带来的增益相对通用LM较为有限，其领域特异性优势尚需进一步验证。

Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p < 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM's additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that lightweight, text-only language-model fusion can improve Hausa medical ASR without additional domain-specific speech collection.

</details>


### [342] [Optimizing Recourse Under Predictive Multiplicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05774)
*Shahin Jabbari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究预测多重性下的鲁棒算法救济问题，将针对单一模型有效的救济在一个竞争模型集合上保持有效性刻画为预算约束下最坏情形有效性损失的最小化，提出oracle高效算法ORPM并给出收敛的充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法救济通常基于单一模型生成修改建议，但在预测多重性下，性能相近的模型会在个体预测上产生分歧，导致对某一模型有效的救济在另一模型上失效。已有方法多针对特定模型类或架构，缺乏跨模型类（线性、神经网络、决策树等）的通用鲁棒救济框架。

Method: 将预测多重性下的鲁棒救济形式化为预算约束下、对竞争模型集合（可含不同架构或不同假设类的模型）最坏情形有效性损失的最小化问题；提出oracle高效算法ORPM，并证明其收敛的充分条件；在1个合成数据集和5个真实数据集上评估，竞争集合包含线性、神经网络、混合及决策树模型；并与面向特定模型类/架构设计的基线方法比较，同时量化在给定预算下要求跨竞争模型采用共同动作对救济成功率的影响，并考察该成功率在不同人口群体间的差异。

Result: 实验显示优化间隙上界逐步下降，在多种测试设置下取得较高有效性；与针对特定模型类或架构的基线相比表现更优；并量化了强制共同动作在给定预算下对救济成功率的影响，以及该成功率在不同人口群体间的差异。

Conclusion: ORPM为跨异构模型集合的鲁棒算法救济提供了具有收敛保证的oracle高效求解方案，实验验证了其在多种设置下的有效性与相对基线的优势；同时表明跨模型共同动作要求会改变给定预算下的救济成功情况，且该成功情况存在群体间差异，提示鲁棒救济设计中需权衡模型一致性与群体公平性。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse identifies modifications that can change an unfavorable model prediction into a favorable one. Under predictive multiplicity, similarly performing models can disagree on individual predictions, so recourse valid for one model may fail for another. We formulate robust recourse under predictive multiplicity as a budget-constrained minimization of the worst-case validity loss across a competing set of models, which can include models with different architectures or from different hypothesis classes. We propose an oracle-efficient algorithm called ORPM and prove sufficient conditions for its convergence. We evaluate ORPM on one synthetic and five real datasets, and competing sets consist of linear, neural, mixed, and decision-tree models. Our experiments show decreasing optimization-gap bounds and high validity in many tested settings, with favorable performance against baselines designed for specific model classes or architectures. We also quantify how requiring a common action across competing models changes recourse success at a given budget and examine disparities in this success across demographic groups.

</details>


### [343] [PRISM-AMC: Replay-Free Continual Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06066)
*Usman Akram,Matthew Graham,Haris Vikalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PRISM-AMC——一种无需回放的持续学习框架，通过梯度投影记忆保留中间表示中的任务相关子空间以缓解灾难性遗忘，并在SNR相关梯度噪声模型下分析投影随机梯度更新；在MIGOU与DeepSig 2018.01A上显著降低遗忘且不存储原始I/Q样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AMC深度学习方法多假设调制类别集合固定且可持续访问历史训练数据；但实际中调制类别与信道条件随时间演化，且存储/数据保留约束可能禁止回放原始基带I/Q样本，导致顺序微调下严重的灾难性遗忘。

Method: 1) 无回放持续学习框架，不保存原始I/Q样本；2) 以梯度投影记忆维护中间表示的任务相关子空间，约束更新方向以抑制对旧任务的干扰；3) 在SNR相关梯度噪声模型下对投影随机梯度更新进行理论分析；4) 在类增量与域增量两种设定下评估。

Result: 在MIGOU与DeepSig 2018.01A数据集上，相比顺序微调与弹性权重固化（EWC），遗忘显著降低；在类增量设定下与基于回放的RSD-AMC相当或更优，且无需存储原始I/Q样本。

Conclusion: 基于子空间梯度投影的无回放持续学习可在存储受限条件下有效缓解AMC中的灾难性遗忘，兼具隐私/存储优势与竞争力，适用于类别与信道条件动态演化的认知无线场景。

Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) is a key component of cognitive wireless systems, enabling spectrum awareness and adaptive communication. Most deep learning approaches to AMC assume a fixed set of modulation classes and access to previously observed training data. In practice, modulation classes and channel conditions may evolve over time, while storage or data-retention constraints may preclude replay of raw baseband I/Q samples. We propose PRISM-AMC, a replay-free continual learning framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting by preserving task-relevant subspaces of intermediate representations via gradient projection memory. We further analyze projected stochastic-gradient updates under an SNR-dependent gradient-noise model. PRISM-AMC is evaluated in both class-incremental and domain-incremental settings. Experiments on the MIGOU and DeepSig 2018.01A datasets show substantially reduced forgetting relative to sequential fine-tuning and elastic weight consolidation, while remaining competitive with or outperforming replay-based RSD-AMC in class-incremental settings, without storing raw I/Q samples.

</details>


### [344] [Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05835)
*Hanzhang Qin,Sophie H. Yu,Yuewei Zhang,Zhi-Hai Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出上下文赌博机策略 ADP-HT，在固定预算下选择调用哪个模型及是否重试，以最大化完成任务数为目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型调用费用仅在完成后才揭晓，单次长响应可能耗尽剩余预算，导致后续任务无法服务；需要在预算约束下在线决定模型选择与重试。

Method: 构建上下文赌博机策略 ADP-HT：学习每个模型的任务相关成功概率；基于分位数网格（2^K 个区间）对响应长度标签做粗化，构造保守成本估计；在预测成功与保守成本间权衡，并按实际花费和每剩余任务的可用预算动态调整成本惩罚项。给出在标定、局部正则与网格覆盖条件下的多余裕度上界。

Result: 固定样本量下，增大 K 会降低离散化误差项但增大估计允许项；在最紧预算下，ADP-HT 在 MATH500 与 GPQA 上解出任务数超过最佳基线两倍以上；在 RouterBench 十四个预算中的十个取得最高平均累计得分；在 LiveCodeBench 三个最低测试预算下优于已部署的商业路由器（默认与节省模式）。

Conclusion: ADP-HT 通过保守成本估计与自适应惩罚在预算受限的模型路由中显著提升任务完成数，且在极低预算区间优势尤为明显。

Abstract: Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion, one long response can exhaust the remaining budget and leave later tasks unserved. Our objective is to maximize the number of tasks solved before service stops. We develop a contextual bandit policy, ADP-HT, which learns each model's task-specific success probability and constructs conservative cost estimates from coarsened response-length labels on a quantile grid with $2^K$ intervals. The policy weighs predicted success against these costs, adjusting the cost penalty to realized spending and the budget available per remaining task. Under calibration, local regularity, and grid-coverage conditions, we bound the excess allowance in the policy's conservative cost estimates. At a fixed sample size, increasing $K$ reduces the discretization term but increases the estimation allowance. At the tightest tested budgets, ADP-HT solves more than twice as many MATH500 and GPQA tasks as the best implemented baseline. It achieves the highest mean cumulative score at ten of fourteen RouterBench budgets. On LiveCodeBench, it outperforms a deployed commercial router in both default and cost-saving modes at the three lowest test budgets.

</details>


### [345] [Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06271)
*Fredrik Nguyen,Qiwen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观测锚定一致性与一致性中期训练（CMT）的单步信道估计器，在MIMO-OFDM中兼顾精度与推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式神经信道估计器能缓解导频污染下的恢复问题，但多次网络评估导致推理开销大，需要单步高效估计方案。

Method: 在时延-波束域对导频最小二乘信道估计做精化；一致性学习沿含噪到干净路径耦合端点预测（观测锚定）；CMT进一步将紧凑的学生模型蒸馏，使其从轨迹中间状态直接预测flow-matching教师的端点。

Result: 在所评估SNR范围内，紧凑CMT学生模型相较单步flow-matching基线将未编码SER降低9.6–20.2%（对数SER降低0.44–0.98 dB），参数量减少74.5%，乘累加运算量减少73.0%。

Conclusion: 一致性学习与CMT可在显著压缩参数与计算量的同时提升单步信道估计性能，实现低开销的迭代式估计替代方案。

Abstract: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.

</details>


### [346] [PEARL: Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning for Selective Forgetting under Partial Preference Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05842)
*Rashmi Gangadharaiah,Balakrishnan Narayanaswamy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PEARL：沿“预测出乎意料错误”的特征方向反向更新Gram矩阵、实现可选择性遗忘的自适应正则化神经上下文bandit，在个性化LLM响应选择基准PRISM上以轻量MLP超越greedy与最强神经bandit基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户偏好随需求、情境和品味演变而漂移，使个性化推荐、LLM响应生成与RLHF奖励模型出现失校准。现有非平稳bandit对所有维度均匀遗忘，而真实偏好漂移通常是局部的：部分维度失效、其余仍然有效。同时神经上下文bandit通过Gram矩阵单调累积置信度，缺乏将不确定性导向“预测已出错”方向的机制。

Method: 提出PEARL（Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning）：在预测出现意外错误（surprisingly wrong）的特征方向上反转Gram更新以降低该方向置信度，而在其他方向上保持置信不变，从而把探索/不确定性集中于已失效维度。给出三项理论结果：(i)任何非自适应策略在偏好漂移后都有线性遗憾；(ii)不存在固定探索率能同时在平稳与非平稳区间取得低遗憾；(iii)PEARL的累积遗憾随发生漂移的用户数N_s而非总人口N缩放。

Result: 在PRISM（1,500用户、21个LLM的个性化LLM响应选择基准）上，PEARL较greedy提升+4.0分、较最优神经bandit基线提升+2.5分（p<0.001），在偏好稳定时与greedy持平；相较滑窗法和折扣法提升3–10分，验证选择性遗忘优于均匀遗忘。选择策略为约100K参数MLP，CPU上毫秒级推理，LLM权重保持冻结，可适配任意API模型。

Conclusion: 选择性遗忘优于均匀遗忘；将置信度更新与预测误差方向对齐可有效应对局部偏好漂移。方法兼具理论保障（遗憾随N_s而非N增长）与工程可行性（轻量、低延迟、模型无关），适用于个性化推荐与LLM响应选择的在线自适应。

Abstract: User preferences shift as needs, context, and tastes evolve. This matters for personalized recommendation, LLM response generation, and RLHF-trained reward models, which can become miscalibrated as preferences drift. Existing non-stationary bandit methods forget uniformly across all dimensions, but real preference shifts are typically partial: some dimensions go stale while others remain valid. Neural contextual bandits accumulate confidence monotonically via the Gram matrix, with no mechanism to direct uncertainty where predictions have gone wrong. We propose PEARL (Prediction Error-Adaptive Regularized Learning), which reverses the Gram update along feature directions where predictions are surprisingly wrong, while leaving confidence intact elsewhere. We prove that (i) any non-adaptive policy suffers linear regret after a preference shift, (ii) no fixed exploration rate achieves low regret in both stationary and non-stationary regimes, and (iii) PEARL's cumulative regret scales with the number of shifted users N_s, not the total population N. On PRISM, a personalized LLM response selection benchmark (1,500 users, 21 LLMs), PEARL beats greedy by +4.0 points and the best neural bandit baseline by +2.5 points (p<0.001), while performing on par with greedy when preferences are stable. It beats sliding-window and discounted approaches by 3 to 10 points, showing that selective forgetting outperforms uniform forgetting. The selection policy is a ~100K-parameter MLP that runs in milliseconds on CPU, leaves LLM weights frozen, and works with any API-based model.

</details>


### [347] [A low-rank decoder bottleneck bounds reliability in foundation-model perturbation prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05849)
*Zheyu Zhang,Yuanhao Huang,Fan Feng,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计STATE中状态转移(ST)解码器的逐预测可靠性，发现其首层注意力输出低秩，可靠性受"与训练响应距离"约束，并提出用"预测最近邻距离"作为逐预测置信度，与PDC的Spearman相关均值达0.81，且阈值可跨编码器与细胞系迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型对扰动响应的预测主要以聚合准确率评价，但若用其预测来优先安排实验，必须评估单个预测的可靠性；现有评估缺少逐预测的置信度度量。

Method: 在CRISPRi下审计STATE的ST解码器，覆盖三种编码器（SE-600M、scGPT、Tahoe-x1）与四个细胞系。分析其首层注意力输出的低秩性，将输出投影到由训练激活估计的4–32个固定方向上；并通过"扰动观测响应到最近训练响应的余弦距离"检验可靠性上界。提出predicted-NN-distance——预测响应到最近训练响应的余弦距离——作为逐预测置信度分数。

Result: 投影到固定方向后仍保持平均逐扰动Pearson delta相关(PDC)；PDC随观测响应到最近训练响应的余弦距离增大而下降；predicted-NN-distance与PDC的平均绝对Spearman相关为0.81，接近用观测响应的0.88；基于该分数校准的阈值可跨编码器与细胞系迁移，且对药物扰动仍能预测PDC。

Conclusion: ST解码器的低秩注意力瓶颈使其可靠性由与训练响应的距离所界定；predicted-NN-distance是一种有效、可迁移的逐预测置信度分数，可用于实验优先级排序。

Abstract: Foundation-model predictors of perturbation response are evaluated primarily by aggregate accuracy. Using their predictions to prioritize experiments requires assessing each prediction's reliability. We audit the state-transition (ST) decoder used in STATE across three encoders (SE-600M, scGPT, and Tahoe-x1) and four cell lines under CRISPRi. The decoder's first attention layer has a low-rank output. Projecting this output onto 4-32 fixed directions estimated from training activations preserves mean per-perturbation Pearson delta correlation (PDC). This low-rank attention bottleneck bounds the decoder's reliability by distance to training responses: PDC declines as the cosine distance from a perturbation's observed response to its nearest training response increases. We propose predicted-NN-distance, the cosine distance from a predicted response to its nearest training response, as a per-prediction confidence score. The score has a mean absolute Spearman correlation of 0.81 with PDC, close to the 0.88 obtained with the observed response. Thresholds calibrated on this score transfer across encoders and cell lines, and the score remains predictive of PDC for drug perturbations.

</details>


### [348] [On Convergence of Gradient Temporal-Difference Learning with Regularized Corrections and Eligibility Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05869)
*Jingyi Jin,Martha White,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了约束型 TDRC(λ) 在递减步长与非独立同分布 off-policy 数据下的收敛性（支持状态相关与历史相关 λ），并提出 TDRC(λ)-Huber，保持原不动点同时降低对大 Bellman 误差的敏感性；借助 ODE 弱收敛方法给出唯一性、全局渐近稳定性及可计算的充分条件，并揭示基于正则化的收敛机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TD 学习在 off-policy、bootstrapping 与函数逼近结合时可能发散。TDRC 理论稳健且实现简单，但现有收敛理论仅覆盖 i.i.d. 采样下的一步情形，Huber Bellman 误差形式也未推广到 TDRC 或资格迹，因此需要更一般的收敛分析与鲁棒化算法。

Method: 采用随机逼近理论中的基于 ODE 的弱收敛方法：(1) 建立递减步长、非 i.i.d. off-policy 数据下约束 TDRC(λ) 的收敛性，λ 可为状态相关或历史相关；(2) 提出 TDRC(λ)-Huber，保留 TDRC(λ) 不动点并抑制大 Bellman 误差影响；(3) 对 TDRC(λ)-Huber 的非线性均值动力学给出积分小增益条件，保证目标平衡点的唯一性与全局渐近稳定性；(4) 建立约束算法收敛性并推导可计算的充分条件。

Result: 证明约束 TDRC(λ) 在非 i.i.d. off-policy 数据下收敛；积分小增益条件保证 TDRC(λ)-Huber 目标平衡点的唯一性与全局渐近稳定性；给出约束算法的收敛性及可计算充分条件；发现线性 TDRC(λ) 与 TDRC(λ)-Huber 共享基于正则化的收敛机制：当均值 TD 矩阵正稳定时，足够强的正则化即可使两者收敛，无需正定性假设。

Conclusion: TDRC(λ) 的收敛理论被推广到 off-policy、非 i.i.d. 与资格迹情形，TDRC(λ)-Huber 在保持不动点的同时提升了鲁棒性；正则化本身可作为两类算法的收敛机制，正稳定条件下无需正定性即可收敛。

Abstract: Temporal-difference (TD) learning underlies many prediction and control algorithms, but can diverge when combined with off-policy learning, bootstrapping, and function approximation. TD with Regularized Corrections (TDRC) is theoretically sound and practically simple, but existing convergence theory covers only the one-step case under i.i.d. sampling, while the Huber Bellman-error formulation has not been extended to TDRC or eligibility traces. In this work, we establish convergence of constrained TDRC($λ$) with diminishing stepsizes and non-i.i.d. off-policy data, for state-dependent and history-dependent $λ$-parameters. We also propose TDRC($λ$)-Huber, which preserves the TDRC($λ$) fixed point while reducing sensitivity to large Bellman errors. For both algorithms, we apply an ODE-based weak-convergence method from stochastic approximation theory. For the nonlinear mean dynamics of TDRC($λ$)-Huber, we give an integral small-gain condition that guarantees uniqueness and global asymptotic stability of the target equilibrium. We then establish convergence of the constrained algorithm, derive computable sufficient conditions for convergence, and identify a regularization-based convergence mechanism shared by linear TDRC($λ$) and TDRC($λ$)-Huber. When the mean TD matrix is positive stable, both constrained algorithms converge under sufficiently strong regularization without requiring positive definiteness.

</details>


### [349] [MIGONet: a multiple-input graph neural operator with solver-free discrete manufactured-solution training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05876)
*Muhammad Hasnain,N. K. Anand,Arun Srinivasa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出多输入图神经算子MIGONet与离散制造解法（MMS），在无需数值求解PDE的情况下生成训练数据并学习稳态热传导中源项与Dirichlet/Neumann边界条件的联合映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输运代理建模需要能同时刻画空间分布源项与混合边界条件影响的算子，且训练数据应低成本生成，而常规基于迭代有限差分的标注代价高。

Method: MIGONet在局部消息传递前向每个节点提供完整源场与边界数据表示；离散MMS预先给定温度场，用与参考FDM相同的离散算子反算源项与边界数据，构造满足离散控制方程的样本，并将边界的条件类型作为算子输入。

Result: 在矩形域弯曲导线与高斯热点加热下平均相对误差为10.31%与10.64%，MIONet为45.97%与48.34%，无完整源编码器的MIGONet-local为72.25%与67.82%；10,000样本数据生成时间由486.65 s降至3.15 s；另在L形、圆盘形与环形域上评估了单独训练的模型。

Conclusion: MIGONet结合离散MMS可高效生成物理一致的训练数据并显著提升混合源项与边界条件下温度场预测精度，优于MIONet与局部版本，且可扩展至复杂几何域。

Abstract: Surrogate modeling of transport requires operators that capture the combined influence of spatially distributed sources and Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions, together with training datasets that can be generated at low computational cost. This work presents MIGONet, a multiple-input graph neural operator, and a discrete method of manufactured solutions (MMS) that trains it without solving a partial differential equation, using steady heat conduction as the model problem. In the discrete MMS procedure, temperature fields are prescribed a priori, and the source terms and Dirichlet or Neumann boundary data are evaluated with the same discrete operators as the reference finite-difference method (FDM), so every training sample satisfies the discrete governing equations by construction. Because the boundary data are derived from each field, a Dirichlet or Neumann condition can be assigned to every boundary segment of every sample, and the boundary specification becomes an operator input. MIGONet supplies representations of the complete source field and boundary data to every node before local message passing. On the rectangular domain, it is compared with a version without the complete-source encoder (MIGONet-local) and with the multiple-input operator network MIONet, using the same training data. MIGONet achieves mean relative temperature errors of 10.31% and 10.64% for curved-wire and Gaussian-spot heating, compared with 45.97% and 48.34% for MIONet and 72.25% and 67.82% for MIGONet-local. For 10,000 samples, discrete MMS reduces data-generation time from 486.65 s to 3.15 s relative to matched iterative FDM labeling. Separately trained MIGONet models are also evaluated on L-shaped, disc-shaped, and ring-shaped domains.

</details>


### [350] [Deep Meets Classical: A CPU-Efficient Decision-Fusion Model for Automatic Modulation Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05937)
*Zhiyi Yin,Zhizhao Wen,Ruoxin Zhang,Chao Wang,Puyang Xu,Yifan Jiang,Yusi Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FuseAMC 通过对轻量残差 CNN 与梯度提升树累积量分类器的类别后验做逻辑回归决策融合，在 RadioML 2016.10a 上以约 0.2M 参数、单 CPU 核可运行的代价取得 55.8% 总体准确率，并同时保留两类方法在低/高 SNR 各自的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动调制分类（AMC）是认知无线电中频谱感知与非协作信号识别的关键环节，但在 CPU 可行的两条主流路线——原始 I/Q 上的紧凑 CNN 与基于高阶累积量的传统特征分类器——之间，缺少按信噪比（SNR）条件下的系统对比。作者发现二者呈互补性：CNN 在低 SNR 更稳健，累积量分类器在高 SNR 更准确，因而有必要设计显式利用该互补性的融合方案。

Method: 先按 SNR 条件对比两种基线：约 198k 参数的残差 CNN 直接处理原始 I/Q 样本；梯度提升树分类器使用高阶累积量特征。再用 FuseAMC 做决策级融合：将两者的类别后验拼接（2C 维），在一个与测试集不相交的验证划分上训练逻辑回归元学习器。数据集为 RadioML 2016.10a，采用 5 个随机种子，测试集为 44k 帧的留出集。
