Result: FuseAMC 总体准确率达 55.8%，较最佳累积量特征基线提升 5.1 个百分点，较单独 CNN 提升 3.2 个百分点；配对 bootstrap 的 95% 置信区间下界分别为 5.0 与 3.1 个百分点，均为正值，说明增益显著。分 SNR 看，融合模型在高 SNR 区间与最佳传统基线持平、在低 SNR 区间与 CNN 持平，即兼得两者优势。整体规模约 0.2M 参数、模型占用数 MB、每帧约 3 MFLOPs，全流程可在单 CPU 核上训练与推理。

Conclusion: 在低资源、无硬件加速的通用或嵌入式处理器场景下，融合手工累积量特征与轻量深度模型的后验是一种低成本且稳定的 AMC 提升途径；分 SNR 的互补性分析也为方法选择提供了依据。

Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) underpins spectrum sensing and non-cooperative signal identification in cognitive radio, yet the two standard CPU-feasible approaches to it, a compact convolutional neural network (CNN) on raw in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) samples and a classical higher-order-cumulant feature classifier, are rarely compared against each other conditioned on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We show that they are, in fact, complementary: the CNN is markedly more robust at low SNR, where hand-crafted statistics collapse toward chance, while the cumulant classifier is more accurate at high SNR, where higher-order statistics cleanly separate dense constellations. We exploit this complementarity with FuseAMC, a lightweight decision-fusion model that trains a logistic-regression meta-combiner over the concatenated class-posteriors of an approximately 198k-parameter residual CNN and a gradient-boosted-tree cumulant classifier, on a validation split disjoint from test. On RadioML 2016.10a (5 seeds, 44k-frame held-out test set), FuseAMC reaches 55.8% overall accuracy, improving on the best cumulant-feature baseline by 5.1 points and on the CNN alone by 3.2 points (paired-bootstrap 95% confidence-interval lower bounds of 5.0 and 3.1 points, both positive), while matching the best classical baseline in its own strong high-SNR regime and the CNN in its strong low-SNR regime. With about 0.2 million parameters, a model footprint of a few megabytes, and roughly 3 MFLOPs per frame, the whole pipeline trains and runs on one CPU core, targeting general-purpose and embedded processors without hardware acceleration.

</details>


### [351] [BAM: Bivariate Additive Models for Interpretable Tabular Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05940)
*Atsushi Koike*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双变量可加模型（BAMs）：将每对特征的交互形状函数约束为参数化的非对称双变量高斯，实现可可视化、可审计的GA²M，并自动选择特征对，精度接近标准GAM/GA²M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GA²M（如EBM、NODE-GAM）学到的成对形状函数过于复杂——轮廓图不规则、局部波动剧烈，实践者难以解读，也无法与领域知识核对。真正意义上的可审计性要求形状函数显著更简单。

Method: 每个成对形状函数限制为简单参数形式，实例化为非对称双变量高斯，故每个分量对应一张单峰轮廓图；特征对在训练中自动选择（而非预先指定）。

Result: 在六个表格基准上，BAM的预测精度与标准GAM相当，并接近GA²M；同时给出精度与需审查分量数量之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 若捕捉到正确的特征对，形状函数的强简化可保持GAM级精度，从而在更强意义上实现可审计性；复杂度与精度可通过分量数量调节。

Abstract: Generalized Additive Models with pairwise interactions (GA$^2$Ms) are regarded as glass-box models, since each pairwise shape function can be visualized as a contour plot. In practice, the shape functions learned by methods such as EBM or NODE-GAM are so complex (irregular contours and sharp local fluctuations) that a practitioner cannot meaningfully interpret them or check them against domain knowledge. Auditability in this stronger sense requires substantially simpler shape functions. We argue that such simplification can match the accuracy of standard GAMs if the right feature pairs are captured. We propose Bivariate Additive Models (BAMs), a class of GA$^2$Ms in which every pairwise shape function is constrained to a simple parametric form, instantiated as an asymmetric bivariate Gaussian. Each component is visualizable as a unimodal contour map, and its feature pair is selected automatically during training. Experiments on six tabular benchmarks show that BAM attains predictive accuracy comparable to standard GAMs and approaches that of GA$^2$Ms. We also show the trade-off between accuracy and the number of components to inspect.

</details>


### [352] [Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05942)
*Mengni Jia,Mengyu Zhou,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从RL的隐式目标策略出发，提出sharpness factor κ 与 κ_eff 刻画奖励/优势差向概率比差的映射强度，并据此提出"reward budgeting"优势构造方法，在不显式保持熵的情况下显著提升多个基线的推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL训练LLM推理时，策略分布趋于尖锐导致性能过早进入平台期；已有工作将策略熵用作诊断与控制信号，但实验表明单纯提高熵并不能可靠改变最终平台，因此需要从更新动力学角度重新理解过早收敛。

Method: 通过分析RL的隐式目标策略，推导sharpness factor κ 及其有效版本 κ_eff，描述奖励或优势差距如何被放大为概率比差距；提出reward budgeting——一种plug-in优势构造，为每个prompt分配固定总奖励预算。在二值奖励与独立on-policy rollout下，其未裁剪score-function估计器对应于一个具有递减收益的精确有限-G凹目标梯度，且当更多rollout正确时优势差减小；一般奖励下在给定正则条件下具有shifted log-mean的渐近解释。裁剪实现仅有动机支持，未证明严格等价。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B与Llama3.2-3B-Instruct上，reward budgeting一致优于多种RL基线，AMC23最高提升+12.50，AIME24与AIME25各提升+10.00。

Conclusion: 结果支持"更新动力学"视角解释过早收敛，并表明无需显式保持熵也能获得显著性能提升。

Abstract: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct, reward budgeting consistently improves a range of RL baselines, with gains up to +12.50 on AMC23 and +10.00 on AIME24 and AIME25. Overall, our results support an update-dynamics view of premature convergence and show that strong gains can be obtained without explicitly preserving entropy.

</details>


### [353] [On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05984)
*Xiangdong Zhang,Xiaohan Qin,Sunan Zou,Tuo Dai,Bizhao Shi,Zhuo Xia,Yebin Yang,Yizhou Chen,Yuliang Liu,Yu Cheng,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 系统分析 Hyper-Connections (HC) 架构的组件作用与训练开销，提出简化设计 SimpleHC：去除残差混合、采用共享内存访问与组内共享门控，仅带来 2.4% 额外训练时间且性能与 mHC 相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HC 架构在前沿语言模型中被越来越多采用，但其各组件机理理解不足，且引入不可忽视的训练开销，因此需要系统剖析其组件并寻找更简单高效的替代设计。

Method: 通过消融分析识别出两个等效有效的交互组：无混合的读写门控学习，以及固定门控下的无约束混合，二者单独使用即可达到 mHC 水平；同时定位到对扩展残差状态的重复访问是训练开销的主要来源。据此设计 SimpleHC：移除残差混合，利用加性结构与共享门控输入实现共享内存访问；层专属门控共享组入口状态，支持批量读取与延迟写入，标量校正精确保持前序子层输出贡献。

Result: 在最大测试规模下，SimpleHC 相对原始残差基线仅增加 2.4% 端到端训练时间；在 15B 至 30B MoE 模型扩展中性能与 mHC 相当；标准训练中梯度动态更平滑，压力测试下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 分析支持所保留的残差结构与共享内存访问设计。SimpleHC 以极低的额外开销实现与 mHC 可比的性能，作者希望其推动基础模型设计中更广泛的简洁性追求，使性能提升在规模化场景下更易获得与实用。

Abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. Our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. SimpleHC incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. It maintains performance comparable to mHC when scaling from 15B to 30B MoE models, exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training, and remains stable under stress. We hope SimpleHC will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design, making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.

</details>


### [354] [A Comparative Study of Importance Attribution to Columns in Deep Learning over Relational Databases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05986)
*Hila Levi-Yosefi,Shunit Agmon,Ester Livshits,Agapi Rissaki,Benny Kimelfeld*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一套系统比较"重要性归因"解释方法的方法论，用属性排名差异与得分分布差异两个维度刻画解释方法的分歧，并结合保真度衡量差异是否反映解释质量；在关系型深度学习（RDL）模型上实证比较了Monte Carlo Shapley、Kernel SHAP、单属性影响、mask learning四种方法，发现解释方法的选择对解释结果有实质影响，且在多数情形下单属性影响可在显著更低计算代价下替代Shapley。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系数据库上的深度学习预测模型日益有效，但其行为亟需解释。已有大量属性重要性归因方法，然而"归因方法的选择本身在多大程度上影响解释结论"这一基础问题缺乏系统研究。

Method: 构建可系统比较归因方法的方法论，从两方面刻画解释差异：(1) 属性排名差异（哪些属性被视为重要）；(2) 得分分布差异（重要性分数在属性间的变化方式）；并检验这些差异是否体现在传统解释质量指标"保真度（fidelity）"上。实证覆盖四个数据集与任务、两种RDL架构（异构GraphSAGE、关系图Transformer），比较四种方法：Monte Carlo Shapley、Kernel SHAP、单属性影响、mask learning。

Result: 解释方法的行为随预测类型（回归/分类）而异：回归任务中多数方法在属性排名上高度一致，分类任务中一致性显著下降；mask learning的重要性分布常出现偏离，而基于Shapley的方法与单属性影响常收敛到相似解释。这表明许多设置下单属性影响能以远低于Shapley的计算成本替代Shapley。

Conclusion: 研究提供了比较重要性归因方法的方法论工具，并给出实证证据：归因方法的选择对解读关系型深度学习模型具有重要影响，实践中应结合任务类型谨慎选择归因方法，单属性影响是低成本的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Deep learning over relational databases has led to increasingly effective prediction models, motivating a growing need to explain their behavior. We study explanation methods that assign importance scores to individual database attributes, focusing on a fundamental question: to what extent does the choice of importance-attribution method matter? We develop a methodology to systematically compare importance-attribution methods and analyze their similarities and differences. In particular, we study two aspects of the explanations: which attributes they deem important, captured by differences in attribute rankings, and how importance scores vary across attributes, captured by differences in score distributions. We further investigate whether these differences are reflected in the conventional measure of explanation quality, fidelity.
  We apply our methodology in an extensive empirical study of four methods: Monte Carlo Shapley, Kernel SHAP, single-attribute impact, and mask learning. We experiment with multiple datasets and tasks using two RDL architectures: heterogeneous GraphSAGE and Relational Graph Transformers. Our experiments show that explanation methods behave differently depending on the prediction type: regression or classification. In regression, most methods exhibit high agreement in attribute rankings, whereas classification yields considerably less consensus. Notably, while mask learning frequently diverges in its importance distributions, Shapley-based methods and single-attribute impact often converge to similar explanations. This suggests that, in many settings, single-attribute impact can replace Shapley at substantially lower computational cost. Overall, our study provides methodological tools for comparing importance-attribution methods, and empirical evidence that their choice has important consequences for interpreting relational deep learning models.

</details>


### [355] [Decouple to Reuse: Fine-Grained Knowledge Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05993)
*Yuqian Wu,Qingxiang Liu,Yuxin Guo,Weifeng Su,Jian Li,Pengfei Xu,Xi Chen,Yutao Yue,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FineKA两阶段细粒度知识增强框架，将预训练TSFM知识解耦为趋势/季节双分支残差码本并按需检索融合，提升冻结TSFM在下游预测任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）迁移到下游任务时存在域偏移；现有检索增强方法通常检索粗粒度窗口上下文，易引入上下文特定噪声，且忽视了趋势与季节动态可能来源于不同上下文。

Method: 核心主张在分解层面复用时间模式。Stage I：对解耦的趋势与季节信号分别构建双分支残差码本，将预训练知识压缩、整合为紧凑的任务共享码本。Stage II：通过任务自适应聚合与门控融合，将细粒度模式动态检索并合并进目标表示，同时保持TSFM主干冻结。

Result: 在8个真实世界基准、4种代表性TSFM骨干上实验，FineKA在效果与计算效率上均优于对比方法；残差码本在不同骨干间表现出较强的可迁移性。

Conclusion: 细粒度、分解级的知识复用是缓解TSFM域偏移的有效途径；紧凑残差码本兼具高效性与跨骨干泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Time series forecasting is critical for demand prediction and resource management in modern Web services, yet applying pretrained Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to downstream tasks remains challenging due to domain shifts. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically retrieve coarse-grained window contexts and may introduce context-specific noise. To address this problem, we argue that temporal patterns should be reused at a decomposition level, as effective trend and seasonal dynamics may originate from different contexts. We propose \method, a two-stage \underline{F}ine-grained \underline{K}nowledge \underline{A}ugmentation framework that decouples and consolidates pre-training knowledge into compact, task-shared residual codebooks to enhance frozen TSFMs. Specifically, Stage I constructs dual-branch residual codebooks for decoupled trend and seasonal signals, while Stage II dynamically retrieves and merges these fine-grained patterns into target representations via task-adaptive aggregation and gate fusion. Extensive experiments across eight real-world benchmarks with four representative TSFM backbones demonstrate the superior effectiveness and computational efficiency of \method, while further validating the strong transferability of the residual codebooks across different backbones. The source code is available at the anonymous repository: https://github.com/yuppielqx/TSFM-Component-Token-Adapter

</details>


### [356] [How Far Can You Steer? Behavior-Capability Frontiers in Contrastive Activation Addition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06001)
*Deepanshu Raj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过"行为—能力前沿"框架研究对比激活加法(CAA)，在显式限制能力退化的条件下选择干预，系统刻画激活引导作为受约束干预的可用范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导可在不更新参数的情况下改变语言模型行为，但行为有效性本身不能决定干预是否可用；CAA在引导目标行为时可能损害无关能力，因此需要同时权衡行为收益与能力代价。

Method: 提出行为—能力前沿框架，选取在能力退化上限约束下最大化行为增益的干预；跨四个指令微调模型、七种行为、1%/3%/5%（绝对百分点）的能力损失预算进行评估，并做弃留数据验证、对照实验、表征几何分析与二次能力/分布外/开放式评估。

Result: 验证集选择的行为效应在留出数据上泛化强(ρ=0.945)；非零操作点的行为—能力联合存活率从1%预算的37.5%升至3%的72.7%，5%时增益有限；效应依赖学习到的行为方向而非通用激活扰动；表征几何对因果跨行为迁移有显著但仅有限的预测力；满足受保护基准的干预仍可能损害未测能力或对自由形式生成迁移不均。

Conclusion: 激活引导应被视为受约束的干预，其可用范围取决于模型、行为、方向、层与评估预算，而非通用控制旋钮。

Abstract: Activation steering can modify language-model behavior without parameter updates, but behavioral efficacy alone does not determine whether an intervention is usable. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) steers targeted behaviors using activation directions derived from contrasting examples, potentially degrading unrelated model capabilities in the process. We therefore study CAA through a behavior-capability frontier, selecting interventions that maximize behavioral gain subject to an explicit bound on capability degradation. We evaluate this framework across four instruction-tuned models, seven behaviors, and capability-loss budgets of 1%, 3%, and 5% (absolute percentage points). Validation-selected behavioral effects generalize strongly to held-out data ($ρ= 0.945$), while joint behavior-capability survival among nonzero operating points rises from 37.5% at the 1% budget to 72.7% at 3%, with limited additional improvement at 5%. Control experiments indicate that these effects depend on learned behavior directions rather than generic activation perturbations. Representational geometry is significantly but only modestly predictive of causal cross-behavior transfer. Finally, secondary capability, out-of-distribution, and open-ended evaluations show that interventions satisfying protected benchmarks can still degrade untested capabilities or transfer unevenly to free-form generation. These results characterize activation steering as a constrained intervention whose usable range depends on model, behavior, direction, layer, and evaluation budget, rather than a universal control knob.

</details>


### [357] [Attraction-Ranking Mismatch in Out-of-Distribution Detection: Theory and Evidence from Hamiltonian Feature Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06021)
*Zilin Wang,Lianghai Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以类条件哈密顿动力学为受控实验平台，揭示"将特征吸引至已学习ID区域"这一OOD检测直觉存在"吸引力—排序失配"：提升各类别亲和度分数并不必然改善ID与OOD样本的相对排序，故类别吸引不足以证明特征精炼的合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD检测普遍假设"把特征拉向ID区域即可提升检测"是直观但未经验证的策略。作者质疑该假设，希望厘清分数改进与检测性能（依赖ID-OOD相对排序）之间的脱节机制。

Method: 以类条件哈密顿动力学作为可控测试台；通过精确的AUROC分解与局部分析，在正则性条件下定位一阶AUROC变化的来源；区分"驱动场与检测分数间的不对齐"与"即便对齐仍存在的排序失败"；开展分数对齐规则的迁移实验与近边界扰动实验；并用质心近似与共享尺度将零步分数联系到包含现有CTM检测器的静态质心族。

Result: 发现分数对齐规则可在源域留出验证集上提升性能，却在迁移后一致性地下降，且未发生任何获胜类别变更；扰动实验显示近边界的相对分数变化能追踪小幅度AUROC变化的方向。

Conclusion: 类别吸引不足以支撑特征精炼，评价应聚焦其对ID-OOD排序边界的影响；AUROC的一阶变化主要由排序边界处的相对分数变化决定。

Abstract: Attracting features toward learned in-distribution (ID) regions is an intuitive strategy for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, but does such attraction improve detection? We investigate this question using class-conditioned Hamiltonian dynamics as a controlled testbed and identify an attraction-ranking mismatch: improving individual class-affinity scores need not improve the relative ordering of ID and OOD samples. Our analysis separates misalignment between the driving field and the detection score from ranking failure that persists even when they are aligned. An exact AUROC decomposition and a local boundary analysis identify relative score changes at the ID-OOD ranking boundary as the source of first-order AUROC change under regularity conditions. Experiments demonstrate that a score-aligned rule can improve performance on a held-out source validation split yet consistently degrade it after transfer, even without a single winning-class change. A separate perturbation study finds that near-boundary relative score changes track the direction of small AUROC changes in the tested settings. Finally, centroid approximation and shared scales connect the zero-step score to a static centroid family that includes the existing CTM detector. Together, these results explain why class attraction is insufficient to justify feature refinement and motivate evaluating its effect on the ranking boundary.

</details>


### [358] [Who Pays for the Knowledge Models Copy? Model Collapse as Rogers' Paradox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06022)
*Nam H. Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将模型崩溃重新表述为罗杰斯悖论：外部"新鲜知识"的供给是内生问题，而非给定条件。纯合成训练拟合罗杰斯模型可跨模型规模预测稀有知识保留率；世界变化越快，靠复制自身过去的谱系需越多新数据；当训练数据作者改用模型而非自行求知时，均衡下模型可靠性恰等于人们自学的成本，无模型时人口处境并无改善；只有携带新信息的核查（批判性学习）能打破悖论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有模型崩溃理论与补救方法都把"循环外信息"的供给视为外生给定（固定档案、固定分布），未解释该供给如何产生与维持。作者主张供给本身才是核心问题，并借用文化进化理论（罗杰斯悖论）为其提供理论框架：依赖复制的人群最终并不优于从不复制者，因为复制品会过时，除非有人坚持自主学习。

Method: 三步识别检验：(1) 仅用全合成训练数据拟合罗杰斯模型，外推到其他新鲜数据混合比例下语言模型（词三元组到预训练Transformer）的稀有知识保留率；(2) 构造世界本身变化的非平稳环境，比较"复制自身过去"的谱系与"每代从固定预训练权重重启"的谱系所需新鲜数据量随变化速率的关系，并与假设固定目标的既有分析对照；(3) 闭合循环，令训练数据撰写者可向模型提问而非自行查证，使新鲜数据供给内生化，求均衡并分析过滤/核查机制的性质。

Result: (1) 罗杰斯模型对稀有知识保留率的预测误差仅为几个百分点，且跨多种模型规模成立；(2) 世界变化越快，自我复制谱系维持性能所需新鲜数据越多，符合罗杰斯模型而固定目标分析无法给出此预测；从固定预训练权重重启的谱系基本不受影响，因其权重是"从不被复制的知识"；(3) 均衡下模型可靠度恰等于人们自学的成本，人口并不比无模型时更好，模型生成文本占比的每次提升都须由更多人自学来偿付；核查并纠错重学的用户可打破悖论。

Conclusion: 模型崩溃的根源在于新鲜知识的供给机制，而非单纯的误差累积。文化进化理论提供了可定量预测的框架。仅挑选"看似合理"文本的过滤器属从众式学习，会加速崩溃；只有携带新信息的核查才构成批判性学习，是维持模型与群体知识水平的必要条件。

Abstract: Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the loop, and the theory of model collapse treats that supply as given: a fixed archive, drawn from a fixed distribution. We argue that the supply is the problem, and that cultural evolution has the theory of it. We read model collapse as Rogers' paradox: a population that comes to rely on copying ends up no better off than one that never copied, because copies go stale unless someone keeps learning for themselves. We test the identification in three steps. First, Rogers' model, fitted only to fully synthetic training, predicts to within a few percentage points how much rare knowledge language models, from word trigrams to a pretrained transformer, retain under other mixtures of fresh data. Second, when the world itself changes, a lineage that copies its own past needs more fresh data to keep up the faster the world changes, as Rogers' model says it must and as analyses that assume a fixed target cannot; a lineage that restarts every generation from fixed pretrained weights is largely insulated, because those weights are knowledge that is never copied. Third, we close the loop: when the people who write a model's training data can ask the model instead of finding things out, the supply of fresh data becomes endogenous. At equilibrium, the model is exactly as reliable as it is costly for people to find out for themselves, the population is no better off than without the model, and every increase in the share of model-written text must be paid for by more people learning for themselves. Users who check what they are told and relearn when it is wrong break the paradox. Filters that select plausible text are conformist and accelerate collapse; only checks that carry new information act as critical learning.

</details>


### [359] [Practical Estimation of the Bayes Optimal Fairness-Accuracy Tradeoff with Soft Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06027)
*Mohit Sharma,Okan Koç,Amit Deshpande,Takashi Ishida,Gang Niu,Rajiv Ratn Shah,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将贝叶斯误差概念推广到带公平约束的分类问题，推导出"公平贝叶斯错误率"的显式表达，并提出仅依赖软标签与群体信息的无实例一致估计器，理论上有界偏差与样本复杂度，实验上能稳健、低方差地刻画最优公平-精度权衡曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典贝叶斯误差是分类性能的根本极限，可用于衡量模型与检测过拟合，但现有二分类贝叶斯误差估计只针对无约束情形且仅用软标签。公平分类作为约束/多目标分类的重要场景，存在内在的公平-精度权衡（Pareto前沿），却缺乏对该权衡根本极限的刻画工具，因此需要定义并估计受公平约束下的贝叶斯误差。

Method: （1）在公平约束（不同人口群体间真阳性率相等或近似相等）下定义公平贝叶斯错误率，即满足给定公平约束时可达到的最优错误率；（2）推导其显式表达式；（3）构造仅使用软标签（正类概率）与群体信息的无实例（instance-free）估计器，并证明其一致性；（4）从理论上给出估计器的偏差界与样本复杂度界。

Result: 理论上证明了估计器的一致性并给出偏差与样本复杂度的可证明界；实验上，该方法能生成稳健、低方差的公平-精度最优权衡曲线估计，即便软标签存在噪声或由基于硬标签训练的分类模型导出时依然有效。

Conclusion: 公平贝叶斯错误率可作为公平分类的基准与过拟合检测准则，其估计无需输入特征或额外训练，仅凭软标签与群体标签即可一致估计，为评估与比较公平分类器、刻画公平-精度Pareto前沿提供了可靠的理论与实用工具。

Abstract: There is a fundamental limit to the best prediction error of any model for a given data distribution. In classification, the Bayes error quantifies this limit and serves as both a benchmark for trained models and a criterion to detect overfitting. The state-of-the-art Bayes error estimation techniques for binary classification use only soft labels (positive class probabilities) and require no input features or auxiliary training. We extend such notions to constrained classification problems, such as fairness. Fair classification is an important case of constrained or multi-objective classification. It requires a model not only to be accurate but also to yield fair outcomes (equal or near-equal true positive rates) across different demographic groups (e.g., race and gender). This leads to an inherent fairness-accuracy tradeoff or a Pareto frontier that is used to compare fair classifiers against each other. The focus of our work is to estimate the fundamental limit for this fairness-accuracy tradeoff. We derive an explicit expression for the fair Bayes error rate (i.e., best achievable error rate subject to given fairness constraints), and construct consistent, instance-free estimators for it using only soft labels and group information. We provably bound the bias and the sample complexity of our estimators. Empirically, our method produces a robust, low-variance estimate of the optimal fairness-accuracy tradeoff curve, even when the soft labels are noisy and derived from a classification model on hard labels.

</details>


### [360] [TRACK: Multiple Instance Learning for Anti-Money Laundering in Transaction Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06035)
*Seonkyu Lim,Inwoo Tae,Gwangui Hong,Jaehoon Lee,Jeongwhan Choi,Taehoon Kim,Min-Soo Kim,Yongjae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“聚合失配”问题，将账户级反洗钱检测重构为多实例学习，并提出TRACK方法：共享编码器编码每笔交易后选择性池化为账户决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AML调查以账户为中心，但可疑证据往往只存在于少数交易中；而现有账户级检测器先对交易做汇总再学习，消息传递模型还会在账户间再次聚合，导致证据信息被稀释，即“聚合失配”。

Method: 以“账户窗口内至少有一笔交易被标记”定义基准标签，将账户级检测视为多实例学习（账户窗口为bag，交易为instance）。提出TRACK：用共享编码器编码每笔交易，再选择性池化（selective pooling）为账户级决策；训练中刻意隐藏五个AML数据集的交易级标签以模拟粗粒度监督。

Result: 在时间顺序协议下，TRACK在每个数据集上的平均精度（AP）均高于由账户标签训练的表模型与图基线；仅用账户窗口监督仍可与直接用交易标签训练的边分类器竞争；其instance分数对已标记交易的排序显著优于随机，并在多个数据集上接近或超过直接监督的排序性能。

Conclusion: 通过避免早期汇总、直接在交易粒度建模并选择性池化，可在仅账户级弱监督下实现高质量账户级AML检测与交易级证据排序，验证了多实例学习范式的有效性。

Abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) investigations are organized around accounts, while the suspicious evidence for an account may reside in only a few of its transactions. Yet many account-level detectors summarize transactions before learning, and message-passing models may aggregate once more over neighboring accounts. We name this discrepancy the aggregation mismatch and study it under an account-window benchmark label defined by the presence of at least one flagged transaction. We recast account-level AML detection as multiple instance learning, in which an account-window is a bag and its transactions are instances. We propose TRACK, which encodes every transaction with a shared encoder and selectively pools the encodings into an account decision. To emulate coarse supervision, we withhold the transaction labels of five AML datasets from TRACK throughout training. Under a time-ordered protocol, TRACK achieves the highest average precision among the tabular and graph baselines trained from account labels on every dataset. Despite using only account-window supervision, it remains competitive with edge classifiers trained directly from transaction labels. Its instance scores also rank flagged transactions well above chance and approach or exceed directly supervised ranking performance across datasets.

</details>


### [361] [Act-HiMotif: Hierarchical Daily Activity Schedule Generation via Learned Activity-Structure Motifs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06038)
*Yushi Bai,Kang Liu,Ling Yin,Wei Wang,Yilin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Act-HiMotif：以可复用活动结构"motif"为中间表示的分层生成模型，从个体属性生成日活动日程，在分布内与空间泛化上均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从个体属性（年龄、收入等）生成日活动日程对基于活动的出行建模与人类行为仿真有价值。难点有二：精确活动结构呈高度不平衡的长尾分布；在全天预算固定时，同一结构可对应多种时长分配。直接生成需从极不均衡观测中学习大量精确结构并建模其时间实现。作者观察到许多精确结构共享重复出现的活动组织模式，可借此共享统计支撑。

Method: 提出分层、基于motif的生成模型。引入可学习的、可复用的活动结构motif作为个体画像与具体活动结构之间的中间表示。流程为三阶段：①区分"仅居家日"与"活动日"；②从以个体画像为条件的先验中采样motif，指导活动结构生成；③用预算约束的时长分配器生成时长，使总时长精确等于全天时域。各层级分别建模仅居家路由、结构生成与时长分配；motif使相关结构共享统计支撑而不丢失其各自序列。

Result: 在大规模出行调查数据上的实验表明，Act-HiMotif在分布内与空间泛化两种设定下均优于强基线，验证了分层生成与可复用活动结构motif在生成真实、以画像为条件的日活动日程上的有效性。

Conclusion: 将活动结构解耦为"可复用motif+具体序列"，并把仅居家路由、结构生成、时长分配分层处理，可有效缓解长尾不平衡与预算约束下多时长分配的双重困难；该方法在跨空间泛化上同样有效。

Abstract: Generating daily activity schedules from individual attributes (e.g., age and income) is valuable for activity-based travel modeling and human behavior simulation. The task is challenging because exact activity structures follow a highly imbalanced, long-tailed distribution, while the same structure can admit multiple duration allocations under a fixed full-day budget. Direct generation must therefore learn many exact activity structures from highly uneven observations while modeling their possible temporal realizations. However, many exact structures share recurring activity organization. Based on this observation, we propose Act-HiMotif, a hierarchical motif-based generative model that introduces learned, reusable activity-structure motifs as an intermediate representation between individual profiles and specific activity structures. Act-HiMotif first distinguishes home-only days from active days, then samples a motif from a profile-conditioned prior to guide activity-structure generation, and finally applies a budget-constrained duration allocator to generate activity durations that sum exactly to the full-day horizon. This hierarchy models home-only routing, activity-structure generation, and duration allocation at their corresponding levels, while motifs allow related structures to share statistical support without losing their distinct sequences. Experiments on large-scale travel survey data show that Act-HiMotif outperforms strong baselines in both in-distribution and spatial generalization settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical generation and reusable activity-structure motifs for producing realistic profile-conditioned daily activity schedules.

</details>


### [362] [Alleviating Limited Effectiveness and Multi-Class Collapse in Deep Graph-level Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06052)
*Xiaoyang Lin,Renchi Yang,Yuqi Chen,Xin Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 S³GLC 框架，融合全局拓扑特征（Spectral Signature，基于 Hoffman-Wielandt 不等式作为 GED 下界）与局部空间表示（GIN），并通过最优传输 + Sinkhorn-Knopp 均衡聚类目标缓解聚类坍缩，在 10 个真实数据集上显著优于 15 个 SOTA 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图级聚类（GLC）中，GIN 作为事实上的编码器忽视全局拓扑，导致无法区分结构不同的图；同时现有深度聚类框架在类别不均衡的多类场景下存在严重的"聚类坍缩"问题。

Method: 1) 基于 Hoffman-Wielandt 不等式构造 Spectral Signature，作为图编辑距离（GED）的严格下界，作为全局拓扑特征的高效代理；2) 提出联合流形保持稀疏回归模块，融合 Spectral Signature 与空间表示，在去噪的同时保留互补信息；3) 引入基于最优传输的均衡聚类目标，利用 Sinkhorn-Knopp 归一化对簇分配施加均分约束以缓解聚类坍缩。

Result: 在 10 个真实数据集上与 15 个 SOTA 基线对比，S³GLC 显著领先，在 REDDIT-12K、OGBG-PPA 等基准上取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 全局拓扑与局部邻域特征的融合、以及基于最优传输的均衡约束，能有效提升 GLC 的判别性与稳定性，尤其在类别不均衡场景下。

Abstract: Given a collection of $N$ graphs, graph-level clustering (GLC) seeks to partition the $N$ graphs into semantically meaningful groups, which serves as a fundamental task in analyzing graph-structured data. While Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) have become the de facto encoders for GLC, they still fail to distinguish graphs due to their neglect of global topology. On top of that, existing deep clustering frameworks suffer from severe "clustering collapse" issues, particularly in imbalanced multi-class scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose S$^3$GLC, a novel framework that integrates global topological characteristics with local neighborhood features for balanced GLC. Theoretically, we leverage the Hoffman-Wielandt inequality to construct Spectral Signature as a rigorous lower bound for graph edit distance (GED), providing a computationally efficient proxy for global topological features. We additionally propose a joint manifold-preserving sparse regression module to fuse Spectral Signature with Spatial Representation, eliminating noise while preserving the complementary information. Furthermore, to mitigate clustering collapse, we introduce a balanced clustering objective based on optimal transport, harnessing the Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization to enforce equipartition constraints on cluster assignments. Extensive experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that S$^3$GLC significantly outperforms 15 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving remarkable improvements on benchmark datasets such as REDDIT-12K and OGBG-PPA.

</details>


### [363] [Learning From Static Context in Federated Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06064)
*Viktor Walter,Andreas Wagner,Fabian Stricker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 联邦学习中每客户端持有单序列时，时间融合Transformer（TFT）的静态输入在客户端内部恒定、仅跨客户端变化。逐batch聚合的FedAdam几乎能像集中训练一样利用该静态信息，而带本地epoch的通信高效方案（FedAvg、FedAdam+Prox）几乎提取不到，且在两个应用数据集上无显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测正从按序列本地训练转向跨异构序列的全局模型，需要学习"序列间的差异"。数据无法集中时用联邦学习（每数据属主一客户端）。TFT等SOTA预测器靠一个不随时间变化的静态输入区分序列；在每客户端仅持单序列的联邦场景下，该静态输入在客户端内恒定、仅跨客户端变化，因此作者追问：联邦TFT能否从中学到东西。

Method: 对比不同联邦聚合方案（逐batch FedAdam、FedAvg、FedAdam+Prox、Adam兼容的SCAFFOLD）对TFT静态通路的利用程度；在建筑能耗电表数据、风电数据集及受控合成数据集上验证；并在合成与风电数据上检验另外两种具有不同静态条件机制的架构，以确认该损失并非TFT特有。

Result: 逐batch FedAdam在利用静态输入上接近集中训练；FedAvg与FedAdam+Prox提取甚少，在两个应用数据集均无显著增益；同等本地计算下，Adam兼容SCAFFOLD在风电数据上保持静态通路活跃并取得显著增益，在建筑能耗上误差虽下降但静态通路"沉默"，因而漂移与通信频率无法完全解耦为因；仅逐batch FedAdam在所有数据集上达到或超过各客户端本地模型；合成与风电数据上另两种架构亦呈现该损失。

Conclusion: 通信高效（带本地epoch）的联邦方案会显著削弱TFT静态条件通路的效用，该现象跨数据集与架构普遍存在；逐batch FedAdam是唯一在各数据集上不劣于本地模型的方案。建筑能耗上静态通路沉默使漂移与通信频率的归因仍待厘清。

Abstract: Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series apart. When the raw data cannot be centralized, such a global model is trained with federated learning (FL), one client per data owner. State-of-the-art forecasters such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) tell series apart through a static input that describes each series and does not change over time. In the special case of a federated setting where each client holds a single series, this static input is constant within each client and varies only across clients. We ask whether a federated TFT can learn from it. Per-batch FedAdam, which aggregates gradients after every batch, uses the static input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing significant on either application dataset. At the same local computation, an Adam-compatible SCAFFOLD keeps the static pathway responsive on wind power and gains significantly there. On building energy its error still drops, but the static pathway falls silent, so drift and communication frequency cannot be fully separated as the cause. Only per-batch FedAdam matches or beats the per-client local models across all datasets. We confirm the effect on building-energy meter data, a wind-power dataset, and a controlled synthetic dataset. The loss is not specific to the TFT: on the synthetic and the wind data two further architectures with different static-conditioning mechanisms show it as well.

</details>


### [364] [Catastrophic Overfitting is Weight Drift the Training Loss Cannot See](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06082)
*Chao Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将快速对抗训练中的灾难性过拟合（CO）重新解释为权重的"静默逃逸"：CO前后训练目标几乎不变，故目标函数对该位移近乎"失明"，而训练中已维护的权重EMA不累积此漂移，因此可在验证鲁棒性下降时回滚到EMA，实现近乎零成本的修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FAT用单步攻击替代多步攻击以降低鲁棒训练成本，但会出现灾难性过拟合（CO）：训练中途对多步攻击的鲁棒性骤降至接近零，而训练所用的单步攻击仍被有效抵御。现有工作多从梯度混淆/步长等角度解释，本文希望给出更本质的机制解释，并据此设计低开销的修复方案。

Method: 1) 现象学分析：追踪CO事件前后权重，发现干净精度静默上升，而从CO前权重到CO后权重仅使训练目标发生微小变化，却摧毁大部分鲁棒性，说明目标函数对该位移不敏感、缺乏回拉梯度；2) 观察FAT协议中已有的权重EMA不累积该漂移，在整个CO事件中保持鲁棒；3) 提出防护机制：当验证鲁棒性下降时将权重重置为EMA值；4) 将其构建于一个基于耦合（coupling）的基础方法之上，使EMA平均权重保持在鲁棒区域内。

Result: 在全部实验运行中均消除CO；在三个基准数据集上取得快速方法中最强的AutoAttack准确率；在CIFAR-100上优势明显，并以约一半的计算成本超过多步参考方法。

Conclusion: CO可归因于训练目标对权重漂移的"失明"而非单纯优化不稳定；利用EMA回滚即可近乎零成本地消除CO，配合耦合式基础方法可同时兼顾鲁棒性、精度与训练效率，为大模型/大数据下的鲁棒训练提供实用方案。

Abstract: Fast adversarial training (FAT) makes robust training affordable by replacing the multi-step attack with a single-step one, but it suffers from catastrophic overfitting (CO): partway through training, robustness to multi-step attacks collapses to near zero while the single-step attack used for training keeps being repelled. We show that CO is a quiet escape of the weights. Across the event the network's clean behavior quietly improves, and moving from the weights just before CO to those just after it changes the training objective only marginally while destroying most of the robustness. The training objective is therefore nearly blind to the displacement it causes, so it exerts no force to undo it. The exponential moving average (EMA) of the weights, which FAT protocols already maintain, does not accumulate this drift and stays robust through the entire event. This observation suggests a nearly free fix: when validation robustness drops, reset the weights to their EMA. We build this guard on top of a coupling-based base method designed so that its average stays inside the robust region. The resulting training removes CO in every one of our runs and attains the strongest AutoAttack accuracy among fast methods on all three benchmark datasets, including a clear margin on CIFAR-100, where it also clears the multi-step reference at roughly half its cost. Code is available at https://github.com/fzjcdt/co-weight-drift.

</details>


### [365] [Shallow Encoding Emits Deep Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06084)
*Mingyuan Ma,Yangmin Li,Harris Nover,Zheyu Fu,Po-Han Huang,Alex Settle,Ashwin Nanjappa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SEED利用混合语言模型的两个性质——深度层"写入"记忆比"读取"更简单、循环状态能量集中于秩一"sink"方向——在预填充阶段仅对last token之外的部分层计算、在解码阶段将循环状态表示为sink加低秩因子存储，从而实现几乎无损的推理加速，端到端吞吐提升1.2–1.4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合模型（少量softmax注意力层+大量线性注意力/状态空间层）每层都保留对历史token的记忆（KV cache或固定大小循环状态），服务时在这些记忆上消耗的算力和高带宽内存超出输出所需：prefill为每个prompt token跑所有层，每个decode step都要加载/存储完整循环状态，单个请求的状态字节数可达数千token注意力缓存的开销。

Method: 基于两个经验性质：(1) 写入易、读取难——训练得到的深层"写路径"副本(emitter)可从较浅anchor层的残差流直接写入深层的记忆表示，使除最后token外所有prompt token只跑至多63%的层；(2) 循环状态存在state sink——大部分能量集中于每个head固定方向的秩一项，其余为低秩工作记忆。据此将每个循环状态存储为sink加低秩因子，且Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention与Mamba-2的更新可精确在该表示上扩展；并证明周期压缩回低秩的开环误差有界且与压缩次数无关。权重冻结、不压缩注意力缓存、每个生成token仍运行全部层。

Result: 在5个生产级混合模型（30B至300B以上参数）的6个checkpoint上，于11项官方考试上几乎无损；在NVIDIA GB300 GPU上用SGLang服务，在agentic-coding负载上将Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的单GPU吞吐提升1.2–1.4倍。

Conclusion: 通过"预填充减深度、解码状态减表示"的解耦思路，SEED在不牺牲质量的前提下显著提升混合模型推理效率，且保持权重冻结、注意力缓存完整、逐token全层计算的通用性，适用于主流混合线性注意力架构。

Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave a few softmax-attention layers with many linear-attention or state-space layers, so every layer keeps a memory of earlier tokens: a key-value cache or a fixed-size recurrent state. Serving them spends more compute and high-bandwidth memory on these memories than the output requires. The prefill runs every layer for every prompt token, and every decode step loads and stores whole recurrent states, which on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next take as many bytes per request as the attention cache of thousands of tokens. We find two properties of trained hybrids that locate this excess. First, writes are easier than reads: writing a deep layer's memory of a token needs little of the deep computation that predicting the next token needs. Trained copies of the deep layers' write paths, which we call emitters, therefore write a prompt's deep memories from the residual stream of a shallower anchor layer, and all prompt tokens but the last run as few as 63% of the layers. Second, recurrent states have a state sink: most of their energy lies in a rank-one term along a fixed direction of each head, and the rest is a low-rank working memory. SEED builds on both: it makes the prefill shallow in depth and the decode state shallow in representation. Each recurrent state is stored as its sink plus low-rank factors, which the Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention and Mamba-2 updates extend exactly; we prove that the open-loop error of the periodic compressions back to low rank is bounded independently of their number. SEED keeps the original weights frozen, compresses no attention cache, and runs all layers for every generated token. On six checkpoints of five production hybrids of 30B to over 300B parameters, it is nearly lossless on eleven official exams. Served with SGLang on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs on an agentic-coding trace, it raises the per-GPU throughput of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 1.2-1.4x.

</details>


### [366] [Learning When to Think Aloud in Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06108)
*Zhehao Zhou,Tongrui Su,Shengyu Zhu,Da Li,Zeyu Liu,Jun Zhu,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VITAL 是一种重要性引导的混合推理框架，仅在关键位置显式生成"推理锚点"token，其余计算保持潜空间完成，兼顾精度与长度效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全潜空间（fully latent）CoT 虽高效，但在数学等精度敏感任务上表现不佳；现有混合方法仍保留大量 token 生成开销。因此需要一个只对信息量高的 token 进行显式表达的折中方案。

Method: 1) 用 token 重要性估计从显式 CoT 构建混合轨迹；2) 轻量 gating head 动态决定是生成显式 token 还是直接回传隐藏状态；3) 先做课程式监督训练，再进行以"正确性+简洁性"为奖励的强化学习。

Result: 与全潜方法相比，在相近推理长度下 GPT-2 上平均准确率相对提升 9.6%，Llama-3.2-1B 上提升 5.1%；与混合基线相比，在 Qwen3-1.7B 上以更短的推理轨迹取得更高准确率。

Conclusion: 选择性显式化关键 token 的混合范式可同时优于全潜方法与常规混合方法，在效率与精度间取得更好权衡。

Abstract: Latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning improves efficiency by shifting intermediate computation into continuous hidden states. However, fully latent methods often struggle on precision-critical tasks such as mathematical reasoning, while existing hybrid approaches retain substantial token-generation overhead. We introduce VITAL, an importance-guided hybrid reasoning framework that selectively verbalizes informative tokens as reasoning anchors while keeping most computation latent. A lightweight gating head dynamically selects between explicit token generation and direct hidden-state feedback. VITAL constructs hybrid trajectories from explicit CoT using token- importance estimation and trains the model through curriculum-based supervised training, followed by reinforcement learning with a reward that balances correctness and conciseness. Experiments show that VITAL consistently out- performs existing fully latent reasoning methods, achieving relative average accuracy gains of 9.6% on GPT-2 and 5.1% on Llama-3.2-1B at comparable reasoning lengths. Compared with hybrid baselines, VITAL achieves higher reasoning accuracy with substantially shorter reasoning trajectories on Qwen3-1.7B.

</details>


### [367] [Short-Term Forecasting of Heterogeneous Wind Power Fleets: Global Temporal Fusion Transformer Leveraging Static Covariates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06130)
*Viktor Walter,Andreas Wagner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究一个在德国多个风电场组合上联合训练的全局时序融合Transformer（TFT）是否在48小时风电预测中优于单场站本地模型。在100个合成风电场与11个真实风电场上，全局TFT分别对87%和77%的场站优于本地模型并显著优于线性基线，但该优势依赖静态协变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer类深度学习虽为当前最优方法，但工业实践仍多为针对单一资产的本地模型训练；作者希望验证跨异质场站组合的全局建模能否在保持或提升精度的同时降低运维复杂度。

Method: 构建全局TFT，联合训练德国多风电场组合，输入ICON-D2与ECMWF HRES的NWP数据；利用静态协变量（场站年龄、海拔、轮毂高度、转子直径、功率曲线参数）学习跨场站共享表征；与本地模型及线性回归基线对比，在100个合成场站与11个真实场站、两个季节测试期（含中期再训练）上评估，并用Wilcoxon符号秩检验验证显著性；通过变量选择网络（VSN）解析特征重要性。

Result: 全局TFT在87%的合成风电场和77%的真实风电场上优于本地模型，且明显优于线性基线；Wilcoxon检验表明优势在两个季节与两个数据集上均显著。剔除静态协变量后全局模型无法泛化，说明其优势依赖资产特定上下文。VSN显示：海拔在两个数据集上均为相关静态判别因子，轮毂高度在真实组合中起决定作用；编码器偏好历史功率，解码器融合两个NWP模型的高空风速，与误差平均化一致。

Conclusion: 结果支持从单场站预测转向可扩展的多场站全局预测：在大规模组合中既提升精度又降低运维复杂度；静态协变量是全局模型跨站泛化的关键前提。

Abstract: Accurate short-term wind power forecasting is critical for grid stability and electricity trading. While transformer-based deep learning is state of the art, industry practice relies mostly on local models trained for individual assets. This study investigates whether a global temporal fusion transformer (TFT), trained jointly on a heterogeneous portfolio of wind farms across Germany, outperforms site-specific local models in 48-hour-ahead forecasting. Using numerical weather prediction (NWP) data from the regional ICON-D2 and the global ECMWF HRES models, we compare the global TFT against local models and a linear regression baseline. The global model leverages static covariates, such as farm age, altitude above sea level, hub height, rotor diameter and power curve parameters, to learn shared representations across sites. We evaluate on 100 synthetic wind farm profiles and a real portfolio of 11 German wind farms, across two seasonal test periods with intermediate retraining. The global TFT outperforms the local models for 87% of the synthetic and 77% of the real wind farms and clearly surpasses the linear baseline. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm that these gains are significant across both seasons and datasets. Crucially, this superiority depends on static covariates: without asset-specific context, the global model fails to generalize. The TFT's variable selection network (VSN) reveals the learned feature selection. Altitude emerges as a relevant static discriminator on both datasets, while hub height is decisive on the real portfolio. For dynamic inputs, the encoder prioritizes historical power, whereas the decoder combines upper-level wind speeds from both NWP models, consistent with averaging out model-specific errors. These findings support a shift from single-site to scalable multi-site forecasting, reducing operational complexity while improving accuracy in large portfolios.

</details>


### [368] [Neural Stochastic Forecasting for Lateral Molecular Diffusion Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06157)
*Jacob Ede Levine,Mario Hidalgo-Soria,Chen Yun Wen,Yun Lyna Luo,Sai Chandra Kosaraju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种神经随机（NS）模型，从粗粒化MD轨迹预测膜蛋白的集体扩散，可生成长达40,000帧的轨迹并保持MD的关键统计特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 膜蛋白长时扩散预测困难：MD模拟计算代价高，实验单粒子追踪受有限观测时间限制，现有变分自回归模型出现超扩散偏差。

Method: NS模型由三部分组成：基于Transformer的蛋白构型表征、多时间尺度循环网络、带可学习记忆的随机潜过程；再由交叉注意力解码器在考虑瞬时系统几何与周期性边界条件下生成相关蛋白位移。

Result: 在七个相互作用PIEZO通道体系与七个PIEZO+十个TREK混合体系中评估。七PIEZO体系复现MD测得的反常扩散指数α~1，显著优于呈超扩散的变分自回归模型；生成轨迹达40,000帧，并捕捉混合体系中PIEZO与TREK群体的不同扩散特性。

Conclusion: 时间平均均方位移、Van Hove位移分布与非高斯参数比较表明模型保留了模拟动力学的关键统计特征；神经随机建模是生成多蛋白膜扩散长轨迹、扩展MD统计分析的有前景方法。

Abstract: Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle tracking is often limited by finite observation times. Here, we introduce a neural stochastic (NS) model for forecasting the collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories. The model combines a transformer-based representation of protein configurations, recurrent networks operating at multiple temporal scales, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory. A cross-attention decoder then generates correlated protein displacements while accounting for the instantaneous system geometry and periodic boundary conditions. We evaluate the model in two membrane systems: seven interacting PIEZO channels and a mixed system containing seven PIEZO and ten TREK channels. For the seven PIEZO system, the NS model reproduces the anomalous diffusion exponent measured in MD simulations $α\sim 1$, substantially improving on a previously developed variational autoregressive model that exhibits superdiffusive behavior. The model also generates trajectories extending to 40,000 frames and captures the distinct diffusion characteristics of PIEZO and TREK populations in the mixed system. Comparisons of time-averaged mean-square displacements, Van Hove displacement distributions, and non-Gaussian parameters show that the model preserves key statistical features of the simulated dynamics. These results establish neural stochastic modeling as a promising approach for generating long trajectories of multi-protein membrane diffusion and extending the statistical analysis of molecular dynamics simulations.

</details>


### [369] [Selective Prediction Intervals: Jointly Learning to Predict, Bound, and Abstain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06158)
*Lidor Rubi,Gilad Katz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SelPI，在单一损失与显式接受率预算下联合训练区间、点值与弃权三个头；论证区间宽度不足以作为弃权依据，改用双门控加Fréchet惩罚耦合各自预算，在18个表格基准上以proper interval score优于宽度阈值与深度集成分歧选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险回归决策同时需要点估计、风险区间与可弃权能力。深度学习现有方法彼此割裂：预测区间方法对每个输入都返回区间（至多附带区间内点值），选择性预测方法只针对点预测学习何时弃权且不给出真值可能偏离的范围。作者要回答：区间宽度本身能否充当弃权信号？

Method: SelPI联合训练区间头、值头与弃权头，共享单一损失并施加显式接受率预算。弃权采用双门控：一个在区间损失上训练，一个在值损失上训练，通过Fréchet惩罚把二者各自的预算与联合接受率绑定。基线对照包括区间宽度阈值化与深度集成分歧选择，并固定基础预测器以隔离选择器贡献。

Result: 在18个表格基准上，宽度对大幅点误差预测良好（AUROC 0.72），但与区间miss呈反相关（AUROC 0.38），说明按宽区间弃权会丢掉区间恰好正确的输入。固定基础预测器时，学习门控在全部18个数据集上以proper interval score优于宽度阈值，中位数填补至oracle选择器差距的87%，并在每个数据集上优于深度集成分歧选择。优势随任务异方差性增强而扩大，论文同时报告了优势消失的设定。

Conclusion: 区间宽度不是可靠的弃权准则，原因在于其与点误差和区间miss的信号方向冲突，需分开建模。显式接受率预算下的多任务联合训练与双门控Fréchet耦合可有效提升选择性区间预测的质量，但收益依赖任务异方差程度，存在失效边界。

Abstract: Many high-stakes regression decisions ask three things of a model at once: a point estimate to act on, an interval that bounds the risk of acting, and the option to abstain when neither can be trusted. Deep learning provides these in isolation: prediction-interval methods return an interval, and at best a value estimate inside it, for every input, while selective-prediction methods learn when to abstain, but only for point predictions and with no statement of how far the truth may lie from the estimate. We introduce SelPI, which trains interval, value and abstention heads jointly under a single loss with an explicit acceptance-rate budget. A natural objection is that interval width already tells us when to abstain. We show that it does not: across 18 tabular benchmarks, width predicts large point errors well (AUROC 0.72) but is anti-correlated with interval misses (AUROC 0.38), so abstaining on wide intervals discards precisely the inputs the interval got right. SelPI therefore selects with two gates, one trained on the interval loss and one on the value loss, coupled by a Fr'echet penalty that ties their separate budgets to the joint acceptance rate they deliver. With the base predictor held fixed, the learned gate beats width thresholding on a proper interval score on all 18 tabular datasets, closing a median 87% of the gap to an oracle selector, and it also beats selection by deep-ensemble disagreement on every dataset. The advantage grows with the heteroscedasticity of the task, and we report the settings in which it disappears.

</details>


### [370] [FaCoDiff: Factor-Correlated Diffusion for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06166)
*Jiaxuan Li,Yao Liu,Yuewei Xue,Shijie Dong,Zixiang Jin,Xiaoyu Guo,Qiao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Factor-Correlated Diffusion (FaCoDiff)：用紧凑的条件因子估计器与结构化去噪耦合，在控制边际噪声尺度、避免稠密协方差开销的前提下学习跨变量依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量概率预测需同时建模边际不确定性与跨变量依赖。难点在于：学习依赖关系的同时控制边际噪声尺度，并避免稠密协方差的存储与分解成本。

Method: 历史条件化的因子载荷使用不同系数分别服务预测中心校正、尺度调整与噪声依赖；对角补偿保持估计的边际噪声方差；低秩算子实现残差高斯似然评估与噪声传输，无需稠密协方差；因子派生特征调制显式条件化去噪器；几何感知目标考虑噪声传输后的误差；同一条件几何同时支配前向扰动与反向采样。

Result: 在九个数据集上，FaCoDiff在八个数据集取得最低平均variogram分数，在54个数据集-指标组合中有43个位列前二。Solar与Weather上的匹配消融显示，在四种中心与尺度校正组合下因子协方差均改善Energy与Variogram分数；在保持边际轨迹的前提下破坏跨变量样本配对会使联合与聚合指标变差，说明生成的跨变量依赖具有预测价值。

Conclusion: 以低秩因子几何统一边际噪声控制与跨变量依赖建模，可在不引入稠密协方差成本的情况下提升多变量概率预测的联合分布质量；消融验证了因子协方差与跨变量配对结构的必要性。

Abstract: Multivariate probabilistic forecasting requires modeling cross-variable dependence alongside marginal uncertainty. The challenge is to learn this dependence while controlling marginal noise scales and avoiding dense covariance costs. We propose Factor-Correlated Diffusion (FaCoDiff), which couples a compact conditional statistical estimator with structured denoising. History-conditioned factor loadings use distinct coefficients for forecast-center correction, scale adjustment and noise dependence. Diagonal compensation preserves the estimated marginal noise variances, while low-rank operators enable residual Gaussian likelihood evaluation and noise transport without dense covariance storage or factorization. Factor-derived feature modulation explicitly conditions the denoiser, and a geometry-aware objective accounts for errors after noise transport. The same conditional geometry governs forward perturbations and reverse sampling. Across nine datasets, FaCoDiff achieves the lowest mean variogram score on eight datasets and ranks among the top two on 43 of 54 dataset-metric combinations in the reported comparisons. Matched ablations on Solar and Weather show that factor covariance improves mean Energy and Variogram scores under all four combinations of center and scale correction. Disrupting cross-variable sample pairings while preserving marginal trajectories worsens joint and aggregate scores on both datasets, demonstrating the predictive value of generated cross-variable dependence.

</details>


### [371] [GPUMAP: GPU-Accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06191)
*Myeongwon Jung,Jaemin Jo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GPU加速的渐进式UMAP（GPUMAP），将UMAP拆解为可增量执行的流水线，支持百万级数据集的交互式降维分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降维是高维数据分析的基础手段，但计算开销大，难以用于交互场景；同时渐进式降维本身的行为特性尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 识别UMAP中三个原子操作并重组为渐进式流水线；引入操作队列、逐实例局部连接（instance-wise local join）与调度策略对UMAP进行改造；利用GPU并行加速，在消费级硬件上实现百万规模数据的交互分析；并借此实现系统研究投影随时间的演化及其相对真实投影的偏差，以及有偏数据流对投影质量与稳定性的影响。

Result: 在消费级GPU上实现百万级数据集的交互式渐进降维；并给出渐进投影随时间相对真实投影的演化规律，以及有偏数据流对投影质量与稳定性的影响分析。

Conclusion: 通过算法重构与GPU并行，渐进式UMAP可满足交互需求，并为渐进降维的行为特性提供了系统性实证认识。

Abstract: Dimensionality reduction (DR) techniques are fundamental to the analysis of high-dimensional data, yet their substantial computational cost limits their use in interactive settings. To address this limitation, we present GPU-accelerated Progressive Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (GPUMAP), an efficient progressive DR algorithm designed for interactive use. We identify three atomic operations within UMAP and restructure them into a progressive pipeline. As part of this adaptation, we introduce modifications to UMAP, including operation queues, instance-wise local join, and scheduling strategies. We further accelerate computation by leveraging GPU parallelism, enabling interactive analysis of million-scale datasets on commodity GPU hardware. Finally, we employ our implementation to systematically study the behavior of progressive DR, investigating how projections evolve over time relative to the ground-truth projection and how biased data streams influence the quality and stability of the resulting projections.

</details>


### [372] [Cross-Asset Knowledge Transfer for Early Fault Detection of Data-Scarce Assets Without Target Fault Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06194)
*Zekai Wang,Yuxuan Li,Zhangyue Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将跨资产早期故障检测建模为“零样本域适应”（目标域无故障样本），提出仅需目标正常数据的ADANN框架，结合EWMA统计过程控制自动标注源域数据、域对抗+MMD+ACD损失对齐特征，实现数据稀缺资产上的早期故障预警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业车队生命周期数据高度不平衡：少数量资产有完整的run-to-failure故障历史，而新装或低故障率资产仅有正常工况数据。传统诊断模型难以在无目标故障样本条件下部署，亟需从数据丰富的“源资产”向数据稀缺的“目标资产”迁移诊断知识。

Method: （1）基于EWMA控制图的统计过程控制步骤，对源资产run-to-failure数据自动打标签，仅需人工核验被标记片段；（2）提出Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network（ADANN），融合域对抗训练、MMD惩罚与Adapted Classification-Domain（ACD）损失——将分类器的正常区域锚定在目标自身正常数据上；（3）采用带预测视界的提前（ahead-of-time）标注方案以捕获早期/萌芽故障。并在“精确分类”假设下给出理论分析，刻画仅含正常样本的目标域下域对抗项的作用及源故障特征与目标正常特征保持分离的对齐状态。

Result: 在公开run-to-failure轴承数据集上，ADANN在四个迁移基线中取得最高平均F1，且相对最强基线取得名义上显著的精确率提升；同时在合成噪声条件下考察了其鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 零样本域适应设定（目标仅需正常数据）可有效支撑跨资产早期故障检测；域对抗+MMD+ACD的组合能在缺乏目标故障样本时维持源故障特征与目标正常特征的分离，配合自动标注与提前预测视界，为工业车队可靠性管理提供可行路径。

Abstract: Reliability management of industrial fleets depends on early fault warnings, yet lifecycle data across similar assets are highly imbalanced. A few assets accumulate run-to-failure histories, while newly installed or rarely failing assets provide only normal-condition data. This paper asks how diagnostic knowledge can be transferred from a data-rich source asset to a data-scarce target asset when no fault data have been observed on the target. We formulate cross-asset early fault detection as a zero-shot domain adaptation problem, in which zero-shot refers to the absence of target fault samples, and propose a framework that requires only normal data from the target. The framework comprises (1) a statistical process control step that labels the source asset run-to-failure data with an exponentially weighted moving average chart, reducing manual annotation to verifying flagged segments, (2) an Adapted Domain-Adversarial Neural Network (ADANN) that combines domain-adversarial training and a Maximum Mean Discrepancy penalty with an Adapted Classification-Domain (ACD) loss, which anchors the classifier normal region to the target own normal data, and (3) an ahead-of-time labeling scheme with a prediction horizon that targets incipient faults. Under an exact-classification assumption, a theoretical analysis characterizes the domain-adversarial term for a normal-only target and the alignment state in which source fault features remain separated from target normal features. On a public run-to-failure bearing dataset, ADANN attains the highest mean F1-score among four transfer baselines, with a nominally significant precision gain over the strongest baseline, and its robustness is examined under synthetic noise.

</details>


### [373] [Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06228)
*Yuda Bi,Yubo Guo,Jiaxiao Cai,Xiaonai Li,Zhuolin Li,Vince D. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在方差随环境变化的多环境设定下，即使所有独立成分都是高斯的，也可通过$K$个协方差的联合对角化实现分离；其可分离性由每个成分的"签名"（跨环境方差）决定，而样本复杂度服从由签名张成维数决定的三档"维数律"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典ICA理论指出所有成分均为高斯时不可辨识，从而无法分离。该文探讨一个自然补救途径：若各成分方差在不同环境下发生变化，则高斯成分亦可能被恢复。核心问题是：需要多少环境、以及随成分数$d$增长需要多少样本——即给出样本复杂度与环境数的精确标度与下界。

Method: 对$K$个协方差做联合对角化（joint diagonalization）。为每个成分$j$定义"签名"——其在各环境下的方差向量（位于$K-1$维空间）；用该签名的Riesz 2-能量$E_j$（等于对其余成分的逆成对Fisher信息之和）刻画分离成分$j$的难度。作者给出对任意估计量的下界（$O(d)$复杂度内任何估计量都无法优于$cE_j/(n+E_j)$），并证明在显式样本量阈值以上，一个谱（spectral）估计量可在任意混合条件下、无需知道签名即达到$E_j/n$（至常数），前提是成对信息有下界。

Result: 由于签名位于$K-1$维，误差率遵循维数律：$K=2$时为$d^2/n$，$K=3$时为$d\log d/n$，$K\ge4$且环境充分分散时为$d/n$。关键因素是签名张成的维数而非签名（环境）个数：$\log d$个精心设计的环境即可使$d\log d$样本足够。此外，将协方差投影到单一线性组合仅在一阶上需$d^2/n$。至$d=1000$的仿真验证了预测；$K\ge4$的联合对角化在$n/d$达数百量级时达到该率。在任务fMRI数据上，该能量指标能指出哪些成分难以分离。

Conclusion: 高斯独立成分可在多环境方差变化下被辨识与分离，其样本复杂度由签名所张成子空间的维数决定，存在匹配的下界与可实现的谱估计量；这为多环境ICA提供了紧的统计率与实用的可分离性诊断（$E_j$）。

Abstract: Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. For Gaussian sources no estimator in $O(d)$ beats $cE_j/(n+E_j)$ at any $n$ and $d$, and above an explicit sample size a spectral estimator attains $E_j/n$ up to a constant, for every mixing and without the signatures (given a lower bound on the pairwise information). Since signatures live in $K-1$ dimensions, the rate obeys a dimension law: $d^2/n$, $d\log d/n$ and $d/n$ for $K=2$, $3$ and $K\ge4$ well-spread environments. What counts is the dimension the signatures span, not their number, and $\log d$ well-designed environments make $d\log d$ samples suffice. Projecting the covariances onto one linear combination pays $d^2/n$ at first order instead. In simulations up to $d=1000$ the predictions hold and joint diagonalization with $K\ge4$ attains the rate once $n/d$ is in the hundreds; on task fMRI the energy says which components are hard to separate.

</details>


### [374] [Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06244)
*Sumeet Ramesh Motwani,Tejas Krishnan,Alistair Letcher,Charles London,Suhaas Bhat,Huitian Jiao,Philip Torr,Riashat Islam,Christopher Summerfield,Jakob Foerster,Christian Schroeder de Witt,Qilong Gu,Shital Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Rubric Curriculum RL（RcRL），利用"生成-验证差距"，将 rollout 间的成对偏好与 rubric 准则课程结合，在无需新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型的条件下，为开放式任务提供更具判别力且非平稳的奖励信号，显著提升创作写作与医疗问答表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 在数学与代码等可验证任务上收益显著，但开放式领域缺乏 ground-truth 验证、人工标注昂贵、学习型奖励模型易被 reward hacking。虽然"评判优于生成"的生成-验证差距提供改进路径，但现有基于 rubric 的评判器往往不够精确且是平稳的（stationary），策略容易过拟合或对其 reward hack。

Method: RcRL 不引入新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型，而是：1）用 rollout 间的成对偏好（pairwise preferences）替代绝对打分，获得更具判别力的信号；2）在 rubric 准则上设计课程（curriculum），使优化目标随时间非平稳化，从而抑制过拟合与奖励攻击。

Result: 基线方法在数百步内即进入平台期，而 RcRL 保持输出熵并在超过 1000 步后仍持续提升。在创意写作上，相对基座模型取得 70.5% 的人工胜率，且在多个基准与评判器上均有增益；在 HealthBench 上，相对基座模型提升 14.6%（全集）与 25.4%（共识子集），优于包括实例级 rubric 在内的所有训练基线。

Conclusion: 通过成对偏好与 rubric 课程相结合，RcRL 有效利用生成-验证差距，为开放式领域提供了可持续、抗 hacking 的强化学习奖励信号，并带来实质性性能提升。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.

</details>


### [375] [Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06255)
*Hongeun Kim,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LeNO，将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为学习式残差传输，实现单次噪声修正的少步生成奖励对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流模型的奖励对齐多建立在随机轨迹上，不适配少步确定性生成器；无梯度初始噪声优化需推理时逐样本昂贵搜索。

Method: 冻结预训练生成器，学习锚点条件下的噪声修正分布（残差传输），用Local GRPO结合标量奖励训练；对高斯初始噪声配合保范投影，推导修正分布与原始先验间KL的上界作为正则目标。

Result: 在少步文生图与蛋白质结构生成（含昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上，单次噪声修正即提升目标奖励，同时基本保持生成质量与多样性。

Conclusion: LeNO以摊销训练替代测试时迭代优化，为少步确定性生成器提供高效、可正则化的奖励对齐方案。

Abstract: Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein structure generation, including expensive black-box designability rewards. Across both domains, LeNO improves target rewards with a single noise correction at inference while largely preserving generation quality and diversity.

</details>


### [376] [Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06265)
*Yun Young Choi,Asung Kil,Sun Woo Park,Minho Lee,Seokhwan Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出常用GNN隐含正定几何先验（热扩散需半正定算子、双曲模型用正定流形、点积/GAT注意力用正定内积），在异配图上该先验失配；提出图签名指数s_G（仅由标签拓扑构建的类别兼容矩阵的惯性）并证明(0,1)内任何同配度都无法排除负特征值；进而设计伪黎曼注意力网络PRAT，注意力logit为可学习对角度量下的有符号平方伪距离，度量由s_G初始化；15个节点分类基准上不劣于最强异配模型，消融显示禁止度量不定时在s_G判定为不定的图上精度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流GNN族（热扩散式图卷积、双曲模型、点积与GAT注意力）都携带正定几何先验。在异配图上边常表示不相似或结构排斥，正定形式无法为标签分离方向赋予负平方距离，构成先验失配；而同配度指标在(0,1)内无法排除负特征值，故需一种可诊断该失配的指标与相应模型。

Method: 1) 定义Graph Signature Index s_G：由仅依赖标签拓扑的类别兼容矩阵的惯性（正/负特征值计数）刻画失配；2) PRAT采用“先诊断后学习”：以s_G初始化可学习对角伪黎曼度量，注意力logit取该度量下的有符号平方伪距离；3) 签名提供符号结构，无约束训练将其保持在近零方向之外，投影仅学习度量其余部分。

Result: 在15个节点分类基准上，PRAT优于或匹配最强的异配自适应模型。控制消融：固定架构与协议，禁止度量为不定时，被s_G标记为不定的图精度下降，其余图不变。

Conclusion: 异配图上的负特征值失配无法由同配度排除，需显式引入不定（伪黎曼）几何；有符号平方伪距离与签名初始化是关键，符号结构本身而非额外容量带来性能增益。

Abstract: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. We then propose the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT), whose attention logit is a signed squared pseudo-distance under a learnable diagonal metric initialized from $s_{\mathcal{G}}$. The design is diagnose-then-learn: the signature supplies a sign structure that unconstrained training keeps outside near-zero directions, and the projection learns the rest of the metric around it. Across fifteen node-classification benchmarks PRAT outperforms or matches the strongest heterophily-adapted models. A controlled ablation ties that performance to the sign structure itself: with architecture and protocol fixed, forbidding the metric to be indefinite costs accuracy on the graphs $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ marks as indefinite and leaves the others unchanged.

</details>


### [377] [The Split Protocol Decides the Result: Re-Evaluating Encrypted Traffic Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06290)
*Mayan Sharma,Kriti Saini,Devansh Behl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 加密流量分类器报告的95-99%准确率主要源于评估协议的"同捕获泄漏"（按流随机划分），改用会话/服务器不相交划分后macro-F1从0.992降至0.567；作者提出单标识符探针可在训练前诊断正确的划分轴，并按规定协议重新评估嵌入模型与鲁棒性声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献中加密流量分类的近乎满分精度被广泛引用，但评估协议是否与真实泛化能力一致从未被系统检验；作者怀疑高精度来自划分泄漏（同一pcap的流被分到训练/测试两侧），并指出哪一划分轴重要取决于语料采集方式，且从标签空间无法察觉。

Method: 1) 在两个公开语料上，用同一模型与代码对比文献标准协议与"同pcap流不跨划分"协议（八随机种子、Holm-Bonferroni校正）；2) 在一个月骨干QUIC流量上，以八个种子评估五种划分协议：随机、时间、客户端不相交、会话不相交、服务器不相交；3) 提出单标识符探针（仅用capture identifier训练决策树）在训练前诊断泄漏轴；4) 按规定评估协议检验指标学习流嵌入、基于距离的未知应用拒识、少样本注册（零/五样本）及二十种包长下的基线对比。

Result: 同一模型在两协议下macro-F1为0.992 vs 0.567（差0.426，八种子，p=0.008）；随机、时间、客户端不相交与会话不相交划分统计上不可区分，服务器不相交损失0.192 macro-F1（d=17.0，p=0.008）；单标识符决策树在随机划分下达0.983，会话不相交下恰为0.000；指标训练嵌入优于四个深度基线，但在二十个包长上不及梯度提升树；五项预注册架构声明失败——距离拒识虽优于softmax阈值，但消融全部度量目标后拒识反而更好（类分离度与拒识质量相关r=-0.88）；少样本注册在语料内无增益，跨语料时每类五个标注流可挽回零样本迁移失败所留缺口的91%。

Conclusion: 报告的高精度在很大程度上是评估协议产物而非泛化能力；划分轴需依语料采集结构选择，并可用单标识符探针在建模前诊断。在修正协议下，嵌入方法并未超越梯度提升树，多项架构假设不成立。作者公开全部分割、结果、代码与负面发现，强调需警惕协议泄漏与预注册假设检验。

Abstract: Encrypted traffic classifiers are routinely reported at 95-99% accuracy. We show that on one of two public corpora, the same model and code score macro-F1 0.992 under the evaluation protocol standard in the literature and 0.567 under a protocol that keeps flows from one packet capture on one side of the split. Nothing changes but the partition (gap 0.426 over eight seeds, p = 0.008 after Holm-Bonferroni correction).
  The inflation is not a property of random splitting as such. On a month of backbone QUIC traffic, we evaluate five split protocols at eight seeds each: random, temporal and client-disjoint splitting are statistically indistinguishable from session-disjoint, while server-disjoint splitting costs 0.192 macro-F1 (d = 17.0, p = 0.008). Which axis matters depends on how the corpus was collected, in a way invisible from its label space.
  We give a diagnostic that identifies the right axis before any model is trained: single-identifier probes. A decision tree on the capture identifier alone reaches 0.983 under a random split and exactly 0.000 under session-disjoint splitting.
  Under this evaluation, a metric-trained flow embedding leads four deep baselines but does not beat gradient-boosted trees on twenty packet sizes. Five of our own pre-registered architectural claims fail: distance-based rejection of unknown applications beats softmax thresholding, but ablating every metric objective makes rejection better, because class separation correlates at r = -0.88 with rejection quality. Few-shot enrollment is flat within a corpus but, across corpora, five labelled flows per class recover 91% of the deficit left by failed zero-shot transfer.
  All splits, results, code and negative findings are released.

</details>


### [378] [When Does Risk-Controlled Throughput Forecasting Actually Control Risk? A Reproduction Study on LEO Satellite Link](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06307)
*Mayan Sharma,Kriti Saini,Devansh Behl,Suganya R,S. Vijayaragavan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文是对当前最优的风险预算吞吐量预测方法 BG-CFQS 的复现与压力测试研究，核心结论为"风险保证可复现但高度依赖校准划分"，并揭示三个系统性缺陷：无法服务低于0.15的风险预算、静态校准无法改变排序、以及组条件在线重校准在多数数据集上反而有害。论文明确主张其贡献在于实证发现而非新算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO 卫星容量预测需要转化为带风险约束的保守上界，供接纳控制安全使用。作者怀疑现有 SOTA 方法 BG-CFQS 的风险保证在真实部署条件下（时间连续划分）可能失效，且其适用预算范围与组条件机制未经充分检验，故需独立复现与压力测试。

Method: 在原作者使用的三条 Starlink 轨迹及一个独立第四数据集上进行复现实验，对比随机划分与连续时间划分两种校准协议；扫描 0.05/0.10/0.15 等风险预算；在延迟尖峰检测任务上验证静态 conformal 校准对排序指标（AUPRC）的影响并对比在线校准；将组条件在线重校准拆分为在线跟踪与组条件两个机制分别评估。

Result: 随机划分下所有已发表量均可复现（3/3 数据集风险通过），连续时间划分下仅 1/3 通过；任何划分下预算低于 0.15 均不可用，四个数据集在 0.05/0.10/0.15 上实现率完全相同，最紧预算处超调 1.4–3.7 倍；在线校准使延迟尖峰检测 AUPRC 最高提升 51%；在线跟踪机制可在 0.05–0.35 内将偏差控制在 1% 内（静态校准偏差 16–21%），但组条件部分在 3/4 数据集上任意协变量（含服务卫星几何）条件下均劣于不条件，且预测"哪些数据集受益"的尝试失败。

Conclusion: BG-CFQS 的风险保证是条件性的，依赖随机划分，在部署端面临的时间连续划分下不可靠；方法存在 0.15 的预算下界、静态校准的排序局限，以及组条件机制缺乏稳健收益。论文的贡献是实证性的发现而非新方法，提示需关注校准协议与预算范围的报告规范。

Abstract: Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so that admission control can act on it safely. We reproduce the state of the art, BG-CFQS, on the three Starlink traces its authors used and on an independent fourth dataset, and report four findings. First, its risk guarantee is reproducible but conditional on the calibration split: under a random split we recover every published quantity, including risk-pass on 3 of 3 datasets, but under a contiguous temporal split, which is what a deployed terminal faces, it holds on 1 of 3. Second, independent of any split, the method cannot serve a risk budget below 0.15, the low end of its candidate quantile set. On all four datasets the achieved rate is identical at budgets of 0.05, 0.10 and 0.15, overshooting by 1.4x to 3.7x at the tightest. Third, static conformal calibration cannot improve a ranking, only shift an operating point; we confirm this exactly on latency spike detection, where online calibration improves AUPRC by up to 51%. Fourth, group-conditional online recalibration splits into two mechanisms. The online part replicates: it tracks the budget within 1% from 0.05 to 0.35, where static calibration is 16 to 21% off. The group-conditional part does not: on three of four datasets, conditioning on any available covariate, including measured serving-satellite geometry, is worse than not conditioning, and our attempt to predict which datasets benefit failed. What is new here is empirical, not algorithmic: we claim the findings, not the methods.

</details>


### [379] [Conformal Prediction for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06320)
*Trung-Khang Tran,Tuan A. Hoang,Viet-Hoang Tran,Tan M. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对分布到分布回归（D2D）任务，指出现有Split CP直接应用会得到边缘有效但不可解释、无良定义体积或可处理采样过程的预测集，提出在正交基空间中构造可解释且保持覆盖保证的保形框架，并给出具渐近条件覆盖的自适应变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Split Conformal Prediction已被扩展到多标签、高维、函数型等复杂输出，但分布到分布回归（输出本身是概率分布）尚未被妥当处理。朴素地将Split CP用于该设定虽在边缘覆盖上有效，却产生不可解释的预测集——缺乏良定义的体积与可处理的采样流程，实用价值有限，因此需要一种在保持覆盖保证的同时产生可解释预测集的保形方法。

Method: 提出在正交基空间（orthogonal basis space）中进行保形化的新框架：将分布型输出投影到正交基上，在该空间中构造非一致性分数与预测集，从而得到结构清晰、可解释的预测集并保持覆盖保证；进一步设计自适应（adaptive）变体，在温和假设下获得渐近条件覆盖。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据集上的实证结果验证了所提方法的有效性（可解释预测集 + 覆盖保证，且自适应变体改善条件覆盖）。

Conclusion: 对D2D回归，朴素Split CP的预测集虽边缘有效但不可解释、实用性差；在正交基空间中做保形化可同时获得可解释性与覆盖保证，自适应版本在温和条件下提供渐近条件覆盖，实验支持其有效性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a model-agnostic framework for constructing finite-sample prediction sets with coverage guarantees and has become a tool for reliable decision-making in high-risk settings. Recent advances have extended Split Conformal Prediction to increasingly complex learning problems, including multilabel, high-dimensional, and functional outputs. In this work, we study CP for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression, a setting of growing interest across many application domains. We show that a naive application of Split CP yields prediction sets that, while marginally valid, are non-interpretable, e.g., lacking a well-defined volume or a tractable sampling procedure, and of limited practical value. To overcome this, we propose a new conformal framework that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets while preserving coverage guarantees. We further develop an adaptive variant with asymptotic conditional coverage under mild assumptions. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/tuanhacs/conformal_d2d.

</details>


### [380] [Learning to Tune with Biased Gradients: Iterative Feedback Tuning of Model-Free Control on Throttle Valves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06338)
*Félix Martinez-Jiménez,Sander Miller-Murphy,Tobie Ondoa-Essomba,Emmanuel Witrant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究电子节气门非线性（摩擦/静摩擦）下 IFT 有偏梯度问题：揭示两次实验初始控制器状态失配引入与第二次实验幅度成反比的误差；数字孪生上梯度仅69%为下降方向且各更新规则均平台化后漂移；实测中最佳更新规则取决于梯度噪声结构，Adam 与 Gauss–Newton 各有利弊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IFT 的梯度估计仅对线性对象无偏；实际节气门存在随个体与批次变化的摩擦与静摩擦，导致控制器状态失配，产生系统性偏差，需要量化该偏差并评估不同参数更新规则的鲁棒性。

Method: 以智能比例（无模型）控制器即增量式 PI 为受控结构，在十个节气门的数字孪生与两个硬件节气门上执行 IFT：每次迭代两次闭环实验，分析两次实验起始控制器状态失配带来的偏差项，并在低代价区域检验梯度是否为下降方向，比较 Gauss–Newton、归一化、动量与 Adam 等更新规则。

Result: 失配误差与第二次实验幅度成反比；孪生上 IFT 梯度仅在低代价区域 69% 情形为下降方向，成因为摩擦，所有更新规则均先平台化后漂移；硬件上最佳规则依赖梯度噪声结构：阀门一某梯度分量被噪声淹没时 Adam 优于 Gauss–Newton，归一化与动量各改善一个参数；阀门二两分量一致时归一化放大 Gauss–Newton 本应抑制的方向，Adam 漂移至劣于初始的控制器；孪生复现机理但未复现该排序。

Conclusion: 非线性摩擦使 IFT 梯度有偏，更新规则选择须依梯度噪声结构而定，数字孪生不足以预测规则排序，需硬件验证。

Abstract: Iterative feedback tuning (IFT) learns the parameters of a fixed-structure controller by stochastic gradient descent. At each iteration, two closed-loop experiments are run on the plant: the first one measures the tracking error, and the second one, driven by this error, provides the sensitivities from which the gradient of the cost is estimated. This estimate is unbiased for linear plants only. We study the biased case on automotive electronic throttle valves, whose friction and stiction vary between valves and runs, controlled by an intelligent proportional (model-free) controller, which is an incremental PI controller. We show that the mismatch of the controller state at the start of the two experiments, which stiction makes unavoidable, adds an error inversely proportional to the amplitude of the second experiment. On digital twins of ten valves, the IFT gradient is a descent direction in only 69\% of the low-cost region, friction being the cause, and all update rules plateau and then drift. On two hardware valves, the best update rule depends on the noise structure of the gradient. On the first valve, where one gradient component is buried in noise, Adam outperforms Gauss--Newton, its normalisation and its momentum each improving one parameter. On the second valve, where both components are consistent, the same normalisation amplifies a direction that Gauss--Newton rightly discounts, and Adam drifts to a controller worse than the initial one. The twins reproduce the mechanism but not this ranking.

</details>


### [381] [Flexible Intensities Matter: A Comprehensive Re-evaluation of Hawkes Processes and Neural Temporal Point Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06348)
*Hendrik Mehrtens,Florian Buettner,Oliver Stegle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统重评了经典与神经时序点过程(TPP)的对比：在5个基准数据集及UK Biobank、MIMIC-IV两大规模医疗任务上，一旦Hawkes过程配备灵活可学习的基线与核函数，其与神经TPP的性能差距基本消失；神经TPP的优势主要来自时间密度建模而非类型预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究宣称神经TPP显著优于Hawkes等经典TPP，但这些比较仅采用最受限形式的Hawkes过程，且未涉及大规模医疗数据，结论可能由模型灵活性差异而非模型类别差异导致，因此需要公平、系统的对比。

Method: 在自回归下一事件预测任务下，构建Poisson与Hawkes过程由简到繁的灵活性梯度，与神经TPP（含基于样条强度头的Transformer、无强度模型）进行系统对比，评测于5个基准数据集和两个大规模医疗任务（UK Biobank疾病史、MIMIC-IV ICU记录）；并将对数似然分解为时间项log p(t)与类型项log p(d|t)分别分析；同时开源TorchPP框架，统一实现经典与神经TPP。

Result: Hawkes过程在引入灵活可学习基线与核函数后，与神经TPP的差距大幅缩小甚至消失；带样条强度头的Transformer优于以往基于强度的神经TPP，并与无强度模型相当；灵活性收益几乎全部集中于时间密度项，类型项未见提升；仅在MIMIC-IV ICU数据上神经TPP在类型项保持优势。

Conclusion: 神经TPP相对经典TPP的优势主要在于建模“事件何时发生”而非“发生何种事件”，且此前的性能差距很大程度源于基线对比不公平。研究强调复杂大规模数据集对评估TPP的必要性，并为方法开发与模型选择提供指导，同时发布开源框架TorchPP。

Abstract: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are the canonical framework for event sequence data, with applications spanning seismology, social media, and electronic health records. Recently, neural TPPs have been reported to substantially outperform classical TPPs, such as Hawkes processes, but these comparisons pitted flexible neural models against Hawkes processes in their most restricted form, and did not consider large-scale medical data. Here, we revisit this comparison through a systematic evaluation of Poisson and Hawkes processes of increasing flexibility against neural TPPs, on five established benchmark datasets and on two large-scale medical evaluation tasks derived from UK Biobank disease histories and MIMIC-IV ICU records, under autoregressive next-event prediction. First, the previously reported gap between Hawkes processes and neural TPPs largely disappears once Hawkes processes are equipped with flexible, learnable baselines and kernels. Second, the flexibility of the intensity parametrization also limits prior neural TPPs: a Transformer with a spline-based intensity head outperforms previous intensity-based neural TPPs and is on par with the intensity-free model. Decomposing the log-likelihood into a time term $\log p(t)$ and a type term $\log p(d \mid t)$, we find that this flexibility advantage lies almost entirely in the time density: more flexibility does not improve the type term. On these benchmarks, the gains of neural TPPs thus lie mostly in modeling when events occur, not which. Third, our results underscore the value of complex datasets for evaluating TPPs: only on the MIMIC-IV ICU records do neural TPPs retain an advantage in the type term. Our results inform both future method development and model choice. We release our framework, TorchPP, as an open-source package with consistent implementations of classical and neural TPPs.

</details>


### [382] [EEGDash Corpus: A Training-Ready Public Corpus for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06356)
*Kuber Shahi,Bruno Aristimunha,Arnaud Delorme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布 eegdash-corpus-v0：一个可直接训练、含 77 个公开 EEG 数据集的语料库（14,075 小时、7,272 名被试、5.0M 个 10 秒样本、每轮 6.21B token），并通过重训 REVE-Base 验证其可用于预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG 基础模型依赖大量预训练数据，但数据难以汇集：最大来源是临床档案，不可再分发；公开数据又分散于多个归档、文件格式与许可协议中。且已发表最大 EEG 基础模型 REVE 所依赖的 89 个数据集中，有 12 个不可再分发（4 个临床档案占其小时数的 82%，8 个采用禁止衍生许可），造成可复现性缺口。

Method: 发布以门控 Hugging Face 数据集形式提供的 eegdash-corpus-v0，并给出每个文件的 SHA-256。所有数据经 EEGDash 统一获取，按 REVE 的预处理方案一次性转换，存入分块 Zarr 存储中各自的分桶（bucket），许可信息就近记录，从而支持在全量或任意数据集子集上训练。为验证可用性，使用作者官方代码从零重训 REVE-Base 两次，仅修改数据读取方式，并在 7 个 OpenEEGBench 公开任务上评测。

Result: 重训模型在线性探测下达到 0.331、微调后 0.273；作为对照，官方发布模型为 0.333 与 0.325，未训练编码器为 0.200 与 0.205。即线性探测性能已与发布模型基本持平，微调性能仍有差距。

Conclusion: 该语料库在许可合规前提下复现了 REVE 预训练语料的绝大部分，并可实际支撑模型预训练，线性探测结果接近原模型；转换器、转换报告与数据加载器改动随语料一并发布，提升了 EEG 基础模型预训练的可复现性与可用性。
