Abstract: Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) are pretrained on tens of thousands of hours of recordings, and their accuracy grows with that amount. Such data is hard to assemble. The largest sources are clinical archives that cannot be redistributed, and the public sources are spread over several archives, file formats, and licences. We release eegdash-corpus-v0, a training-ready corpus of 77 public EEG datasets, as the gated Hugging Face dataset EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0 with the SHA-256 of every file. REVE, the largest published EEG foundation model, names 89 datasets as its pretraining corpus. Twelve cannot be redistributed: four clinical archives that hold 82% of its hours, and eight under no-derivatives licences. The corpus holds the 76 others that REVE's sampling rate allows and one more from REVE's release card: 77 datasets, 14,075 hours from 7,272 subjects, 5.0 million 10-second samples and 6.21 billion tokens per epoch. Every dataset is fetched through EEGDash, converted once with REVE's recipe, and stored in its own buckets of a chunked Zarr store with its licence recorded beside it, so a model can train on the whole store or on any subset of datasets. To test that the store pretrains a model, we retrain REVE-Base from scratch twice with the authors' code, changed only in how it reads data, and score it on seven public OpenEEGBench tasks. It reaches 0.331 under linear probing and 0.273 after fine-tuning, against 0.333 and 0.325 for the released model and 0.200 and 0.205 for an untrained encoder. The converter, the conversion reports, and the loader changes are released with the corpus.

</details>


### [383] [Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06372)
*Jinhyung Bae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 难度比例分配在简单基准上有效，但在困难工作负载上增益极小；真正的收益来自"信息"（判断哪些输入可解）而非分配策略本身；有验证器+迁移先验时Thompson Sampling可将最难负载解决率从14%提升到27%，无先验则任何策略都不如轮询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个输入共享LLM重复尝试预算时，"难者多试"的难度比例规则被广泛采用，但作者怀疑其在困难工作负载上失效，需系统检视该规则的局限并找出真正决定增益的因素。

Method: 1) 在公开数学、代码、形式化证明样本上评估最优已发表的难度比例规则（含真实通过率的上界设定）；2) 对221篇LLM预算分配论文做严格综述，统计将最多尝试给最难输入的论文数；3) 用理论分析说明单次尝试价值在中等难度处最大，故最优静态分配呈倒U形；4) 结合验证器与相关模型历史运行得到的先验，采用Thompson Sampling；5) 在Qwen2.5新样本上复现，并测试先验秩相关阈值与先验回火（tempering）。

Result: 难度比例规则在模型基本能解的基准上可捕获oracle增益的一半以上，但在困难负载上至多13%（即便给定真实通过率）；综述中至少13篇论文将最多尝试给最难输入，其简单设定恰处于接近最优的预算区间。有验证器与先验时，Thompson Sampling将最难负载解决率由14%升至27%；无先验时测试的策略均不优于轮询。增益在秩相关约0.3–0.55间消失，而廉价的文本先验在最弱模型上几乎达不到该水平；并要求验证器误接受率远低于通过率。Qwen2.5样本上规律一致，先验回火可避免简单负载上的损失。

Conclusion: 增益主要由信息（可解性判别）而非分配策略驱动；难度比例规则只是在其适用预算区间内看似有效。实践需满足：可靠验证器、秩相关足够高的迁移先验，并对先验做回火以防简单负载损失。论文据此给出决策指南。

Abstract: When many inputs share a budget of repeated attempts by a large language model (LLM), a common rule gives harder inputs more. On public math, code and formal-proof samples, the best published difficulty-proportional rule captures half or more of the oracle gain on benchmarks the model mostly solves, but at most 13% on hard workloads, even given true pass rates. Because the value of one more attempt peaks at intermediate difficulty, the optimal static allocation is inverted-U and gives little to inputs that are hopeless at the current budget. In a strict survey of 221 LLM allocation papers, at least 13 give the hardest inputs the most attempts; their easier settings sit at budgets where this is near-optimal, so the cost appears on harder workloads. Acting on it requires knowing which inputs are solvable, so information, not the policy, drives the gain. With a verifier and a prior from a related model's past runs on the same inputs, Thompson Sampling raises the solved share on the hardest workload from 14% to 27%; without such a prior, no policy we tested beats round-robin. For the policies we tested, the gain vanishes between prior rank correlations of about 0.3 and 0.55, which cheap text-based priors barely reach on the weakest models, and it requires a verifier whose false acceptances are rare relative to the pass rate. On new Qwen2.5 samples the pattern holds, and tempering the prior avoids losses on easy workloads. We turn these results into a decision guide.

</details>


### [384] [From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06382)
*Xilin Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出基于三条物理定律（守恒、耗散、聚合）的低维集总流域模型框架，经AI辅助迭代改进得到CaRT+，在英、美、澳共1700余个流域上精度接近LSTM且参数可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回应Dooge关于"流域尺度水文是否存在定律"的经典问题，检验一个受物理定律约束的低维系统能否达到甚至超越优于过程模型的神经网络精度。

Method: 用三条定律约束集总模型：守恒→通量连接的水储量网络；耗散→确定每个通量的符号；聚合→通过阈值分布上的有效定律与强迫记忆处理未解析组成。据此提出简约模型CaRT（每流域11参数），并在AI代理辅助的循环中以文献假设逐一针对观测到的缺陷进行改进（四类改进路径），得到CaRT+（14个状态、每流域35参数、无日尺度神经网络）。

Result: 在602个英国和593个美国测站流域的留出年份：单模型CaRT+中位NSE为0.863和0.765；有状态LSTM为0.869和0.751，实体感知LSTM为0.862和0.754；三种子LSTM集成仅比CaRT+集成在配对NSE中位数上领先0.003–0.012。在未参与开发的505个较干旱澳大利亚流域，CaRT+达0.778，优于两个LSTM的0.762和0.753。

Conclusion: 流域尺度定律可能以"形式定律"存在：本构函数族可共享，仅其参数需学习。物理约束的紧凑模型可在与深度模型相当精度下保持可解释性与跨区域泛化优势。

Abstract: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT+ models reach median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT+ ensemble by 0.003-0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT+ models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.

</details>


### [385] [KolTa: A Physics-Informed Active Learning Framework for Formulation Discovery with Limited Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06394)
*Boyong Tang,Tao Wang,Lei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KolTa是一个主动学习框架，用于在有限实验预算下高效发现配方中性能最高的5%候选，并在四项回归任务上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配方空间中测量样本极少、实验预算有限，直接搜索高性能配方代价高昂，需要一种能在固定查询预算下最大化发现top 5%配方的批量实验选择策略。

Method: 提出三阶段预测器：组分贡献、角色条件交互（role-conditioned interactions）、锚定温度响应，并加入任务特定的软物理约束；采集规则为Physics-Residual-Calibrated UCB（PRC-UCB），融合预测效用、集成不确定度与目标温度物理残差，探索权重由out-of-fold有符号误差拟合（非负约束），支持批量选择。

Result: 在二元混合物粘度、药物溶解度、离子液体粘度（三项实测）与电解质电导率（一项模拟）上评估。四项任务的平均AULC均排名第一或第二；成对检验中优于八个对照策略中的七个，在78组成对比较中赢75组；三项实测任务中与最佳平均AULC的最大差距为0.032，而所有对照策略均≥0.056；在Drug任务上达到剩余目标80%平均召回需中位约348次额外配方查询，比最快对照少约18%。

Conclusion: KolTa在有限预算下显著提升高性能配方的发现效率，且其组分角色与物理约束的模块化设计可迁移至多样的配方优化问题。

Abstract: Finding high-performing formulations is difficult when few have been measured and experimental budgets are limited. We propose KolTa, an active learning framework that selects batches to discover the top 5% of formulations at a target temperature under a fixed query budget. KolTa combines a three-stage predictor of component contributions, role-conditioned interactions, and anchored temperature response with task-specific soft physics constraints. Its Physics-Residual-Calibrated Upper Confidence Bound (PRC-UCB) acquisition rule combines predicted utility, ensemble disagreement, and a target-temperature physics residual, with nonnegative exploration weights fitted to out-of-fold signed errors. We evaluate the framework on three measured tasks and one simulated task covering binary-mixture viscosity, drug solubility, ionic-liquid viscosity, and electrolyte conductivity. KolTa ranks first or second in mean area under the learning curve (AULC) on every task and outperforms seven of the eight comparator strategies in paired tests, winning 75 of 78 paired comparisons across tasks and seeds against those seven strategies. Across the three measured tasks, its largest gap to the best mean AULC is 0.032, compared with at least 0.056 for every comparator. On Drug, reaching 80% average recovery of the remaining targets across drugs requires an estimated median of 348 additional formulation queries, about 18% fewer than the fastest comparator. Researchers can adapt the framework to diverse formulation problems through component roles and physical constraints.

</details>


### [386] [Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06409)
*Adrian Hayler,Shashank Reddy Chirra,Andrei Lupu,Johannes Forkel,Bidipta Sarkar,Siheng Feng,Jakob Foerster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM智能体的零样本协调（ZSC）能力，发现前沿LLM在最小化环境中仍难以协调，主因是对协调问题理解不足与对伙伴信念推理薄弱，并提出"协调友好定义"（CFDs）作为改进方案且可自动发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ZSC在RL中研究充分，但LLM智能体的协调表现尚不清楚；已有LLM协调工作依赖独立开发智能体难以共享的专用脚手架，且在Hanabi等复杂环境中难以定位协调失败的来源，因此需要一个可隔离特定协调挑战的简化设定。

Method: 采用简单、通用的脚手架与最小化环境，隔离特定的协调挑战进行受控评估；在此基础上提出Coordination-friendly definitions（CFDs），作为使LLM智能体实现鲁棒协调的原则性方法，并给出CFDs的自动化发现流程以替代人工设计。

Result: 即使在这些受控的简单设定中，前沿LLM智能体仍难以完成协调，主要原因是它们对协调问题本身理解有限、对伙伴信念的推理能力薄弱；LLM虽引入语义信息这一额外协调维度，但未能有效利用该结构。

Conclusion: LLM的ZSC瓶颈在于问题理解与伙伴建模而非脚手架复杂度；CFDs可作为提升协调鲁棒性的有效原则，且能被自动发现，从而免除手工工程。

Abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents.

</details>


### [387] [Partially Interpretable Decision Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06428)
*Ludovic Schwartz,Federico Berton,Tim van Erven*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出三种部分可解释决策树（PIT）训练算法，并在理论上解释了它们在黑箱精度齐次时性能相近，在异质时deferral-aware CART更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有部分可解释模型（允许将复杂输入推迟给高精度但不可解释的黑箱）的训练方法仅基于线性模型或决策规则，缺少决策树形式的方案；需探索如何让树结构在"可解释"与"准确"之间灵活权衡。

Method: 提出三种算法：(1) Branches 算法的部分可解释扩展，做精确搜索优化树；(2) 在标准 CART 之上运行的转换算法，计算更高效；(3) 广义 CART，其分裂准则在生长过程中即考虑推迟（deferral）选项。此外给出关于"智能树构造"潜在收益的形式化上界，并构造黑箱精度故意非齐次的合成数据集，以及概念瓶颈模型应用评估。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，三种算法性能相近；该现象可由形式化上界解释——只要黑箱精度在域内足够齐次，智能树构造的收益有限。在合成非齐次数据集上，deferral-aware CART 优于标准 CART 并达到精确搜索的水平。在概念瓶颈模型中，部分可解释决策树可替代瓶颈之后的不可解释神经网络：未推迟输入上完全可解释，推迟则保持精度。

Conclusion: 部分可解释决策树是一种有效且可落地的方案：常规情形下简单转换即可，黑箱精度异质时需用 deferral-aware CART；并可无缝替换概念瓶颈模型中的后段网络。

Abstract: Partially interpretable models extend simple interpretable models with the option to defer complicated inputs to an accurate but uninterpretable black-box model. By deferring more inputs, the model gets more accurate; by deferring fewer, it gets more interpretable. Existing procedures to train such partially interpretable models build on linear models or decision rules. We propose three algorithms for decision trees: a partially interpretable extension of the existing Branches algorithm, which performs exact search to optimize the tree; a conversion algorithm that we run on top of standard CART, which is computationally more efficient; and a generalized CART whose splitting criterion takes into account the option to defer while growing the tree. Perhaps surprisingly, the performance of the three algorithms is similar across many realworld datasets. We can explain this through a formal bound on the potential gain of smart tree construction, provided the black box accuracy is sufficiently homogeneous across the domain. We also construct a synthetic dataset where the accuracy of the black box is deliberately inhomogeneous. There, our deferral-aware generalization of CART does outperform regular CART and matches the performance of exact search. Finally, we evaluate an application to concept bottleneck models. Partially interpretable decision trees can replace uninterpretable neural networks after the bottleneck. On undeferred inputs, the model is fully interpretable, and deferring preserves accuracy.

</details>


### [388] [Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06438)
*Nuo-Jing Liang,Xiao-Tong Yuan,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将CoT的OOD泛化建模为组合泛化，证明OOD任务风险由ID子任务风险之和乘以与T无关的O(k)系数控制，估计项为O(√(T/n))，并有下界Ω(√(T/n))与Atom-Task/GSM8K实验支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT显著提升LLM推理性能，但其分布外(OOD)泛化的理论机制尚缺乏深入研究；尤其目标任务缺少完整推理轨迹或直接输入-输出对，仅有分布内(ID)单步原子数据时，CoT为何能泛化缺乏理论解释。

Method: 将CoT形式化为组合式OOD泛化：训练仅提供ID原子步数据，通过对共享单步预测器的重复应用来组合可复用的ID转移。理论工具包括：以T（目标任务推理步数）、n（每个子任务训练样本数）、k（每步输出token数）刻画风险界；使用Rademacher复杂度分析估计项；在均匀容量控制下分析预测器共享的效果；给出自回归下一词预测的最终任务风险界；并通过奇偶耦合(parity-coupled)构造给出下界。实验在Atom-Task与GSM8K上进行。

Result: OOD任务风险由各ID子任务风险之和乘以O(k)量级、且不依赖T的系数控制（求和风险本身仍可能随T增长）；Rademacher分析表明因预测器共享，估计项为O(√(T/n))而非关于T线性；下一词预测下最终任务风险≤同类最优步级风险×O(k)+Õ(k√(T/n))；奇偶耦合构造表明当T≤n时，子任务ERM的期望最终任务风险至少为最优类内风险加Ω(√(T/n))。实验显示CoT可实现短到长及组合泛化，显式状态跟踪至关重要。

Conclusion: CoT的OOD泛化源于对共享单步预测器的组合复用，其风险随推理步数T呈√T式而非线性增长，理论上界与下界匹配，实验验证了组合泛化能力及状态跟踪的关键作用。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class step-level risk scaled by the same coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$, plus an estimation term of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(k\sqrt{T/n}\big)$. A parity-coupled construction further shows that, for the sub-task empirical risk minimizer, the expected final-task risk is at least the best in-class risk plus $Ω(\sqrt{T/n})$ when $T\le n$. Experiments on Atom-Task and GSM8K support the theory: CoT enables short-to-long and compositional generalization, while explicit state tracking is crucial.
  Our code is available at https://github.com/maxliang114514/CoT-OOD.

</details>


### [389] [Graph Foundation Models Can Become Effective Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06441)
*Zhuangyan Hu,Zhuoxuan Liang,Wei Li,Xiaohua Jia,Moustafa Youssef,Sumi Helal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gfm4Mtsad框架，将预训练图基础模型迁移用于多元时间序列异常检测，通过SICA、MAPS、TGEC三个模块解决跨模态失配、伪异常监督不可靠与节点到窗口聚合失真问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图的MTSAD检测器需在目标域有限数据上从零训练任务专用网络，易受伪相关影响且无法复用可迁移先验；预训练GFM虽具备可迁移拓扑先验与异常判别能力，但直接适配存在跨模态特征-拓扑失配、伪异常监督不可靠、节点到窗口聚合时决策失真三大障碍。

Method: 1) SICA（结构与信息契约对齐）模块：融合主子空间token投影、正常先验引导的图构建与残差恢复，桥接连续时间序列与GFM空间并抑制虚假边、保留细粒度时序细节；2) MAPS（机制对齐伪异常筛选）：局部依赖断裂同时保留经验残差，挑选靠近正常边界的难负样本进行定向监督；3) TGEC（尾部门控证据校准）：以正常运行参考校准多粒度图响应，保持良性分数排序并仅精修尾部极端异常候选，实现可靠窗口检测与可解释传感器证据。

Result: 在两种GFM骨干网络上的大量实验表明，Gfm4Mtsad的检测性能优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 预训练图基础模型可有效迁移至MTSAD任务；通过结构-信息对齐、机制对齐伪异常监督与尾部校准聚合，可同时提升检测准确性、可靠性及可解释性。

Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) relies on modeling both temporal dynamics and inter-sensor dependencies to identify complex system faults. Although graph-based detectors explicitly model sensor topologies, they train task-specific networks from scratch on limited target-domain data, remaining vulnerable to spurious correlations and unable to reuse transferable priors. While pretrained Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) offer transferable topological priors and anomaly discriminability, directly adapting them to MTSAD is hindered by cross-modal feature-topology mismatch, unreliable pseudo-anomaly supervision, and decision distortion during node-to-window aggregation. To fill these gaps, we propose a novel adaptation framework, Gfm4Mtsad, which unleashes pretrained GFMs for MTSAD. We introduce the Structure-and-Information Contract Alignment (SICA) module to bridge continuous time series and the pretrained GFM space. This module harmonizes principal subspace token projection, normal-prior-guided graph construction, and residual recovery to suppress spurious edges while retaining fine-grained temporal details. We propose a Mechanism-Aligned Pseudo-Anomaly Screening strategy (MAPS) to steer unsupervised learning. It applies localized dependency breaks while preserving empirical residuals, selecting hard negatives near the normal boundary for targeted supervision. We develop a Tail-Gated Evidence Calibration mechanism (TGEC) to eliminate node-to-window aggregation distortion. It calibrates multi-granular graph responses against normal operational references, strictly preserving benign score rankings while selectively refining extreme anomaly candidates in the tail distribution for reliable window detection and interpretable sensor evidence. Extensive evaluations with two GFM backbones demonstrate that Gfm4Mtsad achieves superior detection performance over existing baselines.

</details>


### [390] [The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06476)
*Ye Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该实证研究以 Qwen3.5-4B 为对象，用稀疏 LoRA 与长度归一化 DPO + SFT 保留项（RPO）微调结构化金融文件任务，证明随隐式奖励间隔增长，对齐税是"分级且任务选择性"的：抽取近乎无损、JSON 小幅下降、路由严重退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有对齐/偏好优化研究通常笼统讨论"对齐税"是否整体损害能力，但缺乏对退化是否在任务间均匀分布的系统刻画，也缺乏预注册、等价性检验与量化噪声控制的严格实证证据。

Method: 不提出新方法、不做目标函数对比的实证刻画研究；在三个结构化金融申报任务上，用稀疏 LoRA（8/32 层）微调 Qwen3.5-4B，目标为长度归一化的 DPO 加 SFT 保留项（RPO）。采用预注册设计（8 个种子，冻结时 6 项未参与调参）、产物感知评分与 TOST 等价性检验；追踪下游能力、gold-logp 变化与奖励分解；并在 nf4 训练与未量化 fp16 测量间比较奖励间隔。

Result: 奖励间隔升至约 7 个 β 缩放单位（nf4 训练；未量化基座 fp16 测量下约 3）。抽取任务保持（Δ=−0.55 分，在 ±5 分下等价），JSON 小幅下降（Δ=−3.52 分，聚类项目级区间未通过等价），路由严重退化（Δ=−30 分），退化集中于 margin 1–3 的"损伤窗口"并伴随瞬时格式破坏尖峰。间隔增量 ≥96% 由拒绝样本奖励压制解释，选中样本奖励近乎平坦。Gold-logp 通缩具任务选择性（抽取 −0.15、JSON −1.04、路由 −1.47 nats/token，fp16），抽取上 gold 相对错误对照被选择性保护（8/8 种子）。QLoRA 奖励间隔在 nf4 训练与 fp16 测量间差异可达 3.4×，且差距依赖奖励轴。

Conclusion: 对齐税并非均匀代价，而是分级、任务选择性的，且存在可定位的损伤窗口；间隔增长主要源于对拒绝样本的抑制。研究受限于长度归一化奖励 + SFT 保留、稀疏 LoRA、单一 4B 模型、易分合成偏好与三个任务，无保留项对照与格式对齐量化指标留待后续。

Abstract: Setting. This is an empirical characterization study; we propose no new method and run no comparisons against alternative objectives. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B with sparse LoRA and length-normalized DPO plus an SFT retention term (the RPO objective) on structured financial-filing tasks, and track downstream capability as the implicit reward margin grows to $\sim 7$ $β$-scaled units (nf4 training; $\sim 3$ under fp16 measurement on the unquantized base). Question. Does margin growth degrade capability uniformly across tasks, or selectively? Findings. In a pre-registered study (8 seeds, 6 unseen at freeze) with artifact-aware scoring and TOST equivalence testing, the alignment tax is graded and task-selective: extraction is preserved ($Δ= -0.55$ pts, equivalent at $\pm5$ pts), json loses little ($Δ= -3.52$ pts, equivalence fails on a clustered item-level interval), and router degrades severely ($Δ= -30$ pts). Router's loss concentrates in a margin 1-3 damage window containing a transient format-break spike. The margin is accounted for almost entirely ($\geq 96\%$) by suppression of rejected completions, with chosen reward approximately flat, consistent with the retention term anchoring it; we do not attribute the behavioral damage to any single gradient channel. Gold-logp deflation is task-selective (extraction $-0.15$, json $-1.04$, router $-1.47$ nats/token under fp16), with gold selectively protected relative to incorrect controls on extraction (8/8 seeds). QLoRA reward margins differ up to $3.4\times$ between nf4 training and unquantized fp16 measurement, with an axis-dependent gap. Scope. Length-normalized rewards with SFT retention, sparse LoRA on 8/32 layers, one 4B model, easily-separable synthetic preferences, three structured tasks. A no-retention control and a measured format-alignment metric are left to future work.

</details>


### [391] [What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06483)
*Kejian Zhu,Zhuoran Jin,Shangqing Tu,Tianyi Men,Yupu Hao,Jiachun Li,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 多轮智能体强化学习的收益高度依赖交互预算（采样宽度K与交互深度T），轨迹级RL优势在回合预算收紧时显著衰减；作者提出训练时变化交互预算的BudgetMix RL以缓解部署风险，并在多种执行设置下取得稳健性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体 RL 虽在长程任务上表现优异，但其性能增益对交互约束高度敏感，部署时预算变化会带来风险。作者希望系统刻画这种预算依赖性（通过 Pass@(K,T) 在采样宽度 K 与交互深度 T 两个维度评估），并寻找降低该依赖的训练替代方案。

Method: 以 Pass@(K,T) 为评估框架，从采样宽度和交互深度分析轨迹级 RL 优势对回合预算的依赖；分析智能体 RL 在单步决策质量与长程能力上的作用分布（错误恢复与长程鲁棒性）；初步讨论过程监督信号的利弊；提出 BudgetMix RL，通过在训练中动态变化交互预算，替代固定预算训练。

Result: 轨迹级 RL 优势需充足的回合预算，预算收紧时增益显著下降；智能体 RL 并非均匀提升单步决策质量，其优势集中于错误恢复与长程韧性；BudgetMix RL 在多样化执行设置下取得稳健性能。

Conclusion: 多轮智能体 RL 的性能对交互预算存在结构性依赖，固定预算训练存在部署风险；训练期预算混合（BudgetMix RL）是缓解该依赖、提升跨执行设置鲁棒性的可行方向，过程监督信号则是值得进一步探索的补充手段。

Abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

</details>


### [392] [Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06486)
*Zirong Xie,Zainab Afolabi,Nikita Kozodoi,Jack Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明LoRA专家的秩耦合源于merge方法的按幅值选择机制而非合并本身；按损失效应选择组件可让每个专家自由选择秩，几乎不损失多域精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准做法要求所有专家使用相同LoRA秩，导致跨专家的秩选择被耦合，而各领域其实各有最优秩。作者希望厘清这种耦合是合并方法本身的属性还是合并行为的必然代价。

Method: 在数学、指令遵循、多语言三个领域、四种秩、三种模型规模下训练36个专家，用六种合并方法分别在统一秩与各领域最优秩下合并；并分析合并时保留池化谱分量的不同选择策略（按幅值 vs 按对损失的效应）。

Result: 异秩合并不损害averaging与utility-based selection，还带来最高1.8pp的多域精度提升；冲突消解类方法表现不一致，最多损失4pp。按幅值选择会丢弃大量可降低损失的分量，且系统性丢弃指令适配器（奇异值最小），使IFEval下降16–25pp。改用按损失效应选组件可保留全部三专家，在8倍秩范围内精度波动仅0.7pp（4B规模下TIES为6.7pp）。

Conclusion: 秩耦合是特定merge算子的产物：当合并算子不按幅值选择组件时，可为每个专家单独选择秩，从而在几乎不牺牲多域精度的前提下提升灵活性与精度。

Abstract: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. Merging keeps only a fixed share of the pooled spectral components, and methods that choose them by size discard many that would have reduced loss. They also tend to discard the same expert: the instruction adapter has the smallest singular values, so it is dropped almost entirely and IFEval falls by 16 to 25 pp. Choosing components by their effect on loss instead keeps all three experts, and leaves accuracy nearly flat across an 8$\times$ rank range (0.7 pp, against 6.7 pp for TIES at 4B scale). Rank can therefore be chosen per expert whenever the merge operator does not select by magnitude.

</details>


### [393] [Nowcasting Future Performance for Population Pruning in Survival-of-the-Fittest Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06512)
*Rico Städeli,Léo Meynent,Boris Knyazev,Damian Borth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究用中间训练检查点预测未来测试精度（nowcasting），并据此在训练中对候选模型进行排名与剪枝（SOTF），以减少模型种群搜索的计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练大量超参数、架构或随机种子不同的候选模型开销巨大，但提前停止看似较弱的训练会错误丢弃后期可能反超的模型（学习曲线会交叉），因此需要依据中间检查点对最终性能做出可靠预测。

Method: 构建 nowcaster，预测未来五个epoch的测试精度或训练结束时的最终精度；输入包括精度与损失历史、权重统计量以及 SANE 表示（一种将检查点编码为隐token序列的 transformer 自编码器）。将 nowcaster 用于 Survival-of-Fittest（SOTF）训练：训练中反复按预测精度排名并淘汰排名最低的运行。

Result: 五轮预测中权重统计量效果最好；最终精度预测中 SANE 表示效果最好。与按当前精度剪枝对比：在 CNN zoos 等同质模型库中，按当前精度剪枝已可保留仅略差于最优的最终模型；在性能差异更大的 ResNet-18 与 ViT 模型库中，仅按当前精度难以剪枝，而使用 nowcast 最终精度的 SOTF 几乎弥补了与最优模型的差距。

Conclusion: 中间检查点的预测信号可用于有效的种群剪枝，其价值随模型库性能异质性增大而提升；SOTF 结合最终精度 nowcasting 在大差异模型库中显著优于朴素剪枝。

Abstract: Training high-performing neural networks often involves evaluating populations of candidate models with varying hyperparameters, architectures, or random seeds. Training every candidate to completion is computationally expensive, yet stopping seemingly weaker runs early risks discarding models that would ultimately perform better, as learning curves can cross. To address this challenge, we investigate whether intermediate training checkpoints can predict future model accuracy and enable more informed pruning decisions. Our nowcasters predict test accuracy five epochs ahead or at the end of training. They are trained with accuracy and loss histories, weight statistics, and SANE representations as inputs. SANE is a transformer autoencoder that encodes a checkpoint as a sequence of latent tokens. We then use the nowcasters in Survival-of-the-Fittest (SOTF) training. SOTF repeatedly ranks runs during training by predicted accuracy and stops the lowest-ranked ones. Our results show that weight statistics work best for five-epoch forecasts, and SANE representations work best for final accuracy prediction. For evaluation, we compare SOTF with pruning the population by current accuracy. In homogeneous model zoos such as the CNN zoos, pruning by current accuracy already retains a final model only slightly worse than the best. Model zoos with a larger spread in performance, such as the ResNet-18 and ViT zoos, are more difficult to prune by current accuracy alone. In these zoos, SOTF with nowcasted final accuracy almost closes the gap to the best model.

</details>


### [394] [An Interaction-Aware Decision Framework for FDIC-Assisted Distressed Bank Acquisitions: Empirical Evidence from the FDIC Failed-Bank Panel and the SVB-First Citizens Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06514)
*Yousef Nejatbakhsh,Malihe Aliasgari,Parsa Safaee,Sina Shokoohyar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"Spider Network Filtering Framework"，用四条可解释的交互规则刻画收购决策中五维信号的相互依赖，并在55起FDIC协助的失败银行收购样本上检验。结果显示该框架的AUC仅0.594，弱于逻辑回归(0.615)与岭回归(0.632)，置换检验下至多弱证据优于随机，直接使用Spider评分不优于随机，阈值调优后效用为负。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 失败银行收购决策中，收购价值、监管保护、风险、买方实力与执行难度等信号彼此依存（如政府损失分担会削弱高不良贷款的影响），单一信号的解读脱离其余信号便失真；因此需要一个能显式编码信号间依赖关系的可解释框架，替代将各维度独立处理的常规建模方式。

Method: 将五维信号间的依赖编码为四条可解释的交互规则，由此生成图启发的特征，输入逻辑回归模型，并配合Pursue/Caution/Avoid 三档决策规则。样本为2008–2024年FDIC协助的55起收购（收购方母公司在美国上市）；六个财务输入取自失败前发布的监管报告，两项交易条款取自监管机构新闻稿；标签为公告窗口三日正异常收益。评估采用分组嵌套交叉验证、置换检验（重复完整模型选择），并以银行板块基准及F1调优阈值下的效用作稳健性检验。

Result: Spider增强模型平均AUC为0.594，逻辑回归0.615，岭回归0.632；置换检验表明上述模型至多只有弱证据优于随机。直接使用Spider评分不具备优于随机的排序能力；目标银行困境与更高收益之间的表观关联在以银行板块为基准后消失。按F1分数调优的阈值会批准多数负收益收购，并在"一次负收益成本为一次正收益三倍"的设定下产生负效用。

Conclusion: 可解释的交互规则式建模在该小样本、低信噪比场景中未带来预测增益，甚至不及常规线性模型；Spider评分的直接排序无效，目标困境效应对基准选择敏感（稳健性不足），按分类阈值制定的决策规则在经济效用上不可行。结果警示：以公告期异常收益为标签的失败银行收购决策问题，在现有样本与信号条件下难以形成可靠排序，交互规则的可解释性不能替代统计证据。

Abstract: Acquirers of failed banks weigh acquisition value, regulatory protection, risk, buyer strength, and execution difficulty jointly, because each signal's meaning depends on the others: high non-performing loans matter less when government loss sharing absorbs the losses. The proposed Spider Network Filtering Framework encodes such dependencies as four interpretable interaction rules among five dimensions, yielding graph-inspired features for a logistic model and a Pursue/Caution/Avoid decision rule. We evaluate it on 55 acquisitions assisted by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation in 2008-2024 by acquirers with a parent listed in the United States. Six financial inputs come from regulatory reports published before each failure; two deal terms, which the winning bidder knows when it bids but investors learn at the announcement, come from the regulator's press releases. The outcome, a positive three-day abnormal return around the announcement, records the market's initial reception, not realized success. Under grouped, nested cross-validation, the Spider-enhanced model reaches a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.594, against 0.615 for logistic regression on the same inputs and 0.632 for ridge regression; permutation tests that repeat the full model selection give at most weak evidence that any of them ranks better than chance. The Spider score used directly does not rank better than chance, and an apparent link between target distress and higher returns disappears against a bank-sector benchmark. Thresholds tuned for the F1 score approve most acquisitions with negative returns and realize negative utility when each costs three times what a positively received acquisition gains.

</details>


### [395] [IDSISA: Influence-Distilled Sharded Training for Efficient Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06519)
*Deeraj SK,Sadhana Devarajan,Tanmoy Hazra,Anupam Shukla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IDSISA 用影响函数把易遗忘样本集中到少数分片，并用未受影响分片的蒸馏恢复效用，在保留 SISA 精确删除保证的同时提升选择性与效用，且给出重复删除序列下的级联重训认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SISA 通过分片与独立重训实现可认证删除，但随机分片会使遗忘请求散布到多数分片，增加重训成本；同时隔离重训导致效用下降。因此需要在不牺牲形式化删除保证的前提下，提高分片局部性并补偿效用损失。

Method: 提出 IDSISA：(1) 利用影响函数识别并聚合易遗忘样本到少数分片，减少受影响分片数量；(2) 从未受影响分片向重训分片进行知识蒸馏以恢复隔离带来的效用损失，蒸馏近似误差单独量化（期望 ε_cert ≤ 0.015）；(3) 针对重复删除请求场景，形式化跨分片蒸馏引入的依赖关系，并证明基于闭包的级联重训可在任意删除序列下把删除保证恢复到完整聚合模型。

Result: 在 ResNet-18/CIFAR-10、ResNet-18/CIFAR-100、BiLSTM/IMDB、TCN/IMDB 及 Fashion-MNIST 上的全连接网络上，相对 SISA 选择性遗忘提升 14–91%，相对效用保留最高提升 50%（其他架构上呈稳定的百分点增益），遗忘时间变化在 −6.7% 至 +6.4% 之间，依架构而定。

Conclusion: IDSISA 将精确删除保证与经验量化的蒸馏近似解耦，在保持 SISA 式精确重训删除语义的同时显著改善选择性与效用，并可扩展到重复删除序列，具备理论与实证双重支持。

Abstract: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training examples to comply with privacy regulations. Full retraining gives strong guarantees but is computationally prohibitive at scale; approximate methods are efficient but lack formal guarantees. SISA (Sharded, Isolated, Sliced, and Aggregated training) achieves certified deletion through data sharding and independent retraining, but random partitioning scatters forget requests across most shards, and isolated retraining degrades utility. We introduce IDSISA (Influence-Distilled SISA), which uses influence functions to concentrate forget-prone samples into few shards and distillation from unaffected shards to recover utility lost to isolation. The deletion guarantee inherited from SISA's retraining step remains exact and requires no probabilistic qualification; the distillation-based utility recovery is a separately quantified, empirically bounded approximation ($ε_{\text{cert}} \leq 0.015$ in expectation). We further formalize certification under sequences of repeated deletion requests, where cross-shard distillation can create dependencies between shards; we prove that a closure-based cascading retraining procedure restores the deletion guarantee to the full aggregated model under any deletion sequence. Experiments on ResNet-18/CIFAR-10, ResNet-18/CIFAR-100, BiLSTM/IMDB, TCN/IMDB, and a fully connected network on Fashion-MNIST show $14-91\%$ better selective forgetting, up to $50\%$ better utility retention in relative terms (with consistent percentage-point gains on the other architectures, where a relative baseline is undefined), and unlearning-time changes ranging from $-6.7\%$ to $+6.4\%$ depending on architecture, relative to SISA.

</details>


### [396] [Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06731)
*Jarrod Ragsdale,Rajendra Boppana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出模板间隙重建（TGR）：用小语言模型预测Shell输出时，将可复用输出字面量与占位符组合成模板，仅对占位符间隙自回归生成，并由模板选择器挑选模板（空模板退化为全输出解码），从而提升保真度并缩短生成长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型语言模型用于不实际执行命令的Shell模拟时，全输出解码需要同时预测可复用的工具输出结构和随执行变化的内容，负担重、生成目标长。

Method: TGR提供带哨兵占位符的可复用输出字面量模板，由模板选择器选定模板后，与自回归生成的间隙交错重建完整输出；空模板保留全输出解码（FOD）路径。基于跨异构执行环境收集的1870万条输出构建模板库，在不参与模板库构建的目标环境上，训练模板选择器和五个由不同小模型检查点初始化的重建模型。

Result: 当最优模板覆盖率超过25%时，TGR的输出编辑相似度（O-ES）优于FOD；覆盖率较低时两者相当。短间隙序列下TGR的O-ES为0.964，FOD为0.812；长序列下表现相近。TGR在所涉及的分词器家族中减少生成token数26.3–38.3%。

Conclusion: 将可复用输出结构作为小型Shell模拟器的实用设计选择，可在提升响应保真度、缩短生成目标的同时，保持模板选择与残差预测对响应质量的核心作用。

Abstract: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.

</details>


### [397] [EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06542)
*Ximo Zhu,Ruiqi Liu,Yi Han,Zhengan Wu,Gengsheng Li,ZiAn Wang,Zhu Yuantian,Jin Jiang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EvoOPD，把黑盒教师的特权信息（PI）获取本身当作优化问题，用PI策略库随学生状态演化，在数学与代码任务上六个设置均最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专有模型输出分布不可得，依赖教师logits的细粒度蒸馏无法直接用于黑盒模型；虽然文本反馈可作为特权信息转化为稠密监督，但"应向教师获取何种PI"缺乏指导，且不同PI策略效果随训练进程变化。

Method: 将教师文本反馈视为特权信息，经PI条件化的特权教师转化为学生自身轨迹上的稠密监督；提出EvoOPD，维护随学生状态演化的PI策略库，以PI对当前学生的修复效用为度量，自适应调整反馈的关注点、信息类型与粒度，使获取的信息持续匹配学生学习需求。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B学生上于数学推理与代码生成系统评测，六个模型-任务设置全部取得最佳总体性能，较最强基线平均提升数学2.14个百分点、代码1.30个百分点。

Conclusion: PI获取策略的相对有效性随学生状态改变，固定策略无法在蒸馏全程保持最优，因此将PI获取作为优化问题并动态演化策略是必要且有效的。

Abstract: Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on teacher logits difficult to apply directly to black-box models. We observe that rich textual feedback from a black-box teacher can be treated as privileged information (PI) and converted, through a PI-conditioned privileged teacher, into dense supervision signals on the student's own trajectories. However, what PI should be acquired from the teacher to most effectively support student learning remains unclear. PI strategies that differ in where they focus, what information they request, and how much detail they provide can have substantially different effects on the current student, and their relative effectiveness can further change as training progresses. Based on this observation, we propose Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation (EvoOPD), which treats PI acquisition itself as an optimization problem and maintains a PI Strategy Bank that evolves with the student state. EvoOPD uses the measured repair utility of PI on the current student to adapt the focus, information type, and granularity of teacher feedback, allowing the acquired information to continually match the student's learning needs. We systematically evaluate EvoOPD on mathematical reasoning and code generation with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B students. EvoOPD achieves the best overall performance in all six model-task settings, improving over the strongest baseline in each setting by an average of 2.14 percentage points in mathematics and 1.30 points in code. Further analysis shows that the relative effectiveness of PI acquisition strategies changes with student state, making a fixed strategy difficult to sustain as the best choice throughout distillation.

</details>


### [398] [From Fixed Defaults to Calibrated Activation Policies for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06559)
*Shijie Xu,Boyan Tang,Jianghua Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种校准的激活函数选择策略，从既往实验中学习可靠默认，按任务自适应调整激活函数及其位置，在1225次训练、17个数据集变体、51个预测任务上平均降低MSE 7.86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期时序预测中，现有研究多聚焦模型架构，而激活配置固定，缺乏关于激活选择应如何随数据集与预测步长变化的指导；且每任务穷举搜索配置代价过高。

Method: 构建校准的选择策略：以先验实验为证据学习可靠默认配置，针对每个任务自适应地选择激活函数及其放置位置，当证据不足以支持变更时保留默认。

Result: 在17个数据集变体、51个预测任务、1225次Informer训练运行的评估中，策略相对固定激活基线平均降低MSE 7.86%，并在72.55%的任务上取得改善。

Conclusion: 激活函数的选择与位置是提升现有预测模型的可行方向；累积的实验证据可指导配置决策，无需为每个任务重复穷举搜索。

Abstract: Long-term time-series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, and other applications where reliable predictions are needed beyond the observed data. Although forecasting research has advanced model architectures, fixed activation configurations provide limited guidance on how activation choices should vary across datasets and prediction horizons. This study aims to establish when task-specific activation choices improve forecasting accuracy and how previous experiments can guide the selection of suitable configurations for new tasks. We develop a calibrated selection policy that learns a reliable default from prior experiments, adapts the activation function and its location to each task, and retains the default when evidence for a change is insufficient. In an evaluation supported by 1,225 Informer training runs across 17 dataset variants and 51 forecasting tasks, the policy reduces mean squared error by 7.86% on average relative to the conventional fixed-activation baseline and improves 72.55% of tasks. These findings establish activation choice and placement as practical opportunities for improving existing forecasting models and show how accumulated experimental evidence can guide configuration decisions without repeating an exhaustive search for every task.

</details>


### [399] [Thermodynamics-Informed Learning Captures Hierarchical Hydrogen-Bond Networks in Deep Eutectic Solvents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06590)
*Yanpeng Ye,Chaoran Duan,Mian Xu,S. Mani Sarathy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出热力学信息神经网络TiNN，分层建模HBA-HBD缔合与溶质容纳的自由能路径，实现DES中木质纤维素组分溶解度的准确预测与溶剂筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DES的溶剂化行为取决于多组分氢键网络而非单一组分性质，缺乏可解释、可外推的预测模型，阻碍木质纤维素精炼的溶剂理性筛选。

Method: 构建TiNN模型，以分层结构学习HBA-HBD缔合与溶质容纳的自由能路径；基于938条数据训练，并通过消融实验分析各模块贡献；用葡萄糖、木聚糖、硫酸盐木质素在酸/碱/中性DES中的实测数据进行外部验证，并与COSMO-RS对比；进一步测试对玉米秸秆分馏效果的判别能力。

Result: 测试集R²=0.917，可泛化至新的HBA-HBD组合与稀疏条件；消融显示溶质特异性稳定化贡献最大，氢键相容性重要性依赖溶解机制；相比COSMO-RS将几何平均溶解度误差从>23倍降至约1.5倍；未训练分馏数据即可区分高/低木质素与半纤维素脱除的DES配方。

Conclusion: TiNN提供了一种具有化学机理支撑的DES溶解度预测与溶剂筛选框架，可支持木质纤维素分馏的理性溶剂设计。

Abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) offer a tunable platform for lignocellulose refining, but their solvation behavior depends on multicomponent hydrogen-bond networks rather than individual constituent properties. We develop TiNN, a thermodynamics-informed neural network that hierarchically represents HBA-HBD association and solute accommodation through a learned free-energy pathway. Trained on 938 records, TiNN achieves a test-set $R^2$ of 0.917 and generalizes to new HBA-HBD combinations and sparse conditions. Ablation identifies solute-specific stabilization as the largest contributor to prediction accuracy, while the importance of hydrogen-bond compatibility depends on the dissolution mechanism. Experimental measurements of glucose, xylan, and Kraft lignin in acidic, basic, and neutral DESs show that TiNN reduces the geometric mean solubility error from more than 23-fold with COSMO-RS to approximately 1.5-fold. Without training on fractionation data, TiNN also distinguishes DES formulations with high and low lignin and hemicellulose removal from corn stover. These results support chemically grounded solvent screening for lignocellulose fractionation.

</details>


### [400] [A trust layer for fast pedestal-stability surrogates: calibrated error bars, out-of-distribution alarms and few-shot recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06597)
*Amin Vakhshouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个模型无关的“信任层”，为剥离-气球模稳定性代理模型提供共形误差条、分布外告警与新设计少量仿真再校准，并在JET、BOUT++、SPARC/DIII-D数据上做预注册假设检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习稳定性代理已能毫秒级预测，但仅作点估计，不报告误差大小、也不判断查询是否超出训练分布；对新装置设计而言，关注的平衡几乎全部落在现有代理训练集之外，因此不确定性量化与越界检测尤为关键。

Method: 构建模型无关信任层：(1) 共形预测给出带名义覆盖率的误差条；(2) 分布外告警将可疑样本路由至物理代码；(3) 用新设计的少量仿真进行再校准；在JET-like理想MHD增长率大数据集、BOUT++电阻性代理、SPARC库与DIII-D线圈集上以预注册假设检验评估，并自建神经算子代理作对照。

Result: 误差条在分布内达到名义覆盖，等离子体形状偏移下覆盖不足；数十次新形状仿真或按告警路由可恢复覆盖。BOUT++代理在留出运行上保持校准，告警能识别训练中未出现的托卡马克，情景扫描由小时级降至秒级。SPARC/DIII-D上自标注代理优于基线，异地训练代理排序反向且被告警拒绝；自建神经算子代理的测试暴露两处输入缺陷，修复后与简单网络差距消失。

Conclusion: 信任层对所有测试代理均使覆盖率接近目标，误差条宽度由各代理自身误差决定；并非所有预注册假设成立，论文如实报告了失败结果及其局限。

Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates of linear peeling-ballooning stability now run in milliseconds, but they are mostly deployed as point estimators: they do not say how wrong they may be, or when a query lies outside what they were trained on. For a fusion company designing a new device, every equilibrium of interest is outside the training data of existing surrogates, so this is the case that matters. We describe a model-agnostic trust layer for stability surrogates, made of conformal error bars, out-of-distribution alarms that route doubtful cases to the physics code, and recalibration from a few simulations of a new design, and we test it with pre-registered hypotheses. On a large public dataset of JET-like equilibria with ideal-MHD growth rates, the error bars hold their nominal coverage in distribution and fall short under a shift in plasma shape; a few dozen simulations of the new shape, or routing the cases the alarms flag, restore it. On resistive BOUT++ surrogates, the bars stay calibrated on held-out runs, the alarm flags tokamaks absent from training, and a scenario scan is screened in seconds instead of hours. Across equilibria from the SPARC library and the DIII-D coil set, a surrogate trained on our own graded BOUT++ labels beats the baseline on unseen equilibria, while a surrogate trained elsewhere ranks the same cases backwards and its alarm declines them. Building our own neural-operator surrogate, the harness exposed two input defects whose fix closed its gap to a simple network. For every surrogate tested, the trust layer keeps coverage near target, with a bar width set by that surrogate's own error. Not every pre-registered hypothesis held, and we report those results and the limits of all of them.

</details>


### [401] [The Behavioral Rate of Fine-Tuning: Compression as a Measure of Useful Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06598)
*Joey David,Paul Caillon,Alexandre Allauzen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出操作性“行为速率”$R^\star$，即能在冻结基座模型上保留固定比例微调增益所需的最小压缩适配器序列化大小，并表明该速率取决于数据集-接收器配对而非数据集本身，且压缩会产生显著的降噪效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA通过紧凑的可学习更新适配冻结语言模型，是研究“微调需要写入多少信息”的自然场景；但适配器秩、参数量或数值重建误差都无法直接回答“保留所学行为需要多少比特”。因此需要定义一个直接以行为保真为标准的速率度量。

Method: 定义行为速率$R^\star$：将压缩后的适配器重新载入冻结基座模型后，若其保留固定比例的留出集微调增益，则取满足该条件的最小序列化尺寸。在多个LoRA微调实验中，比较$R^\star$与源描述长度、微调增益、权重空间重建误差等直觉指标的关系；跨不同冻结基座模型测量同一数据集的$R^\star$；在数据上测量校正谱（correction spectra）以对接收器内的速率排序；并对刻意损坏数据集上训练的适配器进行压缩实验。

Result: 在固定优化预算下，$R^\star$随训练内容的多样性增加而上升，但不由源描述长度、微调增益或权重重建误差决定。同一数据集在不同冻结基座模型间表现出显著不同甚至次序反转的速率，说明可压缩性是数据集-接收器配对的属性。数据上测得的校正谱可在单一接收器内对速率排序。压缩具有降噪效应：在故意损坏数据上训练的适配器原本远低于冻结模型，压缩后在GSM8K上从23.7%提升至82.9%（冻结Qwen2.5-7B为77.6%），并在所测模型家族与规模上一致成立；损害不均匀集中于适配器的前导奇异方向，压缩会将其过滤。在训练任务之外，压缩后的损坏适配器泛化更好：在更难数学任务上保留97%基座准确率，而干净适配器仅44%。

Conclusion: 微调可压缩性应由行为保真度而非参数或重建指标衡量，且是数据集与接收器共同决定的属性；校正谱提供了接收器内排序手段。压缩不仅是存储手段，还能过滤集中在主导奇异方向上的损坏信号，从而提升鲁棒性与跨任务泛化，提示低秩压缩可作为适配器质量的正则化机制。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapts a frozen language model through a compact learned update, making it a natural setting for asking how much information fine-tuning needs to write. Yet adapter rank, parameter count, or numerical reconstruction error do not directly tell us how many bits are required to preserve the acquired behavior. We therefore define an operational behavioral rate $R^\star$ as the smallest serialized size of a compressed adapter that, once reloaded into the frozen base model, retains a fixed fraction of its held-out fine-tuning gain. Across LoRA fine-tuning experiments, this rate increases with distinct training content at fixed optimization budgets, but is not determined by intuitive metrics like source description length, fine-tuning gain, or weight-space reconstruction error. Most importantly, the same datasets exhibit substantially different, and even reordered, rates across frozen base models, showing that fine-tuning compressibility is a property of the dataset--receiver pair rather than of the dataset alone. However, we show that correction spectra measured on the data are able to rank these rates within a receiver. Finally, we study a striking noise-reducing effect of compression: adapters trained on deliberately corrupted datasets fall far below the frozen model, yet after compression score above it (23.7% to 82.9% on GSM8K, against 77.6% for frozen Qwen2.5-7B), consistently across tested families and sizes. The damage is unevenly concentrated in the adapter's leading singular directions, which compression appears to filter. Away from its training task, the compressed corrupted adapter also generalizes better than a clean fine-tune: on harder math it retains 97% of base accuracy, versus 44% for the clean adapter.

</details>


### [402] [Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency: Test-Time Reasoning with Imperfect Generators and Verifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06606)
*Ekaterina Fadeeva,Xueyan Li,Mrinmaya Sachan,Maxim Panov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC)，一种随机解码框架，在生成过程中结合步级正确性与未来结果估计来引导推理，同时保留多条轨迹做答案级自洽投票。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多步推理脆弱，中间步骤看似合理却导致错误答案。测试时提升推理需平衡两个不完美信号：提供多样性的生成器与引导正确性的验证器。现有方法偏向一端：验证器加权投票依赖生成器采样，无法将生成导向正确轨迹；束搜索式验证器引导搜索能引导生成，但易过度集中于狭窄轨迹集并放大验证器错误。

Method: VGSC反复从基座语言模型提出候选下一步，在接受/重采样过程中同时使用步级正确性和未来结果估计两个信号，并维护多条轨迹用于最终答案级自洽。作者给出其概率解释：VGSC近似从验证器倾斜的轨迹分布中采样。

Result: 在多个推理基准、多种生成器模型与多种验证器家族上，VGSC的平均准确率高于代表性基线。

Conclusion: 通过在生成过程中联合步级与前瞻两类验证信号并保持多轨迹多样性，VGSC在生成器多样性与验证器正确性之间取得更好折衷，可作为测试时推理增强的有效通用框架。

Abstract: Large language models can solve many multi-step reasoning problems, but their reasoning remains brittle: plausible intermediate steps often lead to incorrect answers. Improving reasoning at test time requires balancing two imperfect signals: the generator, which provides diversity, and the verifier, which guides correctness. Existing approaches largely favor one side of this tradeoff. Verifier-weighted voting relies on trajectories sampled from the generator and cannot steer generation toward correct ones. By contrast, beam-style verifier-guided search can steer generation, but may over-concentrate on narrow trajectory sets and amplify verifier errors.
  We propose Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC), a stochastic decoding framework that combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates to guide reasoning during generation. VGSC repeatedly proposes candidate next steps from the base language model and uses both signals in an acceptance/resampling procedure, while maintaining multiple trajectories for final answer-level self-consistency. We provide a probabilistic interpretation of VGSC as approximate sampling from a verifier-tilted trajectory distribution. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, generator models, and verifier families, VGSC achieves higher average accuracy than representative baselines.

</details>


### [403] [Alternatives to Shallow Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06610)
*Mario Mallea,Angela Nebot,Francisco Mugica*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于EASE提出利用用户-用户信息的替代公式，并进一步提出融合用户-用户与物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型，在多个基准上优于EASE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EASE依赖闭式解实现高排名准确率，但其主要基于物品间关系拟合满秩高维线性映射，作者假设该设计限制了其捕捉相似但不等价的细粒度用户关系的能力，从而制约推荐准确率。

Method: 提出基于EASE的替代公式以利用用户-用户信息（用户侧浅层自编码器建模），并构建混合模型，联合结合用户-用户与物品-物品两种邻接分布。

Result: 在知名推荐基准数据集上，所提模型均优于EASE，验证了引入用户侧信息对CF中浅层自编码器研究的价值。

Conclusion: 在浅层自编码器协同过滤研究中纳入用户侧信息具有重要意义；用户-用户建模及用户-物品混合邻接分布可有效提升推荐准确率。

Abstract: Collaborative filtering (CF) is a cornerstone of recommender systems and plays a relevant role in many modern applications. CF uses user-item interaction data to discover future preferences. Although deep learning models have shown promise in CF, Embarrassingly Shallow Autoencoders for Sparse Data (EASE) has gained attention for its outstanding ranking accuracy provided by its closed-form solution. EASE relies primarily on relationships among items to fit a full-rank high-dimensional linear mapping. We hypothesize that this design limits its capacity to capture similar but not equivalent fine-grained user relationships, consequently limiting its recommendation accuracy. This paper introduces an alternative formulation based on EASE that takes advantage of user-user information. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid model that combines both user-user and item-item adjacency distributions.
  Our experiments reveal that the proposed models outperform EASE on well-known recommendation benchmarks, highlighting the significance of including the user alternative in shallow autoencoder studies for CF.

</details>


### [404] [From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06612)
*Björn Ludwig,Alexander Windmann,René Heesch,Oliver Niggemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练一个不带人工掩码增广的序列重建器并冻结，在推理时将测试窗口的缺失项当作优化变量，通过观测自一致性目标反向传播进行细化，从而把冻结重建器转换为插补器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完整传感器通道失效导致局部插值不可用，且为每种失效模式单独训练插补器不切实际；作者希望无需掩码增广训练、无需重训即可复用重建模型完成插补。

Method: 将测试窗口缺失条目设为可优化变量，固定所有观测值，通过冻结模型反向传播、仅在观测坐标上最小化重建误差（观测自一致性目标）；用从缺失输入到观测残差的交叉雅可比刻画该细化何时有信息量，并在耦合较弱时引入可选的时序平滑先验。实验覆盖5个真实数据集、每窗口精确掩蔽一个通道、4种重建架构。

Result: 无先验的测试时细化在20个"数据集-骨干"组合中的19个上相对单次重建降低MAE；与在标准结构化掩码或匹配的整通道dropout下训练的掩码感知插补器相比，最佳细化重建器在2个数据集上MAE最低、在3个上落后最强基线。增益以显著增加的推理时间为代价，且对跨通道耦合敏感。

Conclusion: 测试时自一致性是一种有条件的推理期适配器，可增强冻结的重建模型，作为掩码感知插补的补充而无需重训重建器。

Abstract: Complete sensor-channel failures create a difficult form of time-series missingness: local interpolation is unavailable, and deploying a separately trained imputer for every failure pattern may be impractical. We ask whether a sequence reconstructor trained without artificial mask augmentation and then frozen can be converted into an imputer at inference time. Our method treats the missing entries of each test window as optimization variables, clamps all observations, and backpropagates through the frozen model to minimize reconstruction error only on observed coordinates. The resulting observed-self-consistency objective requires neither artificial mask augmentation nor full-channel dropout during reconstructor training. We characterize when this refinement is informative through the cross-Jacobian from missing inputs to observed residuals, and use an optional temporal-smoothness prior when that coupling is weak. Across five real-world datasets with exactly one channel synthetically masked per test window and four reconstruction architectures, no-prior test-time refinement reduces MAE relative to one-pass reconstruction in 19 of 20 dataset-backbone combinations. Compared with mask-aware imputers trained under either standard structured masks or matched full-channel dropout, the best refined reconstructor achieves the lowest MAE on two datasets and trails the strongest baseline on three. These gains require substantially more inference time and are sensitive to cross-channel coupling. Our results establish test-time self-consistency as a conditional inference-time adapter for frozen reconstruction models that complements mask-aware imputation without retraining the reconstructor.

</details>


### [405] [Dimension-Free Private Mean Estimation is Impossible Without the Covariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06615)
*Renaud Gaucher,Ephraim Linder,Adam Smith,Jonathan Ullman,Lydia Zakynthinou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究协方差未知时差分隐私高斯均值估计的极限，证明此时无法像已知协方差那样仅依赖谱（各向异性结构）来获得与维度无关的误差或样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明，当协方差Σ已知时，最优样本复杂度可仅依赖其谱（有效维度）而非环境维度d。作者希望厘清协方差未知时是否仍能利用各向异性结构获得类似的维度无关保证。

Method: 针对欧氏误差下的高斯均值估计，建立新的下界（lower bounds），按样本量n与有效维度 trace(Σ)/‖Σ‖_op 的相对大小分两种情形分析，并将未知协方差的最优误差与已知协方差情形进行对比。

Result: （1）当 n 小于有效维度时，未知协方差下的最优误差可比已知时大 √(d/n) 倍；（2）当 n 大于有效维度时，即使对有效维度以 log d 为界的对角协方差矩阵，未知协方差下的最优误差仍可比已知时大 √d/n^{3/2} 倍。

Conclusion: 在协方差未知的设定下，差分隐私中利用各向异性结构必然需要依赖维度的误差或样本复杂度，无法达到已知协方差时的谱依赖保证。

Abstract: We study the limits of differentially private Gaussian mean estimation when the covariance matrix is unknown. Prior work shows that when the covariance $Σ$ is known, the optimal sample complexity can depend only on its spectrum, rather than on the ambient dimension $d$. We establish new lower bounds for Gaussian mean estimation with Euclidean error which show that private estimators cannot achieve similar guarantees when the covariance is unknown. First, when the sample size $n$ is smaller than the effective dimension $\mathrm{trace}(Σ)/\|Σ\|_{\text{op}}$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d/n}$. Second, when the sample size is larger than the effective dimension, even for diagonal covariance matrices with effective dimension bounded by $\log d$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d}/n^{3/2}$. Together, these results show that in the unknown covariance setting, exploiting anisotropic structure under differential privacy can require a dimension-dependent error or sample complexity.

</details>


### [406] [Fingerprinting the Dispatchers behind Distributed Model Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06661)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于请求时间戳（到达时间与流完成时间）的时序分析，可在内容分类器失效时，用20%种子账户对API蒸馏活动的其余账户进行取证排序，AUC达0.92–1.00，20分钟内完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: API蒸馏活动通过将请求分散到数千个负载均衡账户来隐藏模型窃取流量，标准内容分类器往往无法识别；因此需要一种不依赖内容、可在大规模生产账户中定位同一活动账户的取证手段。

Method: 利用请求的到达时间与流完成时间揭示底层调度策略（如轮询计数器、键混洗池等），以20%种子账户为起点，对剩余账户的时序特征进行取证排序；并评估自适应攻击者采用抖动、旋转调度器和键固定（key pinning）等规避手段的效果。

Result: 在数千个真实生产账户中，20分钟内即可完成对活动剩余账户的排序，AUC为0.92至1.00；抖动难以掩盖旋转调度器，键固定虽可成功规避检测，但在配额受限时会严重限制吞吐。

Conclusion: 即使内容过滤失效，时序特征仍能暴露共享基础设施模式，可作为API蒸馏检测的补充取证维度。

Abstract: API distillation campaigns try to hide model-stealing traffic by splitting requests across thousands of load-balanced accounts, which standard content classifiers often miss. However, request timestamps, specifically arrival time and stream completion time, reveal the underlying dispatching strategy, such as round-robin counters or key-shuffling pools. Using a 20 percent seed set, this timing analysis can forensically rank the remaining accounts of a campaign with 0.92 to 1.00 AUC within 20 minutes, even across thousands of real production accounts. While adaptive attackers struggle to hide rotating dispatchers using jitter, pinning keys successfully evades detection, though it can severely throttle throughput when quotas bind. Ultimately, timing exposes shared infrastructure patterns even when content filters fail.

</details>


### [407] [Self-Directed Apple Tasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06677)
*Tanmay Devale,Reed Phillips,Arvind Ramaswami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"苹果品尝"部分反馈模型下自导（self-directed）学习问题：学习者可自适应选择预测顺序，实时情形下基于 VC 维、空集中心星数与自导维给出错误数的四分类刻画；不可知情形下的极小极大遗憾为 Θ̃(√n) 或 Θ(n)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Raman et al. (2024) 已刻画了在线对抗（由对手安排顺序）情形下苹果品尝模型的错误率，但学习者主动选择预测顺序的"自导"情形尚缺刻画。作者希望填补这一空白，并厘清自导能力对学习速率的本质影响。

Method: 在部分反馈模型（仅预测 1 时观测真实标签）下定义自导学习框架。实时情形引入"自导维"（self-directed dimension）作为新组合参数，与 VC 维、∅-中心星数共同刻画最优错误数；通过上界算法与下界构造，建立期望极小极大错误数的四分类定理。不可知情形则结合标准技术的扩展分析遗憾率。

Result: 实时情形呈现四分法：错误率可能为 Θ(1)、O(log n)∩ω(1)、Θ̃(√n) 或 Θ(n)，由 VC 维、∅-中心星数与自导维的取值决定。不可知情形下，极小极大遗憾为 Θ̃(√n) 或 Θ(n)，仅取决于 VC 维。

Conclusion: 自导能力显著改变部分反馈学习的可学习性谱系：与对抗顺序下的单一组合刻画不同，自导情形需三维参数联合分类，且实时与不可知两类设定呈现不同结构。该结果为部分反馈在线学习的顺序自适应问题提供了完整的速率蓝图。

Abstract: We study the classical apple-tasting setting, a partial feedback model in which the learner observes the true label only when it predicts $1$. A combinatorial characterization for the rates of this problem in the online adversarial setting has been studied by Raman et al. (2024). We study the self-directed setting, in which the learner can adaptively choose the order of the points it predicts on. In the realizable setting, we establish a tetrachotomy on the expected minimax number of mistakes made by any learner. Depending on the VC dimension, the $\emptyset$-centered star number, and the self-directed dimension, we show that the rates could possibly be $Θ(1)$, $O(\log n) \cap ω(1)$, $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$, or $Θ(n)$. In the agnostic setting, the minimax regret is $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$ or $Θ(n)$, depending on the VC dimension.

</details>


### [408] [Do unlearning algorithms learn the right features?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06681)
*Polina Dolgova,Amartya Sanyal,Sebastian U. Stich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出标准快照式遗忘评估会掩盖未学习模型与重训练模型在特征层面上的差异；作者提出可分离"缺失特征"与"多余特征"的特征恢复度量，并证明其对后续再学习与下游适配偏差具有预测与纠正作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估主要依赖删除后的快照指标（将未学习模型与在剩余数据上重训练的模型对比输出）。这类评估可能掩盖两个模型所编码特征的重要差异，即使在输出上看似一致，也无法保证行为在后续训练中保持一致。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明若未学习模型与重训练模型输出一致但编码的特征不同，则在其预测头上施加单步梯度更新即可打破这种一致性；并证明删除任意小比例数据都可能使重训练选择性质不同的特征，从而"匹配重训练"可能要求学习完整模型从未拥有的特征。2) 提出特征恢复度量，将缺失特征（missing）与多余特征（extraneous）分开衡量。3) 在八种遗忘方法上进行实证评估，并结合后续再学习与下游适配实验验证该度量与偏差的关系，以及直接纠正该错配的效果。

Result: 在八种遗忘方法中，许多在标准指标上表现良好的模型未能恢复重训练模型的特征；该特征层面的错配能够预测模型在后续再学习和下游适配中相对重训练模型的偏差，且直接纠正该错配可系统性降低这些偏差。

Conclusion: 快照式输出一致性不足以刻画机器遗忘的成功与否，特征层面的恢复是必要且更具预测力的评估维度；将缺失特征与多余特征分离的特征恢复度量可作为诊断工具，并可通过显式纠正提升未学习模型在后续训练场景下与重训练行为的一致性。

Abstract: Machine unlearning is commonly evaluated with standard post-deletion metrics that compare an unlearned model to one retrained on the remaining data. Such snapshot evaluations can conceal consequential differences in the features the two models encode. We prove that if an unlearned and a retrained model agree on their outputs but encode different features, a single gradient step on their prediction heads can break this agreement. We further show that deleting an arbitrarily small fraction of the data can cause retraining to select qualitatively different features, so matching retraining can require learning features that the full model never had. We then introduce a measure of feature recovery that separates missing from extraneous features. Across eight unlearning methods, models that perform well on standard metrics often fail to recover the retrained features. This mismatch predicts deviations from retraining under subsequent relearning and downstream adaptation, and directly correcting it systematically reduces these deviations.

</details>


### [409] [Hallucination Is Linearly Decodable from Mid-Layer Hidden States in Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02628)
*Aizierjiang Aiersilan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究开源LLM隐状态中是否存在线性可分的真实性信号及其最强网络深度，发现单一中层线性探针AUROC可达0.904–1.000，而采样类检测器不超过0.541。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究开源LLM内部是否编码线性可分的真实性信号、该信号在网络哪一层最强，并厘清探针式与采样式幻觉检测方法的性能差异来源。

Method: 在4-bit NF4量化的三个7B–8B指令微调模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B）上，于四个幻觉基准（TruthfulQA、HaluEval-QA、FEVER及受控合成集）逐层提取隐状态，比较线性/MLP探针、INSIDE EigenScore、自一致性、注意力熵四类检测方法。

Result: 单中层线性探针在留出集上AUROC为0.904–1.000；采样类检测器同协议下AUROC不超过0.541；MLP探针较线性探针提升极少超过0.01 AUROC；最优层在不同模型族呈一致区间（Llama/Mistral第13–18/32层，Qwen第19–25/28层）；首块注意力熵在知识 grounded 场景提供互补信号（HaluEval-QA上0.866–0.941 AUROC）且无额外推理开销。

Conclusion: 真实性信号近似线性且集中于中层；采样方法低判别力源于配对标签评测与其可获信息的结构性错配，而非方法本身固有限制；代码与数据在单张8GB GPU上可完全复现。

Abstract: We investigate whether open-source LLMs encode a linearly separable truthfulness signal in their hidden states, and at which network depth this signal is strongest. Across three $7$B--$8$B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-7B) loaded in $4$-bit NF4 quantization, we extract per-layer hidden states on four hallucination benchmarks (TruthfulQA, HaluEval-QA, FEVER, and a controlled synthetic set) and compare four detection approaches: linear and MLP probes, INSIDE EigenScore, self-consistency, and attention entropy. A linear probe on a single mid-network layer achieves $0.904$--$1.000$ AUROC on held-out splits, while sampling-based detectors do not exceed $0.541$ AUROC under the same protocol. The truthfulness signal is approximately linear: MLP probes rarely surpass linear probes by more than $0.01$ AUROC. Peak probing layers fall in a consistent band across model families on natural-language benchmarks -- blocks~$13$--$18$ of~$32$ for Llama and Mistral, and blocks~$19$--$25$ of~$28$ for Qwen. First-block attention entropy provides a complementary signal in knowledge-grounded settings ($0.866$--$0.941$ AUROC on HaluEval-QA) at no additional inference cost. The low discriminability of sampling methods under this protocol reflects a structural mismatch between paired-label evaluation and the information these methods access, rather than an inherent limitation of those methods. Code and data are released for full reproducibility on a single $8$\,GB GPU.

</details>


### [410] [SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06682)
*Guoqin Xiong,Shengtao Wen,Xiang Chen,Xinyi Zeng,Zhaoxin Fan,Wei Ye,Xiaofeng Cao,Sheng-Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种动态本体引导的治理框架，将异构工具调用映射到统一语义表示，并结合可执行本体与回合级任务状态，给出确定性的「就绪/等待/禁止」决策，以实现执行层安全治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型LLM智能体将模型输出转化为具有实际后果的动作，使间接提示注入从内容问题升级为执行安全问题。现有防御约束工具调用、轨迹或信息流，但动作语义、状态依赖与证据关系多为隐式，导致跨异构工具泛化差、安全更新困难。

Method: 框架基于共享语义表示落地异构调用，以可执行本体加回合级任务状态推导确定性决策：ready表示可执行，waiting表示存在未满足但可恢复的义务，从而在不扩大授权边界的前提下支持有界重规划，forbidden则直接禁止。本体在离线阶段演化：由离线LLM提出与实例无关的动作–状态公理，仅当其针对训练失败暴露的本体错误、保持逻辑一致性与受保护蕴含、并通过留出验证时才被接受，随后冻结本体。

Result: 在AgentDojo、ASB与AgentDyn三个基准上，于良性及间接提示注入设置下评估，攻击成功率（ASR）均为0%，且在攻击条件下任务效用优于现有基线。

Conclusion: 显式的语义治理可在不采取无差别拦截的情况下强化执行安全，说明以动作语义、状态依赖和证据关系为核心的本体化治理是提升工具调用智能体安全性的可行路径。

Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.

</details>


### [411] [Don't Replace, Complement: A Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal for Near-OOD Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06688)
*Wonseok Shin,Songkuk Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PLUS 信号：基于稀疏自编码器类活跃神经元构造的每类低维子空间白化马氏距离，作为近OOD检测的通用互补信号，与任意校准基线分数固定权重加法融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后验OOD检测在far-OOD上成熟但在near-OOD上仍弱。二者差异在于类别特征方向的使用：far-OOD输入基本不激活其预测类别的特征方向，而near-OOD输入激活方式与ID样本相似，因此用于区分far-OOD的轴向几乎无法区分near-OOD，单一分数难以同时兼顾，敏感度提升往往以far-OOD性能为代价。

Method: PLUS（Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal）：对每个类别，从稀疏自编码器中选取m个类别活跃度最高的神经元，将其对应的解码方向正交规范化形成低维子空间；输入以其在预测类子空间内的逐类白化平方马氏距离z打分。z作为专用互补项，以单一固定全局权重与任意校准基线分数加性融合，所有校准统计仅由ID验证集估计。

Result: 在涵盖多种方法族的18种现有检测器上，z在全部126个检测器—骨干网络组合中一致提升near-OOD AUROC；far-OOD性能大体保持或提升，仅在基线接近最优时出现边际下降。

Conclusion: PLUS是一个稳健、与检测器和骨干无关的近OOD互补信号，可与现有后验检测器即插即用地融合。

Abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is mature on far-OOD yet remains weak on near-OOD. These two settings differ in their use of class-characteristic feature directions: far-OOD inputs largely fail to activate those of their predicted class, whereas near-OOD inputs activate them much as in-distribution samples do. Because the axis separating far-OOD leaves near-OOD almost indistinguishable from ID, a score optimized for one setting is misaligned with the other; where a detector already saturates far-OOD, added near-OOD sensitivity is bought partly against it. This divergence motivates a targeted near-OOD signal designed to complement existing scores. We propose PLUS (Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal). For each class, PLUS selects the $m$ most class-active neurons from a sparse autoencoder, orthonormalizes the corresponding decoder directions to form a low-dimensional subspace, and scores an input by its per-class whitened squared Mahalanobis distance $z$ within the subspace of its predicted class. Designed as a dedicated complement rather than a standalone detector, the signal $z$ is fused additively with any calibrated base score at a single, fixed weight. This weight is a single global constant: no value is adjusted per backbone, per OOD dataset, or per deployment, and all calibration statistics are estimated from ID validation data alone. When applied to 18 existing detectors spanning diverse method families, $z$ consistently improves near-OOD AUROC in all 126 detector--backbone combinations. Far-OOD performance is broadly maintained or improved, with only marginal declines where the base score is near-optimal, making $z$ a robust, detector-agnostic complement across backbones.

</details>


### [412] [PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06700)
*Zhiyong Zhou,Sheng Liao,Youshen Xiao,Xiaolin Li,Yakang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种物理信息自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架，无需配对源标签或仿真预训练即可实现EEG扩展源空间重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG扩展源成像需定位活跃皮层区并刻画其空间范围，但现有监督逆问题网络依赖合成的EEG-源配对数据，易受仿真到真实（synthetic-to-real）失配影响。

Method: 将导联场矩阵所编码的源-传感器体传导模型作为物理约束，以预测EEG与实测EEG的一致性驱动INR训练；把皮层电流密度建模为连续坐标条件场；用经典逆估计提供暖启动与源活动空间约束；通过patch-integrated projection将连续场映射为离散源系数用于前向建模。

Result: 在不同噪声水平、源数量与源范围的仿真中，方法在识别活跃皮层区域上优势最明显，尤其对多源与较大范围源；基于癫痫患者真实EEG与颅内刺激实验的定量与定性评估进一步支持其源成像可行性。

Conclusion: 物理信息自监督INR在扩展源成像方面具有潜力，可在无配对标签条件下实现连续空间源重建。

Abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.

</details>


### [413] [Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06704)
*Xinglu Wang,Edward Wang,Yong Zhang,Zhenan Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 以Qwen3.5-9B为基础的智能体玩Pac-Man时，需要区分性能瓶颈来自感知（读屏）还是策略（长序列动作选择）；作者通过分离的感知检查与基于文本棋盘的原始策略强化学习进行研究，发现策略优化可将八张留出迷宫的完成率从0%提升至80.2%，但静态读屏准确不代表交互中无错，且进一步优化可能伴随更差的动作选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当智能体仅用上下左右四个动作玩Pac-Man而表现不佳时，难以定位失败来源：是屏幕视觉理解（感知）出错，还是长序列决策（策略）不佳。作者希望厘清这两类问题，并为训练后评估提出可操作的检查方法。

Method: 采用分而治之的实验设计：一方面进行独立的感知检查（考察静态截图读取能力，并与交互过程中的表现对照）；另一方面构建原始策略强化学习研究，使用文本化棋盘表示，将图像转写从决策接口中移除，从而单独隔离策略学习问题；并额外进行策略对比，考察优化程度与动作选择质量的关系。

Result: 在策略研究中，八张留出迷宫的完成率从优化前的0%提升至所选检查点的80.2%（含三条额外生命）。感知检查表明，准确的静态截图读取可以与交互过程中的错误并存；另一项策略对比显示，进一步的优化可能伴随更差的动作选择。

Conclusion: 研究提出训练后应实施的具体检查：在使用中评估感知、区分训练成功与完整游戏验证、考察决策过程及后续表现而非依赖单一选定分数；这些实证经验有助于改进未来智能体的训练与评估。

Abstract: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.

</details>


### [414] [Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06711)
*Giuliano Galadini,Aurelio Uncini,Danilo Comminiello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Energy-Guided Transport，一种免训练框架，将非线性物理约束表述为平滑势能景观，通过连续耗散力直接作用于生成中间态，而非刚性代数投影，实现物理一致且高效的PDE生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准生成模型（尤其Flow Matching）纯统计驱动、对控制方程未知，推理时常违反基本物理约束。现有零样本约束方法多依赖刚性代数投影，对稀疏边界条件有效，但用于稠密全域PDE的离散几何修正可能破坏概率路径、偏离学习流形并带来大量计算开销。

Method: 将非线性物理约束构造为平滑势能景观，在ODE积分过程中向中间生成状态施加连续耗散力以导向物理流形，而非中断积分做投影；该力通过反向模式自动微分隐式求值，保持流的自然动力学并使算法复杂度为O(N)。

Result: 在多种1D、2D物理系统（含混沌Navier-Stokes方程）上评估，实现无结构发散稳定生成，显著改善稳定性-精度权衡，相比精确投影策略大幅加速推理。

Conclusion: 以连续能量引导替代刚性投影，可在不重训练、不破坏概率路径的前提下有效融合物理约束，兼顾物理一致性、生成稳定性与推理效率。

Abstract: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of the flow while maintaining an efficient $\mathcal{O}(N)$ algorithmic complexity. We extensively evaluate our framework across various 1D and 2D physical systems, including the chaotic Navier-Stokes equations. Our method achieves stable generation without structural divergence, significantly improves the stability-accuracy trade-off compared to state-of-the-art methods, and substantially accelerates inference with respect to exact projection strategies. Code available at: https://github.com/ispamm/Projection-free-energy-guided-flow-matching.

</details>


### [415] [Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06718)
*Naima Elosegui Borras,Georgios Arvanitidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究在稳定边缘（EOS）区域，中心流（central flow）描述下梯度流守恒律的演化，证明曲率修正会沿临界参数方向产生由振荡协方差决定的有限维漂移，从而刻画哪些守恒律在 EOS 下仍保持、哪些被破坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的连续对称性给出梯度流下不变的守恒量（如线性/ReLU网络的层间平衡性），但有限步梯度下降未必保持这些定律，尤其在EOS处迭代围绕更光滑轨迹振荡。已有中心流框架描述该振荡，但守恒律在其下的命运尚不清楚。

Method: 在中心流描述下分析守恒律的演化；推导曲率修正引起的漂移项，证明其为有限维且由沿临界参数方向的振荡协方差决定；并在三个模型上具体分析：标量两层模型、两层矩阵分解、以及已知守恒律完备的两层ReLU网络。

Result: 曲率修正产生一个有限维漂移，由振荡协方差沿临界参数方向确定；据此逐一判定标量两层模型、两层矩阵分解和两层ReLU网络中哪些守恒律在EOS处仍成立、哪些被破坏。

Conclusion: EOS下中心流动力学一般会破坏梯度流守恒律，破坏程度由振荡协方差决定；该工作为按中心流刻画EOS处守恒律的保留与破缺迈出第一步。

Abstract: Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complete (Marcotte et al., 2023).

</details>


### [416] [Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06759)
*Gilad Karpel,Itay Evron,Ron Meir,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究高维统计设定下基于线性预测器的持续学习逻辑回归，先给出持续线性分类的最优L2正则强度并刻画泛化行为，再分析两层对角线性网络中L2正则的稀疏偏置在持续学习下失效的问题，提出加权L2变体以恢复稀疏偏置，并理论+实验证明其对稀疏教师收敛更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有持续学习理论研究多集中于持续线性回归与各类L2正则变体，因其分析简洁且与神经网络核机制相关；而持续分类（逻辑回归）的理论刻画不足。同时，单任务下L2正则能诱导预测器稀疏、带来超越核机制的稀疏特征学习，但在持续学习中L2正则以先前任务权重为中心，该稀疏偏置不再保持，需设计新正则以保留此优势。

Method: 1) 推导持续线性逻辑回归的最优L2正则强度，刻画其泛化性能，并与持续线性回归的已有结果对照；2) 采用最小化两层对角线性网络分析深层模型中L2正则的作用；3) 提出加权L2正则变体，将稀疏偏置扩展至持续学习场景；4) 结合理论分析与实验验证。

Result: 持续线性分类的最优L2强度及泛化行为与持续线性回归的已有结论在性质上一致；在持续学习中，以先前任务权重为中心的常规L2正则无法保持单任务下的稀疏偏置；所提加权L2变体对足够稀疏的教师，收敛速度显著快于使用常规持续L2或L1正则直接学习线性预测器，以一定的长时程偏差换取中等任务时程上的明显性能提升。

Conclusion: 持续分类中的L2正则行为可与持续回归理论对应；深层（两层对角线性）模型的关键稀疏特征学习优势在持续学习中会因正则中心化而丧失，通过加权L2正则可恢复该稀疏偏置，在稀疏教师情形下于中短任务时程获得显著加速与性能增益，代价是长时程存在一定偏置。

Abstract: We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression.
