Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). However, in continual learning, where L2 regularization is typically centered on previous-task weights, this sparsity bias is no longer preserved. We therefore propose a weighted variant of L2 regularization that extends this beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning. We show theoretically and empirically that, for a sufficiently sparse teacher, our variant converges substantially faster than directly learning a linear predictor with conventional continual L2 or L1 regularization, trading some long-horizon bias for markedly improved performance over moderate task horizons.

</details>


### [417] [FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06783)
*Quan Minh Nguyen,Hoang M. Ngo,Bhakti Chowkwale,Yasaman Keshtkarjahromi,My T. Thai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedFiOT：以Fisher信息加权的最优传输框架，联合对齐神经元并聚合模型，用于单轮/少轮联邦学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单轮/少轮FL可降低通信开销，但因缺乏频繁同步，客户端模型发生漂移，学习相似特征的神经元在客户端间位置不一致；同时本地数据异构使对应参数对各客户端预测的重要性不同。这导致直接平均会合并错位神经元并对重要度不同的参数等权处理，性能低于常规多轮FL。

Method: FedFiOT利用Fisher信息量化参数重要性，并以此指导神经元对齐与模型聚合；通过交替最小化一个共享的Fisher加权目标，联合优化神经元对应关系与全局模型参数；理论分析证明该优化过程使逐层合并目标单调下降，并给出刻画客户端异构性与非均匀Fisher加权影响的稳定性（stationarity）界。

Result: 在多个数据集的实验中，单轮与少轮联邦学习设置下均相对竞争基线取得一致提升。

Conclusion: Fisher加权的最优传输能有效缓解神经元错位与参数重要性差异问题，在保持低通信轮数的同时提升单轮/少轮FL性能，并具备单调收敛与稳定性理论保证。

Abstract: One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performance than conventional multi-round FL. Without frequent synchronization, client models may drift apart, causing neurons that learn similar features to occupy different positions across clients. At the same time, local data heterogeneity can cause corresponding parameters to differ in their importance to each client's predictions. Together, these challenges cause direct averaging to combine mismatched neurons and assign equal weight to parameters despite differences in their importance. We propose FedFiOT, a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round FL that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation. FedFiOT jointly optimizes neuron correspondences and global model parameters through alternating minimization of a shared Fisher-weighted objective. Theoretically, we show that FedFiOT's optimization procedure monotonically decreases the layer-wise merging objective and establish a stationarity bound that quantifies the effects of client heterogeneity and nonuniform Fisher weighting.Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines in both one-shot and few-round federated learning settings.

</details>


### [418] [Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06793)
*Harsidak Singh Banwait*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SARBLOH智能体，以零参数O(HW)感知引擎构建物体级工作模型，配合代码即动作运行时，在ARC-AGI-3上把评分从3/28提升至25/28、token减少89.4%，隐藏评测得16.53分（首个里程碑冠军的13.7倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型直接读取原始整数网格时，序列化会破坏空间拓扑，导致模型耗费数百步动作重新发现基本边界与对称性；而ARC-AGI-3以相对人类动作效率计分，对探索性浪费施加二次惩罚，因此样本高效流体智能的关键瓶颈在于空间感知而非规划能力。

Method: 零参数O(HW)感知引擎在35 ms内将每帧转为物体清单，含二分图时序跟踪、区分已证不变量与可供性假设的几何简报、标注画布；并与"代码即动作"运行时结合，使智能体编写算法假设而非底层移动。

Result: 8种呈现下接地感知使评分由3/28升至25/28，token下降89.4%。23个留出游戏中几何不变量泛化准确率100%，单帧可供性猜测仅6–50%，故主动验证探针仍必需。公开集上Run A（关简报）8.2小时解出183关中的143关、单次通过效率59.4%，Run B（开简报）达63.5%。单卡九小时预算内隐藏Kaggle评测得分16.53，为首个里程碑冠军的13.7倍。

Conclusion: 空间接地感知是交互式推理的主要制约因素；几何不变量可强泛化，但可供性需主动探测验证；该架构在严格动作效率与算力预算下显著超越先前方法。

Abstract: Sample-efficient fluid intelligence requires agents that rapidly form working models of unfamiliar interactive environments. ARC-AGI-3 tests this across uninstructed visual games scored by Relative Human Action Efficiency, which penalizes exploratory waste quadratically. When frontier models read raw integer grids, serialization destroys spatial topology, and they spend hundreds of actions rediscovering basic boundaries and symmetries. We introduce SARBLOH, an open-weight agent built on the premise that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3. A zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine turns each frame, in 35 ms, into an object inventory with bipartite temporal tracking, a geometric briefing that separates proven invariants from affordance hypotheses, and an annotated canvas. Paired with a code-as-action runtime, the agent writes algorithmic hypotheses instead of low-level moves. Across eight presentations, grounded perception raises the rubric score from 3/28 to 25/28 points while cutting token use by 89.4%. On 23 held-out games, geometric invariants generalize with 100% accuracy, while single-frame affordance guesses fall to 6-50%, so active verification probes remain necessary. On the public set, Run A (briefing off) solved 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours at 59.4% single-pass efficiency; Run B (briefing on) reached 63.5%. Within the nine-hour budget on one Kaggle RTX PRO 6000 GPU, SARBLOH scored 16.53 on the hidden Kaggle evaluation, 13.7x the first Milestone winner.

</details>


### [419] [Message-passing graph persistence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06801)
*Jorge Luiz Franco,Arthur Queiroz Moura,Moacir Ponti,Amauri Souza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出消息传递图持续性（MGP），将消息传递嵌入图过滤过程，使拓扑描述子与表示学习耦合；理论上同构不变且严格强于其所扩展的PH描述子，实验在表达性基准与多数图分类/回归数据集上优于其他基于PH的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消息传递GNN的表达能力受限于1-WL测试；持续同调（PH）可提供互补的拓扑信息，但现有方法将持久性计算与表示学习过程分离，二者未协同。

Method: 构建一类拓扑描述子MGP：在图过滤（filtration）的每一步引入消息传递，用当前子图更新节点嵌入，并将嵌入与持久性事件（persistence events）关联；这些嵌入同时决定持续同调计算中连通分支的代表元。

Result: 证明MGP在图同构下不变，且严格比其所扩展的PH描述子更具表达力；在表达性基准及多个图分类/回归数据集上，MGP在多数数据集上优于其他基于PH的描述子。

Conclusion: 将消息传递融入图过滤可持续性地增强拓扑描述子的表达力，为GNN与拓扑数据分析的深度结合提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Message-passing graph neural networks (GNNs) are limited in expressive power by the one-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman test. Persistent homology (PH) provides topological descriptors that can complement GNN representations, but existing approaches typically compute persistence separately from the representation learning process. In this paper, we introduce Message-Passing Graph Persistence (MGP), a family of topological descriptors that incorporates message passing into graph filtrations. At each filtration step, node embeddings are updated using the current subgraph and associated with persistence events. These embeddings also determine the representatives of connected components during persistence computation. We prove that MGP is invariant under graph isomorphism and that it is strictly more expressive than the PH-based descriptors it extends. We evaluate MGP on an expressivity benchmark and on several graph classification and regression datasets. Experiments show that MGP outperforms other PH-based descriptors on most of these datasets.

</details>


### [420] [Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06828)
*Gagik Amirkhanyan,Nuojin Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Systolic Linear Attention (SLA)，通过将门控delta线性注意力重塑为适配TPU 256×256脉动矩阵单元的结构，在TPU v7x上比Tokamax KDA内核快1.6–2.5倍，MoE预训练提速11%–24%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GDN、KDA、GDN-2等门控delta线性注意力内核针对GPU优化（小tensor-core tile、快速向量寄存器使逐通道衰减重缩放与块内串行求解代价低）。在TPU上，计算集中于宽256×256脉动矩阵单元而向量单元较慢，直接移植会导致矩阵tile有一半空闲并以向量运算为瓶颈。

Method: SLA围绕矩阵单元重构门控delta注意力：(1) 通过分组value head将key维度扩展到256；(2) 将衰减门聚合为四个64通道tile；(3) 用块矩阵乘完全替代串行操作，在单一融合内核中完成chunk solve。

Result: TPU v7x上完整SLA-R4层比开源Tokamax KDA内核快1.6×–2.5×（使用精确chunk求逆时为1.4×–2.4×），主要增益来自head共享与内核融合。在2048芯片TPU v7x上对6.5B–63.1B参数稀疏MoE模型的预训练研究中，SLA在相近困惑度下训练速度快11%–24%，并在较小规模的匹配随机种子实验中取得略低困惑度。

Conclusion: SLA表明线性注意力内核应与目标硬件的矩阵单元形状和运算模式协同设计；硬件感知的张量布局与算子融合可显著提升TPU上门控线性注意力的训练效率，且不牺牲模型质量。

Abstract: Gated-delta linear attention layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and GDN-2 are tuned for GPUs, where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. On Google TPUs, which concentrate compute in wide $256 \times 256$ systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit, porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. We present \textbf{Systolic Linear Attention (SLA)}, which reshapes gated delta attention around the matrix unit by widening keys to $256$ with grouped value heads, grouping decay gates into four $64$-channel tiles, and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel. On TPU v7x, a full \texttt{SLA-R4} layer runs $1.6\times$--$2.5\times$ faster than the open-source Tokamax KDA kernel ($1.4\times$--$2.4\times$ with exact chunk inversion), driven primarily by head sharing and kernel fusion. Across a $2{,}048$-chip TPU v7x pre-training study of sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models from $6.5\text{B}$ to $63.1\text{B}$ parameters, SLA trains $11\%$--$24\%$ faster than KDA at similar perplexity, and reaches slightly lower perplexity than KDA in smaller matched-seed runs.

</details>


### [421] [Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06837)
*Tommy He,Thomas Jiralerspong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"上下文—答案元模型"，用上下文激活序列直接预测随机解码下答案的平均池化激活（点预测或分布预测），无需大量昂贵的自回归采样。四类元模型均能高保真预测，分布模型还可刻画采样变异性，并具备规模扩展、零样本跨域泛化、行为预测信号保留及跨模型迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机解码下同一上下文可产生多种答案，刻画这种变异性通常需要大量昂贵的自回归采样（rollout），且每次仅揭示一个实现。作者希望探讨：读取上下文时产生的激活能否直接预测模型后续rollout的激活，从而在生成首个答案token前实现可扩展的行为预测。

Method: 训练上下文—答案元模型（context–answer metamodels），将上下文激活序列映射为答案平均池化激活的点预测或分布预测；研究四种元模型族；将训练集扩展至50万条提示；评估零样本跨域泛化、预测结果的行为预测信号保留，以及用Qwen2.5的上下文激活预测Qwen3.5与Gemma 4的答案激活的跨模型迁移。

Result: (i) 四种元模型族均能高保真预测平均池化答案激活，分布元模型还能捕捉rollout变异性；(ii) 性能随训练集增至50万提示而提升，且可零样本泛化到域外数据集；(iii) 预测结果保留行为预测信号；(iv) Qwen2.5的上下文激活可预测Qwen3.5和Gemma 4的平均池化答案激活，表明激活预测可跨模型迁移。

Conclusion: 上下文激活轨迹可在首个答案token生成前支持对LLM答案行为的可扩展预测，为表征随机解码变异性提供了廉价替代方案。

Abstract: Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations from Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, suggesting that activation forecasts can transfer across models. Together, these results suggest that context activation traces can support scalable forecasts of behaviors in LLM answers before the first answer token is generated.

</details>


### [422] [Navigating Disagreement Among Criteria for Evaluating Explanation Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06846)
*Grant Shanklin,Jiří Němeček,Asia Biega*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出不同忠实性（faithfulness）操作化定义会对同一解释是否忠实给出冲突判断，提出"忠实性泛函"框架将各家准则的差异定位在三个选择维度上，并以不利行动通知为案例说明如何依据情境正当化这些选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法解释的忠实性虽被普遍要求，但现有评估准则之间存在不一致：同一解释在不同准则下可能被判为忠实或不忠实，开发者和审计者难以在冲突评估中取舍。论文旨在厘清分歧来源并给出可操作的评估路径。

Method: 提出一个faithfulness functional（忠实性泛函），将现有评估准则统一重构于其中，把分歧定位于三个层面：(1) 解释对模型作出了何种断言；(2) 哪些比较与该断言相关；(3) 这些比较之间的一致性如何聚合。将忠实性理解为模型与解释之间的一种"共同但不完全指定"的关系，从而把差异归结为一般性要求所遗留的选择。以adverse action notices（不利行动通知）为案例，重构某行业提议流程中隐含的评估，并识别情境中可正当化与仍开放的选择。

Result: 重构表明现有准则的分歧并非根本冲突，而是同一忠实性关系下不同选择组合的结果；案例研究显示具体制度与规范情境可以缩小选择范围，某些选择可由场景（如监管披露要求）正当化，另一些则保持开放。

Conclusion: 文献中出现多种忠实性操作化是预期之中的，而非缺陷；操作化的正当性取决于对上述选择的论证，需借助解释学、制度与规范层面的考量。该框架为审计者与实践者提供了在冲突评估间导航的方法，并说明共享的忠实性要求如何在情境中获得正当化的具体评估。

Abstract: Faithfulness requires that algorithmic explanations accurately reflect the model's behavior. Yet existing operationalizations of faithfulness can disagree about whether the same explanation is faithful, leaving developers and auditors to choose among conflicting evaluations. In this paper, we investigate disagreement among evaluation criteria and offer a practical path forward for evaluating explanation faithfulness. We first identify how operationalizations of faithfulness differ. We introduce a faithfulness functional that locates their disagreements in what an explanation claims about the model, which comparisons bear on that claim, and how agreement across those comparisons should be aggregated, and we reconstruct existing evaluation criteria within it. We argue these reconstructions support understanding faithfulness as a common though incompletely specified relation between the model and explanation, so the differences reflect choices left open by the general requirement. Justifying an operationalization then comes down to justifying these choices, which, on our view, draws on explanatory, institutional, and normative considerations. We support this argument with a case study of adverse action notices, reconstructing the evaluation implicit in an industry-proposed procedure and identifying which of its choices the setting justifies and which remain open. Our work gives auditors and practitioners a way to navigate disagreeing evaluations of faithfulness. It also explains why the literature should expect multiple operationalizations, while showing how concrete settings can narrow the choice among them. More broadly, our analysis shows how a shared requirement of faithfulness can support contextually justified evaluations despite disagreement among existing metrics.

</details>


### [423] [Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06879)
*Benjamin Jacob Bodner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMM（Adaptive Multi Mode）是一种在已知预算下用在线探针把预算路由到五种连续优化引擎的元优化器，在bbob留出实例上于600个单元中取得382个最高目标份额，并在多个基线、变换与受限设置下保持或部分保持领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑色连续优化中最优经典优化器依赖预算与景观；现有路由器仅依据维度与预算、历史改进或单一基准拟合的特征来决策，且很少在线检验优化器的隐式假设。作者因此提出一种带显式探针、可在已知预算内自适应分配的方法。

Method: AMM 在准牛顿、信赖域、坐标、多起点与进化策略五类引擎间路由已知预算；在线探针检测曲率、平台、可分性、拐点、盆地与分形结构，每个探针设有默认值、维度×预算适用区间，其开销计入总预算。先用bbob预注册开发循环（36条预测中32条在最后16次确认中成立），再在留出bbob实例101–110（D=2–40，10D–1000D）上与最多七个竞争者做一次性测试，并对照自身引擎构成的基线（单引擎最优、按维度与预算的最优引擎、贪心调度）及nevergrad的NgIohTuned；另做仿射与箱变换、箱约束bbob、旋转f2–f4、MA-BBOB等预注册实验。

Result: 在600个函数×维度×预算单元中，AMM在382个取得最高目标份额（236个独占、146个并列），按描述性后验规则在35个单元中可信落后（多在10D与30D）。在每个预算上均领先自身引擎构成的控制组（10D、30D处优势较小）及NgIohTuned；对IPOP-CMA-ES的领先在仿射/箱变换、箱约束bbob和合并的旋转f2–f4上成立，但旋转可分函数f3、f4后领先大部分消失；在留出MA-BBOB上2000D处份额与IPOP-CMA-ES持平而anytime面积更低。

Conclusion: 在线探针式预算路由在已知预算的连续黑箱优化中具有实证优势，但对可分函数结构的领先较为脆弱；作者以开源Python包（pip install amm-optimizer）发布实现。

Abstract: The best classical optimizer for a continuous black-box problem depends on its budget and landscape. Existing routers decide from the dimension and budget, past improvement or features fitted to one benchmark, and few test an optimizer's implicit assumptions online. AMM (Adaptive Multi Mode) routes a known budget among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy optimization engines with online probes of curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure. Each probe has a default, a dimension-by-budget validity range and a cost charged to the budget. In its pre-registered development loop on bbob, 32 of 36 predictions held over the last 16 confirmations. AMM was then tested once on held-out bbob instances 101-110 (D=2-40, 10*D-1000*D) against up to seven competitors. It has the highest target share in 382 of 600 function-dimension-budget cells (236 outright, 146 tied) and, by a descriptive posterior rule, is credibly behind in 35, mostly at 10*D and 30*D. At every budget it also leads the controls built from its own engines (the best engine alone, the best engine per dimension and budget, and a greedy schedule), narrowly at 10*D and 30*D, and nevergrad's NgIohTuned. In pre-registered runs its lead over IPOP-CMA-ES holds under affine and box transformations, on box-constrained bbob and, pooled, on rotated f2-f4, but rotating the separable f3 and f4 removes most of the lead there. On held-out MA-BBOB its final share at 2000*D is level with IPOP-CMA-ES's and its anytime area lower. We published AMM as an open-source Python package (pip install amm-optimizer; https://github.com/BjBodner/amm-optimizer).

</details>


### [424] [Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06905)
*Michal Korniak,Marco Bagatella,Ralf Römer,Michal Nauman,Yarden As,Pranav Vignesh,Manan Agarwal,Leander Diaz-Bone,Piotr Zalewski,Mikołaj Czarnecki,Lenart Treven,Shashwat Saxena,Sreyas Venkataraman,Sarvesh Patil,Zhiyuan Zhou,Daniel Marta,Oier Mees,Nur Muhammad Mahi Shafiullah,Carmelo Sferrazza,Bhavya Sukhija,Angela P. Schoellig,Andreas Krause,Max Simchowitz,Andrew Wagenmaker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性研究了通用机器人策略的多任务在线自我改进问题，并给出可行的算法配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用机器人策略虽零样本泛化强，但部署时仍需适配；已有基于RL的迭代式自我改进几乎只在单任务设定下探索，与基座策略本身的多任务能力不匹配。

Method: 构建一组结构化评测来检验"通用型改进"能力，并系统评估价值估计、策略提取与资源分配等算法及工程选择；据此提炼推荐配方。

Result: 通用策略可在多任务上获得在线改进；正确配方还能泛化到在线训练未涉及的任务，并能刻画该泛化发生的条件——训练任务分布与基于价值的RL两者均关键。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是机器人大模型在线通用型改进的首批证据之一。

Abstract: The introduction of generalist robot policies has enabled a single, large model to learn to perform a variety of tasks from a vast pre-training corpus. While these models often exhibit powerful zero-shot generalization capabilities, they typically require an adaptation phase to achieve sufficient performance in deployment. Iterated self-improvement via reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated promise in enabling this adaptation, yet such approaches have been largely explored in single-task settings - where the goal is to simply improve on a narrow deployment task - which lies in stark contrast to the multi-task capabilities of the base policy. In this work we ask whether generalist robot policies are capable of multi-task, generalist improvement in deployment - targeting many diverse tasks simultaneously - and what algorithmic recipe enables this. To answer this question, we first develop a set of structured evaluations to test generalist improvement capabilities, and systematically evaluate algorithmic and practical design choices regarding value estimation, policy extraction and resource allocation. We show that not only can generalist policies be improved online across diverse tasks, but that the right recipe can enable generalization and increase performance on tasks not considered during online training. We characterize when this generalization occurs and show that both the training task distribution and the use of value-based RL are critical. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first evidence for online generalist improvement for robot foundation models.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [425] [A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06279)
*Ali Nadarloo,Mohammad Javad Hajiahmadi,Mohammad Soleimani*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 论文证明固定、线性、无源网络无法放大调谐元件的调谐能力，每个调谐元件携带由自身阻抗轨迹决定的"调谐预算"，其单位是Smith圆图上的双曲距离；由此给出各类可重构微波器件闭式、可直接使用的性能极限，并引入图形化Λ-chart及四个已发表案例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可重构微波器件通常把变容管、二极管、晶体管、MEMS或相变开关、铁电或液晶负载等调谐元件置于固定无源网络中，设计实践常把器件调谐能力归功于该网络。作者希望澄清固定线性无源网络能否真正"增强"调谐能力，并为广泛器件提供统一的性能上限判据。

Method: 将调谐预算定义为调谐元件自身阻抗轨迹所决定的无量纲长度（以Smith圆图双曲距离为单位）：到匹配点的距离为驻波比的自然对数，两状态间距离设定其互失配并等于换向品质因子的对数。基于一个不等式，导出模拟与数字移相器、真时延线、开关、衰减器、矢量调制器、阻抗调谐器、可调滤波器、可重构天线、超表面单元及多端口网络的闭式极限；两态与衰减极限由显式电路达到，相位极限由恒定损耗轨迹达到。同时提出Smith圆图配套的Λ-chart用于图形读取预算与需求，并应用于四个已发表微波案例。

Result: 固定无源网络只能传递调谐预算或损耗其中一部分，绝不可能扩大它；据此得到的各类器件极限具有闭式、即用形式，其中两态与衰减极限可由显式电路精确达到，相位极限由恒损耗轨迹实现；Λ-chart使预算与需求可图形化读取，并在四个已发表案例中得到应用。

Conclusion: 调谐能力源自调谐元件本身而非固定无源网络；该结论以单一不等式统一刻画多类可重构微波器件的性能上界，为器件设计提供可计算的度量与图形工具（Λ-chart），可用于评估、比较并指导实际设计。

Abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. The unit of the budget is the hyperbolic distance of the Smith chart: the distance from a match is the logarithm of the voltage standing-wave ratio, and the distance between two states sets their mutual mismatch and is the logarithm of their commutation quality factor. From one inequality we derive closed-form, ready-to-use limits for analog and digital phase shifters, true-time-delay lines, switches, attenuators, vector modulators, impedance tuners, tunable filters, reconfigurable antennas, metasurface cells and multiport networks; the two-state and attenuation limits are attained by explicit circuits, and the phase limit by a constant-loss trajectory. We introduce the $Λ$-chart, a Smith-chart companion on which budgets and requirements are read graphically, and apply it to four published microwave case studies.

</details>


### [426] [Directional Control of Chiral Polymer Emission Dissymmetry by Plasmonic Metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06400)
*Debapriya Pal,Louis Minion,David Reger,Jessica Wade,Matthew J. Fuchter,A. Femius Koenderink*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 将有机手性聚合物薄膜与平面手性等离激元超表面集成，首次在固定分子立体化学条件下实现定向、高强度（|g|>0.7）且随角度反转手性的圆偏振发射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 圆偏振发射在下一代光子与光电技术中至关重要，但方向性、强度与手性三者难以同时调控；传统薄膜对发射角度分布控制有限且手性发射强烈依赖角度，而超表面研究多使用本征非手性发光体，缺乏手性发射体与手性超表面的协同。

Method: 将有机手性聚合物薄膜与平面手性等离激元超表面耦合，利用角度分辨斯托克斯傅里叶偏振测量（angle-resolved Stokes Fourier polarimetry）表征发射的方向性、偏振态与角度依赖关系。

Result: 超表面耦合产生定向发射，近法向不对称因子超过0.7，并观察到在固定分子立体化学下发射手性随方向发生反转。

Conclusion: 手性发光体与手性等离激元超表面的集成可同时调控圆偏振发射的方向性、强度与手性，并实现由结构而非分子手性主导的方向依赖手性反转，为手性光子器件设计提供新途径。

Abstract: Circularly polarized (CP) emission is central to next-generation photonic and optoelectronic technologies, yet simultaneously controlling its directionality, intensity, and handedness remains a major challenge. Advances in molecular and materials design have enabled strong chiral light-matter interactions and large dissymmetry between opposite CP states. However, conventional thin-film architectures provide limited control over the angular distribution of CP emission and often exhibit strongly angle-dependent chiral emission. Metasurfaces, on the other hand, offer powerful control over emission directionality and polarization, but have predominantly been explored with intrinsically achiral emitters. For the first time, we integrate organic chiral polymer thin films with planar chiral plasmonic metasurfaces to enhance chiral light-matter interactions while controlling the directionality and angular dependence of chiral emission. Using angle-resolved Stokes Fourier polarimetry, we show that metasurface coupling produces directional emission, near-normal dissymmetry factors exceeding 0.7, and, remarkably, direction-dependent reversal of the emission handedness at fixed molecular stereochemistry.

</details>


### [427] [Neuromorphic Camera for Multi-Target Pointing Acquisition and Tracking in Free Space Optical Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05503)
*Francesco Nardo,Nigitha Selvaraj,Klaus Schertler,Peter Krötz,Ricardo Barrios,Sebastian Houben,Sebastian Randel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文探索将事件相机（神经形态视觉传感器）用于自由空间光通信中的指向、捕获与跟踪（PAT），并对多种直接在异步事件流上运行的多光束同时捕获与跟踪算法进行对比分析，在模拟HAP/UAV动态场景的实验数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FSOC的PAT需同时满足低抖动与大视场，以支持信标捕获与多目标跟踪。传统帧式传感器虽具备所需角覆盖，但受限于延迟、帧率与运动模糊，难以满足动态平台场景下的性能要求。

Method: 采用异步记录亮度变化（事件）、具微秒级时间分辨率的神经形态事件传感器；核心贡献为针对多个光信标的同时捕获与跟踪，对比分析多种直接作用于异步事件流的跟踪算法；在反映HAP与UAV网络真实动态工况的实验数据集上评估。

Result: 在不同信噪/背景条件下对比了各事件跟踪策略的跟踪精度与处理延迟等关键指标，验证其在真实动态场景中的可行性。

Conclusion: 事件视觉在FSOC的PAT任务中具备低延迟、高时间分辨率与抗运动模糊的潜力，可为多信标同时捕获与跟踪提供可行方案，并为后续算法选择与系统设计提供依据。

Abstract: Pointing, Acquisition, and Tracking (PAT) in Free-Space Optical Communication (FSOC) applications must achieve both low jitter and a large Field of View (FoV) to support beacon acquisition and multi-target tracking. While conventional frame-based sensors provide the necessary angular coverage, their performance is limited by latency, available frame-rate, and motion blur. This work explores and demonstrates the application of an event-based vision sensor for PAT tasks in FSOC. The system employs a neuromorphic sensor that asynchronously records brightness changes (events) with microsecond-level temporal resolution. The main contribution of this paper is a comparative analysis of event-based tracking algorithms for the simultaneous acquisition and tracking of multiple optical beacons that operate directly on this asynchronous stream. The performance of these strategies is validated on an experimental dataset representing realistic operational conditions for dynamic High-Altitude Platform (HAP) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. The analysis compares key metrics, such as tracking accuracy and processing latency, under various signal-to-background conditions.

</details>


### [428] [Mueller Matrix Decomposition for a General Rotating Compensator Ellipsometer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05545)
*Aaron Chew,Purnima P. Balakrishnan,Bryan M. Barnes,John H. Burnett,Colton K. Dudley,Steven E. Grantham,Stephanie L. Moffitt,Charles Tarrio,Thomas A. Germer*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出将非退偏Mueller矩阵分解为 $M=T_1 D T_2$ 的形式，把对应对角Jones矩阵的 $D$ 与旋转及圆二向衰减项 $T_1,T_2$ 分离；该分解用于标定EUV反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪，并推广至退偏Mueller矩阵，在266 nm金镜反射数据上完成验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EUV反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪的标定通常需要预先完整已知补偿器与光源偏振特性，实际中难以满足；同时光学元件存在显著的二向衰减与延迟，需要一种在信息不完备条件下仍能获取样品完整Mueller矩阵的标定方法。

Method: 构造非退偏Mueller矩阵的三因子分解 $M=T_1 D T_2$，其中 $D$ 对应对角Jones矩阵，$T_1,T_2$ 承载旋转与圆二向衰减；将该分解用于原型反射式旋转补偿器椭偏仪的标定，使补偿器与光源偏振无需完整已知且允许光学系统具有大二向衰减和大延迟；进一步给出面向退偏Mueller矩阵的推广形式。

Result: 分解方案支持在补偿器与光源偏振信息不完备的情况下测得样品完整Mueller矩阵；推广形式在266 nm处金镜反射数据上得到实验检验，验证了方法对退偏情形的适用性。

Conclusion: 该 $T_1 D T_2$ 分解为EUV椭偏仪提供了一种对补偿器与光源偏振不敏感、且可容纳强二向衰减与强延迟的标定途径，并可自然推广至退偏Mueller矩阵测量。

Abstract: This work develops a Mueller matrix decomposition that factors a nondepolarizing Mueller matrix $M$ into three components $M = T_1 D T_2$, where the elements $D$, which correspond to a diagonal Jones matrix, are separated from rotations and circular diattenuation $T_1, T_2$. This decomposition is employed to calibrate a prototype reflective rotating-compensator ellipsometer designed to operate using extreme ultraviolet (EUV) radiation. This decomposition allows for the measurement of the full Mueller matrix of a sample without full knowledge of the compensators or the source polarization, while allowing for significant diattenuation and retardance for the optics. A generalization of the decomposition is developed for depolarizing Mueller matrices, and the technique is tested on reflection data collected on an Au mirror at $266$ nm.

</details>


### [429] [A closed-form design rule for photonic hopfions of arbitrary order](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05595)
*Ali Nadarloo,Mohammad Javad Hajiahmadi,Mohammad Soleimani*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出光子Hopfion的解析设计规则：两个标量光束（ℓ阶光学涡旋与n个暗环场）的相位作为超表面双偏振掩膜，在三个代数条件满足时必然产生nℓ阶Hopfion，无需优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子Hopfion（不同偏振态的环相互链接）是稳健的拓扑光织构，可用作信息载体与光-物质相互作用探针；但此前只能从激光模式叠加中凭手动权重或数值优化"拼装"得到，缺乏设计准则。

Method: 用闭式解的两个标量光束——ℓ阶光学涡旋与含n个暗环的场——在单一平面上的相位构成超表面双掩膜，独立调控两个正交偏振；证明当环系数与涡旋阶满足三个代数条件时，所得光束为nℓ阶Hopfion，且远场未覆盖的所有偏振环恰好链接nℓ次，每个条件对应阻断一种拓扑逃逸途径。

Result: 标量模拟中，单一太赫兹超表面几何可产生高达九阶的Hopfion；对完整一阶器件的全波仿真保持其拓扑结构不变。

Conclusion: Hopfion阶数可在纸面上预先选定、器件直接随之设计，无需优化；该规则适用于任何能塑造两个正交偏振相位的平台。

Abstract: Topological textures of light are robust against perturbation and are emerging as carriers of information and probes of light-matter interaction. The most intricate of them, the photonic hopfion, in which the loops of different polarization states are linked, has so far been assembled from chosen superpositions of laser modes, with weights set by hand or found by numerical optimization. Here we replace this search with a design rule. Two scalar beams, an optical vortex of order $\ell$ and a field with n dark rings, propagate in closed form, and their phases on one plane are the two masks of a metasurface that controls two orthogonal polarizations. Although a beam, unlike the closed spaces of topology, extends to infinity, we prove that it is a hopfion of order $n\ell$ whenever three algebraic conditions on the ring coefficients and the vortex order hold, and that the polarization loops of every state that the far field does not reach then link exactly $n\ell$ times; each condition guards against one way in which the topology can escape. The order is thus chosen on paper and the device follows directly, without optimization. In scalar simulation, one terahertz metasurface geometry produces hopfions up to order nine, and a full-wave simulation of the complete first-order device preserves its topology. The rule applies to any platform that shapes the phases of two orthogonal polarizations.

</details>


### [430] [Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05800)
*Jasleen Kaur,Yu Mukai,Ryo Okamoto,Shigeki Takeuchi*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文首次实现超快时间分辨的量子红外光谱（TR-量子IR），用可见泵浦与硅探测器在1529 nm附近皮秒分辨地读出半导体可饱和吸收镜的载流子动力学，探针功率仅皮瓦级，不受热背景与强IR光致发光干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统时间分辨红外光谱（TR-IR）需超短红外脉冲源、低温制冷探测器以抑制热背景，且强探针会扰动样品；量子红外光谱借频率纠缠光子对的量子干涉，只探测可见伴生光子即可读出红外响应，但此前仅限稳态测量。本文旨在将其拓展到超快时间分辨形式。

Method: 采用皮秒可见泵浦脉冲激发样品；每个可见脉冲在皮秒时间窗内产生频率纠缠光子对，对中红外光子作为探针在设定延迟处探测激发态样品，瞬态响应由可见伴生光子的计数率读出，使用硅探测器。

Result: 在1529 nm附近分辨出半导体可饱和吸收镜的皮秒载流子动力学，探针功率达皮瓦级，不受热背景影响，且在样品红外光致发光强度为探针50倍时仍可正常工作。

Conclusion: 该方案可推广至红外探测最困难的中红外指纹区及太赫兹波段，为低扰动、免制冷、超快红外光谱提供新途径。

Abstract: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. Each visible pulse generates photon pairs within a picosecond window; the infrared photon of a pair probes the excited sample at a set delay after excitation, and the transient response is read out from the count rate of its visible partner. We resolve picosecond carrier dynamics in a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror near 1529 nm with a picowatt-level probe, unaffected by thermal background and by sample IR photoluminescence 50 times stronger than the probe. The approach is applicable to the mid-infrared, fingerprint region, where infrared detection is hardest, and to the terahertz region.

</details>


### [431] [Optical angular momentum and pseudospin-orbit coupling in photonic graphene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05944)
*Omri Bahat-Treidel,Daniel Leykam,Anton S. Desyatnikov*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文研究携带角动量的结构激光束在光子石墨烯中锥形衍射时的动力学，发现光束轨道角动量（OAM）跟随晶格赝自旋而非缓变包络的角动量，表明赝自旋是真实的角动量形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究结构光束角动量在光子晶格锥形衍射中的演化规律，检验赝自旋能否被视为一种真实角动量，并理解其与能带结构的关联。

Method: 结合数值模拟与解析计算，分析光子石墨烯中锥形衍射下光束OAM的演化；并通过交错蜂窝晶格中满足大质量狄拉克方程的传播，考察能隙大小与初始包络角动量的影响。

Result: 光束轨道角动量随晶格赝自旋动力学变化，而非随缓变包络的角动量变化；在交错蜂窝晶格中，OAM对带隙尺寸和包络初始角动量高度敏感，该结果可与电子轨道磁化进行类比解释。

Conclusion: 赝自旋表现为一种真实的角动量形式，其动力学支配光束OAM演化；借助电子轨道磁化类比可解释相关数值结果。

Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of structured laser beams carrying angular momentum (AM) as they undergo conical diffraction in photonic graphene. Using a combination of numerical simulations and analytical calculations, we demonstrate a surprising result: the beam's orbital AM tracks the dynamics of the lattice pseudospin rather than the AM of its slowly varying envelope. This finding provides evidence that pseudospin behaves as a genuine form of angular momentum. Furthermore, we explore beam propagation in staggered honeycomb lattices governed by the massive Dirac equation, revealing that the orbital AM is highly sensitive to both the band gap size and the envelope's initial AM. We explain our numerical results by drawing an analogy with the orbital magnetization of electrons.

</details>


### [432] [Single-sided lens terahertz flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06050)
*Ehsan Imanbeygi,Mohammad Hossein Koohi Ghamsari,Mehdi Ahmadi-Boroujeni,Babak Honarbakhsh*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种基于几何光学的单面平凸透镜解析设计方法，将准直与整形功能集成于单一光学面，可在菲涅尔区实现太赫兹平顶光束整形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太赫兹成像系统需要平顶光束，但常规双面凹-凸透镜结构复杂、加工难度大；作者希望用单一光学面同时实现准直与整形以简化制造。

Method: 由几何光学原理推导单面平凸透镜（PCL）的面形轮廓；针对100 GHz与200 GHz单色源发散高斯光束，分别设计在3 m与4 m距离处产生半径400 mm与500 mm平顶光束的两款透镜；并用解析法、积分方程法与有限元法评估场分布，同时考察频率与对准偏差的敏感性。

Result: 所设计的单面PCL产生的场分布与传统双面凹-凸透镜相当；对频率漂移与对准误差的敏感性分析表明该单曲率方案具有稳健性。

Conclusion: 单曲率平凸透镜可实现菲涅尔区THz平顶光束整形，兼具性能与可制造性，适合集成到实际太赫兹成像系统。

Abstract: In this paper, a novel, to our knowledge, analytical approach is introduced for the design of a single-sided plano-convex lens (PCL) capable of terahertz (THz) flat-top beam shaping in the Fresnel region. The lens profile, derived from geometrical optics principles, integrates collimating and beam-shaping functions into a single optical surface, thereby simplifying fabrication. The efficiency of the method is demonstrated by designing two PCLs that convert a divergent Gaussian beam from a monochromatic THz source (at 100 and 200 GHz) into flat-top beams with target radii of 400 and 500 mm at distances of 3 and 4 m, respectively. The resulting fields, evaluated through analytical, integral equation, and finite element techniques, are shown to be comparable to those produced by a conventional double-sided concave-convex lens. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the design to frequency and alignment variations is investigated, confirming the robustness of this single-curvature approach for integration into practical THz imaging systems.

</details>


### [433] [Millimeter-Wave Gaussian-to-Flat-Top Beam Shaping Using a Single-Curvature Lens: A Novel Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06053)
*Ehsan Imanbeygi,Mohammad Hossein Koohi Ghamsari,Mehdi Ahmadi-Boroujeni*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出用单个曲面（平凸透镜）同时实现毫米波源高斯波束的准直与整形，将喇叭天线的发散高斯分布转换为3 m处半径400 mm的平顶均匀分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式远距离毫米波成像系统需要均匀（平顶）照明，而毫米波源（圆锥喇叭）输出为发散的高斯强度分布，需同时完成准直与波束整形，通常需多个光学元件，结构复杂。

Method: 将准直器的面形与波束整形器的面形合并到单一曲面中：推导平凸透镜单面轮廓，置于100 GHz圆锥喇叭前方52 mm处；以全波仿真为基础的优化流程对面形进行优化，入射高斯波束半径11.9 mm，目标为3 m处半径400 mm的均匀光斑；并与先前设计的双面（凹凸）透镜进行对比，最后分析透镜对频率变化的敏感性。

Result: 仿真结果表明，在目标视场内，优化后的单面透镜产生具有可接受纹波与滚降的平顶强度分布，性能与双面透镜相当；并给出了该透镜对频率偏差的敏感度特性。

Conclusion: 单曲面透镜可一体化实现毫米波高斯波束的准直与平顶整形，结构简单，适用于主动式远距离毫米波成像系统的均匀照明。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel method for converting the divergent Gaussian intensity distribution of a millimeter-wave source into a uniform (flat-top) distribution using a single curved surface. The proposed method combines the surface profile of a collimator with that of a beam shaper. To validate the method, the profile of a single-sided (plano-convex) lens is derived and placed 52 mm in front of a conical horn antenna operating at 100 GHz. The lens transforms the Gaussian radiation of the horn, with an incident beam radius of 11.9 mm, into a uniform beam with a radius of 400 mm at a distance of 3 m. The lens surface profile is optimized using a full-wave-simulation-based procedure, and the resulting output beam is compared with that of a previously designed double-sided (concave-convex) lens. Simulation results show that, within the desired field of view, the optimized single-sided lens produces a flat-top intensity distribution with satisfactory ripple and roll-off. Finally, the sensitivity of the optimized lens to frequency variation is investigated. The proposed lens is suitable for generating uniform illumination in active stand-off millimeter-wave imaging systems.

</details>


### [434] [Colloidal 2D WS2 nanosheets exhibiting high-purity single photon emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06144)
*Markus Xemaire,Jakob Keck,Marco Kögel,Marc Brecht,Jannik C. Meyer,Alfred J. Meixner,Jannika Lauth*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 湿化学合成的单层二维WS₂纳米片（14±6 nm）无需图案化、应变/缺陷工程或光谱滤波，即可在5 K下实现无反聚束（g²(0)=0.07）、无闪烁、有限谱扩散的单光子发射，为确定性量子发射器提供新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单光子源（如微米级WS₂单层）需依赖精细的局域缺陷或应变工程，而胶体量子点体系存在闪烁与发射周期过长的问题，因此亟需一种无需复杂加工、兼具高单光子纯度的量子发射器。

Method: 采用湿化学法合成横向尺寸14±6 nm的单层2D WS₂纳米片；对70个单个纳米片进行单粒子光谱表征，并结合脉冲激发（80 MHz）测量发射寿命与光子反聚束（g²(0)）。

Result: 观测到激子（2.02 eV）、三子（1.94 eV）与缺陷局域态（1.85 eV）发光，发射快速（t₁<0.2 ns，t₂=3.2 ns）；5 K下g²(0)=0.07，谱扩散有限且无闪烁，可实现高频激发循环。

Conclusion: 胶体WS₂纳米片本身即为确定性单光子源，无需基底图案化、应变/缺陷工程或光谱滤波，兼具高纯度与快速发射循环，克服了传统胶体量子点的闪烁与慢发射问题。

Abstract: The search for quantum emitters, delivering single photons "on demand" at cryogenic and elevated temperatures for photonic technologies is ever progressing. For example, micrometer-sized WS2 monolayers exhibit single photon emission by elaborated local defect or strain engineering. Here, we show that wet-chemically synthesised monolayered two-dimensional (2D) WS2 nano sheets (NSs) with lateral sizes of 14 (+/- 6 nm) readily emit single photons from exciton recombination without the need for substrate-induced patterning, strain/defect engineering or spectral filtering. Single particle spectroscopy of 70 individual NSs shows photoluminescence from excitons (2.02 eV), trios (1.94 eV) and defect-localized states (1.85 eV) with fast emission (t1<0.2 ns, t2=3.2 ns), allowing highly frequent excitation cycles. Pulsed at 80 MHz, colloidal WS2 NSs exhibit limited spectral diffusion, no blinking and distinct photon antibunching (g2(0)=0.07 at 5 K), thereby tackling challenges of established colloidal quantum dot systems (blinking, longer emission cycles), while retaining high single photon purity as key quality of deterministic quantum emitters.

</details>


### [435] [BIC-Engineered Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators Enabled by an Etch-Free Laser-Writing Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06167)
*Leila Hajshahvaladi,Mohammad Amin Salmani,Media Abbasi,Mobin Yaghoobi,Mohammad Asgari,Gholam-Mohammad Parsanasab*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种无需刻蚀的互补方案：在未图形化氮化硅薄膜上用紫外激光直写SU-8脊条构成波导与微环，借连续域束缚态（BIC）抑制辐射损耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流程需图形化并刻蚀氮化硅，侧壁散射损耗大且工艺步骤多；需一种工艺更简、无刻蚀、可控制辐射损耗的方案。

Method: 在未图形化的SiN薄膜上以直接紫外激光光刻写入SU-8脊条，薄膜本身不被图形化，从而消除侧壁散射；TM导模处于TE平板模连续谱中，用BIC作为设计工具，通过耦合模分析与全矢量仿真寻找两脊侧壁辐射相消的离散宽度与弯曲半径。

Result: 首个BIC出现在2.25 μm宽度，在0.3 μm宽度窗口与约200 nm带宽内辐射损耗低于1 dB/cm；曲率使相消仅存在于离散的半径—宽度带。激光写入波导损耗随宽度变化符合预测，BIC附近约1.5 dB/cm（此时非辐射损耗主导）；按半径选取BIC带设计的微环，负载品质因子最高1.6×10^4，在过耦合假设下本征品质因子达3.3×10^5。

Conclusion: 实验首次验证了以图形化低折射率层置于未刻蚀薄膜上、用BIC调控辐射的无刻蚀互补工艺；该方法可推广至其他纳米结构，写入条件与材料优化仍在进行。

Abstract: We report the initial experimental demonstration of a complementary, etch-free approach with fewer fabrication steps, in useful SU-8 ridges written by direct ultraviolet laser lithography on an unpatterned silicon nitride film define waveguides and microring resonators. Because the nitride film is never patterned, scattering at patterned nitride sidewalls does not arise, and the remaining radiative loss is engineered by design. The guided transverse-magnetic mode lies within the continuum of transverse-electric slab modes, and we use bound states in the continuum (BICs) as a design tool to control this radiation. Coupled-mode analysis and full-vectorial simulations show that radiation from the two ridge sidewalls cancels by destructive interference at discrete widths, with a first BIC at 2.25 micron and radiation below 1 dB/cm over a 0.3 micron width window and about 200 nm of bandwidth, and that curvature confines this cancellation to discrete bands of bending radius and width. Laser-written waveguides follow the predicted width dependence of the loss, reaching approximately 1.5 dB/cm near the BIC, where non-radiative loss dominates. A microring designed on a radius-selected BIC band exhibits loaded quality factors up to 1.6 \times 10^4 and, under the over-coupled assignment supported by a coupler model, an intrinsic quality factor of 3.3 \times 10^5. Because radiation is set by a patterned low-index layer on an unetched film, the same approach could be extended to other nanostructures. Optimization of the writing conditions and materials is ongoing.

</details>


### [436] [Closed-form dyadic Green functions for transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06172)
*Akhlesh Lakhtakia,Tom G. Mackay*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 指出Weiglhofer关于横观单轴双各向异性介质并矢格林函数无法闭式求得的结论有误，并给出四个并矢格林函数的闭式表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纠正Weiglhofer（1994）基于标量因子分解法得出“该类介质并矢格林函数不存在闭式解”的错误结论，重新审视该推导。

Method: 复现Weiglhofer原始推导的关键步骤，采用标量因子分解法重新处理横观单轴、磁电标量相等的双各向异性介质。

Result: 成功导出无界介质中全部四个并矢格林函数的闭式表达式，建立电场、磁场与电流源密度之间的对应关系。

Conclusion: 先前“无法闭式求解”的论断不成立；该介质的并矢格林函数可完全闭式表示，可用于电磁场与源的正演分析。

Abstract: A transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars was conceived by Weiglhofer in 1994. Using the scalar factorization method, he concluded that the dyadic Green functions of this medium could not be found in closed form. That conclusion is incorrect. The essentials of the derivation are reproduced here, and closed-form expressions are given for all four dyadic Green functions of the unbounded medium, linking the electric and magnetic fields to electric and magnetic source current densities.

</details>


### [437] [Spatial structure of surface plasmon resonance under narrow-beam illumination and its implications for sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06222)
*Tristan Miralles,Rémi Pollès,Pauline Bennet,Denis Langevin,Martine Mihailovic,Emmanuel Centeno,Jack Mock,David R. Smith,Antoine Moreau*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 将SPR反射光解释为菲涅尔直接反射与等离激元回溯辐射光的干涉；当光腰仅比传播长度大约一个量级时两者空间分离，相消干涉形成暗纹，其空间结构对介质极其敏感，可构建比振幅测量灵敏一个量级以上的观测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SPR传感依赖反射率（振幅/强度）变化，灵敏度和分辨率受限；作者希望利用反射光束内部的空间干涉结构（而非总强度）作为新观测量，以获得更高的灵敏度和分辨率。

Method: 建立该空间干涉效应的解析模型；基于市售器件设计现实可行的实验装置；用开源仿真框架对从照明到探测的全过程进行完整数值模拟，并在干涉最大化的参数区间内分析反射光束空间结构对外部介质的敏感性。

Result: 确认直接反射与等离激元回溯辐射在光腰约为传播长度一个量级时空间分离，并在反射光束内形成相消干涉暗纹；在干涉最强区间，所定义的新观测量灵敏度比振幅型测量高一个量级以上，并预期分辨率有相当程度的改善。

Conclusion: 反射光束内的空间暗纹结构可作为SPR传感的高灵敏观测量；该效应具备解析可描述性、实验可实施性和全流程可仿真性，为提升SPR灵敏度与成像分辨率提供了新途径。

Abstract: The reflection of light on a surface plasmon resonance structure can be understood as the interference between the direct Fresnel reflection and the light radiated back by the plasmon as it propagates along the metal film. When the beam waist is only an order of magnitude larger than the surface plasmon propagation length, these two contributions separate spatially, and their destructive interference localizes into a dark fringe within the reflected beam. We develop an analytical model of this effect, design a realistic setup based on off-the-shelf components to observe it, and simulate the complete experiment, from illumination to detection, with an open-source framework. In the regime where the interference is maximized, the spatial structure of the reflected beam becomes extremely sensitive to the outer medium. This allows us to define an observable more than an order of magnitude more sensitive than amplitude-based measurements, and we expect a comparable improvement in resolution.

</details>


### [438] [Hyperbolic Nanocavities for Single-Molecule Vibrational Strong Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06240)
*Stavros Athanasiou,Olivier J. F. Martin,Francisco J. García-Vidal,Johannes Feist*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文从理论上证明，在横向限制HPhP的hBN纳米腔中可实现单分子振动强耦合，其共振品质因子约600、有效模式体积约10^-7 λ^3，足以与偶极矩约1 D的振动跃迁实现强耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: hBN等低损耗各向异性材料中的双曲声子极化激元可在中红外提供极端亚衍射场限制，有望增强光与分子振动的相互作用；分子系综与HPhP的集体振动强耦合已在扩展平板中实现，但在单分子层面达成该强耦合仍是重大挑战，且可为研究真空电磁场对分子动力学与化学反应性的影响提供平台。

Method: 结合全波电磁仿真与少模量子化方法，研究横向限制HPhP的hBN纳米腔；分析其支持的非对称共振模式对局域谱密度的增强，并依据简单的HPhP射线轨迹给出共振频率，通过腔体纵横比进行调谐。

Result: 纳米腔支持丰富的非对称共振，强烈增强局部谱密度，共振频率可由HPhP射线轨迹简单给出并随纵横比调谐；识别出品质因子约600、有效模式体积|V_eff|~10^-7 λ^3的共振，足以与偶极矩约1 D的振动跃迁实现单分子强耦合。

Conclusion: 双曲纳米腔是单分子振动强耦合的有前景平台，为振动动力学与分子能量流的局域调控开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in low-loss anisotropic materials such as hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide extreme sub-diffractional field confinement in the mid-infrared, making them attractive for enhancing the interaction of light with molecular vibrations. Collective vibrational strong coupling between molecular ensembles and HPhPs has already been demonstrated in extended slabs. Reaching this regime with a single molecule, however, remains a major challenge, and would provide a platform for investigating how vacuum electromagnetic fields influence molecular dynamics and chemical reactivity. Here, we show theoretically that single-molecule vibrational strong coupling can be reached in hBN nanocavities that laterally confine HPhPs within a finite volume. Combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with the few-mode quantization approach, we find that these nanocavities support a rich set of asymmetric resonances that strongly enhance the local spectral density, with frequencies that follow from simple HPhP ray trajectories and can be tuned through the cavity aspect ratio. We identify resonances with quality factors of about $600$ and effective mode volumes of $|V_{\mathrm{eff}}| \sim 10^{-7}λ^{3}$, sufficient for single-molecule strong coupling with vibrational transitions with dipole moments on the order of $1\,\mathrm{D}$. These results establish hyperbolic nanocavities as a promising platform for single-molecule vibrational strong coupling and open new routes toward the local control of vibrational dynamics and molecular energy flow.

</details>


### [439] [Evanescent-Depth-Engineered High-Q topological Cavities for Strong Photon-Exciton Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06351)
*Zihan Mo,Renxuan Peng,Haoyang Zhang,Yu Tian,Ying Gu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过调控赝自旋拓扑光子晶体的横向量子衰减深度抑制拓扑谐振腔散射，实现不规则形状高Q腔及单量子级强光-激子耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑边缘态固有散射导致其干涉形成的拓扑谐振腔（TRC）品质因子较低，限制了其在激光器、传感与量子光子学中的应用。

Method: 提出工程化边缘态横向衰减深度的机制；通过调节赝自旋拓扑光子晶体的胞内与胞间耦合强度，显著减小边缘态的横向衰减深度，从而抑制TRC的散射。

Result: 尺寸为2~3 μm的多种形状TRC在可见光波段的Q值提升至10^5~10^6，并据此实现强光-激子耦合。

Conclusion: 高Q拓扑腔在集成激光器、传感器、腔量子电动力学及量子光子学中具有应用前景。

Abstract: Due to the inherent scattering in topological edge states, the topological resonant cavity (TRC) formed by their interference exhibits a relatively low quality factor (Q). To address this issue, we propose the mechanism of engineering the transverse evanescent depth of edge states to achieve high-Q in irregular shaped TRCs, which further enables strong photon-exciton coupling at the single-quantum level. By adjusting the intra- and inter-cell coupling strengths in the pseudo-spin topological photonic crystal, the transverse evanescent depth of edge states is greatly reduced, thereby suppressing the scattering of TRCs. Consequently, the Q of various shaped TRCs with 2 ~ 3 um size is up to 10^5 ~ 10^6 in the visible, so that the strong photon-exciton coupling is achieved. The high-Q topological cavities hold promising application in integrated lasers, sensors, cavity quantum electrodynamics, and quantum photonics.

</details>


### [440] [Phase matching and mode coupling in photonic-crystal ring resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06456)
*Alexander E. Ulanov,Lukas Bengel,Tobias Herr*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 光子晶体环形谐振腔中多个折射率调制之间的相对相位是决定非线性动力学的关键自由度，可通过干涉引入相位与模式选择规则，完全抑制非线性耦合，并产生前向与后向波形的相对光谱啁啾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子晶体环形谐振腔凭借模式级色散工程已成为非线性光子学的重要平台。当多个调制分量叠加时，其相对角向对准（相位）作为额外自由度对非线性动力学的影响此前尚不明确，本文旨在厘清这一未解问题。

Method: 通过分析前向与后向非线性过程的干涉，推导调制图样相对相位所引入的附加相位与模式选择规则；并在参量振荡与耗散克尔孤子两类典型非线性现象中进行验证。

Result: 相对相位在既有相位匹配条件之上附加了相位与模式选择规则，可完全抑制非线性耦合；同时在前向与后向传播波形之间施加相对光谱啁啾。

Conclusion: 本文把相位匹配概念推广至存在干涉非线性路径的谐振腔，并将折射率光栅的对准确立为非线性微谐振腔的一个设计维度。

Abstract: Photonic-crystal ring resonators, in which periodic refractive-index modulations couple counter-propagating modes, have become a widely used platform for nonlinear photonics, offering mode-by-mode dispersion engineering. When several modulation components are superimposed, their relative angular alignment (phase) is an additional degree of freedom whose impact on the nonlinear dynamics has remained unclear. Here we show that the relative phases between the modulation patterns have a decisive impact. Through the interference of the nonlinear processes in forward and backward direction, they add a phase and mode selection rule to the established phase-matching conditions, which can fully suppress nonlinear coupling. They also impose a relative spectral chirp between forward- and backward-propagating waveforms. We illustrate these effects for parametric oscillation and dissipative Kerr solitons. Our results extend the concept of phase matching to resonators with interfering nonlinear pathways and establish the alignment of index gratings as a design dimension for nonlinear microresonators.

</details>


### [441] [Geometric Pumping of Optical Work in Coherent Wave Scattering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06666)
*Zeyu Kuang,Konstantin Y. Bliokh,Stefan Rotter*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文建立了时变物质与光之间相干电磁散射中光学功的通用几何理论，证明绝热调制周期内累积的净光学功是由出射场在参数空间中的Berry曲率决定的几何量，并给出相干性对功泵浦的影响及最优入射波前与调制轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光与时变物质之间的光学功交换是众多新兴光子技术的基础，但缺乏描述其产生与控制的通用几何理论，此前仅有针对非相干储库间绝热泵浦的常规图像。

Method: 在相干电磁散射框架下，考察绝热调制周期，将累积的光学功表述为出射场在参数空间中的Berry曲率所决定的几何量；分析照明相干度对可获功的影响，并在完全相干照明下解析推导最大化单周期光学功的最优入射波前与调制轨迹。

Result: 净光学功为Berry曲率型几何量，可通过周期性调制两个及以上独立系统参数产生；与常规非相干储库间绝热泵浦不同，光学功泵浦在最大混合照明下消失；照明相干度越高，经波前整形可获得的最大功越大；完全相干时给出最优波前与调制轨迹。

Conclusion: 该框架将时变光子学、光力学与几何输运统一于共同的散射形式体系中，为光学功的产生与调控提供了几何理论工具。

Abstract: Optical work exchanged between light and time-varying matter underlies a wide range of emerging photonic technologies, yet a general geometric theory describing its generation and control has been lacking. Here we establish such a theory for coherent electromagnetic scattering. We show that the net optical work accumulated during an adiabatic modulation cycle is a geometric quantity determined by the Berry curvature of the outgoing field in parameter space. Nonzero optical work can thus be generated by cyclically modulating two or more independent system parameters. In contrast to conventional adiabatic pumping between incoherent reservoirs, optical work pumping vanishes under maximally mixed illumination. Greater illumination coherence increases the maximum work attainable through wavefront shaping. For fully coherent illumination, we derive the optimal incident wavefront and modulation trajectory that maximize the optical work per cycle. Our framework unifies time-varying photonics, optomechanics, and geometric transport within a common scattering formalism.

</details>


### [442] [Photonic and Electronic Interaction of TMD-Hybridized ZnO Nanowire Lasers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06740)
*Moritz Willems,Edwin Eobaldt,Alexander Zaunick,Aurelia Eberhard,Maximilian Tomoscheit,Lukas Raam Jäger,Xiao Chen,Preeti Sharma,Nicolas Tancogne-Dejean,Antony George,Andrey Turchanin,Silvana Botti,Giancarlo Soavi,Carsten Ronning*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 紫外ZnO纳米线激光器与二维TMD材料集成后，倏逝场吸收与空穴转移共同抑制激射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米线激光器等片上相干光源在应用中必须与其他材料接触形成异质结，这会改变器件光学与电学特性，因此需要厘清ZnO纳米线与TMDs接触后性能下降的微观机制。

Method: 用确定性纳米操纵将同一根ZnO纳米线依次与WS₂单层、MoS₂单层、双层、三层及体相MoS₂杂化并测试激射特性；用有限差分本征模（FDE）模拟TMD对倏逝场的吸收；用含界面偶极的DFT计算界面能带排列。

Result: 与WS₂和MoS₂单层杂化后，阈值升高、高泵浦功率下发射被强烈淬灭、模式包络蓝移；与双层、三层及体相MoS₂杂化后激射完全被抑制。模拟表明TMD仅吸收部分倏逝场，且该吸收具波长依赖性，会去掉低能侧的竞争模式，从而解释两种单层间的微小差异，而蓝移源于阈值处载流子密度升高。DFT预测ZnO(10-10)/TMD理想界面为I型排列，羟基化表面（偶极减弱）下转为II型，两种情形下空穴均由纳米线转移至TMD并被移出增益介质。

Conclusion: 倏逝场吸收与空穴转移共同（且相互叠加）抑制激射，两者均须在ZnO纳米线激光器与二维材料集成时纳入设计考量。

Abstract: Semiconductor nanowire lasers are promising on-chip coherent light sources for photonic integrated circuits, but integration inevitably places them in contact with other materials, thereby changing their properties upon hybridization. In this study, we examine the photonic and electronic coupling between single ZnO nanowire lasers and TMDs. Using deterministic nanomanipulation, we first hybridized the same nanowire first with a WS$_2$ monolayer and then with a MoS$_2$ monolayer. The respective lasing threshold rises, the emission is strongly quenched at high pump power densities, and the mode envelope blueshifts. Upon hybridization with bilayer, trilayer, and bulk MoS$_2$, lasing is fully suppressed. Finite-Difference Eigenmode simulations show that the TMD absorbs part of the evanescent field. Because this absorption is wavelength dependent, it also removes modes from the low-energy flank of the envelope, which accounts for small difference between the two monolayers, while the blueshift itself follows the increase of the carrier density at threshold. Density functional theory calculations that include the interface dipole predict a type-I alignment at the ideal ZnO(10$\bar{1}$0)/TMD interface, which turns into type~II for a moderately reduced dipole, as expected for hydroxylated facets in air. In both cases, holes are transferred from the nanowire into the TMD and removed from the gain medium. Evanescent absorption and hole transfer thus jointly suppress lasing, and both must be accounted for when integrating nanowire lasers with 2D materials.

</details>


### [443] [3D Printed Monolithic Optomechanical Chassis for an Unbalanced Field-Widened Interferometer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06898)
*Ramy Tannous,Dogan Sinar,Sagar Patel,Tabitha D. Arulpragasam,Issa Rishmawi,Mark Kirby,Vlad Paserin,Mihaela Vlasea,Thomas Jennewein*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 采用激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）增材制造，以低热膨胀Invar36合金一体化成型全单体光机底座（optomechanical chassis），内置光学安装座、柔性铰链与对准特征，实现小型化高尺寸稳定性的光学系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增材制造正被用于制造复杂光学硬件结构；传统减材制造难以实现复杂几何与高集成度，且环境温度变化下的尺寸稳定性对量子传感与精密光学仪器至关重要。

Method: 选用热稳定性好的低膨胀合金Invar36，通过激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）整体制备单体式光机底座；将光学安装座、柔性铰链（flexures）与对准特征直接嵌入底座几何中，并对比传统光机组件的footprint。

Result: 所制结构突破了常规减材制造的实用几何极限；单紧凑单元相比传统光机组件减小了占地体积（footprint），并具备在环境变化下的高尺寸稳定性。

Conclusion: 增材制造可实现轻量化、高度定制化的光学系统，为下一代量子传感器与光学仪器提供新路径。

Abstract: Additive manufacturing is increasingly being explored as an approach for producing complex structures for optical hardware. In this work, we present a fully monolithic optomechanical chassis fabricated using laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. The structure was fabricated from thermally stable Invar36, a low-thermal-expansion alloy that enables high dimensional stability under varying environmental conditions. Our monolithic design incorporates embedded optical mounts, flexures, and alignment features directly into the chassis geometry that exceed the practical limits of conventional subtractive manufacturing. By integrating the optomechanical support structure into a single compact unit, the system achieves a reduced footprint compared to traditional optomechanical assemblies. The results demonstrate the potential of additive manufacturing to produce lightweight, and highly customized optical systems, opening the possibility of new pathways for next-generation quantum sensors and optical instrumentation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [444] [HippocamPEX: A Hippocampus-Inspired In-Silico Architecture for Context-Aware Sequence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05415)
*Md Abdullah al Kaiser,Keiland W. Cooper,Rouhan Noor,Ankur Singh,Zhishun Yang,Hamed Poursiami,Bhuvanesh Sathish Kayarabettu,Ziyi Liang,Babak Shahbaba,Maryam Parsa,Norbert J. Fortin,Akhilesh Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出从神经科学中提炼海马计算模型，并用混合信号硬件（存内计算、神经形态、异步电路、模拟计算）实现HippocamPEX，仿真表明其可复现海马亚区表征动态并完成上下文相关的序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算架构针对大规模算术优化，难以处理上下文依赖的序列预测等"认知"任务；海马支持的情景记忆（情境编码、序列组织、预测性表征）是生物与常规计算之间的关键差距。

Method: 先从神经科学文献推导出工程友好的海马计算抽象模型；再融合存内计算、神经形态计算、异步电路与模拟计算的进展，设计混合信号硬件架构HippocamPEX；通过详细的活动与电路级仿真进行评估。

Result: HippocamPEX复现了海马各亚区特征性的表征动态，并能通过上下文特异的序列预测任务，表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将硬件设计与神经科学知识紧耦合，为具备快速、自适应、上下文感知决策能力的人工系统提供路径，弥合生物计算与常规计算之间的差距。

Abstract: The brain's hippocampus enables episodic memory - the ability to encode events within their context, organize them into sequences, and generate predictive representations to guide adaptive behavior. Modern computing architectures, however, are optimized for large-scale arithmetic and struggle with such context-dependent sequential prediction or "cognitive" tasks. To translate these capabilities into a mixed-signal architecture, we first derived a working model from the neuroscience literature distilling key hippocampal computations into engineering-friendly abstractions. We then leveraged converging advances in in-memory computing, neuromorphic computing, asynchronous circuits, and analog computing to design a mixed-signal hardware architecture implementing these computations, called HippocamPEX. Finally, we demonstrated that HippocamPEX reproduces characteristic representational dynamics of hippocampal subregions and performs robust context-specific sequence prediction through detailed activity and circuit simulations. By tightly coupling hardware design with neuroscience knowledge, this work establishes a pathway for artificial systems capable of rapid, adaptive, and context-aware decision-making, addressing a central gap between biological and conventional computing.

</details>


### [445] [Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05419)
*Dezhou Shen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 通过turing-unlock内核模块解除驱动层对TU102 FP16矩阵乘的限速，在固定预训练协议下得到随模型规模单调增长的吞吐增益：small档+11.8%、tiny档+4.7%、pico–micro档≤+0.3%，而显存峰值逐位一致、质量指标不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTX 2080 Ti（TU102）硬件上具备完整的第二代Tensor Core，但厂商在驱动层对FP16矩阵乘做节流，使可用的张量吞吐远低于硬件峰值。作者希望量化"解除该限制"在真实端到端预训练中究竟能转化为多少实际收益，以及该收益与模型规模的关系。

Method: 使用内核模块在nvidia驱动绑定设备之前写入FP16速度选择器（SS0=0x88888888、SS1=0x8）并释放ACR互斥锁。在同一块22G 2080 Ti上，沿用配套"内存账本"的从零预训练协议：五档中文编码器-解码器模型，每档2,451步、每步16,384 tokens、随机种子42。small档为75.7M参数、512维宽、8+8层、开启激活检查点。进行前后对照的吞吐核算。

Result: cuBLAS FP16 matmul峰值吞吐由55.7升至91.4 TFLOPS（约1.6×）。端到端：small档稳态吞吐6,480→7,246 tok/s（+11.8%），墙钟1.77h→1.61h（省9.0%）；tiny档15,150→15,866 tok/s（+4.7%），墙钟省3.8%；pico–micro三档增益最多+0.3%。各档峰值显存逐位相同，最终质量指标逐位相同或在10^-3内一致。

Conclusion: 解锁收益是矩阵规模的函数，随模型档位单调上升：pico–micro档不可察觉，自tiny档起可见，到small档兑现为两位数百分比。该收益为纯吞吐收益，不改变训练动力学（显存占用与收敛质量均不变）。

Abstract: The RTX 2080 Ti (TU102) ships full second-generation Tensor Cores in hardware, yet the vendor throttles FP16 matrix multiplication at the driver level, leaving usable tensor throughput well below the hardware peak. turing-unlock lifts this restriction with a kernel module that, before the nvidia driver binds the device, writes the FP16 speed selectors (SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8) and releases the ACR mutex; published measurements report cuBLAS FP16 matmul throughput rising from 55.7 to 91.4 TFLOPS (about 1.6x). On the same 22G 2080 Ti and under the same from-scratch pre-training protocol as the companion memory ledger (five tiers of Chinese encoder-decoder models, 2,451 steps per tier, 16,384 tokens per step, seed 42), we obtain a before/after throughput account: the small tier (75.7M parameters, 512-wide, 8+8 layers, activation checkpointing on) improves in steady-state throughput from 6,480 to 7,246 tok/s (+11.8%) with wall time cut from 1.77h to 1.61h (9.0% saved); the tiny tier goes from 15,150 to 15,866 tok/s (+4.7%) with wall time savings of 3.8%; the three smaller tiers (pico-micro) gain at most +0.3%; per-tier peak memory stays bit-identical, and final quality metrics are bit-identical or consistent within 10^-3. We conclude that the unlock gain is a function of matrix size, rising monotonically with tier -- imperceptible for pico-micro, visible from tiny upward, and cashed out as a double-digit percentage at small -- and that it is a pure throughput gain that leaves training dynamics untouched.

</details>


### [446] [Scheduling Data to Compute: Hierarchical Data Pipelining for LLM Training on AMD GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05751)
*Gengyu Rao,Ghadeer Ahmed H Alabandi,Su Ann Chong,Thomas Huber,Kailash Gogineni,Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury,Saleel Kudchadker,Suchita Pati,Zirui Zhang,Zhen Huang,Yanyuan Qin,Xiaoming Peng,Lihuan Zhang,Botao Hu,Wei Huang,Yang Bo,Wen Xie,Xiangyu Zhao,Ruibin Zhang,Xiaobo Chen,Vidushi Goyal,Anshu Raina,Claire Songhyun Lee,Jiakun Yan,Yao Fu,Nusrat Islam,Ravi Dwivedula,Jie Zhang,Maria Garzaran,Zhenyu Gu,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文将GPU数据搬运（等待）时间视为LLM训练的主要瓶颈，提出利用TDM、转置加载指令、SDMA/RDMA三类数据移动硬件特性构建数据流水线，在AMD GPU上实现平均1.19x–1.88x加速，并开源集成到Primus/Primus-Turbo。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM规模指数增长使训练算力需求巨大，而GPU计算单元常因数据仍在慢速内存或另一块GPU上而空转，规模化下利用率的小幅下降即带来显著成本；作者因此把这类"数据等待时间"而非算力本身作为首要瓶颈。

Method: 围绕为显式数据移动设计的硬件特性进行内核与框架协同编排：用Tensor Data Mover (TDM)将张量数据从HBM搬入片上存储；用transpose-load指令在加载过程中将数据重排为LLM计算所需布局；用System DMA (SDMA)和Remote DMA (RDMA)分别通过scale-up与scale-out网络在GPU间传输数据，从而为计算单元维持稳定的数据流水线。

Result: 内核层面TDM和transpose-load平均分别取得1.88x和1.19x加速；在计算与通信重叠场景下，SDMA和RDMA平均分别带来1.16x和1.33x加速。

Conclusion: 这是首个利用AMD GPU全部数据流水线特性的LLM训练系统，实现已集成进AMD GPU的开源框架与库Primus-Turbo与Primus。

Abstract: Large language models (LLM) have been the key focus of recent machine learning breakthroughs. As the model size grows exponentially, the computation needed for training is astronomical. A GPU can do a huge amount of arithmetic. However, the data its compute units need is not always available when they are ready. This data may still be in slow memory or on another GPU. While the chip waits, expensive compute sits idle, and at scale even a small drop in utilization translates into substantial cost. In this paper, we treat this waiting time as the primary bottleneck. We focus on hardware features designed for explicit data movement. These features load data from off-chip memory onto the chip, rearrange it into the layout the computation requires as it is loaded, and transfer it between GPUs. By orchestrating them, we keep a steady pipeline of data flowing to the compute units so that they remain busy.
  We present kernel and framework implementations that address this bottleneck using three key data-movement instructions and hardware features. The Tensor Data Mover (TDM) moves tensor data from high-bandwidth memory (HBM) into on-chip memory. Transpose-load instructions transpose tensor data into the layout that LLM computations require as it is loaded on-chip. Finally, System DMA (SDMA) and Remote DMA (RDMA) move data between GPUs over the scale-up and scale-out networks, respectively. Our results show that TDM and transpose-load provide on average 1.88x and 1.19x speedup at the kernel level, respectively. The SDMA and RDMA lead to on average 1.16x and 1.33x speedup for computation overlapped with communication. This is the first AMD LLM training system to utilize all the GPU data pipelining features. Our implementation has been integrated into open source framework and library for AMD GPUs. https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus-Turbo https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus

</details>


### [447] [Phantom: Temporal Caching for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06019)
*Yuzhe Fu,Cong Guo,Zishan Shao,Bowen Duan,Chiyue Wei,Haoxuan Shan,Ting Jiang,Hancheng Ye,Jonathan Ku,Changchun Zhou,Hai "Helen" Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Phantom 是一种基于时间缓存的算法-架构协同设计扩散模型加速器，将相邻时间步的相似性视为差分稀疏性，仅重算离群 token，在标准脉动阵列上实现平均 4.0x 加速与 5.5x 能耗节省，且保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型迭代推理需数十个时间步，计算开销巨大。已有加速器利用时间相似性（差分量化、输出稀疏），但带来内存占用增加、设计复杂和图像质量退化问题。

Method: 将时间相似性重新表述为"差分稀疏性"：相邻时间步间仅少数离群 token 显著变化。Phantom 仅重算离群 token，其余从时间缓存复用。硬件在标准脉动阵列上做轻量扩展：全局缓冲区中的 Phantom Engine 在激活流经时检测离群点并更新缓存；condensed pipeline 将稀疏更新映射为稠密脉动计算，覆盖 FC、卷积与注意力层。

Result: 在现代扩散模型上评估，相比 GPU 和已有加速器平均实现 4.0x 加速与 5.5x 能耗节省，同时保持生成质量。

Conclusion: 以时间缓存为核心的差分稀疏复用是实现扩散模型高效推理的有效路径，兼顾能效与图像保真度，并可通过轻量硬件扩展在通用脉动阵列上落地。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become the dominant paradigm for high-quality image generation, but their iterative inference across tens of timesteps incurs substantial computational overhead. Prior accelerators exploit temporal similarity in diffusion models via differential quantization or output sparsity, yet suffer from increased memory footprint, design complexity, and image degradation. In this work, we present Phantom, an algorithm-architecture co-designed accelerator built on temporal caching. We view temporal similarity as differential sparsity: between adjacent timesteps, only a small fraction of tokens (outliers) change significantly. Phantom recomputes only these outlier tokens and reuses the rest from a temporal cache. Phantom runs on standard systolic arrays with lightweight additions: a Phantom Engine at the global buffer that detects outliers and updates the cache as activations stream through, and a condensed pipeline that maps the resulting sparse updates onto dense systolic computation for FC, convolution, and attention layers. Evaluations on modern diffusion models show that Phantom achieves an average 4.0x speedup and 5.5x energy saving over GPUs and prior accelerators while preserving generation quality.

</details>


### [448] [Hardwired Distributed Processing Units for Inference: Neural Decisions at the Sensor that Free the Host](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06436)
*Raj Mali*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU），在传感器端以80×60像素流水线+四层二值化CNN（93,408个1-bit权重）完成斑马线检测决策，固定2,269,477周期/帧（34.04 ms）内于Artix-7 FPGA实现，仅占1,814 LUT，无需处理器、操作系统或全分辨率帧缓存，与位精确软件模型在639张测试图上结果完全一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往HDPU仅承担预处理（边缘、角点、转向），推理仍留在主机；作者希望证明"决策本身"也能迁移到传感器端，从而彻底免除主机的推理负担并大幅压缩数据传输量。

Method: 在低成本Artix-7 FPGA上构建全硬连线检测通路：80×60像素流水线前端（含硬件对比度增强级）接入四层二值化CNN；从Python模型、RTL仿真到板级实现逐位精确验证；以固定时钟周期数实现确定性时延，不使用处理器、OS与全分辨率帧存储。

Result: 每帧固定2,269,477周期（34.04 ms，随FPGA时钟而定），低于37.49 ms帧周期；639张测试图板级输出与位精确软件模型完全一致；整条检测通路占1,814 LUT；"有把握"回答在街景照片上准确率95.7%；硬件对比度级将行车记录仪类图像准确率由47.7%提升至78.2%；每帧为宿主节省8.13 ms核心时间（全精度ResNet-18即使16线程也超一帧周期）；每帧传输由614,400字节降至16字节，减少38,400倍。

Conclusion: HDPU证明神经决策可在传感器端以极低资源、确定性时延和位精确可验证性完成，兼具低带宽、低功耗与免主机推理优势，将硬连线感知单元的能力从预处理推进到决策层面。

Abstract: We show that a hardwired distributed processing unit (HDPU) can take a neural decision at the sensor and so remove the inference from the host. Built for zebra-crossing detection on a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA, the unit decides on every camera frame in a fixed 2,269,477 clock cycles (34.04 ms depends upon Fpga clk ), inside the 37.49-ms frame period, and on the board it returns the same scores and decisions as its bit-exact software model on all 639 test images. The whole detection path, from camera pixels to decision, takes 1,814 LUTs, with no processor, no operating system and no full-resolution frame store. When the unit answers instead of reporting "not sure", 95.7% of its answers on street photographs are correct, and a hardware contrast stage lifts accuracy on camera-like dashcam frames from 47.7% to 78.2%. The host is spared all of the inference: 8.13 ms of a core in every frame period, where a full-precision ResNet-18 would need more than a frame period even on 16 threads. It also receives 16 bytes per frame instead of 614,400, 38,400 times less. The unit is an 80x60-pixel pipeline feeding a four-layer binarized CNN with 93,408 one-bit weights, verified bit-exactly from a Python model through RTL simulation to the board. Earlier HDPUs did pre-processing (edges, corners, steering); this one shows that the decision itself can move to the sensor.

</details>


### [449] [Data Center Agglomeration and Power Infrastructure Capacity in the United States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06737)
*Yutong Ma*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本研究基于2010–2024年美国县级面板数据，结合数据中心建筑足迹与新增电厂个体数据，采用双重机器学习（DML）识别数据中心扩张对本地发电能力的因果效应，发现显著正向效应（ATE=1.982），并揭示显著的区域异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心等数字基础设施快速扩张，对现有电网造成前所未有的、地理高度集中的压力；但关于这些设施如何重塑本地电力基础设施供给的严格因果证据仍然有限。

Method: 构建2010–2024年美国县级面板数据集，整合数据中心个体建筑足迹与新增电厂数据；采用五折交叉拟合的双重机器学习（DML），控制县与年份固定效应及区域社会经济协变量以缓解内生性与高维混淆；辅以1%–99%缩尾处理、滞后一期处理变量、州级固定效应替代设定、事件研究（含历史集聚控制）与安慰剂检验。

Result: 基准估计识别出显著且稳健的正向因果效应：数据中心建筑面积增长显著提升附近发电装机容量（ATE=1.982，P=0.000，CI:[1.25,2.72]）；缩尾后结果依然成立；滞后处理与州级固定效应设定下仍显著；事件研究显示平行趋势成立，并在t=3出现因果峰值，与公用事业级电网建设周期一致；安慰剂检验排除随机性。区域异质性明显：西部呈强正向效应，东北资源受限县出现显著负向（挤出/替代）效应。

Conclusion: 数据中心扩张对本地发电能力具有可识别的因果影响且存在明显区域差异，提示城市规划者与能源监管者应进行前瞻性电网容量投资，以支撑持续的数字化转型。

Abstract: The continuous expansion of digital infrastructure, especially data centers, has imposed unprecedented, geographically concentrated stress on existing power grids. However, rigorous causal evidence quantifying how these facilities reshape local power-infrastructure supply remains limited. This study builds a comprehensive county-level US panel dataset spanning 2010-2024, uniquely integrating individual data center building footprints and power-plant additions. To mitigate endogeneity and high-dimensional confounding, this study deploys Double Machine Learning with five-fold cross-fitting, conditioning on county and year fixed effects alongside regional socioeconomic covariates. Baseline estimation identifies a significant positive causal effect robust across multiple rigorous specifications. The result holds following 1%-99% winsorization that downweights mega-clusters including Loudoun County: growth in data-center floor area drives meaningful increases in nearby power-generation capacity (ATE=1.982, P=0.000, CI: [1.25, 2.72]). Outcomes remain statistically significant using a one-year lagged treatment to address reverse causality, and are stable under state-level fixed-effect alternatives. An event-study framework augmented with historical agglomeration controls validates clear parallel trends and detects a sharp causal spike at t = 3, matching typical utility-scale grid-construction lead times. A placebo test further verifies these causal estimates cannot emerge from random chance. Substantial regional heterogeneity emerges: strong positive impacts concentrate in the West, while significant negative displacement-related effects appear within resource-constrained Northeastern counties. These results deliver timely insights for urban planners and energy regulators, stressing the importance of forward-looking grid-capacity investment to support ongoing digital transformation.

</details>


### [450] [Energy Efficient Near-Threshold Voltage Massive MIMO Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06772)
*MD Salman Sakib,Mehdi Safarpour,Pejman Ghasemzadeh,Shahriar Shahabuddin*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该工作为大规模MIMO检测算法集成低开销的基于算法的容错（ABFT）校验机制，结合SPICE晶体管级仿真与故障注入协同仿真，实现近阈值电压下的可靠运行；估计节能显著，算法开销低于2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近阈值计算（NTC）可为数字电路带来最高约10倍节能，但PVT变异使低压数字处理器更易出现时序错误；传统基于硬件的时序错误检测（TED）开销过大，需要在算法层面以低开销方式获得可靠性。

Method: 将校验和型ABFT无缝嵌入传统大规模MIMO检测算法；构建晶体管级SPICE仿真与负载感知故障注入相结合的协同仿真框架，用Level-1 Shichman-Hodges CMOS模型和蒙特卡洛参数变异（不绑定具体工艺节点）进行电路级表征，并以电路导出的故障模型评估Gauss-Seidel、ADMIN（ADMM无穷范数检测）和共轭梯度（CG）检测器。

Result: 算法表现出显著的韧性：在首次失效点（PoFF）附近，虽有部分计算错误未被检出，但BER仅上升0.7%–1.4%；超出PoFF后，ABFT几乎报告了全部错误情形。校验和ABFT可检测大多数算术与存储错误，64×16 MIMO系统估计开销低于2%，更大规模配置下开销进一步下降。

Conclusion: 算法级容错可使常规大规模MIMO算法在近阈值电压下可靠工作，以远低于硬件TED的开销获得可接受误码性能；但所报节能为基于通用CMOS模型的解析估计，并不对应特定工艺节点，需在具体工艺下进一步验证。

Abstract: Near-Threshold Computing (NTC) offers a substan- tial energy savings, i.e., up to 10x, for digital circuits. However, due to Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) variations, low voltage operating digital processors face increased susceptibility to timing errors. This work equips conventional massive MIMO algorithms with computational error detection mechanisms, en- abling reliable operation down to near-threshold voltages. While conventional hardware based Timing Error Detection (TED) systems introduce substantial overhead, this work modifies MIMO algorithms to seamlessly integrate low overhead Algorithm Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT). A co-simulation framework combining transistor level SPICE simulations and workload aware fault injection is developed to investigate reliability, Bit Error Rate (BER), energy savings, and overheads of modified algorithms operating at low voltages. The transistor-level characterization was performed in PSpice using generic Level-1 Shichman-Hodges CMOS transistor models with Monte Carlo parameter variations. No specific CMOS fabrication process node was assumed. Conse- quently, the reported energy savings are analytical estimates and are not specific to a particular CMOS fabrication technology. We evaluate Gauss Seidel (GS), ADMM based infinity norm detection (ADMIN), and Conjugate Gradient (CG) detectors using circuit derived fault models. Results demonstrate remarkable algorith- mic resilience. Although undetected computational errors in some trials near the Point of First Failure (PoFF) were observed, BER increases by only 0.7% to 1.4%, while beyond PoFF, ABFT reported nearly all erroneous cases. The proposed checksum based ABFT detects most arithmetic and memory errors, with an estimated overhead below 2% for a 64 x 16 MIMO system, decreasing further for larger configurations.

</details>


### [451] [Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06829)
*David Rostcheck*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一套从PyTorch到AWS EC2 F2 FPGA的Vitis HLS→HDK→AFI完整工具链，并以四层级验证方法与TinyBERT地址NER任务验证其可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AWS FPGA（F2实例）已商用八年，但学术文献中缺少从高层语言到HDK/AFI的端到端桥接流程与工程决策的公开记录，阻碍研究者与自动化编码代理开展FPGA设计。

Method: 构建完整Vitis HLS→HDK→AFI的工具链，使编码代理能依据用户指令实现、测试和调试FPGA设计；提出四级验证方法（FP32 PyTorch、位精确量化Python、HLS C仿真、物理FPGA）逐层定位误差（含FPGA特有电路错误）；并记录部署流程、时序收敛策略与关键HLS工程取舍。

Result: 在TinyBERT（微调于地址命名实体识别）上完成验证，于FPGA硬件实现嵌入层及四个编码器层中的第一层；因权重需从主机DRAM流式读取，性能劣于CPU/GPU实现。

Conclusion: 工具链与四级方法可有效支撑FPGA设计开发与错误定位，但当前“权重流式加载”架构导致性能不佳；作者讨论了后续优化方向（前向路径改进）。

Abstract: We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch, bit-accurate quantized Python, HLS C-simulation, physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Our implementation streams weights from host DRAM, yielding poor performance compared to CPU/GPU implementations; we discuss forward paths.

</details>
